No present-tense break and no `\textbf{` tag; the white room, the page over the speakers and the hands that stayed in the field go on gathering interest from Chapter 113, unspent. No new scar, possession, knowledge usable in the world, rank or power. }Ch 117 (bonds).\textbf{ Through Ilmen 8, 9 and 10 nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and the year’s first Account-day was earned by its own morning and not brought into the two tending days before it. Each morning the surgeon took the body in its old order — the leathery crust gone harder in the dry nights two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, the fold in the empty place found where put, the thread stiff in the dry heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — knowing a face composed by cold is not composure, that a cold patient cannot clot and must be rewarmed slowly from the outside, never hurried, never rubbed, and that pink returning is the surface still lying over a cold core. The infant wanted the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle; both true, the second louder, neither winning. With Sella the hearth grammar held at both ends of all three days — fire before basket, coals told it was the thaw, intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger above the unread charcoal, lips on a two-gapped row, the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure or handful, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand, widow’s mark untouched, seven walked-around places once and not twice — and on Ilmen 10 she set the basket in the moot-post’s finger’s width of shade where no slate lay, stood half a pace off through Berr’s reading and the bell, and carried him home at the going of the light saying nothing. With Tarn the sixth piece stood where the house could check and the seventh at the lip, the hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, *Six counted. The next I don’t count*, the term ended and the loan uncalled. With Jorra the dusty forearms were parted from clean as clot from vessel, the wheel and a pot spoken to before any person, the full note known three turns ahead and withheld, and the bent finger put into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence without a second holding of Ash 26. }On Ilmen 10 the district’s arithmetic began again and cannot be undone (T015/T041/T047 advanced, not paid):\textbf{ Berr Clay read *One in twelve, as the notice says* twice over the basket, called the levy and denied it with *your house*, never *I*, taking himself out of his own sentence as a surgeon draws a hand from a field before the dressing goes on, said something low to the block about kindness being entered and went off up the road with the box locked, believing he had done a kindness. The boy filed it as the first of a fresh count and not a thirteenth: one reading is one and not an account, a reset is not a signing, no signature stands on the space, the figure read is still not the figure paid and no doctrine comes out of one. He did not lay his twelve old findings across the new figure to make a row come out even, for paper is not a payer, and put Berr’s low saying on a place of its own with a finger between it and both the twelve findings and the new figure. Hessa went up the road before noon with the writing to her sleeve, answering the question put and not the one behind it, and was not made a reader; Ilva’s count stayed in wood; the clerk at the landing and the man from Slate Row stayed on their trays. No payer, witness, reader, tenth hand, seventh hearing, eighth opening or ending stood. No new scar, possession, rank or power; no change of voice. }Ch 116 (bonds).\textbf{ Through Ilmen 5, 6 and 7 — three ordinary tending days in the new year’s first working week — nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and the working week was not made a threshold, a signing or a doctrine. Each morning the surgeon took the body in its old order — one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, the fold in the empty place found where put and still a finding, the thread of drool frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped because nobody had ever been given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here would perform — knowing a face composed by cold is not composure, that a cold patient cannot clot and must be rewarmed slowly from the outside, never hurried, never rubbed, and that pink returning is the surface still lying over a cold core; the infant wanted the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle, both true, the second louder, neither winning. With Sella the hearth grammar held at both ends of every day — fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot, intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger above the unread charcoal, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing, the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure or handful, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, widow’s mark untouched, seven walked-around places once and not twice — and she carried him down and up the nineteen steps at the half-pace and set him under the roof, never in the Debt Loft, adding no second fold. With Tarn at the kindling the sixth piece stood where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, *Six counted. The next I don’t count*, the loan uncalled at the very end of a term already ended, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the ear-sentence stopped at the word that would call it, the degree of Ilmen 3 held as a shape and not repeated as a habit or a rule. With Jorra the wheel-shed kept its silence, the men unnamed went low into the back room before first grey, the meal-fine grey dust came white in a fist-crease, forearms were parted from clean as clot from vessel, the full note was known three turns ahead and withheld, and the bent finger stood in the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence without leaving the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time. }The chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T080/T090, T062/T035/T031, T036/T076/T006):** on Ilmen 6, before first grey, three or more men unnamed went low into the room off the wheel-shed and Jorra came through the finger’s-width door with the day’s grey dust white in a fist-crease; then from the basket’s low angle a man from Slate Row whose name was on no roll stood at the yard’s edge with his hands loose, the soft hands of a man who sits at a table and the patient face of a man who can wait in a doorway. Nobody asked him what he wanted and he did not say; no loaf passed, no slate was shown, no word carried, no figure was read and no threshold was crossed. The boy filed the face on a place of its own beside the older record-first hands, made no tenth of it, made no witness of the men, never called the waiting a sale and gave the man no name or interior, keeping the face, Jorra’s promise and Tarn’s degree on three places with a finger between every pair and not laying them together to make a cause, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood. The count went 398 to 401 exact, six months and two hundred and eighteen to two hundred and twenty-one days told by nobody, answers 373 through 378 filed on the sixth place, six honest answers and not one a doctrine, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid and Garl’s name unspoken the same three days. No new scar, possession, rank or power, no change of voice.

\textbf{Ch 115 (bonds).} Three ordinary tending days after the turn — Ilmen 2, 3 and 4 — lived each under its own dated `\textbackslash{}daymark` in two full scenes, nothing crossing from one day to the next as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, no tend-day set against a holy day and Ilmen 10 unbrought. Each morning the surgeon took the body in its old order — crust two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, the fold found where put in the empty place, the thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and wrist, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform — knowing a face composed by cold is not composure, that a cold patient cannot clot and must be rewarmed slowly from outside, never hurried, never rubbed, and that pink returning is the surface still lying over a cold core; the infant wanted the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle, both true, the second louder, neither winning. With Sella the grammar held at both ends of all three days — fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot’s back, intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger above the unread charcoal, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the cold clay jar with the hand half over nothing, the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure or handful, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, widow’s mark untouched, seven walked-around places once and not twice — and she carried him down and up the nineteen steps at the half-pace and set him under the roof, never in the Debt Loft, adding no second fold. With Tarn at the kindling the sixth piece stood where the house could check and the seventh at the lip, knife at the edge of its sill, hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held, \emph{Six counted. The next I don’t count}, the term ended and the loan uncalled; on Ilmen 3 his head went a degree toward the landing where a soft-cuffed clerk was reported set with his slate turned inward for an uncalled measure, and came back to the broom without a word — the first movement joining an ended term and a valuable ear to the people who would measure it, filed on its own place and not made a rule, a hearing, a seventh or a calling of the loan (T036/T076/T006 and T090/T080 advanced, not paid). With Jorra the bent finger went into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence and out without a second holding of Ash 26, meal-fine grey dust white in a fist-crease, \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn. The boy filed the reported clerk’s hand on a place of its own, nine hands staying nine with no tenth, the clean-voice speaker taken out of his own sentences because a clean voice is not a hand; nine stoppings, six hearings with the seventh place empty and the Drawing’s knock outside, the heard bell beside the told with both gaps in their squares, four rooms held apart, twelve arithmetics behind one unsigned figure, and the glaze-green filed as a colour and the foundling as a shape with no eighth of either. Answers 367 and 368 on Ilmen 2, 369 and 370 on Ilmen 3, 371 and 372 on Ilmen 4, each exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer. No present-tense break, no tagged memory, no rank, no power, no new scar or possession and no change of voice.

\textbf{Ch 114 (bonds).} Across the Remembering, the Last Day and Ilmen 1 nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer: the five holy days ended with the Last Day and the year turned on Ilmen 1 with nothing signed, twelve arithmetics of Y.H. 813 carried unchanged behind one unsigned figure and Ilmen 10’s first reading unbrought. Each morning the surgeon took the body in its old order — one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, the empty place beside it holding the fold put there on the fifteenth and found where put, the thread of drool frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — knowing that a face composed by cold is not composure, that a cold patient cannot clot and must be rewarmed slowly from the outside, never hurried, never rubbed, and that pink returning is the surface still lying over a cold core. The infant wanted the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle; both true, the second louder, neither winning. With Sella the old grammar held at both ends of all three days — fire before basket, coals told the thaw, the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain covered and unfigured, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, charcoal unread, widow’s mark untouched, the seven walked-around places once and not twice — and on the Remembering she carried him to House Silt on an errand, set the basket just inside the finger’s-width door away from every open slate and took what she came for without opening the pewter tin above the empty bed, naming the woman or speaking the number. The keeping at the fold was found where put on the mornings and goings of the light of all three days and stayed a finding, not a placing, not a habit, way, sign, gift, payment or rule. With Tarn the equality held at six counted and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged sentence, the hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, \emph{Six counted. The next I don’t count}, the term already ended and the loan uncalled; with Jorra the bent finger went into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence and came out without the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time, \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn. The boy refused to let Tarn’s stopped sentence, Jorra’s ungiven promise and the yard’s called-gone grey stand up together and call themselves a rule, for a rule is an account that has found a payer and none stood. Answers 361 through 366 were filed exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, restraints and not payments borrowing no house count and supplying no payer; the surgeon’s small satisfaction in a field taken as found and left as found cost nothing, which is how he knew it was not peace. No present-tense break and no tagged memory; the white room, the page over the speakers and the hands in the field go on gathering interest. No new scar, possession, rank or power and no change of voice.

\textbf{Ch 113 (bonds).} Through Kindling, Weighing and the Long Night nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer: the three holy days kept their names, had no tend-days and no market, and the year was not said to turn on any of them. Each morning the surgeon took the body in its old order — the stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, the empty place holding the fold put there on the fifteenth and found where put, the thread of drool frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and knew that a basket set level out of the draught where the heat came sideways is the rewarming he would choose and cannot ask for, that a face composed by cold is not composure and that a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed slowly from outside, never hurried, never rubbed. The infant wanted the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle; both true, the second louder, neither winning. With Sella the old grammar held at both ends of all three days — fire before basket, \emph{The house will keep it}, instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire and never to the basket, the half-pace from every open slate, the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, the dressed grain turned under wool with no figure and no handful, the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, the charcoal unread, the widow’s mark untouched, the seven walked-around places gone around once and not twice — and on the Long Night she banked the coals early, told them it was the thaw and lit no fire after dusk; at each going of the light she put the fold right at his ear and under his chin without a look at his face and added no second fold. \textbf{The chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T080/T090):} on Kindling a collector took the year’s first measure with an ordinary writing hand and no pause in it, hand to slate before eyes to bed and one flat sentence to the slate (\emph{The measure is banked. The account stands. The return is recorded.}); the boy filed that reaching on a tray of its own — not Marra, not the Court-table clerk, not the Fishstairs clerk, not the Drawing collector, not a tenth hand — and planted, unspoken, the reason that will one day be remembered against the taker, that he keeps the world alive by taking what is already going. On Weighing a clean voice announced a whole return for somebody absent, took the speaker out of his own sentences and left a name the household would not repeat; on the Long Night a neighbour’s story left a name standing empty. Both silences went on the gap tray beside the told bell’s gap with no reader, witness, payer or doctrine standing up. \textbf{The first present-tense break in eighty-eight chapters} came on the Long Night on the clean voice’s form alone — a page over the speakers, a white room that does not look up, hands staying in the field — untagged, for one or two sentences, paying nothing; the grammar fell straight back into the past and the unsent call to Nina was not paid again (T020 held). Tarn’s seventh year ended with the loan uncalled and the Seed 16 breath unspent; Jorra’s promise stayed neither given nor withdrawn; Ilva’s strip, Hessa’s unread slate and Berr’s locked box stood where last seen. The count reached 392 exact with 360 honest answers on the sixth place, each exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment; the carried fire’s fifth stayed unpaid and Garl’s name unspoken 390, 391 and 392 days.

\textbf{Ch 112 (bonds).} Through Stone 28, 29 and 30 nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer: the year’s last three days were lived without a boundary drawn and neither of the district’s two habits of naming its months was set right or left. Each morning the surgeon took the body in its old order — the stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, the empty place beside it holding the fold put there on the fifteenth and found where put, the thread frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and knew that a basket set level out of the draught where the heat came sideways is the rewarming he would choose and cannot ask for; a face composed by cold is not composure, a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed slowly from outside, never rubbed. The infant wanted the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle; both true, the second louder, neither winning. With Sella the old grammar held at both ends of all three days — fire before basket, \emph{The house will keep it}, instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire and never to the basket, the half-pace from every open slate, the twice-mended pot lifted thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, the dressed grain turned under wool with no figure and no handful, the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, the charcoal unread, the widow’s mark untouched, the seven walked-around places gone around once and not twice — and at each going of the light she put the fold right at his ear and under his chin without a look at his face and added no second fold. \textbf{The chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T015/T041/T047):} on Stone 30 the twelfth arithmetic went up behind one unsigned figure — the three of Frost, the first, second and third of Bone, the first, second and third of Ash, and Stone’s first, second and last — and twelve are twelve and not one account, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space and no doctrine out of twelve; twelve true subtractions ride locked in Berr’s box up the road with the key gone up in a coat pocket that never comes back down and the boy having no key. He kept the finding on a place of its own and did not lay it across the keeping at the fold, the four rooms’ gap, the four directions or any of his own gaps. With Tarn six held in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip, the hand up over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, the ear-sentence stopping at the calling word with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and the loan uncalled; with Jorra the meal-fine grey dust, the forearms parted as clot from vessel, the damper’s two bites and the promise neither given nor withdrawn; with Ilva her ninth at the well on Stone 29 with the strip unread; with Hessa the slate carried unread up the road on Stone 30; with Garl the objects and his name unspoken 387, 388 and 389 days. The hand answered six times, \textbf{349} and \textbf{350} on Stone 28, \textbf{351} and \textbf{352} on Stone 29, \textbf{353} and \textbf{354} on Stone 30, each exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer. The year went out without a boundary drawn and the Five stood beyond, unbrought; no new scar, possession, rank or power and no change of voice.

\textbf{Ch 111 (bonds).} Through Stone 25, 26 and 27 nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer; the eleven readings, the keeping and the fourth direction stood behind the household and bought no teaching here. Each morning the surgeon took the body in its old order — the stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, the empty place beside it, the thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and knew that a basket set level out of the draught is the rewarming he would choose and cannot ask for, that a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from the outside and slowly, never hurried, never rubbed; the infant wanted the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle, both true, the second louder, neither winning. With Sella the old grammar held at both ends of all three days — fire before basket, \emph{The house will keep it}, the half-pace from every open slate, the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, the dressed grain turned under wool and given no figure or handful, the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, the charcoal unread, the widow’s mark untouched, the seven walked-around places gone around once and not twice — and at each going of the light she put the fold right at his ear and under his chin without a look at his face and added no second fold. \textbf{The keeping passed from nine findings to a tenth on Stone 25, an eleventh on Stone 26 and a twelfth on Stone 27}, each found folded once in the crust’s empty place where a hand put it on the fifteenth, changed by nobody; twelve findings from a hand that only read add no twelfth placing, and a habit wants a hand that placed twice and a way a third, both wanting a payer where none stands. He filed each beside the crust’s gap, the shelf’s two gaps, the gone pan’s round ring and the field’s empty place, with a finger between every pair, and filed the small alarm at a double-digit count on a place of its own. With Tarn the six and the seventh held on all three afternoons, the hand up and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, the loan uncalled at the very end of the seventh year; with Jorra the damper’s two bites held and the promise under the wheel-shed neither given nor withdrawn; Ilva kept her ninth at the well on Stone 26 with the strip unread; Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken 384, 385 and 386 days. Twelve findings were twelve findings, eleven arithmetics eleven and four directions four and not a witness; nothing was opened, joined by a standing hand, named, called, paid or ended, no rank or power changed and no new scar or possession.

\textbf{Ch 110 (bonds).} Through Stone 22, 23 and 24 nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer; the eleven readings and the fourth direction stood behind the household and bought no teaching here. With Sella the old grammar held at both ends of every day — fire before basket, \emph{The house will keep it}, instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire and never to the basket, the half-pace from every open slate, the seven walked-around places with the returning-line place widest and once and not twice, the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing, the grain covered and unfigured, the charcoal unread, the widow’s mark untouched, the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed — and at each going of the light she put the fold right at his ear and under his chin without a look at his face and \textbf{added no second fold to the empty place}. \textbf{The keeping was found a seventh, eighth and ninth time and NOT paid (T097/T060/T086):} nine findings from a hand that only read add no ninth placing; finding is not placing, a habit wants a hand that placed twice and a way wants a third, and both want a payer where none stands. With Tarn the equality held at six counted and the seventh at the lip, the hand up and away with no breath held at the top of the reach on all three afternoons, the loan uncalled at the very end of the seventh year, the fear of being entered again for vagrancy still his; with Jorra the bent finger went into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence and came out without a second holding of Ash 26, \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn. Ilva kept her ninth at the well on Stone 22 with the strip unread and no tenth; Hessa went up the clay road before noon on Stone 23 with the writing turned to her sleeve and was not made a reader; Berr’s eleven true subtractions stayed locked in his box up the road. \textbf{The chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T035/T031/T065/T095 and T101):} on Stone 23 an ownerless voice over the boards from the direction of Slate Row gave the shut room and the burned slate a fourth direction — the cold and the count going out through the same gap, with no room named, no hand at any flame, no figure, no date, no person standing — and he filed it on a place of its own beside the three older ones with a finger between every pair, not a sixth telling, not a witness, not a rule, gathering interest toward a far-off hand that is not his and has not come. No bond paid, sold, named or spoken, no new scar or possession, no change of voice.

\textbf{Ch 109 (bonds).} Through Stone 19, 20 and 21 nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer; the eleventh arithmetic stood behind the household and bought no teaching here, and the keeping at the fold was not joined to the reading. With Sella the old grammar held at both ends of every day — fire before basket, \emph{The house will keep it}, instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire and never to the basket, the half-pace from every open slate, the seven walked-around places with the returning-line place widest and once and not twice, the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing, the grain covered and unfigured, the charcoal unread, the widow’s mark untouched, the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed — and at each going of the light she put the fold right at his ear and under his chin without a look toward his face and \textbf{added no second fold to the empty place}. The keeping was found where put on the mornings and at the goings of the light of all three days — a fourth, fifth and sixth finding — and six findings from a hand that only read added no seventh placing; finding is not placing, a habit wants a hand that placed twice and a way wants a third, and both want a payer where none stands. With Jorra the bent finger went into the damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence and came out without a second holding of Ash 26; \emph{he’s not Vail} stayed sealed and the promise to the slate-burners neither given nor withdrawn. Ilva kept her ninth at the well on Stone 19 with the strip unread; Hessa took Berr’s slate up the road unread on Stone 20 and was not made a reader by eleven arithmetics; Berr called the levy and denied it with \emph{your house}, never \emph{I}, believing he had done a kindness; the soft-cuffed clerk stayed set at the landing, the seventh green and seventh shape had no eighth, and Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken three hundred and seventy-eight, seventy-nine and eighty days. \textbf{Ch 108 (bonds).} Through Stone 16, 17 and 18 nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer: the Drawing stood behind the household with its flat knock outside the six hearings and bought no teaching, and ten arithmetics stood behind one unsigned figure with no doctrine out of ten. With Sella the old grammar held at both ends of every day — fire before basket, \emph{The house will keep it}, instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire and never to the basket, the half-pace from every open slate, the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, the twice-mended pot lifted thumb-first with the hairline showing, the grain covered and unfigured, the charcoal unread, the widow’s mark untouched, the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed — and at each going of the light she put the fold right at his ear and under his chin without a look toward his face and \textbf{added no second fold to the empty place}. \textbf{The keeping was tested and not paid (T097/T060/T086):} found folded once in the crust’s empty place on three mornings and at three goings of the light, changed by nobody; he filed it beside the crust’s gap, the shelf’s two gaps, the gone pan’s round ring and the field’s empty place, expressly not a joining, gift, payment, payer, sixth held object, habit, way or rule, gathering interest toward the far-off finger that is not his and has not come. A hand that finds is not a hand that places, and a second placing would make a habit wanting a payer where none stands. With Tarn the equality held where it had moved to, six counted and the seventh at the lip, the ear-sentence stopped at the calling word as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled; with Jorra the bent finger went into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence and came out without a second holding of Ash 26, \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn. Ilva’s ninth at the well on the sixteenth with the strip unread and Hessa’s going \textbf{up} the road on the seventeenth with the writing to her sleeve stayed two sightings on separate places with no tenth hand, no reader and no fifth shaping; Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken 375, 376 and 377 days. No bond paid, sold, named or spoken, no new scar or possession, no change of voice.

\textbf{Ch 107 (bonds).} Through Stone 13, 14 and 15 nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer: the Hearth Drawing stood behind the household with its flat knock on its own place outside the six hearings and bought no teaching, the tenth arithmetic went up the clay road in Berr’s box and bought none either. With Sella the old grammar held at both ends of every day — fire before basket, \emph{The house will keep it}, instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire and never to the basket, the half-pace from every open slate, the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, the twice-mended pot lifted thumb-first with its hairline showing, the grain covered and unfigured, the charcoal unread, the widow’s mark untouched, the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed — and the empty place beside the crust was left untouched on the mornings of the thirteenth, fourteenth and fifteenth so that what came at the going of the light on the fifteenth would be a change and not a habit. \textbf{That change was hers and was not paid (T097/T060/T086):} setting him on his bed and righting the fold without a look at his face, her hand tucked the wool into the empty place beside the crust — a small keeping, no word, no third crust, no name for the place, no instruction to the basket, the hand resting the half-beat longer than the setting needed before it went away, the thread left frozen and unwiped. He took the interval apart by what was there and by what was not and filed it on a place of its own beside the crust’s gap, the shelf’s two gaps, the gone pan’s round ring and the field’s empty place: not a joining of rooms, not a gift (a gift wants a giver and nobody gave), not a payment, no payer, not a sixth held object, not a habit or a rule, gathered once and not made again, gathering interest toward the far-off finger that is not his and has not come. With Tarn the equality held where it had moved to, six counted and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged sentence, the Ash 14 breath and Bone 26 thumb’s resting found where put and not made again, the ear-sentence stopped at the calling word as a ninth stopping with no tenth, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled; with Jorra the men unnamed went low into the back room before first grey, the wheel and a pot were spoken to before any person, the full note was withheld and the bent finger went into the cold damper with one iron’s two bites and without a second holding of Ash 26, \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn. Ilva’s ninth hand at the well on the thirteenth and Hessa’s coming down the road on the fourteenth with her writing turned to her sleeve stayed two sightings on separate places with no tenth hand and no reader, and Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken 372, 373 and 374 days. No bond paid, sold, named or spoken, no new scar or possession, no change of voice.

\textbf{Ch 106 (bonds).} Nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road on Stone 10, 11 or 12 as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer: the tenth arithmetic went up the clay road in Berr Clay’s locked box behind the nine and bought no teaching under this roof; the Hearth Drawing stood behind the household with the flat knock on its own place outside the six hearings and the seventh place empty; the four rooms with the same gap stayed apart with a finger between every pair; the collector’s ordinary hand stayed on its own tray joined to none. With Sella nothing changed hands: fire before basket at both ends of every day, instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire and never to the basket, the half-pace from every open slate, the seven walked-around places gone around with a look and no number, the bed under the roof and never the Debt Loft, the thread left frozen and unwiped; at the Drawing she set him where he could see and not join and stood half a pace off, and carried him home at the going of the light saying nothing of where they had been. With Tarn the equality held where it had moved to, six counted and the seventh at the lip, the Ash 14 breath and the Bone 26 thumb’s resting found where put and not made again, the loan uncalled; with Jorra the men unnamed went low into the back room before first grey and the bent finger went into the cold damper with one iron’s two bites, the promise neither given nor withdrawn; Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken 369, 370 and 371 days. Berr’s self-removal with \emph{your house}, Hessa’s unread slate and Ilva’s strip stayed on their own places, no tenth hand filed and no reader made of any keeping. No bond paid, sold, named or spoken, no new scar or possession, no change of voice.

\textbf{Ch 105 (bonds).} Through Stone 7, 8 and 9 nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and the month came round to the day a year before without a hand under any roof naming it: Stone 7 was his first birthday in this life and was spent as an ordinary tending day — no party made, no cake baked, no figure entered, no recognition given, no threshold crossed and nobody who would know what a number counted. He kept three hundred and sixty-six, three hundred and sixty-seven and three hundred and sixty-eight exactly and did not stand the completed year up as a line; the house kept its days in loaves, in glances, in the space where a loaf had stood and in the shape a room takes when a weight is lifted out of it, and could not say a year had turned, and its not saying was neither a cruelty nor a mercy that could be entered on a slate. Each morning the surgeon’s register took the body in its old order — the leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches off with its corner a hair off the wool and its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread of drool frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof had ever been given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here would perform — and the infant’s want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrelled without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the argument the work. Sella came to the hearth before the basket at both ends of every day, kept the hearth grammar with the charcoal unread and the grain unfigured and the widow’s mark untouched, carried him down and up at the half-pace, went wide around the seven walked-around places and widest around the returning-line place, set him on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, let her hand rest the half-beat longer at the fold and left the thread frozen and unwiped, saying nothing of where they had been; with Tarn the six and the seventh, the checked breath and thumb’s resting, the ear-sentence stopped at the calling word as a ninth stopping with no tenth and the loan uncalled held at the equality’s moved place; with Jorra the dusty forearms parted as clot from vessel, the wheel and a pot spoken to before any person, the full note withheld, the damper’s two bites and the Ash 26 holding not made a second time, \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed and the promise under the wheel-shed neither given nor withdrawn; with Garl the objects and the unspoken name 366, 367 and 368 days, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid the same number. Nothing was joined, named, opened, called, paid or ended and no bond changed hands.

\textbf{Ch 104 (bonds).} Through Stone 4, 5 and 6 nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and the first firing of Stone stood behind the household with no lesson anybody named. Each morning the surgeon’s register took the body in its old order — the stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and he knew a basket set level out of the draught where the heat came sideways was the careful rewarming he would choose and could not ask for; the infant wanted the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle, and neither won, the quarrel the work. Sella carried him down and up at the half-pace, gave the instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire she would bank against their coming back and never to the basket, went wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, widest around the returning-line place, set him on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft at each going of the light, righted the fold without a look at his face and left the thread frozen and unwiped. \textbf{Her one change was at the kiln on Stone 5:} before any instruction went to the basket she put her left hand to the widow’s mark, held it one breath, let go, lifted the clay lid with the back of a hand and tipped the carried coal under a broken pot; the fire took in fours with its fifth unpaid, nobody praised the opening or made a lesson of it, seven openings in seven months were seven and not a rule and no eighth was made due. With Tarn the six and the seventh held at the kindling, the checked objects found where put and not made again, the ear-sentence stopped at the calling word with no tenth and the loan uncalled; with Jorra the dusty and clean forearms parted as clot from vessel, the wheel and a pot spoken to before any person, the full note withheld, the bent finger standing a moment longer in the cold iron without leaving the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time; with Ilva the ninth hand at the well on Stone 4, strip unread and no tenth; with Garl the objects and the unspoken name three hundred and sixty-three, sixty-four and sixty-five days. No bond changed hands, no slate opened within reach of the basket, no power gained, no new scar or possession and no change of voice.

\textbf{Ch 103 (bonds).} Through Stone 1, 2 and 3 nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and the river’s going under its winter skin on Stone 1 bought no lesson under any roof. Each morning the surgeon’s register took the body in its old order — the stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool and its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and the infant’s want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrelled without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the argument the work. Sella went to the hearth before the basket, told the coals it was the thaw, turned them with a broken pot’s back, kept the charcoal unread, the dressed grain covered and unfigured with no figure or handful and the widow’s mark untouched; she carried him down and up at the half-pace, went wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and no number, widest around the returning-line place, set him on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft at each going of the light, let her hand rest the half-beat longer than the setting needed and left the thread frozen and unwiped. With Tarn the six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip held, the Ash 14 breath and the Bone 26 thumb’s resting were checked on all three days and not made again, the ear-sentence stopped at the calling word as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled; with Jorra the dusty forearms were parted from clean as clot from vessel, the wheel and a pot spoken to before any person, the full note known three turns ahead withheld, the bent finger standing in the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence and the holding of Ash 26 gathered once and not made a second time, with \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed; with Ilva the ninth record-first hand came once at the well on Stone 2 with her strip unread, no tenth made and no voice spoken; with Garl the objects and the unspoken name for 360, 361 and 362 days. No bond changed hands, no power used, no new scar or possession and no change of voice.

\textbf{Ch 102 (bonds).} Through Ash 28, 29 and 30 nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and the ninth reading bought no lesson there. Sella went to the fire before the basket at both ends of every day and gave the instruction to the wool and the river wind and never to the basket; she carried him down and up at the half-pace from every open slate, went wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and no number, set him on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft at every going of the light, let her hand rest the half-beat longer than the setting needed and left the thread frozen and unwiped; the widow’s mark hung untouched, six openings in six months were six and not a rule and no seventh was made due. On Ash 30 she set the basket in the moot-post’s finger’s width of shade where no slate lay and stood half a pace off through Berr’s twice-read figure, carrying him home saying nothing. With Tarn the six and the seventh held and the Ash 14 breath and Bone 26 thumb’s resting were checked on all three days and not made again, the ear-sentence stopping at the calling word with no tenth stopping and the loan uncalled; with Jorra the dusty forearms, the withheld note, the damper’s two bites and the holding of Ash 26 found where put and not made a second time; with Ilva the ninth hand at the well on Ash 28 with the strip unread and no tenth; with Berr the third subtraction going up the road locked and unread with \emph{your house}, never I, and the figure read still not the figure paid; with Hessa the slate going up unread with hand before eye; with Garl the objects and the unspoken name for three hundred and fifty-seven, fifty-eight and fifty-nine days. Nothing was opened, joined by a standing hand, named, called, paid or ended, no power used, no rank changed, no new scar or possession and no change of voice.

\textbf{Ch 101 (bonds).} Through Ash 25, 26 and 27 (Days 354–356) nothing crossed under the roof, out of the yard or up the clay road as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and nothing from Ash 22, 23 or 24 crossed over either. Each morning the surgeon’s register took the body in its old order — the stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches off with its corner a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread frozen in the dry kiln heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and the infant’s want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrelled without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the argument the work (T060/T086). Sella went to the fire before the basket at both ends of every day, told the coals it was the thaw and \emph{The house will keep it} where another woman would say I, turned them with a broken pot’s back, kept the charcoal unread and the dressed grain turned under wool with a touch lighter than a woman would use on a sleeping child and no figure or handful, lifted the twice-mended pot thumb-first where the wire crossed the crack with the hairline showing between old-brass staple and tighter wire, and set the rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed; she carried him down and up at the half-pace, went wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and no number, set him on the bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft at each going of the light, righted the fold without a look at his face and left the thread; the widow’s mark hung untouched and no seventh opening was made due (T058/T079/T100, T077). Tarn kept six in the worn thumb-mark where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, knife at the edge of its sill, said \emph{Six counted. The next I don’t count}, checked the Bone 26 thumb’s resting and the Ash 14 held breath on all three days and found each where put and not made again, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled (T036/T076/T006). Jorra parted dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, withheld the note known three turns ahead and put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence. \textbf{The one meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T062/T035/T031 and T061/T082):} on Ash 26, after the tongue had been moved, the sentence finished and the household straightened around the waiting — after the work was done, not before — his bent finger stayed in the cold iron a breath longer than the work required. He filed the extra interval on a place of its own with a finger between it and the five held objects, the pot-crack resting, the hand-at-the-sill breath and his own gaps: a private keeping gathered once and not spent, expressly not a sixth held object, not a seventh, not an eighth of anything, not a habit, a way, a hearing, a near-full answer, a mending, a cause, a payment or a rule, with no payer standing under it, gathering toward the far-off hand that will lay the district’s private keepings together, and that hand not his. On Ash 27 the finger came out and the interval was found where it had been put and not made again, for a second would be a habit and a third a way and both want a payer. \emph{He’s not Vail} stayed sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn. Ilva came once to the well on Ash 26 with her hand to sleeve before her eyes to the asker and her mouth after both, answered \emph{Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account} with her strip unread, and was filed as the ninth record-first hand with no tenth, expressly not the speaker of any voice (T080 advanced, not paid). Three coverings stayed weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause (T083/T085); eight arithmetics stood behind one unsigned figure, eight and not one account, with both Ash subtractions locked in Berr’s box, the finding on a place of its own with no payer and no doctrine out of eight (T015/T041/T047 held); the Ash 5 joining, Ash 17 direction and Ash 23 direction stood apart with a finger between every pair, still gathering and unspent (T101 held); the burned slate stood at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings, the well-saying at four shapings, nine hands and nine stoppings with no tenth and the loan uncalled. No new scar, possession, rank or power; no answer became a hearing, a gift or a power. Forward, not closed.

\textbf{Ch 99 (bonds).} Through Ash 19, 20 and 21 (Days 348–350) nothing crossed under the roof as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, and the reading on the twentieth bought no lesson there. Each morning the surgeon’s register took the body in its old order — the stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches off with its corner a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof has ever been given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and the infant’s want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrelled with it without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the argument the work. Sella went to the fire before the basket at both ends of every day, told the coals it was the thaw and \emph{The house will keep it} where another woman would say I, kept the charcoal unread and the grain covered and unfigured with no handful, lifted the twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, set the rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, carried him down and up at the half-pace from every open slate, went wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and no number, and at each going of the light set him on the bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, righted the fold without a look at his face and left the thread; the widow’s mark stayed untouched and no seventh opening was made due. On Ash 20 Berr Clay came up short off the clay road with the red wool cord folded under his coat and the sweet green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner, wiped his thumb twice before touching nothing, read \emph{One in twelve, as the notice says} twice over the basket, called the levy and denied it with \emph{The levy is called. It is not called by me} and \emph{your house}, never I, said something low to the block about kindness being entered, and went off up the road with the box locked and Ash’s second true subtraction inside, believing he had done a kindness. \textbf{The chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T015/T041/T047, held with T077):} eight arithmetics of the year now stand behind one printed figure; eight are eight and not one account, the figure read is still not the figure paid and no signature stands on the space between. He filed the finding on a place of its own with no payer and did not lay it across the house’s not-doings, the covered grain, the five held objects, the pot-crack resting, the hand-at-the-sill breath, the Ash 5 joining, the Ash 17 direction or his own kept gaps; the edges came near to touching and the finger went between. No doctrine stood up out of eight, and nothing in the reading answered the hand that went in on Seed 15, the man carried out on Day 188, the dressed grain under wool, the carried fire’s missing fifth, the word that went up the terrace or the room shut with the damper closed. Tarn kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip, checked the Ash 14 held breath on the nineteenth, twentieth and twenty-first and did not make it again, and brought the ear-sentence to the calling word and stopped; Jorra spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, withheld the note known three turns ahead and put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence; Ilva came once at the well on Ash 19 with her strip unread and her ninth hand nine, expressly not the speaker of any voice. The hand answered six times, answers 271 through 276, each a small intake held whole on the river’s note and come straight down as a tool put away where the next hand will find it; \textbf{two hundred and seventy-six honest answers} stand on the sixth place, each an object and not a power. No new scar, possession, rank or power, no change of voice, and nothing promoted into a gift, hearing, stopping, habit or rule. Forward, not closed.

\textbf{Ch 98 (bonds).} Through Ash 16–18 (Days 345–347) nothing changed hands under the roof, in the yard or up the clay road, and no collector came on any of the three days; there was no market, Cross or bell, and no runner was seen on any road. Each morning the surgeon’s register took the body in its old order — the stiff leathery brown-edged crust two inches off with its corner a hair off the wool and its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread frozen and unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and the infant’s louder want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrelled with it without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the argument the work. Sella went to the fire before the basket at both ends of every day, told the coals it was the thaw and \emph{The house will keep it} where another woman would say I, kept the charcoal unread and the grain covered and unfigured with no handful lifted, lifted the twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, set the rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, carried him down and up at the half-pace and went wide around the seven walked-around places, and let her hand rest the half-beat longer than the setting needed at the bed; the widow’s mark was not touched and no seventh opening was made due. Tarn kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, said \emph{Six counted. The next I don’t count}, said \emph{Yes, house} to the early and the late thaw while keeping the late, and checked the Ash 14 held breath at the knife-sill on the sixteenth, seventeenth and eighteenth, finding it where it had been put and not making it again; the loan stayed uncalled and the nine stoppings nine. Jorra parted dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, withheld the note known three turns ahead, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, and grew quieter when the direction went around the boards while the household straightened around the quiet without an order. \textbf{The chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T035/T031/T065/T095 with T101):} on the afternoon of Ash 17 an ownerless voice over the boards from the direction of Slate Row gave a word about a room shut with the damper closed and a slate burned over a man nobody named — no room named, no hand at any flame, no figure, no date and nobody standing in any doorway to be asked, the weather answering first and the price of barley after it — and he filed it on a place of its own beside the Ash 5 joining with a finger between, a further shaping of that joining and an advancement of the finding that a place wants a witness. It is expressly not a sixth telling of the burned slate (five), not a third telling of the shut room (two), not a sixth asking of the row (five), not a fifth shaping of the well-saying (four), not a hearing, a seventh, a cause, a witness, a reader, a name or a payment, and no payer stands under it. Ilva drew at the well that afternoon with her strip unread and her ninth hand nine and was expressly not the speaker; her hand to sleeve before eyes to asker and mouth after both was filed as the ninth record-first hand with no tenth. The hand answered six times, answers 265 through 270, each a small intake held whole on the river’s note and laid down straight as a tool put away where the next hand will find it; \textbf{two hundred and seventy} honest answers now stand on the sixth place, each an object and not a power. No new scar, possession, power or rank, no change of voice, and nothing promoted into a gift, hearing, stopping, habit or rule. Forward, not closed.

\textbf{Ch 97 (bonds).} Through Ash 13–15 (Days 342–344) nothing changed hands under the roof, in the yard or up the clay road, and no collector came on any of the three days; there was no market, Cross or bell, and no runner was seen on any road. Each morning the surgeon’s register took the body in its old order — the stiff brown-edged barley crust two inches off with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread frozen and unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody here will perform — and the infant’s louder want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrelled with it without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning, the argument the work. Three counts in three places did not become one; six hearings kept the seventh place empty; the file lay open on the towel with every gap left gap. Sella went to the fire before the basket at both ends of every day, told the coals it was the thaw and \emph{The house will keep it} where another woman would say I, kept the charcoal unread and the grain covered and unfigured, lifted the twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with the crack showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, set the rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, carried him down and up at the half-pace and went wide around the seven walked-around places, and let her hand rest the half-beat longer at the fold; the widow’s mark was not touched and no seventh opening was made due. Tarn kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, told the wood \emph{Six counted. The next I don’t count}, said \emph{Yes, house} to an early and a late thaw while keeping the late, and on Ash 14 at the kindling set the small knife where it could be checked and let his hand stay at the sill a breath longer than the check required before taking it away — cutting nothing, counting nothing, calling no loan, spending no Seed 16 breath and not making the thumb’s resting of Bone 26 again. The boy filed the held breath on a place of its own beside the five objects and the pot-crack resting, expressly not a sixth, not a habit, hearing, sign, mending, cause, payment or rule, not made again on Ash 15 and gathering toward the far-off hand that will lay the district’s private keepings together, a hand that is not his. Jorra parted dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, withheld the full note known three turns ahead, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence and kept \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed with the promise neither given nor withdrawn. Ilva came once to the well on Ash 15 with her strip unread and her ninth hand nine, answering the question put, expressly not the speaker of any voice. Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken 342, 343 and 344 days and his tile debt uncalled. No bond changed hands, no new scar or possession and no change of voice.

\textbf{Ch 96 (bonds).} Through Ash 10–12 nothing changed hands under the roof, in the yard or up the clay road, and no collector came. On Ash 10 Sella carried him down before first light at the half-pace she keeps from every open slate, set the basket in the moot-post’s finger’s width of shade where no slate lay and stood half a pace off through Berr’s twice-read figure and the bell, and carried him home at the going of the light saying nothing of what had been read over him; Ash 11 and 12 were ordinary days with no market, Cross or bell. At both ends of all three days she went to the fire before the basket, told the coals it was the thaw and \emph{The house will keep it} where another woman would say \emph{I}, kept the charcoal unread beneath her finger, turned the dressed grain under wool with no figure and no handful, lifted the twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with the crack left showing, and set the rim two inches beyond his reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed. The widow’s mark was not touched; six openings in six months were six and not a rule. Berr denied the levy with \emph{your house}, never \emph{I}, and said something low to the block about kindness being entered, and went up the road believing he had done a kindness; Hessa took the slate up the road unread, her hand to it before her eyes to the crowd; Ilva at the well on Ash 11 answered \emph{Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account} with her strip unread and her ninth hand nine; Tarn said \emph{Yes, house} to an early and a late thaw and kept the late, six counted and the seventh at the lip, his thumb’s resting checked and not made again; Jorra spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person and kept \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed with the promise neither given nor withdrawn. Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken 339, 340 and 341 days. No bond changed hands, no slate opened within reach of the basket, no new scar or possession and no change of voice.

\textbf{Ch 95 (bonds).} Through Ash 7–9 nothing changed hands under the roof, in the yard or up the clay road, and no collector came. Sella kept the hearth grammar at both ends of all three days — fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot, \emph{The house will keep it}, the half-beat at the pot’s setting, the charcoal unread and the grain covered and unfigured — carried him at the half-pace and went wide around the seven walked-around places, and on Ash 9 at the going of the light her thumb stayed one breath longer than the lift required where the wire crossed the crack of the twice-mended pot. He took that held interval apart and filed it on a place of its own beside the five objects with a finger between, expressly not a sixth, no habit, sign, payment or rule and with no payer standing. With Tarn the exact account held: six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip, the knife at the edge of its sill, the thumb’s resting on Bone 26 checked and not made again on any of the three days, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled; he said \emph{Yes, house} to the kindling question and the two fence-menders and kept the late thaw because it puts off the paying. With Jorra the wheel and a pot were spoken to before any person, the full note known three turns ahead was withheld, and the bent finger went into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence on Ash 9; \emph{he’s not Vail} stayed sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn. Ilva came once to the well on Ash 8 with her strip unread and her ninth hand nine, answering the question put and not the one behind it and expressly not the speaker of any voice; Hessa was offstage and no runner came on any road. Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken three hundred and thirty-six, thirty-seven and thirty-eight days. Nothing was opened, named, called, paid, joined or ended and no bond changed hands.

\textbf{Ch 94 (bonds).} Through Ash 4–6 nothing changed hands under the roof, in the yard, at the well or on the clay road, and no collector came. Sella went to the fire before the basket at both ends of every day, told the coals it was the thaw and \emph{The house will keep it} where another woman would say \emph{I}, counted a small intake, a hold and a letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, kept her finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stayed unread, moved her lips along a two-gapped row unfigured, glanced once at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, lifted the twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with both proverbs to pot and fire and the crack showing, turned the dressed grain under wool with a lighter touch and no figure and no handful, set the pot rim two inches beyond his reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and righted the fold at his ear and chin without a look at his face, leaving the thread frozen and unwiped. The widow’s mark was not touched on any of the three days — a morning, a hearth, a going of the light and a bed are not openings — and the sixth opening at Ash 2 was not revisited as a sign or payment and no seventh was made due. With Tarn the exact account held: six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, the knife at the very edge of its sill, the thumb’s resting on Bone 26 checked on Ash 4, 5 and 6 and not made again, \emph{Yes, house} to the woman with kindling and the two fence-menders and the late thaw kept because it puts off the paying, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled. With Jorra the dusty forearms were parted from clean as clot from vessel, the wheel and a pot spoken to before any person, the full note known three turns ahead and withheld, the bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, and on Ash 5 he grew quieter when the joining went around the boards; \emph{he’s not Vail} stayed sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn. Ilva came once to the well on Ash 5 with the notched strip unread and her ninth hand nine; Hessa came down the clay road on Ash 6 with the writing turned toward herself and still unread, her eighth hand eight; no tenth hand was filed and neither was made a reader. Three ownerless arrivals were taken apart as a surgeon takes a field apart and filed on places of their own with a finger between every pair — the Ash 5 joining of the burned slate to the shut room, the Ash 5 fourth shaping of the well-saying, the Ash 6 turning of Hessa’s writing — none promoted into a witness, a prophecy, a payment, a sixth telling, a fifth shaping or a rule, and no payer stood under any of them.

\textbf{Ch 93 (bonds).} Through Ash 1–3 nothing changed hands under the roof, in the yard, at the well or up the clay road, and no collector came. Sella went to the fire before the basket at both ends of every day, told the coals it was the thaw and \emph{The house will keep it} where another woman would say \emph{I}, turned the coals with the back of a broken pot, counted a small intake, a hold and a letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, kept her finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stayed unread, moved her lips along a two-gapped row unfigured, glanced once at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with her hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, lifted the twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with both proverbs to pot and fire and the crack showing, turned the dressed grain under wool with a lighter touch and no figure and no handful, set the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, righted the fold without a look at his face and left the thread frozen and unwiped. The one change in three days was hers and was not spent: on Ash 2 at the kiln mouth, before any instruction went to the basket and before any word, she put her left hand to the widow’s mark at her throat for one breath, let go, lifted the clay lid with the back of a hand and tipped the carried coal under a broken pot; the fire took, still answering four low pulls with the silence where the fifth should have stood, its payer unnamed three hundred and thirty-one days, and she did not touch the mark again at shelf, well, rack, road, basket, yard, morning, afternoon, dusk or going of the light. Six openings in six months are six and not a rule, no seventh is made due, nobody praises the opening, names what it mended or enters a slate, and the five behind are not looked at again as signs or payments. With Tarn the exact account held — six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, the knife at the very edge of its sill, the ear-sentence stopped at the word that would call the loan, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the thumb’s resting of Bone 26 checked and not made again on any of the three days, and \emph{Yes, house} to an early and a late thaw with the late kept because it puts off the paying. With Jorra the dusty forearms were parted from clean as clot from vessel, the wheel and a pot spoken to before any person, the full note known three turns ahead and withheld from a High Kiln master who would make a song of it, the bent finger put into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed, the promise neither given nor withdrawn, the burned slate at five. Ilva came once to the well on Ash 2 with her strip unread and the ninth hand nine, answering \emph{Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account}; offstage on Ash 1 and 3, nothing from her well crossed under the roof. Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken three hundred and thirty, thirty-one and thirty-two days and his tile debt uncalled. No bond changed hands, no name given, no scar or possession, no power gained and no change of voice; the surgeon’s clean satisfaction in a field left as found went on quarrelling under the infant’s louder want of the crust, the wiped thread and a hand on the pot handle, both true, the second louder, neither winning.

\textbf{Ch 92 (bonds).} Through Bone 28–30 nothing changed hands under the roof, in the yard, at the well or up the clay road, and no collector came. Sella went to the fire before the basket at both ends of every day, told the coals it was the thaw and \emph{The house will keep it}, lifted the twice-mended pot thumb-first where the wire crossed the crack with the crack showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, turned the dressed grain under wool with no figure and lifted no handful, set the rim two inches beyond his reach with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, kept her finger on top of the loaf shelf with the charcoal unread, righted the fold without looking at his face and left the thread frozen and unwiped, and touched the widow’s mark at no hour because a morning, a hearth, a rack, a well, a yard and a bed are not openings. On Bone 30 she set the basket in the moot-post’s finger’s width of shade where no slate lay and stood half a pace off through Berr’s reading and the bell, carried him home at the going of the light and set him on his bed and not in the Debt Loft, her hand resting the half-beat longer than the setting needed before it went away; she said nothing of where they had been or what had been read over the basket. Tarn kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip, the knife at the edge of its sill, and did not make the thumb’s resting of Bone 26 again on any of the three days; on Bone 30 he said \emph{Yes, house} to a woman with a basket of kindling and to two fence-menders arguing the thaw, and kept the late because a late thaw puts off the paying. Jorra parted dusty forearms from clean, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, withheld the note known three turns ahead, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, and kept \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed and the promise to the men who burn slates neither given nor withdrawn. Ilva came once to the well on Bone 29 with her strip unread and her ninth hand nine; Berr read Bone’s third arithmetic and went up the road with the box locked, believing he had done a kindness, and Hessa carried his slate up toward Greybank edge-on and unread. Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken three hundred and twenty-seven, twenty-eight and twenty-nine days and his tile debt uncalled. With all of them the boy’s staying at the inch, his early letting-go, the handful and Tarn’s thumb’s resting stayed four objects on four places, none made again and none a habit or a payer; Berr’s reading put six arithmetics behind one printed figure and did not join them to any of them. Nobody under any roof saw either hand-movement, spoke a number or gave a name to the basket. No bond changed hands, no new scar or possession and no change of voice.

\textbf{Ch 91 (bonds).} Through Bone 25–27 nothing changed hands under the roof, in the yard, at the well or up the clay road, and no collector came. Sella went to the fire before the basket at both ends of every day, told the coals it was the thaw and \emph{The house will keep it} where another woman would say \emph{I}, turned them with the back of a broken pot, counted a small intake, a hold and a letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, kept her finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stayed unread, moved her lips along a two-gapped row unfigured, glanced once at the clay jar with her hand half over nothing, lifted the twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with both proverbs to the pot and the fire and the crack showing, turned the dressed grain under wool with no figure and lifted no handful, set the pot rim two inches beyond his reach with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, righted the fold without a look at his face and left the thread frozen and unwiped, and touched the widow’s mark at no hour; her fingers at the rack end went in and came out without closing on all three days. She carried him down and up at the half-pace from every open slate and went wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a step and no number, and the three coverings stayed weather entered nowhere. Tarn kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence; on Bone 26 he set the knife at the edge of its sill, laid his thumb on the uncut seventh for one breath, drew it back to the six and said \emph{Six counted. The next I don’t count}, cutting nothing, counting nothing, calling no loan and spending no breath; he did not make it again on Bone 27, when he said \emph{Yes, house} to an early thaw and a late and kept the late because it puts off the paying. The boy filed the resting on a place of its own with a finger between it and the nine stoppings, the four held changes, the handful and his own gaps — not a tenth stopping, not the seventh year given, not a payment, not a fifth held change, not a rule, with no payer. Jorra parted dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, withheld the full note known three turns ahead from a High Kiln master, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence and kept \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed with the promise of the boy’s name neither given nor withdrawn; the men who come low before first grey got no name.
