at the threshold, at the well and at the loaf shelf she sent cost-questions to the pot and the weather and carried them away level, and a man come down the clay road brought a number up out of a fist toward the well, looked at it and put it back into his sleeve so the figure arrived nowhere, while the space between the figure read over the basket on Grain’s second Account-day and the figure paid had no signature on it and went up the terrace in a locked box answering nothing for the man carried out on Day 188 (T077, T015/T041/T047 held); a wrong wind off High Kiln brought the sweet edge of glaze over the boards, touched the fold and went out again, a direction arriving nowhere and not a second edge paid, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape gathered at Grain’s first market and carried unjoined with no eighth, no second look, no name, no loaf, no slate, no sale and no promotion into a hearing, a cause or a romance (T064, T050/T051 and T033/T034 held); Sella moved her lips along the two-gapped row without a figure, glanced once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and shut her hand half over nothing, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, set the pot rim out with its handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and left the widow’s mark untouched with no opening in fifty-six days (T058/T079, T100); Tarn took the broom only after it was instructed, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count with six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, brought the ear-sentence to the calling word and stopped as a remembered stopping, held nine with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath and did not spend it, swept past the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector’s road without a turn, and no collector came up or went down the clay road on Grain 25, 26 or 27 while the warm stone lay cold in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006, T062); Jorra came through with meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent finger and under the nails, parted dust from slip as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel and told a pot You’ll do, withheld the note known three turns ahead, kept the burned-slate word at four and the two shut-room tellings at two, held his bent finger in the cold damper as a remembered repetition, sealed he’s not Vail with the promise neither given nor withdrawn, while unnamed men went low into the back room before first grey and got no name (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); the yard went around the seven walked-around places --- the clean dark line, the finer grey called the thaw, the rack space with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring with no scrape, crumb, print, chip or word, the bare dark trough, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out --- each with a look and a wide step and no number, seven things in a row with no payer under them, no third gap and no fourth likeness made a cause (T009/T013/T092, T098 advanced and NOT paid); Garl was kept in objects with his name unspoken for two hundred and thirty-six days, and Sella carried him home at the going of the light at the half-pace around every walked-around place, set him on the bed and not in the Debt Loft with the fold right and the thread frozen, and went to her own bed before the small hours and left the coals to keep themselves; no voice came over the boards to make a fourth of the question and he made none himself, and in the small hours the hand went up an inch under conditions that had once answered and came down at once, a miss entered without shame, the forty-seventh answer, and then in the chapter’s last small hours went up an inch toward the low note through the finger’s-width door and stayed, was taken through the small intake, the hold and the letting-go of one of the breaths Sella counted at her fire in the room that does not touch his, kept through the little silence after her count had ended and brought down on the river’s next low note --- two rhythms held one against the other across a wall that does not touch, remembered, not a change made again, the forty-eighth answer, filed on the sixth place with no payer named, not spent or explained, not a longer reach, miss entered, hearing, seventh, tenth stopping, payment, held change, key, power or rule (T061/T082); two hundred and thirty-six stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill or Grath, six months and fifty-six days told by nobody, the fire’s fifth unpaid the same number of days, the widow’s mark untouched with no opening in fifty-six days, the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, the question standing over the boards with three askings and nobody to own them, Grain 30 (Day 239) three mornings ahead unbrought, the file lying open on the towel complete and worth nothing, and the count going forward exact and unspent into Day 237, Grain 28, Firstday (T061/T082, T071/T072, T098, T101).}

\CRday{Day 239}{Grain 30, Y.H. 813 (Tenthday)  —  the Vail kiln-house at the bed, hearth and loaf shelf’s low angle, the Clay Yard and its seven walked-around places, the clay road, the Cross, the reading block under the moot-post and the moot-post’s thin shade, the pot board, the square, below the north bridge at the out-of-line landing, the fish-trade shade at the market’s edge, the walk home at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath, with Greybank up the road  —  the boy came into his two hundred and thirty-ninth day and six months and fifty-nine days with nobody saying so, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid for two hundred and thirty-nine days and fire, river and boards keeping three counts in three places that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082), and Grain 30 arrived as the third and last Account-day and market of Grain, one morning ahead at the previous close and now earned; Sella went to the fire before the basket, instructed wool, fire, pot, broom and river wind and never the basket, said The house will keep it, told the fire it was the thaw, counted under her breath toward no opening, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, left the widow’s mark untouched with no opening in fifty-nine days, because a reading is not an opening, and carried him down at the half-pace from every open slate, setting the basket in the moot-post’s finger’s width of thin shade where no slate lay and standing half a pace off with no instruction or reason given to the basket (T058/T079, T100); \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change came when the district’s arithmetic changed for the third time in Grain where two hundred people stood and could not be changed back:} Berr Clay came up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat and the green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner, wiped his thumb twice on his apron before touching nothing, held a narrow slate unopened to his forearm with the writing inward, passed a finger over the figure and let his eyes rest a breath longer than the writing required before he raised them to the crowd, read one in twelve, as the notice says low into the top of the crowd so that the figure went twice over the basket, once for the moot and once for the households that came late, said The levy is called. It is not called by me and spoke of your house, never I, and went off toward High Kiln with the red cord folded square, the narrow slate and the box locked with the true subtraction inside, believing he had done the district a kindness, while the printed figure stood unchallenged and a figure read aloud was still not the figure paid and the figure over the basket was not the figure over the dressed grain under wool at home, the space between them with no signature and left apart, not averaged (T015/T041/T047, T077); the bell went from the Cross, four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself, the heard bell kept beside the told (T078); before noon Hessa Rale took the slate up the clay road toward Greybank edge-on to her forearm with the writing to her sleeve, her hand to the slate before her eyes to the crowd, the second strap let out, the dried pale scurf of mud unbrushed on her shortened coat, and to a woman at the rail who asked what she carried she said I don’t read it. I carry it. There’s a difference, and the road doesn’t care which, answering the question put and not the one behind it, her record-first order of reaching the eighth such hand on a place of its own, advanced and not paid, no figure coming off the slate (T080); below the north bridge the soft-cuffed clerk stayed set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called, cuff grey from washing and grey again by midday, slate to forearm and writing inward, hand to slate before eyes to stalls, the market selling over him as water over a stone and nobody stepping around him or taking him off (T090/T080/T083); across the square the seventh green stayed a colour at a silent woman’s mouth with clay in her nail crescents, a pale line across the back of one hand and the sweetish green of glaze in the crease beside her lip, her cup turned a quarter and set back where it stood, and at the market’s edge the seventh shape stayed a shape in cast-offs with a man’s shoulders on a child’s frame, silt pale in the wrist creases, a gap where a front tooth had been and a green sliver catching light and going dull, its head going toward a set-down pot a half-beat late and stopping in the middle of the turn, so that no eighth of either came, no second look was joined, no name was spoken, no loaf passed, no slate came near and no sale was made, neither called Fenna nor Ulda in the telling (T050/T051 and T033/T034 held); at the market’s edge the hand went up an inch toward the river’s low note and held to the river’s own low interval with no count in the house to borrow and came down on the next low note, the fifty-third answer, filed on the sixth place with no payer named, not a hearing and not water over water promoted among the hearings (T061/T082); Sella carried him home at the going of the light saying nothing of what had been read over him, went wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, set him on his bed and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look at his face and left the thread frozen, and Garl was kept in objects with his name unspoken for two hundred and thirty-nine days and no collector up or down the clay road on Grain 28, 29 or 30 (T009/T013/T092, T098 advanced and NOT paid); in the afternoon Grain went out without a boundary drawn and neither month-name corrected, Smoke unbrought, and in the small hours there was no breathing number anywhere in the house and the hand went up an inch, was taken through the small intake, hold and letting-go of one of Sella’s counted breaths in the room that does not touch his, kept through the little silence after her count had ended and came down on the river’s next low note, the fifty-fourth answer, two rhythms in one inch remembered and not a change made again, filed on the sixth place with no payer named, not a longer reach, miss entered, hearing, seventh, tenth stopping, payment, held change, key, power or rule, so that fifty-four answers stood exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air (T061/T082); two hundred and thirty-nine stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill and Grath, six months and fifty-nine days told by nobody, the fire’s fifth unpaid the same number of days, the widow’s mark untouched with no opening in fifty-nine days, the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, the question over the boards with four askings and no witness and no fifth asking, the dressed grain covered and unfigured, Grain’s third reading gone up the clay road in Berr’s locked box and unread under this roof, and the count going forward exact and unspent into Day 240, Smoke 1, Firstday (T061/T082, T071/T072, T098, T101).}
\CRday{Day 240}{Smoke 1, Y.H. 813 (Firstday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kiln mouth, the Clay Yard, the drying racks, the yard well and the trough, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and fortieth day and six months and sixty days with nobody saying so, Smoke coming on without a boundary drawn and no market, Cross or bell, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid for two hundred and forty days while fire under the floor, river through the finger’s-width door and the boards’ four nails, four and a thumb-width knot kept three counts in three places that did not become one because agreeing them would want a payer and none stood to any (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); the hand lay down against the fold after the fifty-fourth answer as a man lays a tool on a bench, the file turned out as instruments on a towel exact, complete and worth nothing with six hearings beside and never among and no seventh, three near-full answers, three pot sayings, the fourth burned-slate telling, the two shut-room tellings, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled (T061/T082, T036/T076); \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change came before the kiln when Sella Vail, before the basket and any instruction, put her hand to the widow’s mark at her throat, a thumb-length of lead-glazed clay with the Vail kiln scratched into it, held it one breath, let go, lifted the clay lid with the back of a hand and tipped the carried coal under the back of a broken pot, and the fire took, still answering four low pulls with the fifth missing, nobody seeing what it mended and no slate entered, lesson made, bond changed or payer named, and she put it behind the household without a word (T058/T079 and T088 advanced, not paid)}; she touched the mark at no shelf, well, rack, road, basket, afternoon or dusk, for the hand goes to the mark before the kiln and at no other hour, as on Tallow 1 and Ember 1; hot clay came under tallow and wet wool with the sour Ash breath of the thaw, one leathery brown-edged crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread froze unwiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint with the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform; she gave the instruction to the wool, fire, pot, broom, running water and river wind and never the basket, told the fire it was the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, and set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T100); Tarn took the broom only after it had been instructed, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count, set the knife where six could be checked and the seventh could not, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped with no figure and no name as a remembered stopping, kept nine stoppings and the Seed 16 breath unspent, and swept over the collector road without once turning along it, no collector coming up or down the clay road (T036/T076, T009/T013/T092); Jorra Vail parted meal-fine slate dust from slip past the bent finger, spoke to the wheel (It doesn’t care whose hands. It cares if they’re steady), told a pot You’ll do, knew its full note three turns ahead and withheld it on the near-full tray beside the hearings and never among them, kept the burned slate at four and the shut-room tellings at two and left he’s not Vail sealed (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); the hand went up an inch toward the river’s note, was taken through the small intake and came down at once against the fold, filed on the sixth place with no payer named as the fifty-fifth answer, not a longer reach, miss entered, hearing, seventh, tenth stopping, payment, held change, key, power or rule (T061/T082); at the going of the light she carried him home at the half-pace, going wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and no number, set him on his bed and not in the Debt Loft, left the thread frozen and went to her own bed before the small hours (T098 carried); in the small hours fire, river and boards kept three counts that did not become one, and the count went forward exact and unspent into Day 241.}
\CRday{Day 241}{Smoke 2, Y.H. 813 (Secondday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and drying racks, the Clay Yard and the boards fronting the shelf, the yard well and the trough, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and forty-first day and six months and sixty-one days with nobody saying so, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid for two hundred and forty-one days while fire, river and boards kept three counts in three places that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082), and the widow’s mark hung where it hung at Sella’s throat, touched once before the kiln on Smoke 1 and at no shelf, well, rack or basket on this morning, for the hand goes to the mark before the kiln and at no other hour (T058/T079); the dressed grain was lifted from under its wool for damp, felt to the knuckle, spread thin on the flat stone to finish, gathered back by the handful and set under the fold flat again, changing state and gaining no figure, counted in glances, handfuls and by the carrying arm’s weight that knew weight and not cost, entered on no slate and laid across none of the absences (T077); a neighbour at the threshold with a pot hitched on her hip asked what the storing would take now the grain was under wool and was answered Ask the pot. The weather knows the rest, going off level with the question still on her, and a man come down the clay road with dried pale scurf on his coat brought a number out of a fist toward the yard well, looked at it and put it back into his sleeve, so the figure arrived nowhere, not a missing figure but a figure kept where no thumb could read it (T077, T015/T041/T047 held); Sella kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal tally beneath stayed unread, glanced once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and shut her hand half over nothing, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and turned the coals with the back of a broken pot (T100); the hand went up an inch, was taken through the small intake and came down before the counted breath had finished, filed as the fifty-seventh answer with no payer named, and later went up again to the river’s low note, carried through the small intake, the hold and the letting-go of one of Sella’s breaths in the room that does not touch his, held through all three and coming down with the breath, the old two-rhythm coordination remembered and not a change made again, filed as the fifty-eighth answer with no payer named, not a longer reach, miss entered, hearing, seventh, tenth stopping, payment, held change, key, power or rule (T061/T082); Tarn took the broom only after it had been instructed, kept six where the house could check and the seventh where it could not, brought the ear-sentence to the calling word and stopped as a remembered stopping with nine standings and no tenth, drew the Seed 16 breath and did not spend it, and no collector came up or went down the clay road on this second morning of Smoke (T036/T076); Jorra Vail kept dusty and clean forearms on one tray, spoke to the wheel before any person, told a pot You’ll do, withheld its note known three turns ahead, kept the burned slate at four and the shut-room tellings at two, and when Sella’s sentence went low and unfinished his bent finger went into the cold iron of the damper ahead of it, took the cold out, held and moved a hair’s breadth, a remembered repetition paired with no other fraction, with he’s not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); no eighth green came and no eighth shape, no name spoken over either, no loaf, slate or sale, no fifth asking over the boards and no witness standing anywhere to be asked (T050/T051, T033/T034, T101 carried); in the small hours the three counts kept apart and the count stood at two hundred and forty-one, exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody.}
\CRday{Day 242}{Smoke 3, Y.H. 813 (Thirdday)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and drying racks, the Clay Yard and its boards, the terrace, High Kiln on the wrong wind, the yard well and the trough, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and forty-second day and six months and sixty-two days with nobody saying so, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid for two hundred and forty-two days while fire, river and boards kept three counts in three places that did not become one because agreeing them would want a payer and none stood to any (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082), and the widow’s mark hung where it hung, touched once before the kiln on Smoke 1 and not at a shelf, well, rack, basket or pot on this morning (T058/T079); the dressed grain was turned under wool for damp again, spread thin and gathered back by the handful and the fold set flat, changing state and gaining no figure, counted in glances and handfuls and by an arm that knew weight and not cost, entered on no slate (T077); a woman at the threshold with a pot under her arm asked what the keeping would take and was sent to the pot and the weather, and a man come down the clay road brought a number out of a fist toward the well, looked at it and put it back into his sleeve, so the figure arrived nowhere; a wrong wind got up off High Kiln, came down the terrace and over the boards with the sweet edge of lead glaze on it, touched the fold where the dressed grain lay and went out on the wind that brought it, a direction arrived nowhere and not a second edge paid, and one of the three shapings of the pot saying, that a pot had gone quiet on every row come the thaw, stood again as a saying, no fourth likeness made a cause and no name given to what ailed the man carried out on Day 188 (T064, held); Sella told the fire it was the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge, glanced once at the cold clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, and set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T100); the hand went up an inch toward the river’s note with no count in the house borrowed, held to the river’s own low interval and down on the next low note, filed as the fifty-ninth answer, and at the close went up again, was carried through the small intake, the hold and the letting-go of one of Sella’s counted breaths in the room that does not touch his, kept through the little silence after her count had ended and brought down on the river’s next low note, two rhythms crossing in one inch, remembered and not a change made again, filed as the sixtieth answer with no payer named, so that \textbf{sixty answers stood on the sixth place, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air}, none a longer reach, miss entered, hearing, seventh of the full note, tenth stopping, payment, held change, key, power or rule (T061/T082); the file was turned out as instruments on a towel and found exact, complete and worth nothing, six hearings beside and never among with the sixth out of a person and no seventh invented to fill the empty place, three near-full answers, three pot sayings, the fourth burned-slate telling and the two shut-room tellings, the told bell beside the heard and the told figure beside the paid with Grain’s third arithmetic gone up the clay road in Berr’s locked box, nine stoppings with no tenth, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled, three held changes with the loft scrape fourth, the pale line fifth and the held inch sixth, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth, and the question on its seventh place with four askings and no witness (T061/T082, T101 carried); Tarn kept six where the house could check and the seventh where it could not, the ear-sentence stopping at the calling word with nine standings and no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, the warm stone cold and unreconciled in its loft pot, and Jorra kept the burned slate at four, the shut-room tellings at two and he’s not Vail sealed (T036/T076, T006, T035/T031/T065/T095); no collector came up or went down the clay road on Smoke 1, 2 or 3, no fifth asking came, no row was named and no third gap, fourth likeness or finger drawn between absences appeared (T098 carried); Smoke went out without a boundary drawn and neither of the district’s two month-names corrected, Smoke 10 standing seven mornings ahead and unbrought, and the count went forward exact and unspent into Day 243.}
\CRday{Day 243}{Smoke 4, Fourthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle, kiln mouth and boards, the kindling, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the Clay Yard, the drying racks and the lowest rack, the yard well and the bare trough, the worked strips, and the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and forty-third day and six months and sixty-three days with nobody saying so, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid for the same count while fire under the floor, river through the finger’s-width door and the boards’ four nails, four and a thumb-width knot kept three counts in three places that did not become one because agreeing them would want a payer and none stood to any (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); one leathery brown-edged barley crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread froze unwiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint with the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, and the surgeon took the inventory and entered it nowhere; Sella went to the fire before the basket, told it the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, turned the dressed grain under its wool for damp and spread it thin and gathered it by the handful, changing state and gaining no figure, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, glanced once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and shut her hand half over nothing, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and left the widow’s mark untouched at shelf, well, rack, road and basket, for the hand goes to it before the kiln and at no other hour (T058/T079, T077, T100); Garl was kept in objects with his salt-stiff coat, hollow wheel-seat and two unswept lines, his name unspoken for two hundred and forty-three days and no collector up or down the clay road (T009/T013/T092); Tarn took the broom only after it had been instructed, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count with six in the worn thumb-mark where the house could check and the seventh at the lip where it could not beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered stopping with nine standings and no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath and did not spend it, swept past the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector road without a turn, and the warm stone lay cold and unreconciled in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006, T062); Jorra parted meal-fine slate dust from slip past the bent finger, spoke to the wheel and told a pot You’ll do, withheld the note known three turns ahead, kept the burned slate at four and the shut-room tellings at two, held his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence as a remembered repetition, and sealed he’s not Vail with the promise ungiven, while unnamed men went low into the back room before first grey and got no name (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); the hand went up an inch toward the river’s low note and came down at once against the fold, the sixty-first answer, and in the long afternoon went up, was taken through the small intake and came down before the letting-go, the sixty-second, both filed on the sixth place with no payer named, not longer reaches, misses entered, hearings, sevenths, tenth stoppings, payments, held changes, keys, powers or rules (T061/T082); Sella carried him home at the going of the light at the half-pace around the seven walked-around places with a look and no number and set him on his bed and not in the Debt Loft, and in the small hours two hundred and forty-three stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody, six months and sixty-three days told by nobody, the seventh year still ungiven and Smoke 10 six mornings ahead unbrought, and the count went forward into Day 244, Smoke 5, Fifthday (T061/T082, T071/T072).}
\CRday{Day 244}{Smoke 5, Fifthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and drying racks, the Clay Yard, the boards and the terrace, the yard well and the bare trough, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the worked strips, and the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and forty-fourth day and six months and sixty-four days with nobody saying so, no bell on a Fifthday, no market and no Cross, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid for two hundred and forty-four days while fire, river and boards kept three counts that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); the dressed grain came out from under wool for damp, was spread thin on the flat stone, turned with the back of a hand, gathered by the handful and set under the fold flat, changed state and gained no figure, counted in glances and handfuls and by an arm that knew weight and not cost, entered on no slate and laid across none of the absences, while the figure read over it on Grain 30 was still not the figure paid and the true subtraction stayed locked in Berr’s box answering nothing for the man carried out on Day 188 (T077, T015/T041/T047 held); a neighbour at the threshold with a pot hitched against her hip asked what the storing would take now the grain was under wool and was answered Ask the pot what a wet thing costs set down there. The house has said it, and a man come down the clay road with dried pale scurf on his coat skirt brought a number up out of a fist toward the well, looked at it and put it back into his sleeve, so the figure arrived nowhere and was not a missing figure, a sleeve being no slate and a thing not priced being a thing whose payer has not been named; Sella lip-read the two-gapped row without a figure, glanced once at the cold clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and left the mark untouched at shelf and hearth, for the hand goes to it before the kiln and at no other hour (T058/T079, T100); \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change came at the yard well, T080 advanced and NOT paid:} Ilva, a woman of the firing work of the yard and not of the house, drew a short strip of birch bark notched along one edge out of her sleeve and passed the nail of a thumb across the notches before her eyes went to the woman who asked and before her mouth answered Five to this morning, and the boy took the order of reaching and nothing else, setting a \textbf{ninth record-first hand-shape} on a place of its own beside the eighth with a finger between every pair and fingers between it and the charcoal, the cord, the knots, the pages, the tins, the missing hand and the pale line, refusing to read the stick, ask her about it, join it to the reed-cutter’s cord or let nine likenesses stand up and call themselves a rule, for a rule is an account that has found a payer and none stood to any; she was not Marra, not Hessa Rale, not the soft-cuffed clerk, not the grey-coated collector and not an officer, and nothing was sold, entered or explained (T080 advanced, unpaid); the hand went up an inch toward the river’s low note with no count in the house to borrow, was held to the river’s own low interval and came down on the next note, the sixty-third answer, and in the small hours went up, was taken through the small intake, held through the letting-go of one of Sella’s counted breaths in the room that does not touch his, kept to the end of the count and brought down where the count ended, the sixty-fourth answer, one borrowed rhythm and one kept, the sixtieth coordination remembered and not a change made again, both filed on the sixth place with no payer named (T061/T082); the boy turned out the file as instruments on a towel and found it unchanged with six hearings beside and never among and no seventh, three near-full answers, three pot sayings, the fourth burned-slate telling and the two shut-room tellings, told bell beside heard and told figure beside paid with Grain’s third subtraction locked in Berr’s box, nine stoppings with no tenth, three held changes plus the loft scrape, pale line and held inch on six places, seventh green a colour and seventh shape a shape with no eighth, dressed grain covered and unfigured, pan’s gone ring and returning-line place on trays of their own, the question on its seventh place with four askings and no witness, and now the ninth hand beside the eighth (T061/T082, T101, T098, T064, T050/T051, T033/T034 carried); Garl was kept in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and forty-four days and no collector on the clay road (T009/T013/T092), Tarn kept six where the house could check and the seventh where it could not with nine stoppings and the Seed 16 breath unspent (T036/T076), and Jorra parted dust from slip, withheld the note known three turns ahead, kept the burned slate at four and the shut-room tellings at two and held his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, with unnamed men going low into the back room before first grey and getting no name (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); Sella carried him home at the going of the light around the seven walked-around places, and in the small hours two hundred and forty-four stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody, six months and sixty-four days told by nobody, the mark untouched, the seventh year still ungiven and Smoke 10 five mornings ahead unbrought, and the count went forward into Day 245, Smoke 6, Sixthday (T071/T072, T080, T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 245}{Smoke 6, Sixthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle, kiln mouth, boards and terrace, the drying racks, the Clay Yard, the yard well and the bare trough, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), High Kiln on the wrong wind, the worked strips, and the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and forty-fifth day and six months and sixty-five days with nobody saying so, a day arriving as a continuation of a sound that had been going on all night, no bell on a Sixthday, no market and no Cross, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and forty-five days while fire, river and boards kept three counts that did not become one because agreeing them would want a payer and none stood to any (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread froze unwiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint with the afterdrop waiting beyond all three, and he knew the shape of a man going cold and of a man warmed too fast and wanted the crust while keeping the tray; the dressed grain came out from under wool for damp, was felt to the knuckle, spread thin on the flat stone to finish, turned, gathered by the handful and set under the fold flat, changed state and gained no figure, counted in glances and handfuls and by a carrying arm that knew weight and not cost, entered on no slate and laid across none of the absences (T077); a neighbour’s cost-question went to the pot and the weather and a man with dried pale mud-scurf on his coat skirt brought a number out of a fist toward the well, looked at it and put it back into his sleeve, so the figure arrived nowhere and was not a missing figure (T015/T041/T047 held); Sella went to the fire before the basket, told it the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, glanced once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and shut her hand half over nothing, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, moved her lips along the two-gapped row without a figure, and left the widow’s mark untouched at hearth, shelf, well, rack, road, basket, afternoon and dusk on Smoke 4, 5 and 6 (T058/T079, T100); Garl was kept in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and forty-five days and no collector up or down the clay road on Smoke 4, 5 or 6 (T009/T013/T092); a wrong wind got up off High Kiln in the middle of the morning, came down the terrace and over the boards with the sweet edge of lead glaze on it, rode the length of the boards, crossed the sill, touched the fold where the dressed grain lay and went out on the wind that brought it, a direction arrived nowhere and not a second edge paid, and one of the three shapings of the pot saying, that a pot which sings before its time mostly sings itself out early, stood again as a saying and went off up the terrace with the weather, while no pot was lost, no fourth likeness made a cause, no name given to what ailed the man carried out on Day 188 and no sweet edge laid across the green at the silent woman’s mouth (T064 held); the hand went up an inch toward the river’s low note and held one rhythm through the little silence after Sella’s count had ended in the room that does not touch his, not crossing two rhythms this time, and came down on the river’s next low note, the sixty-fifth answer; in the afternoon Tarn took the broom only after it had been instructed, kept six where the house could check and the seventh where it could not beside Garl’s unforged sentence, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered stopping with nine standings and no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath unspent, swept past the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector road without a turn, and the warm stone lay cold in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006); Jorra parted meal-fine dust from slip past the bent finger, spoke to the wheel and told a pot You’ll do, withheld the note known three turns ahead, kept the burned slate at four and the shut-room tellings at two, held his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence as a remembered repetition and sealed he’s not Vail with the promise ungiven, while unnamed men went low into the back room before first grey and got no name (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); at the going of the light the boy turned out the file as instruments on a towel and found it exact, complete and worth nothing, six hearings beside and never among with no seventh, three near-full answers, three pot sayings, the fourth burned-slate telling and the two shut-room tellings, told bell beside heard and told figure beside paid with Grain’s third subtraction locked in Berr’s box, nine stoppings with no tenth, three held changes plus the loft scrape, pale line and held inch on six places, the ninth record-first hand on a place of its own with a finger between it and the eighth and between it and every other private keeping, seventh green a colour and seventh shape a shape with no eighth, dressed grain covered and unfigured, pan’s gone ring on its own tray, returning-line place gone around with a look and no number, and the question on its seventh place with four askings and no witness, no finger drawn between the absences and no fourth likeness made a cause (T080 advanced, not paid, T061/T082, T101, T098, T064); then he put the question to his hand the sixth way, taking the whole of Sella’s count in the room that does not touch his --- small intake, hold, letting-go and the little silence after it --- and crossing it with the river’s next low note in the inch and nowhere else, two rhythms crossing across a wall that does not touch, remembered and not a change made again, the \textbf{sixty-sixth answer} filed on the sixth place with no payer named, not a longer reach, miss entered, hearing, seventh, tenth stopping, payment, held change, key, power or rule (T061/T082); at the close the hand lay against the fold like a tool put away, the file lay open exact and worth nothing, under the floor the fire stopped at four, two hundred and forty-five stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill and Grath, six months and sixty-five days told by nobody, the mark untouched, the seventh year still ungiven, Smoke going out without a boundary drawn and neither month-name corrected, and Smoke 10 (Day 249) four mornings ahead unbrought, with the count going forward into Smoke 7, a day that had not earned its heading (T071/T072, T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 246}{Smoke 7, Seventhday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle, kiln mouth and boards, the drying racks, the Clay Yard, the yard well and bare trough, the kindling, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the terrace, High Kiln, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and forty-sixth day and six months and sixty-six days with nobody saying so, no bell, market or Cross on a Seventhday, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and forty-six days while fire under the floor, river through the finger’s-width door and the boards’ four nails, four and a thumb-width knot kept three counts in three places that did not become one because agreeing them would want a payer and none stood to any (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); the hand lay down against the fold on the sixty-sixth answer as a surgeon sets down an instrument, the file turned out as instruments on a towel exact, complete and worth nothing with six hearings beside and never among and no seventh, three near-full answers, three pot sayings, the fourth burned-slate telling and the two shut-room tellings, told bell beside heard and told figure beside paid with Grain’s third subtraction locked in Berr’s box, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent, three held changes plus the loft scrape, pale line and held inch on six places, the ninth record-first hand on its own tray and the question on its seventh place with four askings and no witness (T061/T082, T101 held); one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread froze unwiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waited past a warming nobody would perform, and he knew the face of a man going cold and wanted the crust while keeping the tray; Sella went to the fire before the basket, told it the thaw, turned the coals with the back of a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed the coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, glanced once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and shut her hand half over nothing, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, sent cost-questions to pot and weather, turned the dressed grain under wool for damp and spread and gathered it by the handful with no figure, and left the widow’s mark untouched at shelf, well, rack, road, basket, morning and dusk, for the hand goes to it before the kiln and at no other hour (T058/T079, T077, T100); Garl was kept in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and forty-six days and no collector up or down the clay road (T009/T013/T092); Tarn took the broom only after it was instructed, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count with six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered stopping with nine standings and no tenth, drew the Seed 16 breath and did not spend it, swept past the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector road without a turn, and the warm stone lay cold in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006, T062); Jorra parted meal-fine dust from slip past the bent finger, spoke to the wheel and told a pot You’ll do, withheld the note known three turns ahead, kept the burned slate at four and the shut-room tellings at two, held his bent finger in the damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence as a remembered repetition and sealed he’s not Vail, while unnamed men went low into the back room before first grey and got no name (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); the hand went up an inch toward the river’s low note and came down at once, the sixty-seventh answer, and in the late afternoon went up and held for the small intake only, coming down before the letting-go, the sixty-eighth, both filed on the sixth place with no payer named (T061/T082); two hundred and forty-six stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill and Grath, six months and sixty-six days told by nobody, Smoke 10 three mornings ahead unbrought, and the count went forward into Day 247, Smoke 8, Eighthday (T071/T072).}
\CRday{Day 247}{Smoke 8, Eighthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and boards, the drying racks, the lowest rack, the Clay Yard, the yard well and bare trough, the worked strips, the kindling, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the terrace and High Kiln on the wrong wind, the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and forty-seventh day and six months and sixty-seven days with nobody saying so, no bell, market or Cross on an Eighthday, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and forty-seven days while fire, river and boards kept three counts in three places that did not become one (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); one leathery brown-edged crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread froze unwiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint, and the afterdrop waited past a warming nobody would perform; Sella went to the fire before the basket, told it the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted toward no opening, pushed the coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and turned the dressed grain under wool for damp, spread it thin on the flat stone and gathered it by the handful, changing state and gaining no figure (T058/T079, T077, T100); a neighbour’s cost-question went to pot and weather and a man come down the clay road brought a number up out of a fist toward the well, looked at it and put it back into his sleeve, so the figure arrived nowhere and was not a missing figure, while the yard went around the clean dark line and the thaw, the rack space, the pan’s gone ring, the bare dark trough, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place with a look and a wide step and no number (T015/T041/T047 held, T098 carried); at the yard well Ilva of the firing work drew water with the pail against her knee, clay pale in her nail crescents and grey rack dust in the seam of one thumb, and this time her hand stayed in her sleeve and she answered the question put --- It’s kept where it’s kept. Ask the pot what it cost --- going on with her water; the boy filed no tenth hand-shape, the ninth stayed on its own tray with a finger between it and every other private keeping, and the notches stayed in wood, not read, not asked about, not joined to the cord, the knots, the pages, the tins, the missing hand or the pale line (T080 held); Garl was kept in objects, his name unspoken two hundred and forty-seven days and no collector on Smoke 7 or 8 (T009/T013/T092); Tarn instructed the broom before taking it up, kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged sentence, stopped the ear-sentence at the calling word as a remembered repetition with nine standings and no tenth, drew the Seed 16 breath unspent, swept over the collector road without a turn, and the warm stone lay cold in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006); Jorra parted dust from slip, spoke to the wheel and told a pot You’ll do, withheld the note known three turns ahead, kept the burned slate at four and the shut-room tellings at two, held his bent finger in the damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence and sealed he’s not Vail, while unnamed men went low into the back room before first grey and got no name (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change, T101 advanced and NOT paid, came in the flat hour of the afternoon:} a voice with no owner, room, hand at the kiln or cause asked over the boards a fifth time Which row did the pot go quiet on?, the weather answering first as a wrong wind off High Kiln carried the sweet edge of glaze over the boards, touched the fold and went out on the wind that brought it, the price of barley answering after it, and the voice going off up the terrace while the row stood where it stood and nobody leaned in to take the answer down; the boy opened it as a surgeon opens a wound, through what it asked, where it stood, what it would want and who would stand under the answer to pay, and found no witness and no payer at the bottom, then set the fifth asking on the seventh place beside the first four (Grain 21, 23, 26 and 29) with a finger between each pair and a finger between it and the sayings, the burned-slate word, the two shut-room tellings, the six hearings and the count, five askings still not one witness, not a fourth shaping of the pot saying, not a hearing, not a seventh, not a fifth telling of the slate, not a third telling of the shut room, not a cause, not a name and not a row named, no sixth asking coming and no witness standing (T101, T061/T082, T064 held); the hand held to the river’s own low interval with no count in the house to borrow, the sixty-ninth answer, and in the small hours crossed two rhythms in the inch through one of Sella’s counted breaths and the silence after it, the seventieth, both filed on the sixth place with no payer named (T061/T082); two hundred and forty-seven stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody, six months and sixty-seven days told by nobody, the mark untouched and the seventh year at its very end, Smoke 10 two mornings ahead unbrought, and the count went forward into Day 248, Smoke 9, Ninthday (T071/T072, T101).}
\CRday{Day 248}{Smoke 9, Ninthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle, kiln mouth and boards, the drying racks, the lowest rack, the Clay Yard, the yard well and bare trough, the worked strips, the kindling, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the terrace, the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and forty-eighth day and six months and sixty-eight days with nobody saying so, no bell, market or Cross on a Ninthday, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and forty-eight days while fire, river and boards kept three counts in three places that did not become one because agreeing them would want a payer and none stood to any (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread froze unwiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waited past a warming nobody would perform, and the surgeon took the inventory and entered it nowhere; Sella went to the fire before the basket on the last working morning, told it the thaw, turned the coals with the back of a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted toward no opening, pushed the coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, glanced once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and shut her hand half over nothing, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and turned the dressed grain under wool for damp, put her fingers into it to the knuckle, spread it thin to finish, turned it and gathered it by the handful and set the fold flat, changing state and gaining no figure, the figure Smoke 10 would read over it not knowing what it cost (T058/T079, T077, T100); a neighbour’s cost-question went to pot and weather and a man come down the clay road brought a number up out of a fist toward the well, looked at it and put it back into his sleeve, so the figure arrived nowhere, the figure read over Grain’s covered grain still not the figure paid and the true subtraction locked in Berr’s box answering nothing for the man carried out on Day 188 (T015/T041/T047 held); the yard went around the clean dark line and the thaw, the rack space, the pan’s gone ring, the bare dark trough, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place with a look and a wide step and no number, and no collector came up or went down the clay road on Smoke 7, 8 or 9 (T098 carried, T009/T013/T092); Garl was kept in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and forty-eight days and his keeping maintenance and not a story (T009/T013/T092); Tarn took the broom only after it was instructed, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count with six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, brought the ear-sentence to the calling word and stopped as a remembered stopping with nine standings and no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath unspent, swept past the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector road without a turn, chest tight since the dark, Ash in the knuckles, pale clip-ring at the wrist, warm stone cold and unreconciled in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006, T062); Jorra parted meal-fine dust from slip past the bent finger, spoke to the wheel before anyone and told a pot You’ll do, withheld the note known three turns ahead, kept the burned slate at four and the shut-room tellings at two, held his bent finger in the damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence as a remembered repetition and sealed he’s not Vail, while three or more unnamed men went low into the back room before first grey on Smoke 7, 8 and 9 and got no name (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); the hand held one rhythm across the borrowed silence after Sella’s count without crossing two, the seventy-first answer, and at the close crossed two rhythms in the inch across a wall that does not touch, remembered and not a change made again, the seventy-second, both filed on the sixth place with no payer named (T061/T082); at the close the file was turned out as instruments on a towel and found exact, complete and worth nothing, six hearings beside and never among with no seventh, three near-full answers, three pot sayings, the fourth burned-slate telling and the two shut-room tellings, told bell beside heard and told figure beside paid with Berr’s third subtraction locked in his box, nine stoppings with no tenth, three held changes plus the loft scrape, pale line and held inch on six places, the ninth record-first hand beside the eighth with a finger between every pair, seventh green a colour and seventh shape a shape with no eighth, dressed grain covered and unfigured, pan’s gone ring and returning-line place on trays of their own, and the ownerless question on its seventh place with five askings and no witness, the fifth from Smoke 8 gathered in without joining and no row named (T061/T082, T080 held, T101 advanced not paid, T064, T098, T050/T051, T033/T034 carried); the hand came down on the river’s next low note and laid itself against the fold like a tool put away, under the floor the fire stopped at four, two hundred and forty-eight stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill and Grath, six months and sixty-eight days told by nobody, the widow’s mark untouched, the seventh year still ungiven, Smoke going out without a boundary drawn and neither month-name corrected, and Smoke 10 (Day 249) one morning ahead unbrought, with the count going forward into a day that had not earned its heading (T071/T072, T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 249}{Smoke 10, Tenthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle, kiln mouth and boards, the Clay Yard, the drying racks, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the yard well and bare trough, the worked strips, the kindling, the flagstones, the terrace, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road, the Cross, the moot-post’s thin shade, the reading block, the wet boards, the pot board, below the north bridge the out-of-line landing, and the roads toward High Kiln and Greybank, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and forty-ninth day and six months and sixty-nine days with nobody saying so, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and forty-nine days while fire under the floor, river through the finger’s-width door and the boards’ four nails, four and a thumb-width knot kept three counts in three places that did not become one because agreeing them would want a payer and none stood to any (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082), one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread frozen unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint with the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, and the surgeon taking the inventory in the order the facts arrived and entering none of it; Sella went to the fire before the basket, told it the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed the coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist, left the widow’s mark hanging where it hung, turned the dressed grain under wool for damp and spread it thin and gathered it by the handful, changing state and gaining no figure, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, sent a neighbour’s cost-question to the pot and the weather, and watched a man bring a number up out of a fist toward the well and put it back into his sleeve so the figure arrived nowhere (T058/T079, T077, T100, T015/T041/T047 held); Garl was kept in objects, his name unspoken two hundred and forty-nine days, no collector coming up the clay road in the morning that was coming (T009/T013/T092); the hand went up an inch toward the river’s note and came down at once on the next one, answer seventy-three filed on the sixth place with no payer named, not a longer reach, hearing, seventh, tenth stopping, payment, held change, key, power or rule (T061/T082); \textbf{then came the chapter’s one meaningful change, the first Account-day and market of the second firing:} Sella set the basket in the moot-post’s finger’s width of shade where no slate lay and stood half a pace off, eight pigs went over the wet boards and two hundred leaned in, and Berr Clay came up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat and the green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner, wiped his thumb twice before touching nothing, held a narrow slate unopened to his forearm, passed a finger over the figure and read one in twelve, as the notice says low into the crowd, the figure going twice over the basket, once for the moot and once for the households that came late, called the levy, denied it with your house never I, and went off up the clay road toward High Kiln with the box locked and the true subtraction inside, believing he had done a kindness (T015/T041/T047, T077 advanced, not paid), so that the district’s arithmetic changed for the first time in Smoke and could not be changed back while the printed figure stood unchallenged, the figure read was still not the figure paid, the space between the figure read over the covered grain at home and what that grain had cost had no signature, and nothing answered for the man carried out on Day 188 or the hand that went in on Seed 15; the bell went four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself, the heard bell kept beside the told and its gap not made a hearing or a seventh of the full note (T078, T061/T082), the hand went up toward the bell and held through the missing stroke and down on the next sound in the square, answer seventy-four, and Hessa Rale went up toward Greybank before noon with the slate edge-on and unread, answering I don’t read it. I carry it, while the soft-cuffed clerk stayed set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called (T080, T090); at the going of the light Sella carried him home at the half-pace from every open slate, went wide with a look and no number around the clean dark line and the thaw, the rack space with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone ring, the bare dark trough, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, set the basket on the bed and not in the Debt Loft, and said nothing of the reading, and two hundred and forty-nine stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody (T098, T060/T086, T009/T013/T092).}
\CRday{Day 250}{Smoke 11, Firstday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle, kiln mouth and drying racks, the Clay Yard and the boards fronting the shelf, the yard well and the bare trough, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place on the worked strips, the terrace, High Kiln on a road gone quiet, the kindling, the flagstones and its shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (entered by unnamed men before first grey, not by the narration), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only) and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  a new day came onto the house the way a loaf comes onto a board and nobody said so, the boy two hundred and fifty days old and six months and seventy days, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and fifty days, Smoke’s first arithmetic gone up the clay road in Berr’s locked box and unread under this roof, the figure read over the basket still not the figure paid, and fire under the floor, river through the door and the boards’ four nails, four and a knot keeping three counts in three places that did not become one because agreeing them would want a payer and none stood to any (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T015/T041/T047 held); no bell, market or Cross on a Firstday, Smoke 20 (Day 259) standing eight mornings beyond the close and unbrought; one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread frozen unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, and the surgeon entering none of it anywhere (T060/T086); Sella went to the fire before the basket, told it the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed the coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist, left the widow’s mark untouched at shelf, well, rack, road and basket, lifted the dressed grain from under its wool for damp, put her fingers into it to the knuckle, spread it thin, turned it, gathered it by the handful and set the fold flat, changed in state and gaining no figure, counted in glances and handfuls and by an arm that knew weight and not cost, entered on no slate (T058/T079, T077); a neighbour’s cost-question went to the pot and the weather with nothing priced or entered, and a man come down the clay road with dried pale mud-scurf on his coat skirt brought a number up out of a fist toward the well, looked at it and put it back into his sleeve, so the figure arrived nowhere and was not a missing figure, a sleeve being no slate and a figure kept not a figure lost (T015/T041/T047 held); at the loaf shelf Sella moved her lips along the two-gapped row without a figure, glanced once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and shut her hand half over nothing, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, and set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T100); the yard went around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, four absences on four trays with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause (T098, T060/T086); at the yard well Ilva of the firing work drew water with the pail against her knee, clay pale in the crescents of her nails and grey rack dust in the seam of one thumb, and to a woman who asked what the firings of Smoke had cost she kept her hand in her sleeve, the notched birch unread, and answered Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account, so the boy filed no tenth hand-shape and the ninth stayed nine with a finger between it and every other private keeping, for nine likenesses must not stand up and call themselves a rule (T080 held at nine); the hand went up an inch, held for the small intake only and came down before the letting-go, answer seventy-five (T061/T082); in the afternoon Garl was kept in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and fifty days and no collector on the road (T009/T013/T092), Tarn took the broom only after it was instructed, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count, set the knife at the very edge of its sill with six where the house could check and the seventh where it could not, brought the ear-sentence all the way to the word that would call the loan and stopped there with no figure and no name, a remembered stopping with nine stoppings and no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath at the top of the reach and did not spend it, his chest tight, Ash in the knuckle creases, the pale clip-ring at the left wrist, and the warm stone cold and unreconciled in its unmarked loft pot, which is not forgiving (T036/T076, T006), while his stroke went over the bright patch without the half-check and did not turn along the collector road; Jorra came through with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent finger and white where a fist had opened, parted dust from slip, told a pot You’ll do, spoke to the wheel before any person, knew the note that pot would give three turns ahead with air under it and a want in it and withheld the knowing on the near-full tray beside the hearings and never among them, kept the burned-slate word at four, the two shut-room tellings at two and the three pot sayings at three with no fourth likeness made a cause, went unnamed the men who went low into the back room before first grey, held his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence as a remembered repetition with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies, and kept he’s not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); the first reading stayed beside the paid figure and answered nothing for the carried man or the missing hand, and the hand went up an inch, kept to the river’s own interval with no count in the house to borrow, and came down on the next note, answer seventy-six, while two hundred and fifty stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody (T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 251}{Smoke 12, Secondday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle, kiln mouth and boards, the drying racks, the Clay Yard, the yard well and bare trough, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place on the worked strips, the terrace, the kindling, the flagstones and its shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (entered by unnamed men before first grey, not by the narration), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and fifty-first day and six months and seventy-one days with nobody saying so, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and fifty-one days, Smoke’s first arithmetic behind and unread in Berr’s box, the figure read over the basket still not the figure paid, and fire under the floor, river through the door and the boards’ four nails, four and a knot keeping three counts in three places that did not become one because agreeing them would want a payer and none stood to any (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T015/T041/T047 held); no bell, market or Cross on a Secondday, Smoke 20 (Day 259) standing eight mornings beyond the close and unbrought, and Smoke 13 beyond the close and not reached into; one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread frozen and unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint with the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, and the surgeon taking the inventory in the order it arrived and entering none of it (T060/T086); the widow’s mark hung where it hung, touched once before the kiln on Smoke 1 and at no shelf, well, rack, road, basket, afternoon or dusk on any of the three days, the one opening behind the household and made into no lesson and no payment (T058/T079); Sella went to the fire before the basket, told it the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed the coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist, turned the dressed grain under wool for damp, spread it thin, gathered it by the handful and set the fold flat, gaining no figure, kept her finger above the charcoal, glanced once at the cold clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, sent the neighbour’s cost to the pot and weather, and watched a number go up out of a fist toward the well and back into a sleeve so the figure arrived nowhere (T077, T100, T015/T041/T047 held); the yard went around its seven places with a look and a wide step and no number, the question over the boards holding five askings with no witness and no row named, neither a sixth asking nor a hearing (T098, T101 held), and Garl was kept in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and fifty-one days and no collector up or down the clay road on Smoke 10, 11 or 12 (T009/T013/T092); the hand went up an inch toward the river’s note and was kept through the little silence after Sella’s count had ended in the room that does not touch, one rhythm carried across a borrowed silence without crossing two, and came down on the next low note, answer seventy-seven (T061/T082); in the afternoon Garl was kept in objects again, Sella gave the fire its instruction before the basket and touched the mark at no hour, Tarn set six where the house could check and the seventh where it could not, stopped the ear-sentence at the word that would call the loan with nine stoppings and no tenth and the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight, Ash in the knuckles, the pale clip-ring at the wrist and the warm stone cold in its loft pot, and swept over the bright patch without the half-check and past the collector road without turning (T036/T076, T006), while Jorra came through with meal-fine dust past the bent finger, parted dust from slip, told a pot You’ll do, withheld the note he knew three turns ahead, kept the burned slate at four and the shut-room tellings at two, held his finger in the damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, kept he’s not Vail sealed and gave the men no name (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095); then the boy turned out the file as instruments on a towel and found it exact, complete and worth nothing, six hearings beside and never among with no seventh, three near-full answers, three pot sayings, the fourth burned-slate telling and the two shut-room tellings, told bell beside heard and told figure beside paid with Smoke’s first arithmetic in a locked box answering nothing for the Day 188 man or the Seed 15 hand, nine stoppings, three held changes plus the loft scrape, pale line and held inch on six places, the ninth record-first hand on a tray of its own, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth, the dressed grain covered and unfigured, four walked-around absences on trays that do not touch, and the ownerless question at five askings with no witness, before he put the sixth question to his hand and crossed two rhythms across a wall that does not touch, in the inch and nowhere else, remembered and not a change made again, answer seventy-eight, and laid the hand against the fold like a tool put away (T061/T082); six months and seventy-one days were told by nobody, the fire stopped at four, the silence where the fifth should have stood stood where it stood, and two hundred and fifty-one stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill and Grath as the count went forward into Smoke 13, a day that had not yet earned its heading.}
\CRday{Day 252}{Smoke 13, Thirdday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle, kiln mouth and boards, the drying racks, the Clay Yard and its walked-around places, the yard well and bare trough, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place on the worked strips, the terrace, the kindling, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (entered by unnamed men before first grey, not by the narration), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and fifty-second day and six months and seventy-two days with nobody saying so, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and fifty-two days, fire under the floor, river through the finger’s-width door and the boards’ four nails, four and a thumb-width knot keeping three counts in three places that did not become one because agreeing them would want a payer and none stood to any (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); no bell, market or Cross on a Thirdday morning, Smoke 20 (Day 259) standing seven mornings beyond the close and unbrought, and the file turned out as instruments on a towel found exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air; one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread frozen and unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint with the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon taking the inventory in its old order and entering none of it (T060/T086); Sella going to the fire before the basket, telling it the thaw, turning the coals with a broken pot, saying The house will keep it, counting under her breath toward no opening, pushing coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, keeping her finger above the charcoal so the tally stayed unread, moving her lips along a two-gapped row with no figure, glancing once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and shutting her hand half over nothing, setting the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and leaving the widow’s mark where it hung, touched once before the kiln on Smoke 1 and at no shelf, well, rack, road, basket, afternoon or dusk (T058/T079, T100); the dressed grain turned under wool for damp, spread thin, turned, gathered by handfuls and set under the fold flat, changed in state and gained no figure, entered on no slate and laid across none of the absences (T077); Garl kept in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and fifty-two days and the uncalled tile debt circling without a figure, no collector up or down the clay road (T009/T013/T092); Sella carrying the basket about the yard at the half-pace and going wide around the clean dark line, the finer grey called the thaw, the space beneath the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the round ring where the pan stood, the bare dark trough whose water was called weather, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15, each with a look and a wide step and no number, seven in a row still seven and not an account until a payer stands (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried); Ilva drawing at the yard well with the pail against her knee, clay pale in her nail crescents and grey rack dust in one thumb’s seam, her hand staying in her sleeve with the notched birch strip unread and her mouth answering Ask the pot what it cost.
