I keep the count, not the account, the ninth hand staying nine and no tenth filed (T080 held, not paid); a neighbour’s cost-question going to the pot and the weather and a man come down the clay road with a number in his fist bringing it up toward the well, looking at it and putting it back into his sleeve so the figure arrived nowhere (T015/T041/T047 held); Tarn taking the broom only after it was instructed, saying Yes, house and Six counted. The next I don’t count, setting the knife where six could be checked and the seventh could not, bringing the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopping there with no figure and no name as the ninth stopping, the Seed 16 breath unspent, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, chest tight, Ash in the knuckle creases, the pale clip-ring holding what light there was, the warm stone cold and unreconciled in its loft pot, his stroke going over the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector’s road without turning (T036/T076, T006); Jorra coming through with meal-fine dust past the bent finger and white in a fist’s creases, speaking to the wheel (It doesn’t care whose hands. It cares if they’re steady) and telling a pot You’ll do, knowing its note three turns ahead and withholding it, burned slate at four, shut-room tellings at two, pot sayings at three, he’s not Vail sealed, the promise neither given nor withdrawn, his bent finger going into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, two bites in one piece of iron with no Grathic word for both (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T064); and two hand questions answered --- the first down at once on the river’s next low note (seventy-nine), the second down before the letting-go of a borrowed count in the room that does not touch (eighty) --- each filed on the sixth place with no payer named, an object and not a power, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, the hand laid down against the fold where the next hand will find it without looking (T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 253}{Smoke 14, Fourthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle, kiln mouth and boards, the drying racks and the lowest rack, the clay road and yard well as directions, the kindling, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and fifty-third day and six months and seventy-three days with nobody saying so, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and fifty-three days, fire under the floor, river through the door and the boards keeping three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings of the full note beside and never among with no seventh and none invented to fill the empty place, the told bell beside the heard and the told figure beside the paid, and Smoke’s first arithmetic gone up the road in a locked box, answering nothing here (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); the dressed grain turned under wool for damp, spread thin, turned, gathered by the handful and set under the fold flat, changed state, gained no figure, entered on no slate and laid across none of the absences (T077); Sella went to the fire before the basket, told it the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed the coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist, moved her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, set the pot rim out with its handle two inches beyond the reaching hand and a half-beat at the setting and no look toward the bed, told the fire the thaw and fed it, and left the widow’s mark where it hung, touched once before the kiln on Smoke 1 and at no shelf, well, rack, road, basket, afternoon or dusk (T058/T079, T100); a neighbour’s cost-question went to the pot and the weather with nothing priced, and a man come down the clay road with a number in his fist brought it up toward the well, looked at it and put it back into his sleeve so the figure arrived nowhere, a sleeve being no slate and a figure kept not a figure lost, read as a chart turned face-down (T015/T041/T047 held); the chapter’s small non-fatal edge came at the racks when a woman come to turn her pots set one down wrong, out of her shadow and near the warm side of the wall, and the pot gave its high thin note before its time --- not the full note, not a flat crack, not a seventh hearing and not the small flat knock out of a person --- and she swept around it with her broom and said Don’t set that where the wall’s warm. You’ll have the note off it before it’s fired. And that’s slip on your hands --- wipe it, or it’ll show in the pot, and the boy filed the note on a place of its own beside the three sayings, made no fourth likeness and no cause, lost no pot and gave no name to what ailed the man carried out on Day 188, an almost-note filed without being spent (T064, T061/T082 advanced, not paid); a wrong wind off High Kiln carried the sweet green edge of lead glaze over the boards, touched the fold and went out on the wind that brought it, a direction arrived nowhere and not a second edge paid; Garl kept in objects, his name unspoken two hundred and fifty-three days, the cleaner dark line and the finer grey called the thaw neither swept, the uncalled tile debt worse for being uncalled, no collector up or down the clay road (T009/T013/T092); Tarn at the kindling with the knife at the lip of its sill, six counted where the house can check and the seventh where it cannot, the ear-sentence brought to the word that would call the loan and stopped there with no figure and no name as the ninth stopping, the Seed 16 breath unspent, nine stoppings with no tenth, the loan uncalled, chest tight, Ash in the knuckle creases, the clip-ring at the wrist, the warm stone cold and unreconciled in its loft pot, his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector’s road without turning (T036/T076, T006); Jorra at the wheel-shed with meal-fine dust past the bent finger, parting dusty forearms from clean as a surgeon parts clot from vessel, telling a pot You’ll do and withholding the note he knew three turns ahead, the burned-slate word at four, the shut-room tellings at two, the pot sayings at three with no fourth likeness made a cause, he’s not Vail sealed, men unnamed before first grey, and his bent finger going into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, one piece of iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095); and two hand questions --- the third held to the river’s own interval with no count in the house to borrow (eighty-one), the fourth one rhythm held across the little silence after Sella’s count without crossing two (eighty-two) --- filed on the sixth place with no payer named, an object and not a power (T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 254}{Smoke 15, Fifthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle, kiln mouth and boards, the drying racks, the Clay Yard and its walked-around places, the yard well and bare trough, the lowest rack, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place on the worked strips, the terrace, the kindling, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and fifty-fourth day and six months and seventy-four days with nobody saying so, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and fifty-four days, fire under the floor, river through the door and the boards keeping three counts in three places that did not become one because agreeing them would want a payer and none stood to any, six hearings with no seventh and none invented to fill the empty place, the told bell beside the heard and the told figure beside the paid (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); no bell, market or Cross on a Fifthday, Smoke 20 (Day 259) five mornings beyond the close and not brought early, Smoke 16 (Day 255) one morning ahead with no heading earned, and the next real opening the first firing of Frost (Day 271) far off and unbrought; one stiff brown-edged crust two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread frozen and unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint with the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon taking the inventory in its order and entering none of it (T060/T086); the widow’s mark hung where it hung, touched once before the kiln on Smoke 1 and at no shelf, well, rack, road, basket, afternoon or dusk on Smoke 13, 14 or 15, the one opening before Smoke 1 behind the household with no lesson made and no payer named (T058/T079); Sella went to the fire before the basket, told it the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted toward no opening, pushed the coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist, moved her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, kept her finger above the charcoal, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, set the pot rim out with its handle two inches beyond the reaching hand and a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and turned the dressed grain under wool, spread, gathered by handfuls and laid flat, changed in state and given no figure (T077, T100); a neighbour’s cost-question went to the pot and the weather and a man’s fist-number came up toward the well and went back into his sleeve (T015/T041/T047 held); the ownerless question was not asked a sixth time --- five askings stood on the seventh place (Grain 21, 23, 26, 29 and the afternoon of Smoke 8) with no owner, room, hand at the kiln, cause, witness and no row named, not a hearing, not a fourth shaping of the pot saying, not a fifth telling of the slate, not a third telling of the shut room, not a cause, not a name and not a row, held toward the far-off day a witness stands somewhere and can be asked (T101 held); Garl kept in objects, his name unspoken two hundred and fifty-four days, no collector up or down the clay road on Smoke 13, 14 or 15 (T009/T013/T092); Tarn’s knife at the sill with six checkable and the seventh not, the ear-sentence to the calling word and stopped as the ninth stopping, the Seed 16 breath unspent, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, the loan uncalled, chest tight, Ash in the knuckles, the clip-ring at the wrist, the warm stone cold and unreconciled in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006); Jorra’s meal-fine dust, the pot saying withheld, the bent finger in the damper ahead of the unfinished sentence, burned slate at four, shut-room tellings at two, pot sayings at three with the premature note of Smoke 14 on its own place and no fourth likeness made a cause, the row at five askings with no witness, he’s not Vail sealed, the promise ungiven, men unnamed before first grey and low voices a direction only (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T064); at the going of the light Sella carried him up the clay road at the half-pace, going wide around the clean dark line, the thaw, the space beneath the lowest rack, the pan’s gone ring, the bare trough with its water called weather, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15, each with a look and a wide step and no number, then set him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right, left the thread frozen, told the fire the thaw, turned the coals, said The house will keep it, counted toward no opening and went to her own bed; he turned the file out as instruments on a towel and found it exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air --- six hearings and no seventh, three near-full answers, three pot sayings, the premature note on its own place, burned slate four, shut-room two, the heard bell beside the told and the told figure beside the paid, nine stoppings and no tenth, three held changes plus the loft scrape, the pale line and the held inch on six places, nine record-first hands with a finger between every pair and Ilva’s strip unread in her sleeve, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth, the grain covered and unfigured, the pan’s ring, the crust’s gap, the shelf’s two gaps and the field’s empty place on trays that do not touch, and the ownerless question at five askings with no witness, one arithmetic not redeeming the other and no figure written across the space between (T061/T082, T100); and two hand questions --- the fifth crossing two rhythms in the inch across a wall that does not touch, a borrowed count and the silence after it crossed against the river’s note (eighty-three), and the sixth taking up the borrowed count and silence again and crossing the two against the river’s note (eighty-four) --- both remembered and not made again, filed on the sixth place with no payer named, \textbf{eighty-four} honest answers standing, each an object and not a power; the hand laid down against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking, the file left open with every gap left gap, 254 exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill and Grath, going forward into Smoke 16, a day that had not earned its heading (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082).}

The next I don’t count, set the knife at the lip with six in the worn thumb-mark where the house could check and the seventh where it could not, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped there as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath and did not spend it, his chest tight, Ash in the knuckle creases, the pale clip-ring holding what light there was, the warm stone cold in its unmarked loft pot, his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector road without turning (T036/T076, T006); Jorra parted meal-fine dust from slip past the bent finger as a surgeon parts clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel (It doesn’t care whose hands. It cares if they’re steady) and told a pot You’ll do, withheld the note he knew three turns ahead, kept burned slate at four, shut-room tellings at two and pot sayings at three with the premature Smoke 14 note on its own place, gave no name to the men who went low into the back room before first grey, held his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence as one piece of iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies, and kept he’s not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T064); the hand went up an inch and came down at once on the river’s next low note (eighty-five), and in the small hours took a borrowed count and the little silence after it from the room that does not touch, crossed the two in the inch and came down before the letting-go (eighty-six), both filed on the sixth place with no payer named, Sella carrying him up the clay road at the going of the light and setting him on his bed and not in the Debt Loft, and 255 standing exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody as the count went forward into Smoke 17 (T061/T082, T071/T072).}
\CRday{Day 256}{Smoke 17, Seventhday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle, kiln mouth and boards, the drying racks and the cool stone at the rack end, the Clay Yard and its walked-around places, the yard well and bare trough, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place on the worked strips, the terrace, the clay road, the kindling, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and fifty-sixth day and six months and seventy-six days with nobody saying so, no bell, market or Cross on a Seventhday, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and fifty-six days while fire, river and boards kept three counts in three places that did not become one because agreeing them would want a payer and none stood to any, six hearings with no seventh and none invented to fill the empty place, the ownerless question at five askings with no witness, and Smoke 20 (Day 259) three mornings beyond the close and unbrought (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T101 held); one stiff leathery brown-edged crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread froze unwiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint, the afterdrop waited past a warming nobody would perform, and he knew the face of a man going cold and wanted the crust while entering none of it (T060/T086); Sella went to the fire before the basket, told it the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted toward no opening, pushed the coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist, kept her finger above the charcoal so the tally stayed unread, moved her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and left the widow’s mark untouched since before the kiln on Smoke 1 (T058/T079, T100); \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change came in the ordinary morning:} she lifted the dressed grain from under its wool for damp, spread it thin, turned it, gathered it in by the handful for the last time before Smoke’s second reading, felt the weight of each handful in her palm and laid it under the fold flat, then drew the wool up over it and set the covered heap away from the hearth on the cool stone at the rack end, so that the arithmetic read over it on Smoke 20 would not know what it cost and the space between the figure spoken and the price paid would stand unsigned, no loaf passing, no slate opening, no third gap coming and no lesson or payer made of the covering (T077 advanced, not paid, T015/T041/T047 held); a neighbour’s cost-question went to the pot and the weather with nothing priced, and a man come down the clay road with dried pale scurf of mud on his coat skirt brought the sweet edge of lead glaze off High Kiln on his breath as a direction arrived nowhere, brought a number up out of a fist toward the well, looked at it and put it back in his sleeve so the figure arrived nowhere, no green coming to a mouth, no eighth sighting made, no fourth likeness laid across the premature Smoke 14 note or the row question and no name given to what ailed the man carried out on Day 188 (T051 carried not paid, T015/T041/T047 held); Garl was kept in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and fifty-six days, the uncalled tile debt circling without a figure and no collector on the road (T009/T013/T092); the yard went around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, including the returning-line place where the hand went in on Seed 15 (T098 carried); Tarn instructed the broom before taking it up, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count with six checkable and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged sentence, stopped the ear-sentence at the word that would call the loan as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight, Ash in the knuckles, the clip-ring at the wrist, the warm stone cold and unreconciled in its loft pot, his stroke past the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector road without turning (T036/T076, T006); Jorra parted dusty forearms from clean as a surgeon parts clot from vessel, told a pot You’ll do, withheld its note known three turns ahead, kept burned slate at four, shut-room tellings at two and pot sayings at three with the premature note on its own place, gave no name to the unnamed men in the back room before first grey, held his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, and kept he’s not Vail sealed and the promise ungiven (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T064); the hand held to the river’s own interval with no house count to borrow (eighty-seven) and then for the small intake only, down before the letting-go (eighty-eight), both filed on the sixth place with no payer named, and 256 stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody, six months and seventy-six days told by nobody, as the count went forward into Smoke 18 (T061/T082, T071/T072).}
\CRday{Day 257}{Smoke 18, Eighthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle, kiln mouth and boards, the drying racks and the cool stone at the rack end, the Clay Yard and its walked-around places, the yard well with its frosted stone lip and the bare trough, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place on the worked strips, the terrace, the kindling, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and fifty-seventh day and six months and seventy-seven days with nobody saying so, no bell, market or Cross on an Eighthday, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and fifty-seven days with its payer unnamed while fire, river and boards kept three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings with no seventh and none invented to fill the empty place, the ownerless question at five askings with no witness, Smoke 19 (Day 258) one morning ahead unearned and unbrought, Smoke 20 (Day 259) two mornings ahead and unbrought, and the first firing of Frost (Day 271) far off and unbrought (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); one stiff leathery brown-edged crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread froze unwiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint, the afterdrop waited past a warming nobody would perform, and he knew a cold patient cannot clot and wanted the crust while entering none of it (T060/T086); Sella went to the fire before the basket, told it the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted toward no opening, pushed the coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, kept her finger above the charcoal so the tally stayed unread, moved her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, lifted a corner of the wool over the covered grain, turned the heap once for damp and drew the wool back smooth with no fifth gathering and no figure, and left the widow’s mark untouched, touching it at no shelf, well, rack, road, basket, morning or dusk, for a well is not an opening (T077, T058/T079, T100); frost-bloom wrote white fronds on the stone lip of the well where the Warm had lately gone out and the boy kept it on a place of its own as the shape a leak makes with no cause, not a hearing, not a seventh, not a payer, not the widow’s mark and not the first firing of Frost, and the rope went over it and the bucket knocked it grey and the yard called it weather and went on drawing, while a woman wet a finger in the water and said It tastes different and a man waiting his turn said the ice had been honeyed under the mud in Ilmen, the two sayings passing each other without an owner (T083/T085 carried, T009/T013/T092); a neighbour’s cost-question went to the pot and the weather with nothing priced and a man come down the clay road brought a fist-number up toward the well, looked at it and put it back into his sleeve so the figure arrived nowhere (T015/T041/T047 held); Garl was kept in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and fifty-seven days and no collector up or down the clay road on Smoke 16, 17 or 18, the uncalled tile debt neither paid nor settled (T009/T013/T092); the yard went around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number (T098); Tarn instructed the broom before taking it up, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count, set the knife at the lip with six checkable and the seventh not, stopped the ear-sentence at the word that would call the loan as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight, Ash in the knuckles, the clip-ring at the wrist, the warm stone cold in its loft pot, his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check and over the collector road without turning (T036/T076, T006); Jorra parted meal-fine dust from slip past the bent finger as a surgeon parts clot from vessel, told a pot You’ll do, withheld the note known three turns ahead, kept burned slate at four, shut-room tellings at two and pot sayings at three with the premature note on its own place and no fourth likeness made a cause, gave no name to the men who went low into the back room before first grey, held his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence as one piece of iron with two bites, and kept he’s not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T064); the hand carried one rhythm across the empty silence after a count that had ended in the other room without crossing two (eighty-nine), and at the close he turned the file out as a surgeon turns instruments out on a towel and found it exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, with six hearings and no seventh, three near-full answers, three pot sayings and the premature note on its own place, burned slate at four, shut-room tellings at two, the heard bell beside the told and the told figure beside the paid, nine stoppings with no tenth, three held changes plus the loft scrape, the carried man’s pale line and the held inch on six places, nine record-first hands with Ilva’s strip unread in her sleeve, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth, the covered and unfigured grain, the pan’s ring, the fold’s crust and its gap, the shelf’s two gaps and the field’s empty place on trays that do not touch, the white well lip on a place of its own, and the ownerless question at five askings with no witness (T061/T082, T080 held, T101 held); the sixth question held the empty interval as an object in its own right without filling it or crossing a second count and came down on the river’s next low note (ninety), Sella carrying him up the clay road at the going of the light, setting him on his bed and not in the Debt Loft, putting the fold right without a look at his face, leaving the thread frozen, telling the fire the thaw and going to her own bed, and 257 standing exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill and Grath, six months and seventy-seven days told by nobody, the file left open with every gap left gap and the count going forward into Smoke 19 (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 258}{Smoke 19, Ninthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle, kiln mouth and boards, the drying racks and the cool stone at the rack end, the Clay Yard and its walked-around places, the yard well and the bare trough, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place on the worked strips, the terrace, the kindling, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and fifty-eighth day and six months and seventy-eight days with nobody saying so, the hand put down against the fold on the ninetieth answer as a man puts away a tool, no bell, market or Cross on a Ninthday, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and fifty-eight days with its payer unnamed while fire under the floor, river through the finger’s-width door and the boards’ four nails, four and a thumb-width knot kept three counts in three places that did not become one because agreeing them would want a payer and none stood to any, six hearings beside and never among with no seventh and none invented to fill the empty place, and Smoke 20 (Day 259) standing one morning ahead unearned and unbrought (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread froze unwiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint, the afterdrop waited past a warming nobody would perform, and he knew a cold patient cannot clot and wanted the crust while entering neither (T060/T086); Sella went to the fire before the basket, told the coals it was the thaw, turned them with the back of a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed the coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, moved her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and lifted a corner of the wool over the dressed grain on the cool stone at the rack end for damp before laying it back with no figure on it, so that the arithmetic read over it tomorrow would not know what it cost and the space between figure and price stayed unsigned (T058/T079, T100, T077); frost went out of the well lip under the bucket and the yard called it weather, a woman at the well wet a finger in the water and said it tasted different and did not say what it had tasted like before, a neighbour’s cost-question went to the pot and the weather, and a man come down the clay road brought a number up out of a fist toward the well, looked at it and put it back into his sleeve so the figure arrived nowhere (T083/T085, T015/T041/T047 held); the yard went around the clean dark line, the finer grey called the thaw, the space beneath the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the bare dark trough with its water called weather, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15, each with a look and a wide step and no number, seven in a row not an account until a payer stands and none standing (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried); Ilva drew at the well with the pail against her knee, clay pale in her nail crescents and rack dust in one thumb seam, kept her hand in her sleeve and her notched birch unread, and answered Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account, so the boy filed no tenth hand-shape and the ninth stayed nine (T080 held); Garl was kept in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and fifty-eight days and the uncalled tile debt neither paid nor settled, no collector up or down the clay road on Smoke 19 (T009/T013/T092); Tarn took the broom only after it was instructed, said Yes, house and Six counted. The next I don’t count, set the knife at the very lip with six where the house could check and the seventh where it could not, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped there as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight, Ash in the knuckle creases, the pale clip-ring holding what light there was, the warm stone cold in its loft pot, and his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check (T036/T076, T006); Jorra came through with meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent finger and white in a fist’s creases, parted dusty forearms from clean, spoke to the wheel before any person, told a pot You’ll do, withheld the note he knew three turns ahead, kept the burned-slate word at four, the two shut-room tellings at two and the three pot sayings with the premature note apart, gave no name to the men who went low into the back room before first grey, held his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, and kept he’s not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T064); the hand went up an inch toward the river’s low note and came down at once on the next, holding and borrowing nothing (ninety-one), and in the small hours went up an inch, held for the small intake only and came down before the letting-go (ninety-two), each filed on the sixth place with no payer named, and 258 stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody as the count went forward into Smoke 20 (T061/T082, T071/T072).}
\CRday{Day 259}{Smoke 20, Tenthday, Y.H. 813 (the second Account-day and market of the second firing)  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle and kiln mouth, the clay road, the Cross, the moot-post’s finger’s width of shade, the reading block, the weighing board, the stalls and the pot board, below the north bridge the out-of-line landing, and back under the roof, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Smoke 20 came on its own morning and was not brought into a day that had not earned it, the count moving into two hundred and fifty-nine and six months and seventy-nine days with nobody in Sarn, Sill or Grath saying so, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid the same number of days, no bell under the roof, and the dressed grain lying covered and unfigured on the cool stone at the rack end with no signature on the space between the figure that would go over it and its price (T071/T072, T088, T077); Sella went to the fire before the basket, told it the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted toward no opening, pushed the coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist, kept her finger above the charcoal and the pot handle two inches out, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, left the widow’s mark where it hung, for a market and a reading are not openings, carried him up at the half-pace from every open slate and set the basket in the moot-post’s thin shade where no slate lay, stood half a pace off and gave the instruction to the wool and the river wind and never to the basket (T058/T079, T100); eight pigs went over the wet boards and two hundred leaned in, an assessor wrote the eight down with hand to slate before eye to rail, and Berr Clay came up short off the clay road with the red cord of his office folded square under his coat, the green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner and the smell of nothing at all under the hot clay, wiped his thumb twice before touching nothing, held a narrow slate unopened to his forearm, passed a finger over the figure and read One in twelve, as the notice says twice over the basket, once for the moot and once for the households that came late, then called the levy and denied it with your house, never I, sent a number from a fist by a shoulder going up toward High Kiln to arrive nowhere, and went off with the box locked and the true subtraction inside, believing he had done a kindness; \textbf{the district’s arithmetic changed for the second time in Smoke where two hundred people stood and could not be changed back}, the printed figure standing unchallenged and the figure read still not the figure paid, answering nothing for the man carried out on Day 188 or the hand that went in on Seed 15 (T015/T041/T047, T077); the bell went four, four and a gap and nobody crossed himself, the heard bell staying beside the told and not made a seventh of the full note or laid across the fire’s four-and-gap or the boards’ four nails and knot (T078), and the hand went up an inch toward the bell, held through the absent stroke without supplying one and came down on the stroke after it (ninety-three); Hessa Rale went up the clay road before noon with Berr’s narrow slate edge-on and the writing to her sleeve, saying I don’t read it. I carry it and I’ve got a road to walk, no figure coming off it, her eighth hand staying eighth beside Ilva’s ninth with no tenth filed (T080); the soft-cuffed clerk stayed set at the out-of-line landing below the north bridge for a measure nobody called, his inward slate and hand-to-slate-before-eyes entering a buyer’s number, and the market sold over him as water over a stone (T090); at the pot board a silent woman turned a cup a quarter with green of glaze at her mouth and a pale line on the back of one hand, and at the market’s edge a small shape in cast-offs caught light on a green sliver, grinned with a gap and turned its head a half-beat late toward a pot set down, a seventh colour and a seventh shape with no eighth, no name, no loaf, no slate and no sale, never Fenna or Ulda in the narration (T050/T051, T033/T034 held); Sella lifted the basket at the going of the light, carried him home saying nothing of what had been read over him, went around the seven places and set him on his bed and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look at his face and left the thread frozen; in the small hours he turned the file out as instruments on a towel and found it exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, the six hearings with no seventh, three near-full answers, three pot sayings with the premature note apart, burned slate at four, two shut-room tellings, told bell beside heard and told figure beside paid with Smoke’s second arithmetic locked up the road, nine stoppings with no tenth, three held changes plus the loft scrape, the pale line and the held inch on six places, nine record-first hands with Ilva’s strip unread in her sleeve, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth, the covered grain unfigured and the absences on trays that do not touch, and the five askings with no witness (T061/T082); the hand went up an inch and carried one rhythm across the wall that does not touch, taking the little silence after a count that had ended in the other room as an object and crossing no second count (ninety-four), and 259 stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody, the figure read still not the figure paid, Smoke 30 (Day 269) standing nine mornings ahead and not reached for and the first firing of Frost far off (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 260}{Smoke 21, Firstday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle, kiln mouth and boards, the drying racks and the cool stone at the rack end, the Clay Yard and its walked-around places, the yard well and the bare trough, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place on the worked strips, the terrace, the kindling, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and sixtieth day and six months and eighty days with nobody saying so, no bell, market or Cross on a Firstday, the hand resting where the ninety-fourth answer had put it down, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and sixty days with its payer unnamed, six hearings beside and never among with no seventh and none invented to fill the empty place, the heard bell beside the told, the told figure beside the paid with Smoke’s second arithmetic gone up the road in Berr’s locked box, the ownerless question at five askings with no witness, Smoke 30 (Day 269) standing nine mornings ahead and the first firing of Frost far off, both unbrought (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); frost went out of the well lip under the bucket and the yard called it weather, a neighbour’s cost-question went to the pot and the weather, and a man come down the clay road brought a number up out of a fist toward the well, looked at it and put it back into his sleeve so the figure arrived nowhere (T083/T085, T015/T041/T047 held); Garl was kept in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and sixty days and the uncalled tile debt neither paid nor settled, no collector up or down the clay road on Smoke 19, 20 or 21 (T009/T013/T092); in the afternoon Sella carried him down and up again at the going of the light at the half-pace and went wide around the seven walked-around places, including the returning-line place where the hand went in on Seed 15, each with a look and a wide step and no number, seven in a row not an account until a payer stands and none standing (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried); Tarn at the kindling took the broom only after it was instructed, said Yes, house and Six counted. The next I don’t count, set the knife at the very lip with six checkable and the seventh not, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped there as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight, Ash in the knuckles, the pale clip-ring holding what light there was, the warm stone cold in its loft pot, and his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check (T036/T076, T006); Jorra at the wheel-shed edge parted meal-fine dust from slip past the bent finger, spoke to the wheel before any person, told a pot You’ll do, withheld the note he knew three turns ahead, kept the burned-slate word at four, the two shut-room tellings at two and the three pot sayings with the premature note apart, gave no name to the men who went low into the back room before first grey, held his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, and kept he’s not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T064); Sella set him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look at his face, left the thread frozen, told the fire the thaw, turned the coals and went to her own bed, the one opening before Smoke 1 staying behind the household with no lesson, sign, mending or payer and the next real opening the first firing of Frost far off (T058/T079); the hand went up an inch and held for one whole interval of the river, borrowing no house count (ninety-five), and in the small hours held one rhythm for the small intake and let it go, then carried a second rhythm across the little silence after a count that had ended in the other room, laying the two intervals apart and not across one another (ninety-six), both filed on the sixth place with no payer named; he turned the file out as instruments on a towel and found it exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, with the covered grain unfigured, the figure read and the figure paid apart with no signature between, the absences on trays that do not touch and the five askings with no witness (T061/T082, T077); and 260 stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill and Grath, six months and eighty days told by nobody, the file left open with every tray parted and every gap left gap and the count going forward into Smoke 22, Smoke 30 nine mornings beyond and not reached for (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 261}{Smoke 22, Secondday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle, kiln mouth and boards, the drying racks and cool stone at the rack end, the Clay Yard and its walked-around places, the yard well with thin white frost on its north stone lip and the bare trough, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place on the worked strips, the terrace, the kindling, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and sixty-first day and six months and eighty-one days with nobody saying so, the hand put down against the fold on the ninety-sixth answer as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking, no bell, market or Cross on a Secondday, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and sixty-one days with its payer unnamed, fire under the floor, river through the finger’s-width door and the boards’ four nails, four and a thumb-width knot keeping three counts in three places that did not become one because agreeing any two would want a payer and none stood to any, six hearings beside and never among with no seventh and none invented to fill the empty place, the heard bell beside the told and the told figure beside the paid with Smoke’s second arithmetic gone up the road in a locked box, Smoke 30 eight mornings ahead and the first firing of Frost far off, both unbrought (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082); one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread froze unwiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint, the afterdrop waited past a warming nobody would perform, and the surgeon took the inventory in its old order and entered none of it (T060/T086); Sella went to the fire before the basket, told the coals it was the thaw, turned them with the back of a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted under her breath toward no opening, pushed the coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, moved her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, set the pot rim out with its handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and left the widow’s mark hanging, touched once before the kiln on Smoke 1 and at no shelf, well, rack, road, basket, morning or dusk (T058/T079, T100); the dressed grain was lifted at a corner for damp and laid back on the cool stone at the rack end with no figure, so that the arithmetic read over it on Smoke 30 would not know what it cost and the space between the figure and its price stayed unsigned (T077); frost wrote thin white fronds on the north stone lip of the well where the Warm had lately gone out, the cold iron of the rope went over it, the bucket knocked the heads off it and the yard called the whole of it weather, while the boy kept whatever white had been there on a place of its own with no cause --- not a payer, not the widow’s mark, for a well is not an opening, and not the first firing of Frost (T083/T085); a neighbour’s cost-question went to the pot and the weather with nothing priced, and a man come down the clay road brought a number up out of a fist toward the well, looked at it and put it back into his sleeve so the figure arrived nowhere and was not a missing figure (T015/T041/T047 held); Garl was kept in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and sixty-one days, the salt-stiff coat, hollow wheel-seat and crackless proverb intact, the uncalled tile debt circling without a name and neither paid nor settled, and no collector up or down the clay road on Smoke 22 (T009/T013/T092); the yard went around the clean dark line, the finer grey called the thaw, the space beneath the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the bare dark trough with its water called weather, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, each with a look and a wide step and no number, seven in a row not an account until a payer stands and none standing (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried); Tarn took the broom only after it was instructed, said Yes, house and Six counted. The next I don’t count, set the knife at the lip with six checkable and the seventh not, Garl’s unforged collector sentence beside it, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped there as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, drew the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight, Ash in the knuckle creases, the pale clip-ring holding what light there was, the warm stone cold and unreconciled in its loft pot, and his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check (T036/T076, T006); Jorra came through with meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent finger and white in a fist’s creases, parted dusty forearms from clean, spoke to the wheel before any person, told a pot You’ll do, withheld the note he knew three turns ahead, kept the burned-slate word at four, the two shut-room tellings at two and the three pot sayings with the premature Smoke 14 note apart, gave no name to the men who went low into the back room before first grey, held his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, and kept he’s not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T064); Sella set him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look at his face, left the thread frozen, told the fire the thaw and went to her own bed; the hand went up an inch toward the river’s low note, held for the small intake only and came down before the letting-go, borrowing no house count (ninety-seven), and in the small hours held through one whole interval of the river’s own going and came down on the next low note (ninety-eight), both filed on the sixth place with no payer named, and 261 stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill and Grath as the count went forward into Smoke 23 (T061/T082, T071/T072).}
\CRday{Day 262}{Smoke 23, Thirdday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle, kiln mouth and boards, the drying racks, the cool stone at the rack end, the yard well and its stone lip, the bare trough, the Clay Yard and its walked-around places, the kindling, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Smoke 23 earned its morning by its own light and was not brought into a day that had not earned it, the boy coming into his two hundred and sixty-second day and six months and eighty-two days with nobody saying so, no bell, market or Cross, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and sixty-two days, three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings with no seventh and none invented to fill the empty place, the widow’s mark untouched because a yard, a rack, a well and a bed are not openings, Smoke 30 seven mornings ahead and the first firing of Frost far off (T071/T072, T088, T058/T079, T061/T082); one crust two inches off with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread frozen, cold at cheek, temple and wrist, the afterdrop waiting, the surgeon taking the inventory in its old order and entering none of it (T060/T086); Sella went to the fire before the basket, told the coals the thaw, turned them with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted toward no opening, pushed the coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, moved her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and gave every instruction to the fire, the pot, the wool and the water and never to the basket (T100); \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change came in the plain work of the morning:} the boy saw that the house keeps itself by not-doings --- the two lines in the corner not swept, the mark not touched, the charcoal not read, the fifth pull not supplied, the loan not called, no number spoken over the basket, the crust not lifted --- and kept the seeing as a finding with no payer, not a grievance, a lesson or a doctrine, and did not lay the house’s omissions across his own kept empty intervals with a finger between them, for a joining would want a payer and none stood, the absence of the joining itself kept, entered nowhere and not spent (T071/T072, T061/T082); the dressed grain was lifted at a corner for damp under the wool on the cool stone at the rack end and laid back with no figure, changed in state and gaining nothing, the arithmetic read over it on Smoke 30 that would not know its cost and the space between figure and price still unsigned (T077); Ilva was glimpsed once at the well drawing with the pail against her knee, clay dried pale in her nail crescents and grey rack dust worked into the seam of one thumb, her hand going toward her sleeve and staying there, her eyes going to the asker before her mouth answered the question put and not the one behind it --- Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account --- the notched birch staying in her sleeve, not taken out, read, asked about or joined to the reed-cutter’s cord, the knots, the pages, the tins, the charcoal under the shelf or any other private keeping, no tenth hand filed and the ninth staying nine (T080 held); the neighbour’s cost-question went to the pot and went off level with nothing slopped, a man come down the clay road brought a number up out of a fist toward the well, looked at it and put it back into his sleeve so the figure arrived nowhere and had not been withheld, and the white edge on the well lip went grey under the bucket and the yard called the whole of it weather, kept on a place of its own with no cause (T015/T041/T047 held, T083/T085); Garl was kept in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and sixty-two days, the tile debt circled without a name and no collector up or down the clay road on Smoke 22 or 23 (T009/T013/T092); the yard went around the seven walked-around places, including the returning-line place where the hand went in on Seed 15, carried and not named, not paid and not joined to the shelf’s two gaps or the one crust (T098); Tarn at the kindling instructed the broom before taking it up, said Yes, house and Six counted. The next I don’t count, set six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged sentence, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped there as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight, Ash in the knuckles, the clip-ring at the wrist, the warm stone cold and unreconciled in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006); Jorra at the wheel-shed parted meal-fine dust from clean as a surgeon parts clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel before any person, told a pot You’ll do, withheld the note he knew three turns ahead, kept the burned-slate word at four, the two shut-room tellings at two and the three pot sayings with the premature Smoke 14 note apart, gave no name to the men who went low into the back room before first grey, held his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, and kept he’s not Vail sealed and the promise ungiven (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T064); Sella carried him up at the going of the light at the half-pace, went wide around the places, set him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look at his face, left the thread frozen, told the fire the thaw, turned the coals and went to her own bed; the hand went up an inch toward the low note and came down before the letting-go of a borrowed count from the room that does not touch, borrowing no stroke (ninety-nine), and in the small hours went up an inch and, with the inch held, carried one rhythm across the little silence after a count that had ended in the other room as an object in its own right, crossing no second count and filling nothing to make a stroke in a row that had none, and came down on the river’s next low note (one hundred), both filed on the sixth place with no payer named, and 262 stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody as the count went forward into Smoke 24 (T061/T082, T071/T072).}
\CRday{Day 263}{Smoke 24, Fourthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, loaf shelf’s low angle, kiln mouth and boards, the drying racks and the cool stone at the rack end, the yard well with its lip gone grey under the bucket, the Clay Yard and its walked-around places, the terrace, the kindling, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (not entered), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his two hundred and sixty-third day and six months and eighty-three days with nobody saying so, the third working week going out as it had come in, an ordinary tending that had learned nothing from the reading, the nothing learned kept as a finding with no payer and not a lesson, no bell, market or Cross, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and sixty-three days, three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings with no seventh, the heard bell beside the told and the told figure beside the paid with Smoke’s second arithmetic gone up the road in a locked box and unread under this roof, the widow’s mark hanging where it hangs at shelf, well, rack, road, basket, yard, afternoon and dusk, Smoke 30 six mornings ahead and not brought early and the first firing of Frost far off (T071/T072, T088, T058/T079, T077, T061/T082); one stiff leathery brown-edged crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread froze unwiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint, the afterdrop waited past a warming nobody would perform, and the surgeon entered none of it (T060/T086); Sella went to the fire before the basket, told the coals the thaw, turned them with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted toward no opening, pushed the coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, moved her lips along a two-gapped row without a figure, set the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and gave the instruction to the fire, the pot, the wool and the water and never to the basket; she turned the dressed grain under wool for damp on the cool stone at the rack end and laid the fold back with no figure, so that the arithmetic read over it on Smoke 30 would not know what it cost and the space between figure and price stayed unsigned (T077, T100); frost had gone out of the well lip under the bucket and the yard called the whole of it weather, and a wrong wind off High Kiln brought the sweet edge of lead glaze over the boards, touched the fold and went out on the wind that brought it --- a direction arrived nowhere, not a second edge paid, not a fourth saying about a pot, not a likeness of the man carried out of the glaze room on Day 188 and not a cause (T083/T085, T064); at the door a neighbour’s cost-question went to the pot and the weather with nothing slopped, and at the well a man brought a fist-number up toward the water, looked at it and put it back into his sleeve so the figure arrived nowhere and had not been withheld, the figure read kept apart from the figure paid (T015/T041/T047 held); Garl was kept in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and sixty-three days, the salt-stiff coat, hollow wheel-seat and crackless proverb intact, the tile debt neither paid nor settled nor done with, and no collector up or down the clay road on Smoke 22, 23 or 24 (T009/T013/T092); the yard went around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, including the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, carried and not named (T098); Tarn at the kindling set six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged sentence, instructed the broom before taking it up, said Yes, house and Six counted. The next I don’t count, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped there as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, drew the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight, Ash in the knuckles, the clip-ring at the wrist, the warm stone cold in its loft pot and unreconciled by not trying, the loan uncalled and no collector on the road (T036/T076, T006); Jorra at the wheel-shed came through with meal-fine grey dust past the bent finger and white in a fist’s creases, parted dusty forearms from clean, spoke to the wheel before any person, told a pot You’ll do, withheld the note he knew three turns ahead, kept the burned-slate word at four, the two shut-room tellings at two and the three pot sayings with the premature Smoke 14 note apart, gave no name to the men who went low into the back room before first grey, held his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, kept he’s not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn, and lost no pot and gave no name to what ailed the man carried out on Day 188 (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T064); Sella carried him up at the going of the light at the half-pace, went wide around the places, set him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look at his face, left the thread frozen, told the fire the thaw, turned the coals, counted under her breath toward no opening and went to her own bed, the one opening before Smoke 1 staying behind the household with no lesson, sign, mending or payer named; in the small hours he turned the file out as instruments on a towel and found the whole of it exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air --- six hearings with no seventh and none invented to fill the empty place, three near-full answers, three pot sayings with the premature note on its own place, four low things with water over water a fifth, told bell beside heard and told figure beside paid with the second arithmetic up the road in a locked box and the figure read over the covered grain still not the figure paid, nine stoppings with no tenth, three held changes plus the loft scrape, the pale line and the held inch on six places, nine record-first hands with the ninth taken from the firing work and her strip unread in her sleeve, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth, the covered grain unfigured, the pan’s gone ring, the shelf’s two gaps and the fold’s one crust with its gap on trays that do not touch, the ownerless question at five askings with no owner, no witness and no row named and no sixth asking, and the house’s not-doings on a place of their own with his own kept gaps on another, a finger between them, the finding that a not-doing keeps entered nowhere and not turned into a rule (T061/T082, T080 held, T101 held, T100); the hand went up an inch toward the river’s note, held for the small intake and came down on the river’s next low note and not on the kiln’s gap, keeping the three counts in three places that did not become one (one hundred and one), and on the hundred and second it went up an inch, held for the small intake, came down on the next low note, and left the little silence after the count in the other room whole and empty on its own place beside the held one, no rhythm carried across it and nothing supplied to make a stroke in a row that had none --- an empty object, a keeping and not a miss, not a longer reach, a hearing, a seventh, a stopping, a payment, a held change, a key, a power or a rule, with no likeness made a rule and no payer named (T061/T082); 263 stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill and Grath, ninety-six answers had become one hundred and two and none was a reach, the fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and sixty-three days with its payer unnamed, the widow’s mark hanging, the grain covered and unfigured, the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, Smoke 30 six mornings ahead and unbrought, the first firing of Frost far off, the towel lying on nothing but the fold with every tray parted and every gap left gap, and the hand laid back against the fold on the hundred and second answer while the kiln under the floor kept its silence where the fifth should stand, the count going forward into Smoke 25 (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082).}
