Sella’s grammar held exactly, fire before basket, instruction to the tools and never the basket, the dressed grain lifted and turned beneath the wool with a progressively lighter touch and no figure though a number was already travelling up the clay road that would not know what it cost, the widow’s mark untouched because a reading is not an opening, and the basket set in the moot-post’s finger’s width of thin shade where no slate lay with the boy standing half a pace off through the reading; \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and not paid:} Berr Clay came up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat and the green of tasted lead glaze at one corner of his mouth, under the hot clay the smell of nothing at all, wiped his thumb twice on his apron before touching nothing, passed a finger over a narrow figure, held the slate unopened to his forearm with the writing inward, read \emph{one in twelve, as the notice says} low into the two hundred, sent the figure over the basket once for the moot and a second time for the households that came late, told the man at the rail who held a number up out of a fist that the figure stood as read and his household had heard wrong, called the levy for Frost and denied it with \emph{The levy is called. It is not called by me} and \emph{your house}, never \emph{I}, taking himself out of his own sentence as a surgeon takes a hand out of a field before the dressing goes on, and went off toward High Kiln with the box locked and believing he had done a kindness; Frost’s second true subtraction went up beside the first and the district’s arithmetic changed a second time for the month where two hundred people stood and could not be changed back, the printed figure unchallenged and the figure read still not the figure paid, while the figures over the basket and over the covered grain knew nothing of the man carried out on Day 188, the hand that went in on Seed 15 or the price under the wool; Hessa took Berr’s narrow slate up the clay road toward Greybank before noon edge-on to her forearm with the writing to her sleeve, answered the women who asked with \emph{I don’t read it. I carry it} and \emph{Reading goes up before noon. I’ve got a road to walk}, and was not made a reader by either shaping of the well-saying; the soft-cuffed clerk stayed set at the out-of-line landing with his cuff grey again by midday and his buyer’s number entered before he looked up, and the market sold over him as water goes over a stone; the bell went four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself and stayed in the square beside the told bell, not folded into the three counts; at the pot board a silent woman with the sweetish green of lead glaze at one corner of her mouth, clay pale under her nails and a pale cord-mark across the back of one hand, turned a cup a quarter and set it back where it stood, and at the market’s edge a child in cast-off clothes worn like a uniform never measured for him, with silt pale in his wrist creases, a gap where a front tooth had been and a green sliver on a string at his throat, turned half a beat after a pot was set down, both sightings only, a colour and a shape with no eighth and no name, never Fenna or Ulda in the narration; Sella carried him home at the going of the light saying nothing of what had been read over him, set him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look at his face, left the thread frozen, told the fire it was the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, kept her finger above the charcoal and her lips along the two-gapped row and gave every instruction to the tools and never the basket; in the small hours the hand took the space between the moot’s reading and the late households’ reading and set it beside his own unnamed gap with a finger between (one hundred and fifty-three), a told figure beside a paid figure and neither made to agree, and then the heard bell’s gap held beside a counted breath from the room whose floor does not touch his (one hundred and fifty-four), crossing no silence that belonged to another’s breathing, and nothing of the reading came back under the roof as lesson, sign, mending, cause or payment.}
\CRday{Day 290}{Frost 21, Firstday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, boards, pot board and towel, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well and flat stone, the drying racks and rack end, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the Debt Loft (heard only), and back under the roof in the small hours, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Frost 21 came on its own ordinary Firstday with no market, Cross or bell, the grey discovered on the well lip where no grey had lain when the coals were banked, the count crossing from two hundred and eighty-nine to two hundred and ninety exact, six months and one hundred and ten days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and ninety days, three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings with no seventh, the heard bell staying in its square, both arithmetics locked in Berr’s box, the two shapings held beside Hessa’s eighth hand, Frost 30 standing nine mornings ahead and unbrought, and the boy taking the body in its old order of crust, unnamed gap, frozen thread, cold and afterdrop and entering none of it (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T060/T086, T078); Sella’s grammar held exactly at the fire and the grain, the wool told to keep the river wind off his ears, the broom told to go around, the pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, the charcoal unread, the widow’s mark untouched at a morning, the dressed grain turned beneath the wool with a lighter touch and no figure, and the clay jar glanced at once with the hand shut half over nothing; the hand took the small intake of the river’s note and held it past that count’s letting-go and through the little silence after it, leaving the silence whole and empty and not filled to make a row come out even (one hundred and fifty-five); in the afternoon the yard went around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, the stayed frost and the silt-clouded plate of ice on its flat stone were called weather with no fourth likeness made a cause, Tarn at the kindling kept six checkable and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, his chest tight, Seed 16 breath unspent, Ash in his knuckles and the pale clip-ring at his wrist, Jorra at the wheel-shed edge kept dusty and clean forearms on one tray, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s sentence, withheld the note he knew three turns ahead and kept the burned slate at four, the shut-room tellings at two, three pot sayings with the Smoke 14 note apart, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness and he’s not Vail sealed, while the promise of the boy’s name was neither given nor withdrawn, and Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and ninety days and no collector on the clay road; at the going of the light Sella carried him up at the half-pace from every open slate; in the small hours the file was turned out with every tray parted by a finger’s width, the Frost 14 saying standing at one saying and one second shaping beside Hessa Rale’s eighth hand with a finger between, not a witness, not a confession, not a joining and not paid, and the hand took the held interval and the empty interval from the file, set them side by side with a finger between, borrowed no house count, supplied no fifth to the kiln, crossed no silence that belonged to another’s breathing and came down on the river’s next low note of water over water (one hundred and fifty-six), exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, a round threshold not a doctrine, the surgeon’s clean satisfaction checked by the infant’s plain want of the crust and the checking not called a virtue; 290 stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill and Grath, six months and one hundred and ten days were told by nobody, the fire’s fifth stood unpaid the same number of days, the hand laid back against the fold on the one hundred and fifty-sixth answer, the file open on the towel with every gap left gap, the river’s low note going quiet, and nothing opened, named, called, paid or ended.}
\CRday{Day 291}{Frost 22, Secondday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, boards, pot board and towel, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well and flat stone, the drying racks and rack end, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the Debt Loft (heard only), and back under the roof in the small hours, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Frost 22 came on its own ordinary Secondday with no market, Cross or bell, the count going from two hundred and ninety to two hundred and ninety-one exact, six months and one hundred and eleven days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and ninety-one days with its payer unnamed, the kiln’s four low pulls and its silence, the river’s water over water and the boards’ four, four and a thumb-width knot keeping three counts in three places that did not become one because agreeing any two would want a payer and none stood to any, six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place kept empty, the heard bell’s four, four and a gap in its square beside the told bell, the told figure beside the paid with Frost’s first and second arithmetics locked in Berr’s box and the printed one in twelve unchallenged, the Frost 14 saying held with one saying and one second shaping beside Hessa’s eighth hand with a finger between and no third supplied, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, and Frost 30 six mornings ahead and unbrought (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T078, T080 held); the boy took the body in its old order of crust two inches off with its empty place unnamed and no third, frozen thread unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint, and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, wanting the crust while knowing a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from the outside and slowly, the surgeon taking the inventory and the infant keeping the want with neither authority over the other (T060/T086); Sella went to the fire before the basket, said The house will keep it, told the wool to keep the river wind off his ears, turned the coals with a broken pot, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, moved her lips along a two-gapped row with no figure, glanced at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, left the widow’s mark untouched at a morning, turned the dressed grain beneath the wool with a lighter touch and no figure, set the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and gave every instruction to the fire, the wool, the pot, the broom and the running water and never to the basket (T058/T079, T100, T077); in the afternoon the yard went around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, the stayed frost, the skinned trough and the silt-clouded plate of ice stayed weather entered nowhere with no fourth likeness made a cause, Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and ninety-one days and no collector on the clay road, Tarn kept six where the house could check and a seventh at the lip with the ear-sentence stopped as a remembered ninth stopping and the Seed 16 breath unspent, Jorra kept meal-fine grey dust on his forearms, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person and put his bent finger into the cold damper, and no voice came over the boards (T009/T013/T092, T083/T085 held, T036/T076, T035/T031/T062); in the small hours the hand took the fire’s silence carried across the interval to the first morning’s going (one hundred and fifty-seven) and later two intakes from the room whose floor does not touch his held apart with a finger between and the letting-go left where it was (one hundred and fifty-eight), each exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, the surgeon’s clean satisfaction checked by the infant’s louder want and the checking not called a virtue, 291 standing exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody, the file open on the towel with every gap left gap, nothing opened, joined, named, called, paid or ended (T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 292}{Frost 23, Thirdday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, boards, pot board and rack end, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well, boards and well-roof, flat stone, trough and drying racks, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the Debt Loft (heard only), and back under the roof in the small hours, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Frost 23 came on its own ordinary Thirdday with no market, Cross or bell and nothing of the days behind brought into it, the count going from two hundred and ninety-one to two hundred and ninety-two exact, six months and one hundred and twelve days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and ninety-two days, the smells of hot clay cooled under tallow, wet wool and the sour breath of the unswept corner called the thaw, three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings with no seventh, the heard bell beside the told, the two shapings of the Frost 14 saying kept as shapings so a third could be filed beside them, Frost’s two arithmetics locked up the clay road with the space between figure and price unsigned, and Frost 30 six mornings ahead and unbrought (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T077, T080 held); the body was inventoried in the old order of crust two inches off with its unnamed gap, frozen thread, cold at cheek, temple and wrist and the afterdrop waiting, the composed face that is not composure and the want of the crust checked by the knowledge that a man must be warmed slowly (T060/T086); Sella’s grammar held exactly at the fire and the grain, fire before basket, The house will keep it, the charcoal unread, the widow’s mark untouched at a morning, the pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and the dressed grain turned beneath the wool with a progressively lighter touch and no figure read over by numbers that did not know its cost (T058/T079, T100, T077); the hand filed the hundred and fifty-ninth answer with the fire’s silence carried down onto the river’s note and the two sounds kept in two places and not made to agree, and in the afternoon, after the yard went around its seven places and the stayed frost, trough and plate of ice stayed weather, \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change came as an ownerless voice over the boards and the well-roof, with no owner standing, no room, no hand at a slate, no name, no figure, no confession and no cause, giving the Frost 14 saying a third shaping --- the slate-runner once carried a name the district spent and did not say whose --- and going on with the day the way the yard says the weather}, which the boy took apart as a surgeon takes a wound apart, the absence being the finding, and filed beside the first and second with a finger between every pair on a place of its own beside Hessa’s eighth hand, toward the far-off choosing; three shapings did not stand up as a witness, a cause, a confession, a joining, a rule or a payment, did not make Hessa a reader, were not joined to Ilva’s strip, Berr’s thumb, the clerk’s inward slate or the charcoal, and were expressly not a sixth asking of the row, which stayed at five askings with one shaping and no witness (T080 advanced and not paid, T101 held, T035/T031/T065/T095 and T064 held); Tarn at the kindling kept six and a held seventh with the ear-sentence stopped at the calling word as a remembered ninth stopping, Jorra kept his dusty forearms and his withheld knowing and put his bent finger into the cold damper, Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and ninety-two days, and Sella heard the voice and brought nothing under the roof as lesson, figure, mending, cause or payment; in the small hours the hand took two intakes held apart with a finger between where the three shapings stood with a finger between every pair, filing the hundred and sixtieth answer exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, 292 standing exact, complete and spoken by nobody, nothing opened, joined, named, called, paid or ended (T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 293}{Frost 24, Fourthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, boards, pot board and towel, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well and flat stone, the drying racks and rack end, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the Debt Loft (heard only), and back under the roof in the small hours, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Frost 24 came on its own ordinary Fourthday with no market, Cross or bell, yesterday’s third shaping not brought into the morning as a witness, cause, confession or payment, the count going from two hundred and ninety-two to two hundred and ninety-three exact, six months and one hundred and thirteen days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and ninety-three days, three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings with no seventh, the heard bell beside the told, the told figure beside the paid, the Frost 14 saying with its first, second and third shapings on a place of its own beside Hessa’s eighth hand with a finger between every pair, the boy’s own gaps on another with a finger between the two keepings, and Frost 30 six mornings ahead and not made a sign (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T080 held, T060/T086); the body was inventoried in its old order of crust two inches off, unnamed gap, frozen thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the older keeping the inventory and the younger the wanting with neither authority over the other; Sella went to the fire before the basket, said The house will keep it, turned the coals with a broken pot, kept the charcoal unread, moved her lips along a two-gapped row with no figure, glanced at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, set the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, left the widow’s mark untouched at a morning and a going of the light, turned the dressed grain beneath the wool with a lighter touch and no figure, carried him down and up at the half-pace from every open slate, and gave no instruction at any hour to the basket (T058/T079, T100, T077); the hand took the letting-go of an intake on the river’s note, kept it whole and set it beside the held interval with a finger between, not an ending made early, not a freedom and not a gift, filing the hundred and sixty-first answer as restraint and not attainment; in the afternoon the yard went around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, the stayed frost, the skinned trough and the silt-clouded plate of ice stayed weather entered nowhere with no fourth likeness made a cause, Tarn kept six checkable and a seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence with the ear-sentence stopped as a remembered ninth stopping, the Seed 16 breath unspent, Ash in the knuckle creases, the pale clip-ring and his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, the loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness, Jorra came through with meal-fine grey slate dust, parted dusty forearms from clean, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, withheld the full note and put his bent finger into the cold damper, and Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and ninety-three days and no collector up or down the clay road (T083/T085 held, T036/T076, T006, T035/T031/T062, T009/T013/T092); in the small hours the file was turned out on the towel as instruments on a tray with every gap left gap and every tray parted by a finger’s width, six hearings with the seventh place empty, the heard bell beside the told, three pot sayings with the Smoke 14 note apart, the burned slate at four, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, nine stoppings with no tenth, nine hands with Ilva’s ninth unread, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape, and the three shapings beside Hessa’s eighth hand not standing up as a witness, for a witness stands somewhere and can be asked and none stood; the hand took the held interval and the empty interval, set them side by side with a finger between, borrowed no house count, supplied no fifth and came down on the river’s next low note, filing the hundred and sixty-second answer exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, neither interval promoted into a reach, a hearing, a gift, a keeping, a seventh, a stopping, a payment, a held change, a key, a power, a freedom, a doctrine or a rule, a round threshold not a doctrine and three shapings not a witness; 293 stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill and Grath, six months and one hundred and thirteen days were told by nobody, the fire’s fifth was unpaid the same number of days, and the hand laid itself back against the fold on the one hundred and sixty-second answer, the crust two inches off, the file open on the towel with every gap left gap, the frost white on the well lip and the plate of ice clouded on its flat stone, and the river’s low note going quiet after the hand came down, nothing opened, joined, named, called, paid or ended (T061/T082, T080 held).}
\CRday{Day 294}{Frost 25, Fifthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, boards, pot board and towel, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well with the stayed frost-bloom and the flat stone where the silt-clouded plate of ice stood out of the path of feet, the trough skinned edge to edge, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling and flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and back under the roof in the small hours, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Frost 25 came on its own ordinary Fifthday with no market, Cross or bell, bringing nothing from the day behind, the count going from two hundred and ninety-three to two hundred and ninety-four exact, six months and one hundred and fourteen days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and ninety-four days with its payer unnamed, three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings with the seventh place empty, the heard bell beside the told, the told figure beside the paid, Frost’s two arithmetics locked up the road with the printed one in twelve unchallenged, the three shapings of the Frost 14 saying held beside Hessa’s eighth hand with a finger between every pair and no fourth supplied, and Frost 30 five mornings ahead and not made a sign (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T078, T080 held); the boy took the body in its old order of crust two inches off with its empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint, and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon taking the inventory while the infant kept the want of the crust with neither authority over the other (T060/T086); Sella went to the fire before the basket, told the coals it was the thaw, turned them with the back of a broken pot, said The house will keep it where another woman would have said I, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge so the charcoal stayed unread, moved her lips along a two-gapped row with no figure, glanced at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, set the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, turned the dressed grain beneath the wool with a lighter touch and no figure, left the widow’s mark untouched because a morning is not an opening, went wide around the seven places with a look and no number, carried him down and up at the half-pace from every open slate and set him on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft (T058/T079, T100, T077); Tarn at the kindling kept six in the thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl Vail’s unforged collector sentence, said Six counted. The next I don’t count, said Yes, house to early and late and kept the late because it puts off the paying, stopped the ear-sentence at the word that would call the loan as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, kept the Seed 16 breath unspent, Ash in his knuckles and the pale clip-ring at his wrist, his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, the loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying, no collector on the clay road (T036/T076, T006), and Jorra parted dusty forearms from clean, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence and withheld the knowing of the full note while the burned slate stood at four, the shut-room tellings at two, three pot sayings with the Smoke 14 note apart, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, he’s not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T101, T064); Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and ninety-four days and the tile debt worse for being uncalled, the missing hand carried and not named, the stayed frost and the silt-clouded plate called weather and entered nowhere, no fourth likeness made a cause and no payer named (T009/T013/T092, T098, T083/T085 held); in the small hours the hand took the small intake from the next room at its top and set it beside the kiln’s fourth pull with a finger between, did not carry it into the missing fifth, left the gap a gap and borrowed no house count, filing the hundred and sixty-third answer exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air and promoted into no reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, gift, doctrine or rule, the surgeon’s clean satisfaction checked by the infant’s louder want of the crust and the checking not called a virtue (T061/T082); the hand laid back against the fold, 294 standing exact, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill and Grath, six months and one hundred and fourteen days told by nobody, the fire’s fifth unpaid the same number of days, the file open on the towel with the held and empty intervals parted by a finger and nothing that had moved, the river’s low note going quiet under the finger’s-width door and nothing opened, joined, named, called, paid or ended (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 295}{Frost 26, Sixthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, boards, pot board and towel, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well and stone lip where Ilva drew with the pail against her knee and a neighbour’s slate lay open with its writing turned inward, the stayed frost-bloom and the flat stone with the silt-clouded plate of ice, the trough skinned edge to edge, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling and flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and back under the roof in the small hours, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Frost 26 came on its own ordinary Sixthday with no market, Cross or bell, bringing nothing in with it, the count going from two hundred and ninety-four to two hundred and ninety-five exact, six months and one hundred and fifteen days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and ninety-five days with its payer unnamed, hot clay cooled under tallow, wet wool and the sour mineral breath of the unswept corner called the thaw in the small hours, the kiln answering in fours with its gap and not a bell, three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings with the seventh place empty, the heard bell beside the told, the told figure beside the paid, Frost’s two arithmetics locked up the road with one in twelve unchallenged, three shapings of the Frost 14 saying beside Hessa’s eighth hand and Ilva’s ninth hand held at nine with the strip unread in her sleeve, and Frost 30 four mornings ahead and not made a sign (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T060/T086, T078, T080 held); the boy took the body in its old order of crust two inches off with its unnamed gap and no third, thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint, and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the older keeping the inventory and the younger the want with neither authority over the other (T060/T086); Sella went to the fire before the basket, told it the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, kept her finger above the charcoal so the tally stayed unread, moved her lips along a two-gapped row with no figure, glanced at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist, set the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, turned the dressed grain beneath the wool with a lighter touch and no figure, left the widow’s mark untouched because a morning is not an opening, and set the basket at the edge of the work where no slate lay (T058/T079, T100, T077); in the afternoon, at the yard well, \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and not paid:} Ilva of the firing work drew with the pail against her knee, clay dried pale in the crescents of her nails and finer grey rack dust worked into the seam of one thumb she did not scrub out, and to a neighbour with a pot who asked what the month’s firings had taken now the month was nearly out her hand went toward her sleeve and stayed there, the short strip of notched birch bark not taken out, read, asked about, copied, counted or joined to the open slate on the stone lip and no figure coming off the wood, her eyes going to the asker after the hand settled and her mouth opening after both, answering the question put and not the one behind it: Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account. She put the flat of her hand down once more on the sleeve and went back to the pail, and nobody turned twice; the boy took the order of reaching --- hand to the record, eyes to the asker, mouth after both --- and filed it as the \textbf{ninth} record-first hand on a place of its own beside the eighth with a finger between every pair, filed \textbf{no tenth}, took no figure off the wood, kept the slate’s nearness as an absence and did not make Ilva a reader, a witness, a party or a story, the count staying in wood where no slate could take a figure off it (T080 advanced, not paid); Sella heard the exchange where she stood with the broom and went on with the house, bringing nothing under the roof as lesson, figure, mending, cause or payment, and the stayed frost, the skinned trough and the silt-clouded plate remained weather entered nowhere with no fourth likeness made a cause (T083/T085 held); Tarn at the kindling kept six in the thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl Vail’s unforged collector sentence, said Six counted. The next I don’t count and Yes, house to early and late, kept the late because it puts off the paying, stopped the ear-sentence at the calling word as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, kept the Seed 16 breath unspent, Ash in the knuckles, the pale clip-ring at the wrist, his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, the loft stone cold and unreconciled, no collector on the clay road (T036/T076, T006), while Jorra parted dusty forearms from clean, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, put his bent finger into the cold damper and withheld the knowing of the full note, the burned slate at four, the shut-room tellings at two, three pot sayings with the Smoke 14 note apart, the row at five askings with one shaping, he’s not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T101, T064); Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and ninety-five days and the tile debt worse for being uncalled (T009/T013/T092); in the small hours the hand set the river’s low note on one side of the finger and a letting-go from the next room on the other, two sounds in two places with neither crossing and no fifth supplied to the kiln, filing the hundred and sixty-fifth answer, and then laid the order of the reaching on the ninth hand’s own place with the slate’s nearness kept as an absence, filing the hundred and sixty-sixth, each exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air and promoted into no reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, gift, doctrine or rule (T061/T082, T080 advanced); the hand laid back against the fold, 295 standing exact, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill and Grath, six months and one hundred and fifteen days told by nobody, the fire’s fifth unpaid the same number of days, the file open on the towel with every gap left gap, the strip still in the sleeve a pace off and the ninth hand left nine, and the river’s low note going quiet under the door (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 296}{Frost 27, Seventhday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, boards, pot board and towel, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well with the stayed frost-bloom, the skinned trough and the flat stone where the silt-clouded plate of ice stood out of the path of feet, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling and flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and back under the roof in the small hours, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Frost 27 came on its own ordinary Seventhday with no market, Cross or bell and brought nothing in with it, yesterday’s sighting at the well not brought into the day as sign, lesson, mending, witness, cause or payment, the count going from two hundred and ninety-five to two hundred and ninety-six exact, six months and one hundred and sixteen days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and ninety-six days with its payer unnamed, the kiln answering in fours with its gap and not a bell, three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings with the seventh place empty, the heard bell beside the told, the told figure beside the paid, Frost’s two arithmetics locked up the road with one in twelve unchallenged, the three shapings of the Frost 14 saying beside Hessa’s eighth hand, Ilva’s ninth hand held at nine with the strip unread in a sleeve not under this roof today, the row at five askings with one shaping, the burned slate at four, the shut-room tellings at two and nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T080 held, T101, T036/T076); the boy took the body in its old order of crust two inches off with its unnamed gap and no third, thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint, and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the knowing that a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from the outside and slowly buying nothing at two inches of air, the older keeping the inventory and the younger the want (T060/T086); Sella went to the fire before the basket, told it the thaw, turned the coals with the back of a broken pot, said The house will keep it, kept her finger above the charcoal, moved her lips along a two-gapped row with no figure, glanced at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak showed pale, stood a moment counting under her breath toward no opening, set the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, turned the dressed grain beneath the wool with a lighter touch and no figure and left the widow’s mark untouched, because a morning is not an opening (T058/T079, T100, T077); in the afternoon the yard went around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, the stayed frost, the skinned trough and the silt-clouded plate called weather and entered nowhere with no fourth likeness made a cause and no payer named (T083/T085 held, T009/T013/T092, T098 carried), the grain turned once more beneath the wool with no figure (T077), Tarn at the kindling keeping six checkable and the seventh at the lip beside Garl Vail’s unforged collector sentence, bringing the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopping as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, the Seed 16 breath unspent, Ash in the knuckles, the pale clip-ring at the wrist, his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, the loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying, the loan uncalled and no collector up or down the clay road (T036/T076, T006), and Jorra parting dusty forearms from clean, speaking to the wheel and a pot before any person, putting his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence and withholding the knowing of the full note while the burned slate stood at four, the shut-room tellings at two, three pot sayings with the Smoke 14 note apart, the row at five askings with one shaping, he’s not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T064, T101); Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and ninety-six days and the tile debt worse for being uncalled (T009/T013/T092); the last tend of Frost went out as it had come in with no boundary drawn, neither habit of naming the months set right or left wrong, Frost 30 (Day 299) standing three mornings ahead and not brought into a day that had not earned it (T015/T041/T047/T077); at the going of the light Sella carried him up at the half-pace, set him on his bed under the roof and not in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look, left the thread frozen, told the fire it was the thaw, turned the coals with a broken pot, set the pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and kept her finger above the charcoal; in the small hours the file was turned out on the towel as instruments on a tray, six hearings with the seventh place empty, the heard bell beside the told, the told figure beside the paid, three shapings beside Hessa’s eighth hand, nine hands and nine stoppings with no tenth, five askings with one shaping and no witness, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth, the house’s not-doings apart from his own gaps with a finger between, and nothing standing up and calling itself a rule (T061/T082, T080 held, T101, T050/T051, T033/T034); the morning’s temptation to lay the held interval and the empty interval together and call the joining a total was refused, the empty interval set beside the held one with a finger between, the finger put down and taken up and both left where they were, a keeping and not a spending, filing the hundred and sixty-seventh answer; at the very end of the day a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his was taken at its top and let go on the same note, whole and unjoined, the hand coming down on the river’s low note without supplying the kiln’s fifth or crossing the letting-go, filing the hundred and sixty-eighth, each answer exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air and promoted into no reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, gift, doctrine or rule (T061/T082); the hand laid back against the fold, one hundred and sixty-eight answers standing on the sixth place, 296 standing exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill and Grath, six months and one hundred and sixteen days told by nobody, the fire’s fifth unpaid the same number of days, nothing opened, joined, named, called, paid or ended and no thread opened or closed, the file open on the towel with every gap left gap and nothing that had moved, the crust two inches off with its empty place unnamed, the plate of ice standing clouded with silt out of the path of feet, and the river’s low note going quiet under the finger’s-width door (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T083/T085 held, T080 held).}
\CRday{Day 297}{Frost 28, Eighthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, boards, pot board and towel, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well and flat stone, the drying racks and rack end, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the Debt Loft (heard only), and back under the roof in the small hours, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Frost 28 came on its own ordinary Eighthday with no market, Cross or bell, bringing nothing in with it, the count going from two hundred and ninety-six to two hundred and ninety-seven exact, six months and one hundred and seventeen days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and ninety-seven days with its payer unnamed, the kiln answering in fours with its gap and not a bell, three counts in three places that did not become one because agreeing any two would want a payer and none stood, six hearings with the seventh place empty, the heard bell in its square beside the told, Frost’s first and second arithmetics locked up the clay road with one in twelve unchallenged and the figure read still not the figure paid, the stayed frost, skinned trough and silt-clouded plate called weather and entered nowhere, three shapings of the Frost 14 saying beside Hessa Rale’s eighth hand, Ilva’s ninth hand held at nine with the strip unread in her sleeve, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, and Frost 30 two mornings ahead and not made a sign (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T078, T080 held, T101); the boy took the body in its old order of crust two inches off with its unnamed gap and no third, thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint, and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, wanting the crust lifted while knowing a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from the outside and slowly, the surgeon taking the inventory and the infant keeping the want with neither authority over the other (T060/T086); Sella went to the fire before the basket, told it the thaw, turned the coals with the back of a broken pot, said The house will keep it, kept her finger above the charcoal, moved her lips along a two-gapped row with no figure, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, pushed coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist, set the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, turned the dressed grain beneath the wool with a progressively lighter touch and no figure, left the widow’s mark untouched because a morning is not an opening, went wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, carried him down and up at the half-pace from every open slate and gave every instruction to the fire, the wool, the pot, the broom and the running water and never to the basket (T058/T079, T100, T077); at the yard well, \textbf{Ilva was seen again}, drawing with the pail against her knee, clay pale in the crescents of her nails and fine rack dust worked into a thumb seam she did not scrub out, and to a neighbour who asked what the month’s firings had taken now the month was nearly out her hand went toward her sleeve and stayed there, the notched birch strip not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the open slate on the stone lip and no figure coming off the wood, her eyes going to the asker after the hand settled and her mouth opening after both, answering Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account; the boy filed the order of reaching as the \textbf{ninth} record-first hand on a place of its own beside the eighth with a finger between every pair, filed \textbf{no tenth}, took no figure off the wood, kept the slate’s nearness as an absence and made her no reader, witness, party or story, and nothing of the exchange came under the roof as lesson, figure, mending, cause or payment (T080 advanced, not paid); a wrong wind off High Kiln brought the sweet edge of lead glaze over the boards, touched the fold and went out on the wind that brought it, a direction arrived nowhere and not a second edge paid; Tarn at the kindling kept six in the thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, said Six counted. The next I don’t count and Yes, house to early and late, kept the late because it puts off the paying, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, kept the Seed 16 breath unspent, Ash in his knuckles and the pale clip-ring at his wrist, his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, the loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying, the loan uncalled and no collector on the clay road (T036/T076, T006); Jorra came through with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal past the bent finger, parted dusty forearms from clean, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, withheld the knowing of the full note, gave the men in the back room no name and did not say the room was cold, while the burned slate stood at four, the shut-room tellings at two, three pot sayings with the Smoke 14 note apart, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, and he’s not Vail sealed (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T101, T064); Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and ninety-seven days and no collector up or down the road (T009/T013/T092); in the small hours the hand took a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his at the end of the morning and let it go whole on the same note, filing the hundred and sixty-ninth answer, and another small intake at the very end of the day let go whole and unjoined, filing the hundred and seventieth, each exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air and promoted into no reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, gift, doctrine or rule (T061/T082); the hand laid back against the fold, 297 standing exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill and Grath, six months and one hundred and seventeen days told by nobody, the fire’s fifth unpaid the same number of days, the file open on the towel with every gap left gap, the crust two inches off, the plate of ice clouded with silt out of the path of feet, and the river’s low note going quiet under the finger’s-width door, nothing opened, joined, named, called, paid or ended and no thread opened or closed.}
\CRday{Day 298}{Frost 29, Ninthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, boards, pot board, oiled paper at the window and towel, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well and flat stone, the drying racks and rack end, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the Debt Loft (heard only), and back under the roof in the small hours, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Frost 29 came on its own ordinary Ninthday with no market, Cross or bell and brought nothing in with it, yesterday’s sighting at the well not carried in as sign, lesson, mending, witness, cause or payment, the count going from two hundred and ninety-seven to two hundred and ninety-eight exact, six months and one hundred and eighteen days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and ninety-eight days with its payer unnamed, hot clay cooled under tallow, wet wool and the sour mineral breath of the unswept corner called the thaw in the small hours, the kiln answering in fours with its gap and not a bell, three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings with the seventh place empty, the heard bell beside the told, the told figure beside the paid with Frost’s two arithmetics locked and unread in Berr’s box and one in twelve unchallenged, three shapings of the Frost 14 saying beside Hessa’s eighth hand, Ilva’s ninth hand held at nine with the strip unread in a sleeve not under this roof, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, the burned-slate word at four, the shut-room tellings at two and nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T080 held, T101); the boy took the body in its old order of crust two inches off with its unnamed gap and no third, thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint, and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the older keeping the inventory and the younger the want with neither authority over the other, and the naming buying nothing at two inches of air (T060/T086); Sella’s grammar held exactly at the fire and the grain, fire before basket, The house will keep it, the charcoal unread under a finger kept on top of the shelf’s front edge, the lips along a two-gapped row with no figure, the glance at the clay jar and the hand shut half over nothing, the grey streak pale off the low light, the pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, the dressed grain turned beneath the wool with a progressively lighter touch and no figure, and the widow’s mark untouched because a morning is not an opening (T058/T079, T100, T077); the yard went wide around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, the stayed frost, the skinned trough and the silt-clouded plate stayed weather entered nowhere with no fourth likeness made a cause and no payer named (T083/T085 held), Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and ninety-eight days (T009/T013/T092), Tarn kept six checkable and the seventh at the lip beside the unforged collector sentence, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, the Seed 16 breath unspent, Ash in the knuckles, the pale clip-ring at the wrist and his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, the loan uncalled and no collector on the clay road (T036/T076, T006), and Jorra parted dusty forearms from clean, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence and withheld the knowing of the full note while the burned slate stood at four, the shut-room tellings at two, three pot sayings with the Smoke 14 note apart, the row at five askings with one shaping, he’s not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T064, T101); back under the roof \textbf{he very nearly laid the house’s not-doings --- the two unswept lines, the mark untouched, the charcoal unread, the fire’s fifth pull unsupplied, the loan uncalled, no number over the basket and the crust not lifted --- across his own empty intervals, and put the finger between instead}, for a joining would have wanted a payer under both and none stood, so the absence of the joining was itself kept and not spent on its own place with a finger between (T061/T082); a small dry scrape from the loft, the foot of a pot set down on stone, was filed on a place of its own and not joined to the fraction at the damper, the returned beat beneath the shelf or the flagstone half-check (T006 held, T062 held); three shapings stayed three with no witness, nine hands stayed nine with Ilva’s strip unread and no tenth, and the row stayed at five askings with one shaping (T080 held, T101 held); in the small hours the hand held a small intake against the kiln’s fourth low pull without carrying it into the missing fifth, filing the hundred and seventy-first answer, and at the very end of the day took another small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his and let it go whole on the same note, filing the hundred and seventy-second, each exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air and promoted into no reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, gift, doctrine or rule (T061/T082); Frost 30 stood one morning off and was not brought into a day that had not earned it, the file open on the towel with every gap left gap, 298 standing exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody, the river’s low note going quiet under the finger’s-width door and the plate of ice standing clouded with silt out of the path of feet, nothing opened, joined, named, called, paid or ended.}
\CRday{Day 299}{Frost 30, Tenthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, boards, pot board and towel, then up the clay road past the terrace toward High Kiln and down to the Cross, the reading block under the moot-post with its finger’s width of thin shade, the pot board, the out-of-line landing below the north bridge, the clay road again, and home at the going of the light to the Clay Yard, the yard well and flat stone, the hearth and the bed, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Frost 30 came on its own morning as the month’s third and last Account-day and market, earned by that light and not brought into the day behind it, the count going from two hundred and ninety-eight to two hundred and ninety-nine exact, six months and one hundred and nineteen days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid two hundred and ninety-nine days with its payer unnamed, the body taken in its old order of crust two inches off with its unnamed gap, thread frozen and unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint, and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the older keeping the inventory and the younger the want (T060/T086), three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings with the seventh place empty, nine stoppings with no tenth, the row at five askings with one shaping, the burned slate at four, the shut-room tellings at two, three shapings of the Frost 14 saying beside Hessa’s eighth hand and a strip unread in a sleeve not under this roof, nine hands not standing up as a rule, and no bell before its morning (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T080 held, T101); Sella went to the fire before the basket, told the coals it was the thaw, turned them with the back of a broken pot, said The house will keep it, kept the charcoal unread, her lips along a two-gapped row, glanced once at the clay jar, set the pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, turned the dressed grain beneath the wool with a lighter touch and no figure though a number was already on its way that would not know what it cost, left the widow’s mark untouched because a reading is not an opening, carried him up at the half-pace from every open slate and set the basket under the moot-post’s finger’s width of thin shade where no slate lay, standing half a pace off through the reading (T058/T079, T100, T077); \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and not paid:} Berr Clay came up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat and the green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner, under the hot clay the smell of nothing at all, wiped his thumb twice on his apron before touching nothing, held a narrow slate unopened to his forearm with the writing inward, passed a finger over the figure, read One in twelve, as the notice says low into the two hundred, sent the figure over the basket twice --- once for the moot and once for the households that came late --- called the levy and denied it with The levy is called. It is not called by me and your house, never I, taking himself out of his own sentence as a surgeon takes a hand out of a field before the dressing goes on, told a man at the rail who brought a number up out of a fist that a number goes into a slate and there would be a slate at the watch, and went off toward High Kiln with the box locked and Frost’s third true subtraction inside beside the first two, believing he had done a kindness; the district’s arithmetic changed a third time for the month where two hundred people stood and could not be changed back, the printed figure unchallenged and the figure read still not the figure paid with no signature on the space between, and no figure answered for the man carried out on Day 188, the hand that went in on Seed 15 or the dressed grain lying covered under wool at the rack end, now read over a third time by a number that did not know what it cost (T015/T041/T047 advanced and not paid, T077); the boy kept the three Frost arithmetics on three places with a finger between, three and not one account, and kept the finding on a place of its own with no payer, very nearly laying the three readings across the house’s not-doings and his own gaps before putting the finger between, not a lesson, grievance, mending or doctrine (T061/T082); the bell went over the square in the turn of the morning, longer than a bell in a temple yard, four strokes and four and the place where the fifth should have stood, with not one hand in two hundred going to a face, and stayed in its square beside the told bell of the Long Night, not folded into the three counts and not heard as a seventh (T078 held); Hessa took Berr’s narrow slate up the road toward Greybank before noon edge-on to her forearm with the writing to her sleeve, answered the women who asked with I don’t read it. I carry it and Reading goes up before noon. I’ve got a road to walk, gave no figure off the slate, did not look toward the well and was not made a reader by any shaping (T080 held); the soft-cuffed clerk stayed set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called, cuff grey by midday and buyer’s number entered before he looked up (T090 held); across the square the seventh green stood at a silent woman’s mouth at the pot board, a cup turned a quarter and set back, and the seventh shape stood at the market’s edge in cast-off clothes worn like a uniform never measured for him, each a colour and a shape with no eighth, no name and no joining to loaf, slate, sale, hearing, cause or romance, never Fenna or Ulda in the narration (T050/T051 and T033/T034 held); in the quiet interval between the moot’s reading and the late households’ reading the boy held the space beside the twice-spoken figure with a finger between, filing the hundred and seventy-third answer as two sayings and not one account; at the going of the light Sella carried him home at the half-pace saying nothing, the bell’s gap left in the square (T061/T082); in the Clay Yard she went wide around the seven walked-around places, Frost went out in its last tend without a boundary drawn and neither habit of naming the months set right or left wrong, Tarn kept six and the seventh with the ear-sentence stopped as a remembered ninth stopping and no tenth, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled, Jorra kept his dusty forearms and silence, put his bent finger into the cold damper, withheld the knowing of the full note, kept he’s not Vail sealed and the promise ungiven, the burned slate at four and the shut-room tellings at two, Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken two hundred and ninety-nine days, the stayed frost, skinned trough and silt-clouded plate stayed weather entered nowhere, the three arithmetics stayed locked up the road, the grain stayed covered and unfigured, the three shapings stayed unpaid and the charcoal stayed unread; in the small hours the hand took a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his at the very end of the day and let it go whole on the same note, not carried into the fire’s missing fifth, the bell’s gap or the river’s low note, filing the hundred and seventy-fourth answer, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air (T061/T082); the hand laid back against the fold, 299 standing exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill and Grath, six months and one hundred and nineteen days told by nobody, the fire’s fifth unpaid the same number of days, one hundred and seventy-four honest answers on the sixth place and neither the number nor the hand-movings calling themselves a doctrine, the file open on the towel with every gap left gap, the river’s low note going quiet under the finger’s-width door and the plate of ice clouded with silt out of the path of feet while Frost went out without a boundary drawn, nothing opened, joined, named, called, paid or ended and no thread opened or closed, Bone a direction in the dark beyond the door not brought into a day that had not earned it (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T083/T085 held, T080 held).}
\CRday{Day 300}{Bone 1, Firstday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, kiln mouth, boards, pot board and towel, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well and flat stone, the trough, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place on the worked strips, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the north gate road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Bone came on without a boundary drawn, the count going from two hundred and ninety-nine to three hundred exact with six months and one hundred and twenty days told by nobody, the round figure kept as a threshold and not spent, no market, Cross or bell on Firstday, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid three hundred days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number (T071/T072, T088, T009/T013/T092), the body taken in its old order of crust two inches off with its unnamed gap, frozen thread, cold at cheek, temple and wrist and the afterdrop waiting, the surgeon’s knowing checked by the infant’s louder want and the checking not called a virtue, three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings with the seventh place empty, the heard bell in its square beside the told, the told figure beside the paid with Frost’s three arithmetics locked in Berr’s box and no signature on the space, the grain turned beneath the wool and unfigured, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, the burned slate at four, the shut-room tellings at two, nine hands with Ilva’s strip unread and no tenth, and the stayed frost, skinned trough and silt-clouded plate called weather and entered nowhere (T061/T082, T060/T086, T015/T041/T047, T101, T080 held, T083/T085 held); Sella went to the fire before the basket, told the coals the thaw, turned them with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, kept her finger above the charcoal, glanced once at the clay jar, set the pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed and left the widow’s mark untouched because a morning is not an opening (T058/T079, T100); the yard went wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and no number; a hunter come down from Cold Acre waited at the well with a hare across his shoulders, the weight judged by the carrying arm and not by a figure, told a woman who asked the cost that it was the weather and went off toward the north gate road with no name, no slate and no second look, the month’s trade coming into the yard as a direction and going out as a direction (T077 advanced, not paid); Tarn kept six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip, stopped the ear-sentence at the word that would call the loan as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, left the Seed 16 breath unspent, agreed with an early thaw and a late while wanting the late because it puts off the paying, and kept the warm loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying (T036/T076, T006); Jorra brought meal-fine grey dust past the bent finger, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s sentence and withheld the note he knew three turns ahead, the burned slate at four, the shut-room tellings at two and he’s not Vail sealed (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095); and the hand held a small intake from the next room against the kiln’s fourth low pull at the moment it gave and let it go whole on the same note for the 175th answer, then held two small intakes apart with a finger between, the nearer ending early and kept whole as an absence, for the 176th, both exact and worth nothing at two inches of air, the file left open on the towel with every gap left gap and the plate of ice standing clouded with silt out of the path of feet (T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 301}{Bone 2, Secondday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, kiln mouth and boards, the pot board and towel, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well and flat stone, the trough, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his three hundred and first day and six months and one hundred and twenty-one days with nobody saying so, nothing from the yard of the day before brought in as a lesson or a sign, no market, Cross or bell on a Secondday, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid three hundred and one days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings with the seventh place empty, the heard bell in its square beside the told and the told figure beside the paid, and the body taken in its old order of crust, gap, thread, cold and afterdrop with a man must be warmed from the outside and slowly buying nothing at two inches of air (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T060/T086); \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and not paid:} Sella Vail went to the kiln mouth before the basket at first light, put her hand to the widow’s mark on its cord, held it one breath, let go, lifted the clay lid with the back of a hand and tipped the carried coal under the back of a broken pot; the fire took and answered four low pulls with the silence where the fifth should have stood, its payer unnamed, and nobody praised the opening, named what it mended, entered a slate, raised a hand to a face or made a lesson of it; \textbf{five openings in five months} (Days 150, 180, 240, 271 and 301) were five and not a rule, the four behind not looked at again as signs, menders or payments, and no hand counted toward a sixth (T058/T079, T088); the surgeon read it as a controlled reconnection under a clamp, heat coming back from outside paid for by a man nobody in the room would name, and kept the fifth opening on a place of its own with a finger between it and his own gaps, not laid across the house’s not-doings or the covered grain (T061/T082, T060/T086); at the very moment of the opening the hand took a small intake from the next room and held it against the first low pull without carrying it into the missing fifth, letting it go whole on the river’s note for the 177th answer, a restraint and not a payment, a key, a gift or a rule; Sella thereafter said The house will keep it, kept the charcoal unread, left the clay jar untouched, set the pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and did not touch the mark at shelf, well, rack, yard, afternoon or going of the light (T100); in the afternoon the yard went around the seven walked-around places with the stayed frost, skinned trough and clouded plate called weather, the dressed grain turned beneath the wool with a progressively lighter touch and no figure, and the mark hung where it hung (T077, T083/T085 held); at the well Ilva drew with the pail against her knee, clay pale in her nail crescents and rack dust in a thumb seam she did not scrub out, and to a woman who asked what the month’s firings had taken her hand went toward her sleeve, the notched strip unread and no figure coming off it; her eyes went to the asker and her mouth opened after both: Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account; the boy filed the order of reaching as the ninth hand beside the eighth with a finger between, filed no tenth, made no figure and did not make her a reader of her own keeping (T080 held and advanced, not paid); Tarn kept six and the held seventh with the ear-sentence stopped at the calling word as a remembered ninth stopping, and Jorra brought his meal-fine dust and withheld the note three turns ahead with his bent finger in the cold damper (T036/T076, T035/T031/T062); and the hand set a small letting-go from the next room on one place and the fourth low pull on another with a finger between, neither carried into the other, for the 178th answer, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, the file left open on the towel with every gap left gap and the morning’s opening settled no account (T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 302}{Bone 3, Thirdday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, boards, pot board, oiled-paper window and towel, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well with its north lip and flat stone, the trough, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the round three hundred went over on Bone 1 and was kept as a threshold and not spent, nobody marking its passing under the roof, and the count went on to three hundred and two exact, six months and one hundred and twenty-two days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid the same number of days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the firing of two mornings ago kept as a thing done and left, not a sign, not a mended account and not the fifth of a rule, no market, Cross or bell on a Thirdday and Bone 4 and Bone 10 standing ahead unbrought (T071/T072, T088, T058/T079); the body was taken in its old order of crust two inches off with its unnamed gap, frozen thread unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the ease cold puts on a face not ease and the wanting of the crust louder than the knowing (T060/T086); the file was turned out as instruments on a towel and found with every gap left gap, six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the heard bell in its square beside the told, the told figure beside the paid with Frost’s three arithmetics, three true subtractions and one in twelve locked in Berr’s box and no signature on the space, three readings three and not one account with the finding on a place of its own and no payer, nine stoppings with no tenth, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, Hessa’s eighth hand beside the three shapings of the Frost 14 saying with a finger between every pair, Ilva’s ninth hand unread in a sleeve a pace off with no tenth, the burned slate at four, the shut-room tellings at two, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth, the charcoal unread, the reed-cutter’s cord where no Court thumb had read it and the clerk’s slate inward at the out-of-line landing, none standing up as a rule or payment (T061/T082, T015/T041/T047, T101, T080, T100, T099, T090); Sella went to the fire before the basket at first light and again at the going of the light, told the coals the thaw, turned them with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, kept her finger above the charcoal, left the two gaps unfigured, glanced once at the clay jar, set the pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, righted the fold and left the thread, and did not touch the widow’s mark because neither a morning nor a going of the light is an opening (T058/T079, T100); in the afternoon the white went off the north lip of the well while the yard was looking elsewhere, the trough kept its skin and the silt-clouded plate stood out of the path of feet, all called weather and entered nowhere, and the dressed grain was turned beneath the wool with a progressively lighter touch and no figure (T083/T085 held, T077); Tarn kept six in the thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip with the ear-sentence stopped at the calling word as a remembered ninth stopping, the Seed 16 breath unspent, Ash in the knuckle creases, the clip-ring holding what light there was, the stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, the warm loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying and the loan uncalled with no collector on the road (T036/T076, T006); Jorra brought meal-fine grey dust past the bent finger, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, withheld the note three turns ahead, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, kept the burned-slate word at four, the shut-room tellings at two and he’s not Vail sealed (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095); Garl stayed in objects with the salt-stiff coat, hollow wheel-seat, clean dark line and finer grey thaw, proverb gone to pot and fire and the uncalled tile debt (T009/T013/T092); and the hand set a held interval from the next room beside an empty interval, brought the finger down between them and took it up, leaving both parted on the towel for the 179th answer, then at the very end of the day let a small intake go whole on the same note, not carried into the fire’s missing fifth, the bell’s gap or the river’s note, for the 180th, each exact and worth nothing at two inches of air, the hand laid back against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking, the file left open with every gap left gap and nothing that had moved (T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 303}{Bone 4, Fourthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, kiln mouth, pot board, boards and towel, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well with its north lip gone bare and its flat stone where the silt-clouded plate of ice stood out of the path of feet, the skinned trough, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place on the worked strips, the kindling and flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Bone came on without a boundary drawn, the older women naming the months by weather and the slatemen by Account-days with neither habit set right or left wrong, the boy coming into his three hundred and third day and six months and one hundred and twenty-three days with nobody saying so, no market, Cross or bell on a Fourthday, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid three hundred and three days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number (T071/T072, T088, T009/T013/T092), the hand laid down against the fold on the hundred and eighty-first answer and a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his let go whole on the river’s note beside the fire’s fourth pull, then the hundred and eighty-second answer setting an empty interval beside a held interval with the finger between and neither spent, both exact and complete and worth nothing at two inches of air and promoted into no reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, key, power, freedom, gift, doctrine or rule with no payer named (T061/T082), the body taken in its old order of crust two inches off with its unnamed gap, frozen thread unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon’s knowing checked by the infant’s louder want and the checking not called a virtue (T060/T086), three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings with the seventh place empty, the heard bell in its square beside the told, the told figure beside the paid with all three Frost arithmetics locked in Berr Clay’s box and no signature on the space, the burned slate at four and the shut-room tellings at two, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, nine hands with Ilva’s ninth unread and no tenth, the three shapings of the well-saying beside Hessa’s eighth hand, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth, the stayed frost gone off the well’s north lip on Bone 3 while the trough kept its skin and the silt-clouded plate of ice stood on its flat stone, all called weather and entered nowhere, the dressed grain turned beneath the wool with a lighter touch and no figure, men down from Cold Acre in the afternoon with hares across their shoulders whose carrying was answered with the weather and not with a figure, Sella going to the fire before the basket and saying The house will keep it with the charcoal unread and the widow’s mark untouched because a morning is not an
