opening, Tarn’s six and held seventh with the loan uncalled and no collector on the road, Jorra’s dust and cold damper with he’s not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn, Garl in objects, and Bone 10 standing ahead unbrought.}
\CRday{Day 304}{Bone 5, Fifthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, kiln mouth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel, then the Clay Yard, its boards and the terrace toward Slate Row as a direction, the yard well and flat stone, the skinned trough, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling and flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the boy came into his three hundred and fourth day and six months and one hundred and twenty-four days with nobody saying so, no market, Cross or bell on a Fifthday, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid three hundred and four days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings with the seventh place empty, the heard bell beside the told, the told figure beside the paid with the three Frost arithmetics locked up the road, the body inventoried in its old order of crust, gap, thread, cold and afterdrop with the surgeon’s knowing checked by the infant’s louder want (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T060/T086); the chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and not paid: an ownerless voice came up from Slate Row over the boards of the Clay Yard on the same breath as the price of barley and the weather, saying a slate had been burned again, with no owner standing under it, no room, no hand at the flame, no reason, no name and no witness, and went off up the terrace while the yard went on with its work; the boy took it apart as a surgeon takes a wound apart, by what was there and what was not, and set it on a place of its own beside the four earlier tellings (the one in Ember, the telling between, the one in Grain and the one after it) with a finger between every pair as the fifth telling of the burned slate, still not a third telling of the counting room shut in the war which stands at two, not a hearing, not a seventh, not a stopping, not a payment, not a cause, not a confession, not a joining, not a rule and not paid, five being five and not a rule and no sixth laid beside it (T035/T031/T065/T095 advanced, not paid), the seed held for the far-off calling-in of Jorra’s promise to the men who burn slates, not a confession and not a payment, and Bone 10 able to carry it unchanged; Jorra, who knows the full note a slate-burner’s pot gives three turns before it leaves his hands and withheld it from a High Kiln kiln-master, grew quieter whenever the saying went around the boards, with he’s not Vail sealed and the promise of the foundling’s name neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062); a pot whose handle had been mended twice stood on the pot board with two staples and the original crack showing, and the sayings went to the pot and the fire and never to a person, a repair that holds mending nothing anybody will name (T009/T013/T092, T058/T079); the hand entered the hundred and eighty-third answer as the half-beat between the pot’s set-down and Sella going away laid beside a small intake with a finger between, and the hundred and eighty-fourth as the empty interval between the ownerless voice and the weather’s answer kept empty and not filled to make a row come out even, each exact and worth nothing and no payer named (T061/T082); Sella kept the fire before the basket, the charcoal unread, the two gaps unfigured and the widow’s mark untouched, Tarn kept six counted and the seventh held with the loan uncalled, Jorra kept the dust and the cold damper, Garl stayed in objects, and Bone 10 stood five mornings ahead unbrought.}
\CRday{Day 305}{Bone 6, Sixthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, kiln mouth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well where Ilva drew once with the pail against her knee and the open slate lay on the stone lip, its flat stone with the silt-clouded plate of ice, the skinned trough, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling and flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the burned-slate saying from the day before was not brought in as a sign, lesson, mending, cause or first of a rule, the fifth telling standing with a finger between it and the four, five being five and a sixth not due on a morning that had not earned one (T035/T031/T065/T095 held, not paid), the boy coming into his three hundred and fifth day and six months and one hundred and twenty-five days with nobody saying so, no market, Cross or bell on a Sixthday, the count at three hundred and five exact, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid and Garl’s name unspoken the same number of days with its payer unnamed, the body taken in its old order of crust two inches off with its unnamed gap and no third, frozen thread unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the two voices arguing and neither winning and the argument being the work (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086); the pot on the board carried its twice-mended handle with the dark hairline showing and Sella lifted it with her thumb first where the wire crossed the crack before letting the weight come on the handle, saying both proverbs to the pot and the fire and never to a person, and nobody made a lesson of the repair or the half-beat (T009/T013/T092, T058/T079); the hand entered the hundred and eighty-fifth answer as a small intake let go whole on the same low note, a restraint and not a payment, and at the very end of the day the hundred and eighty-sixth as a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his let go whole on the river’s note and carried into neither the fire’s missing fifth, the bell’s gap left in the square nor the river’s low over lower, so that \textbf{one hundred and eighty-six} honest answers stood on the sixth place, each an object and not a power and no payer named to any (T061/T082); Ilva was at the well once, drawing with the pail against her knee, clay pale in the crescents of her nails and grey rack dust in the seam of one thumb she did not scrub out, and to the woman who asked what the month’s firings had taken her hand went toward her sleeve and stayed, the notched strip not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined and no figure coming off the wood, her eyes going to the asker and her mouth opening after both with \emph{Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account}, the boy filing the order of reaching again as the ninth record-first hand beside the eighth with a finger between and filing no tenth, the ninth staying nine and nothing of the well going under the roof as lesson, figure, mending, cause or payment (T080 advanced, not paid); Tarn kept six counted and the seventh held at the lip of the sill with the ear-sentence stopped at the word that would call the loan, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled and no collector on the clay road, Jorra kept the grey dust, the full note withheld and the bent finger in the cold damper with the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, he’s not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn, and Garl stayed in the coat, the hollow wheel-seat, the clean dark line with its grey hairline, the proverb and the uncalled tile debt with his name unspoken three hundred and five days (T036/T076, T035/T031/T062, T009/T013/T092); the stayed frost, skinned trough and clouded plate stayed weather entered nowhere, the dressed grain lay covered and unfigured under three readings that did not know its cost, the three Frost arithmetics rode locked in Berr Clay’s box, the file lay open on the towel with every gap left gap and nothing that had moved, the hand laid itself back against the fold as a man puts away a tool, and Bone 10 stood four mornings ahead and was not brought into a day that had not earned it.}
\CRday{Day 306}{Bone 7, Seventhday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well with its north lip gone bare and its flat stone where the silt-clouded plate of ice stood out of the path of feet, the skinned trough, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Bone came on without a boundary drawn, the older women naming the months by weather and the slatemen by Account-days with neither habit set right or left wrong, the boy coming into his three hundred and sixth day and six months and one hundred and twenty-six days with nobody saying so, no market, Cross or bell on a Seventhday, the count going 305 to 306 exact, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 306 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the body inventoried in its old order of crust two inches off with its unnamed gap, frozen thread unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon’s knowing that a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly checked by the infant’s louder want of the crust with neither voice winning, three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the heard bell in its square beside the told, the told figure beside the paid with all three Frost arithmetics locked up the clay road in Berr’s box and no signature on the space, the burned slate at five with no sixth, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, the well-saying at three shapings beside Hessa’s eighth hand, nine hands with Ilva’s ninth unread and no tenth, the pot sayings at three with the Smoke 14 note apart, the shut-room tellings at two and the seventh green a colour and seventh shape a shape with no eighth (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T060/T086, T078, T080 held); Sella went to the fire before the basket, told the coals the thaw, turned them with the back of a broken pot, said The house will keep it with the charcoal unread under her finger and the two gaps unfigured, glanced once at the clay jar, left the widow’s mark untouched because a morning is not an opening, set the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand, lifted the twice-mended pot with her thumb first where the wire crossed the crack and said both proverbs to the pot and fire and never to a person; Tarn kept six checkable years and a seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, said Six counted. The next I don’t count, stopped his ear-sentence at the word that would call the loan, left the Seed 16 breath unspent, worked Ash into his knuckles, and went over the flagstones’ bright patch without the half-check; Jorra parted dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel before any person, withheld the full note he knew three turns ahead, and put his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence with he’s not Vail sealed; Garl was kept in objects with his name unspoken; in the yard Sella went wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a step and no number, called the gone white on the well’s north lip, the trough’s skin and the silt-clouded plate on its stone weather and entered none of them, turned the dressed grain beneath the wool with a lighter touch and no figure, and answered a woman’s question about the month’s cost with the weather of a man carrying a hare toward the north gate road; Ilva drew once at the well with the pail against her knee, kept her notched strip in her sleeve unread, answered the question put rather than the one behind it with Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account, and the boy filed the ninth record-first hand and no tenth (T080 advanced, not paid); the hand entered the hundred and eighty-seventh answer, a small intake from the next room laid beside the fire’s fourth low pull and let go whole on the river’s note, and the hundred and eighty-eighth, an empty interval set beside a held interval with the finger brought down between and neither spent, both exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air with no payer named; the file lay open on the towel with every gap left gap and Bone 10 stood three mornings ahead, unbrought.}
\CRday{Day 307}{Bone 8, Eighthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well and flat stone with the skinned trough and the clouded plate of ice, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the kindling and flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the eighth morning came on like the seven before it without a line drawn across it, nothing from Bone 7 brought in as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, the boy coming into his three hundred and seventh day and six months and one hundred and twenty-seven days with nobody saying so, no market, Cross or bell on an Eighthday, the count going 306 to 307 exact, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 307 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the body inventoried in its old order with the composed face that is not composure and the cold patient who cannot clot checked by the infant’s want with neither winning, three counts in three places, six hearings with the seventh place empty, the heard bell beside the told, the told figure beside the paid with the three Frost arithmetics locked, the burned slate at five with no sixth, nine stoppings with no tenth, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, the well-saying at three shapings beside Hessa’s eighth hand, nine hands with Ilva’s ninth unread offstage, the shut-room tellings at two and the pot sayings at three (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T060/T086, T078, T080 held); the pot on the board carried its repair standing visible between the old-brass staple and the tighter wire and Sella said both proverbs to the pot and fire; in the afternoon the yard went wide around its seven places, kept the three coverings as weather entered nowhere, turned the dressed grain beneath the wool with a touch lighter even than the day before and no figure, and answered the month’s cost with the weather; \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and not paid:} at the going of the light, while Jorra’s bent finger stood in the cold iron of the damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence and she let the end of it arrive at the pot, Tarn’s broom checked half a beat behind the standing finger on the flagstones and went on toward the road without a word and without a turn of the head --- the Seed 22 half-check and the Day 171 flagstone movement returned changed after a hundred and thirty-six days; the flagstones kept the place where the stroke stopped and a new shallow brightness at the edge of the patch that nobody entered or swept, neither man named the other’s silence, the loan that could hear stayed uncalled and no collector came up or went down the clay road, and the boy filed the returned half-check on the stone’s own place beside the Day 161 damper fraction, the Day 166 shelf beat and the Frost 5 returned beat as four held changes on four places and forbade them to stand up and call themselves a rule, for a rule is an account that has found a payer and none stood (T062/T035/T031, T036/T076, T061/T082 advanced, not paid); Jorra grew quieter at the burned-slate word now told five times and supplied no sixth and no witness, Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken, and the hand entered the hundred and eighty-ninth answer, the half-beat after the pot’s set-down laid beside a small intake with a finger between, and the hundred and ninetieth, the little interval between Jorra’s finger arriving at the iron and the end of Sella’s sentence reaching the pot held whole and not filled, both exact and worth nothing at two inches of air; the returned half-check was not made on the seventh or the ninth and Bone 10 carries it unchanged, and the file lay open on the towel with every gap left gap.}
\CRday{Day 308}{Bone 9, Ninthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well with its north lip bare and its flat stone where the silt-clouded plate of ice stood out of the path of feet, the skinned trough, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the kindling and flagstones with the shallow bright patch and the checked place at its edge, the wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the ninth came on without a line drawn across it and nothing from Bone 8 brought in as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, the returned half-check remembered and not made again so four held changes stayed four and not a rule, the boy coming into his three hundred and eighth day and six months and one hundred and twenty-eight days with nobody saying so, no market, Cross or bell on a Ninthday, the count going 307 to 308 exact, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 308 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the body inventoried in its old order of crust, unnamed gap, frozen thread, cold at cheek, temple and wrist and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon’s inventory argued by the infant’s want with neither winning, three counts in three places, six hearings with the seventh place empty, the heard bell beside the told, the told figure beside the paid with the three Frost arithmetics locked up the road and the finding on a place of its own with no payer, the burned slate at five with no sixth and no witness, the row at five askings with one shaping, the well-saying at three shapings beside Hessa’s eighth hand, nine hands with Ilva’s strip in her sleeve offstage and no tenth, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the pot sayings at three with the Smoke 14 note apart, the shut-room tellings at two, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T060/T086, T062/T035/T031, T080 held); Sella went to the fire before the basket at morning and again at the going of the light, kept the charcoal unread and the two gaps unfigured, glanced once at the clay jar, left the widow’s mark untouched because a going of the light is not an opening and five openings in five months are five and not a rule, set the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand, lifted the twice-mended pot with her thumb first where the wire crossed the crack, and carried him down and up at the half-pace; Tarn kept six checkable and a seventh at the lip, stopped his ear-sentence at the calling word as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, left the Seed 16 breath unspent, went over the bright patch without the half-check, and kept the warm loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness; Jorra kept grey dust and the cold damper, withheld the full note three turns ahead, and kept he’s not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn; Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken 308 days; in the afternoon the yard went around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, kept the three coverings called weather and entered nowhere, turned the dressed grain beneath the wool with a lighter touch and no figure with the finding kept apart from the house’s not-doings, the covered grain, the returned half-check and the boy’s own gaps, and kept the small keepings small --- charcoal unread, Ilva’s strip in her sleeve offstage, three shapings, the row at five, the reed-cutter’s cord and the clerk’s inward slate --- none a sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment; in the small hours he turned out the file as instruments on a towel and found every gap left gap, nothing spent to make a row come out even and nothing standing up as a reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, key, power, freedom, gift, doctrine or rule; the hand entered the hundred and ninety-first answer, a small intake let go whole on the same note as a restraint and not a payment, and the hundred and ninety-second, the final small intake let go whole on the river’s note, and the ledger closed at 308 exact, six months and one hundred and twenty-eight days told by nobody, 192 honest answers on the sixth place, the fire’s fifth unpaid and Garl’s name unspoken 308 days, no payer named; Bone 10 stood one morning ahead and was not brought into a day that had not earned it, and the file lay open on the towel with every gap left gap.}
\CRday{Day 309}{Bone 10, Tenthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, boards, pot board and towel, then down to the Cross with the reading block under the moot-post and its finger’s width of shade, the pot board, the market’s edge, the square’s Slate Row fringe, below the north bridge at the out-of-line landing, the rack end, the clay road up toward High Kiln and Greybank, and home at the going of the light to the bed, boards and towel under the roof, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Bone 10 came on its own morning as the month’s first Account-day and market, earned by that light and not brought into the day behind it, the count going from three hundred and eight to three hundred and nine exact, six months and one hundred and twenty-nine days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid three hundred and nine days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the body taken in its old order of crust, unnamed gap, frozen thread unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon’s knowing that a cold patient cannot clot checked by the infant’s louder want with neither winning, three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings with the seventh place empty, the heard bell in its square beside the told, and the five openings in five months kept as five and not a rule (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086, T061/T082, T058/T079, T100); Sella went to the fire before the basket, told the coals the thaw, turned them with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, kept the charcoal unread under a finger on top of the shelf’s front edge and the two gaps unfigured, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, set the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, put the fold right without a look at his face, left the thread where it lay, and left the widow’s mark untouched because a market-day morning is not an opening (T058/T079); Tarn at the kindling kept six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, said Six counted. The next I don’t count, brought his ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped with no figure and no name as a remembered ninth stopping, left the Seed 16 breath unspent, worked Ash into his knuckles, held the pale clip-ring to the grey, and wanted the late thaw because it puts off the paying with no collector on the clay road (T036/T076, T006); Jorra brought meal-fine grey dust past the bent finger, kept dusty and clean forearms apart as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s sentence, withheld the note he knew three turns ahead from any High Kiln master, and kept the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five, he’s not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095); \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and not paid:} at the Cross two hundred leaned over the reading block while eight pigs went over the wet boards and Berr Clay came up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat and the green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner, wiped his thumb twice on his apron before touching nothing, held a narrow slate unopened to his forearm with the writing inward, passed a finger over the figure, read One in twelve, as the notice says low into the crowd, sent the figure twice over the basket --- once for the moot and once for the households that came late --- called the levy and denied it with The levy is called. It is not called by me and your house, never I, taking himself out of his own sentence as a surgeon draws a hand from a field before the dressing goes on, and went off up the clay road with the box locked and Bone’s first true subtraction inside beside the three from Frost, believing he had done a kindness; four arithmetics of the year now stand behind one printed figure, four are four and not one account, the figure read is still not the figure paid and no signature stands on the space, and the boy kept the finding on a place of its own with no payer, not a lesson, grievance, mending, doctrine or rule, and did not lay it across the house’s not-doings, the dressed grain covered under wool at the rack end, the four held changes or his own gaps, the edges coming near to touching and the finger going between (T015/T041/T047 advanced and not paid, T077, T061/T082); the bell went four, four and a gap with not one hand in two hundred going to a face and stayed in its square beside the told bell of the Long Night, not a seventh hearing of the full note, a fifth pull of the carried fire or an agreement with the boards’ knot (T078 held); Hessa took Berr’s slate up the clay road toward Greybank before noon edge-on to her forearm with the writing to her sleeve, answered I don’t read it. I carry it. There’s a difference, and the road doesn’t care which and Cross to Greybank. Reading goes up before noon. I’ve got a road to walk, gave no figure off the slate and stayed the eighth record-first hand (T080 held); the soft-cuffed clerk stayed set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called, hand to slate before eyes to stalls and the market selling over him as water over a stone (T090 held); the seventh green stood at a silent woman’s mouth at the pot board, a cup turned a quarter and set back exactly, and the seventh shape stood at the market’s edge in cast-offs worn like a uniform never measured for him, turning half a beat after a pot was set down, each a seventh with no eighth and neither named Fenna or Ulda (T050/T051, T033/T034 held); the fifth burned-slate telling went through the reading untouched with no owner, room, witness, hand at the flame, sixth or payer, gathering interest against Jorra’s promise (T035/T031/T065/T095 held); the number that went over the covered grain did not know what it cost and answered nothing for the man carried out on Day 188, the hand that went in on Seed 15 or the hare gone toward the north gate road (T077, T098 carried); at the going of the light she carried him home at the half-pace saying nothing, and in the small hours the hand let a small intake go whole on the river’s note for the hundred and ninety-third answer and again at the close for the hundred and ninety-fourth, each exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, no payer named, the file left open on the towel with every gap left gap and the printed figure standing over a square gone quiet after the bell (T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 310}{Bone 11, Firstday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well and flat stone, the skinned trough, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the worked strips, the kindling and flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  an ordinary Firstday came on with no market, Cross or bell and nothing from Bone 10 brought in as a sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, the boy coming into his three hundred and tenth day and six months and one hundred and thirty days with nobody saying so, the count going 309 to 310 exact, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid three hundred and ten days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the body taken in its old order with the crust gone leathery two inches off, the thread still frozen and unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and wrist and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the ease on a cold face not ease and the surgeon’s knowing that a cold patient cannot clot checked by the infant’s want with neither winning and the argument itself the work, three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings with the seventh place empty, the heard bell in its square beside the told, the told figure beside the paid with four arithmetics now behind one printed figure and the finding kept on a place of its own with no payer (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086, T061/T082, T015/T041/T047); Sella went to the fire before the basket, told the coals the thaw, turned them with the back of a broken pot, said The house will keep it, stood a moment counting small intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, kept her finger above the charcoal and her lips along a two-gapped row, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, pushed the grey streak back with the burn-wrist, lifted the twice-mended pot with her thumb first where the wire crossed the crack, said both proverbs to the pot and the fire, set the rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, righted the fold without a look at his face, left the thread where it lay and did not touch the widow’s mark because a morning and a hearth are not openings (T058/T079, T009/T013/T092, T100); at the rack end the dressed grain was turned beneath the wool with a lighter touch and no figure, the arithmetic that had gone over it on Bone 10 not brought back as a lesson and the unknowing kept on its own place with no payer, not laid across the house’s not-doings, the returned half-check on the flagstones or his own gaps (T077, T015/T041/T047, T061/T082); Tarn at the kindling kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped with no figure and no name as a remembered ninth stopping, said Yes, house to an early thaw and a late while wanting the late because it puts off the paying, left the Seed 16 breath unspent with his chest tight since the dark, worked Ash into his knuckles, held the pale clip-ring to the grey and kept the warm loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness, with no collector up or down the clay road (T036/T076, T006); Jorra came through the finger’s-width door with meal-fine grey dust, parted dusty and clean forearms as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, knew the full note that pot would give three turns ahead with air under it and a want in it and withheld it from any High Kiln master who would call it early, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, read one iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies, gave the men in the back room no name and did not say the room was cold, and kept the burned slate at five with a finger between the fifth and the four, the shut-room tellings at two, the pot sayings at three with the Smoke 14 note apart, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, he’s not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095, T064, T101); in the afternoon she carried him down at the half-pace and went wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a step and no number, kept the stayed frost gone off the well’s north lip, the trough’s skin and the silt-clouded plate on its flat stone as three coverings called weather and entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause, answered a woman who asked what the month’s carrying had taken with the weather and a direction that left no entry, and kept the small keepings small --- charcoal unread beneath her finger, Ilva’s strip in her sleeve offstage and her ninth hand nine with no tenth, the Frost 14 well-saying at three shapings beside Hessa’s eighth hand, the seventh green and seventh shape with no eighth, the reed-cutter’s cord and the clerk’s inward slate --- none a sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment under the roof (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T060/T086, T083/T085, T077, T062/T035/T031, T080, T050/T051, T033/T034, T099, T090); Tarn’s stroke went over the shallow bright patch on the flagstones without the half-check and the returned half-check of Bone 8 stayed on the stone’s own place with the Day 161 fraction, the Day 166 beat and the Frost 5 beat, four held changes on four places and not a rule, no fifth likeness made a cause and no payer named, a thing kept by not being made again still kept (T062/T035/T031, T036/T076, T061/T082 held); in the small hours the hand set an empty interval beside a held interval with the finger brought down between for the hundred and ninety-fifth answer and at the close set a small intake beside a letting-go with the half-beat of the pot’s set-down laid beside them and none joined for the hundred and ninety-sixth, both exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air with no payer named, the file left open on the towel with every gap left gap and the river going low over lower under the finger’s-width door (T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 311}{Bone 12, Secondday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards, kindling and towel, the Debt Loft as a sound with a direction, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well and flat stone, the skinned trough, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the twelfth came on in the small hours with no door opened and no hand lifted to mark it, no market, Cross or bell on a Secondday, the reading of two mornings ago gone up the clay road in a locked box and not brought back as a sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, the boy coming into his three hundred and eleventh day and six months and one hundred and thirty-one days with nobody saying so, the count going 310 to 311 exact and nobody in Low Kiln, Sill or Grath able to say what it counted, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid three hundred and eleven days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the crust gone leathery and brown-edged with its corner standing a hair off the wool two inches from his ear, the empty place unnamed and no third, the thread frozen and unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the composed face not composure and the surgeon’s knowing that a cold patient will seem better before he is worse checked by the infant’s want with both true, the second louder and neither winning (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086); the finding of four arithmetics behind one printed figure was not set beside anything to make it mean, the four true subtractions riding locked up the clay road in Berr Clay’s box with one in twelve unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid and no signature on the space, the finding kept on a place of its own with no payer, not a lesson, grievance, mending, doctrine or rule and not laid across the house’s not-doings, the covered grain under wool at the rack end, the four held changes on four places, the returned half-check on the flagstones or the small gaps in his own file, the edges coming near to touching and the finger going between so that a finding with no payer could be carried light without becoming a rule (T015/T041/T047, T061/T082); Sella went to the fire before the basket at first light, told the coals the thaw, turned them with a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted toward no opening with neither gap figured, kept her finger on top of the shelf’s front edge and the charcoal unread, moved her lips along a two-gapped row, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, pushed the grey streak back with the burn-wrist, lifted the twice-mended pot with her thumb first where the wire crossed the crack, said both proverbs to the pot and the fire, set the rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, put the fold right without a look at his face, left the thread where it lay and did not touch the widow’s mark at shelf, well, rack, morning, hearth or bed because none was an opening and five openings in five months were five and not a rule with the next standing far off in a later month’s first firing (T058/T079, T009/T013/T092, T100); Tarn at the kindling had the knife at the very edge of its sill where it could be checked and slip, six years in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, Ash worked into his knuckles in the colour of the clean dark line, the pale clip-ring at his left wrist held up to the grey, his chest tight since the dark and the Seed 16 breath still unspent, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped with no figure and no name as a remembered ninth stopping, kept the warm stone she gave him in the winter Garl died cold in its unmarked pot in the loft, unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness, and no collector came up the clay road or went down it (T036/T076, T006); Jorra came through the finger’s-width door with meal-fine grey dust white in the creases, kept dusty and clean forearms apart as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, knew the note that pot would give three turns ahead with air under it and a want in it and would not say it before a High Kiln master, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s sentence and read one iron with two bites, gave the men who went low into the back room no name and did not say the room was cold, grew quieter as the burned-slate saying went around with the fifth telling standing at five, no witness, no hand at the flame, no sixth due on a day that had not earned one and the seed waiting on the far-off calling-in of his promise, he’s not Vail sealed as tightly as a lid nobody had tried to lift in three years (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101); Garl stayed in objects and not in a story --- the salt-stiff coat with the left-shoulder crease on its peg, the wheel-seat with its twenty-year lean and hollow that Sella let no one fill, the clean dark line and the finer grey called the thaw unswept both, the ridge measured by a thumb against the death-house ridge, the proverbs gone to pot and fire and never a person, and the debt against a firing of tiles circling without a name, neither paid nor settled nor done with and worse for being uncalled, his name unspoken three hundred and eleven days and the keeping of him maintenance and not a lesson (T009/T013/T092); in the going of the light she carried him down at the half-pace and went wide around the seven walked-around places with no number, the yard’s hunts and repairs staying directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather and never figures, a man come down from Cold Acre with a hare across his shoulders saying Ask the weather. It carried the snow; it can carry the price and a barrow man told to ask the pot while no man priced a repair and stood up in the yard, the three coverings at the well staying weather entered nowhere with a finger between and no fourth likeness made a cause (T077, T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T083/T085); on the flagstones Tarn’s stroke went over the shallow bright patch without the half-check and the returned half-check of the eighth stayed with the Day 161, Day 166 and Frost 5 changes as four held changes on four places and not a rule, no fifth likeness made a cause and no payer named (T062/T035/T031, T036/T076, T061/T082 held); in the small hours he turned out the file as instruments on a towel, six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the heard bell in its square beside the told bell of the Long Night, the told figure beside the paid with no signature, nine record-first hands with Ilva’s strip in a sleeve and no tenth, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, the well-saying at three shapings, the shut-room tellings at two, the pot sayings at three with the Smoke 14 note apart, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and seven green a colour and seven shape a shape with no eighth, nothing spent to make a row come out even and nothing standing up as a reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, key, power, freedom, gift, doctrine or rule (T061/T082, T078, T080, T101, T050/T051, T033/T034, T036/T076, T064, T065/T095); at the very end of the day the hand came up an inch toward the river’s note, took a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his and let it go whole on the same note for the hundred and ninety-eighth answer, a restraint and not a payment borrowed from no house count and with no payer named, carried into neither the carried fire’s missing fifth, the bell’s gap in the square nor the river’s low over lower, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air; the older man took a clean satisfaction in the keeping of the number, the infant wanted the crust lifted and the thread wiped, both true, the second louder and neither winning, and the hand came down on the river’s note and laid itself back against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it, three hundred and eleven standing exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody, one hundred and ninety-eight honest answers on the sixth place, the file open on the towel with every gap left gap, the silt-clouded plate of ice standing on its flat stone out of the path of feet and Bone going on without a boundary drawn, nothing on the twelfth of Bone opened, joined, named, called, paid or ended (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082).}

\CRday{Day 313}{Bone 14, Fourthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel, the rack end and the kindling, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well where Ilva drew with the pail against her knee and an open slate lay on the stone lip a pace away, the flat stone with the silt-clouded plate of ice, the skinned trough, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the fourteenth came on its own morning with no market, Cross or bell and nothing from Bone 12 or 13 brought in as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, the boy coming into his three hundred and thirteenth day and six months and one hundred and thirty-three days with nobody saying so, the count going 312 to 313 exact, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 313 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the dark under the roof taken with its grain by the small sounds first because the small sounds do not lie, the body inventoried in its old order with the crust gone stiffer and leathery two inches off, its empty place unnamed and no third, the thread frozen and unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon’s knowing checked by the infant’s want with both true and neither winning (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086); the finding that four arithmetics stand behind one printed figure was kept on a place of its own with no payer, four readings four and not one account, one in twelve printed and unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space and the four true subtractions riding locked up the clay road in Berr Clay’s box behind the three of Frost, not a lesson, grievance, mending, doctrine or rule and not laid across the house’s not-doings, the covered grain turned under wool at the rack end with a progressively lighter touch and no figure, the four held changes on four places or his own gaps, the edges coming near to touching and the finger going between (T015/T041/T047, T061/T082); Sella went to the fire before the basket and to the hearth before her hands, told the coals the thaw, said The house will keep it, lifted the twice-mended pot with her thumb first where the wire crossed the crack and said both proverbs to the pot and the fire with crack showing, kept her finger above the charcoal tally, moved her lips along a two-gapped row unfigured, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, pushed the grey streak back with the burn-wrist, set the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, righted the fold without a look at his face, left the thread where it lay and touched not the widow’s mark, five openings in five months being five and not a rule with the next standing far off (T058/T079, T100, T009/T013/T092); Tarn at the kindling kept six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count, brought his ear-sentence to the calling word and stopped with no figure and no name as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, left the Seed 16 breath unspent with his chest tight since the dark, worked Ash into his knuckles and held the pale clip-ring to the grey, kept the warm loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness, and the loan uncalled with no collector on the clay road (T036/T076, T006); Jorra came through the door with grey dust white in the creases, parted dusty and clean forearms as clot from vessel, spoke to wheel and pot before any person, knew the note three turns ahead and withheld it from a High Kiln master, set his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, read one iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies, grew quieter at the burned-slate saying and kept the fifth telling at five with a finger between five and four, no witness, no hand at the flame and no sixth, he’s not Vail sealed and the promise of the foundling’s name neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095); \textbf{Ilva was at the yard well drawing with the pail against her knee, rope stiff in the dry cold, clay dried pale in the crescents of her nails and grey rack dust worked into the seam of one thumb she did not scrub out}, and to the woman who asked what the firings of Bone had taken her hand went toward her sleeve and stayed, the short strip of notched birch bark not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the open slate a pace away, no figure coming off the wood, her eyes going to the asker and her mouth opening after both with a half-beat, answering the question put and not the one behind it with Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account, then putting the flat of her hand once more on the sleeve and going back to the pail with nobody turning twice; the boy filed the order of her reaching as the \textbf{ninth} record-first hand on a place of its own beside Hessa Rale’s eighth with a finger between, filed \textbf{no tenth}, made no figure of the slate’s nearness and did not make her a reader of her own keeping, she being not Marra, not the soft-handed man, not the soft-cuffed clerk, not Hessa and not the green-mouthed woman at the pot board, with Bone 10’s reading not come to her well (T080 advanced, not paid); a woman with a mended jar was sent to the pot with Ask the pot what a wet thing costs set down there. The house has said it, leaving no entry, the dressing grain lay covered and unfigured, the three coverings at the well stayed weather entered nowhere with a finger between and no fourth likeness made a cause, and the small keepings stayed small --- charcoal unread, the three shapings of the Frost 14 well-saying beside Hessa’s eighth hand, the row at five askings, the burned slate at five, the two shut-room tellings, the clerk’s inward slate, the reed-cutter’s cord, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth (T101, T065/T095, T090, T099, T050/T051, T033/T034); the hand entered the two hundred and first answer on the morning as the half-beat of the pot’s set-down laid beside a small intake with the finger brought down between and neither spent, and the two hundred and second at the close as a small intake let go whole on the river’s note, each exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, promoted into no reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, gift, doctrine or rule with no payer named, the file left open on the towel with every gap left gap, the ninth hand on its own place and Ilva’s strip gone back into her sleeve, nothing on the fourteenth of Bone opened, joined, named, called, paid or ended (T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 314}{Bone 15, Fifthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel, the Debt Loft as a sound with a direction, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well and flat stone with the skinned trough and the clouded plate of ice, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling and flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the clay road and the terrace toward High Kiln, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the fifteenth came on in the small hours with no door opened and no hand lifted to mark it, no market, Cross or bell on a Fifthday, nothing from Bone 13 or 14 brought in as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, the boy coming into his three hundred and fourteenth day and six months and one hundred and thirty-four days with nobody saying so, the count going 313 to 314 exact, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 314 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the crust gone stiffer and leathery two inches from his ear with its corner standing a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the composed face not composure and the surgeon’s knowing that a cold patient cannot clot checked by the infant’s want with both true, the second louder and neither winning and the argument itself the work (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086); the house kept by its not-doings and he kept his finger between what it omitted and what he omitted, three counts in three places that did not become one with the bell’s gap not fetched in from the square and six hearings standing beside and never among with the seventh place empty, and the finding of four arithmetics behind one printed figure sat on a place of its own with no payer, one in twelve unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space and four readings four and not one account, the true subtractions riding locked up the clay road in Berr Clay’s box toward High Kiln, not a lesson, grievance, mending, doctrine or rule and not laid across the house’s not-doings, the covered grain, the four held changes on four places or his own gaps, the edges coming near to touching and the finger going between (T015/T041/T047, T061/T082); Sella went to the fire before the basket, told the coals the thaw, turned them with the back of a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted small intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, kept her finger above the charcoal tally and her lips along a two-gapped row, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, lifted the twice-mended pot with her thumb first where the wire crossed the crack and said both proverbs to the pot and the fire with the crack showing, set the rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, righted the fold without a look at his face, left the thread where it lay and touched not the widow’s mark, five openings in five months being five and not a rule with the next standing far off in a later month’s first firing (T058/T079, T100, T009/T013/T092); Tarn at the kindling kept the knife at the very edge of its sill where it could be checked and slip, six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count, brought his ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped with no figure and no name as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, left the Seed 16 breath unspent, worked Ash into the creases of his knuckles, held the pale clip-ring to the grey, said Yes, house to an early and a late thaw while wanting the late because it puts off the paying, kept the warm loft stone cold in its unmarked pot in the Debt Loft, unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness, and no collector came up the clay road or went down it (T036/T076, T006); Jorra came through the finger’s-width door with meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent finger and white in the creases, parted dusty and clean forearms as clot from vessel, spoke to wheel and pot before any person, knew the full note three turns ahead and withheld it from a High Kiln master who would call it early, set his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, read one iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies, grew quieter at the burned-slate word with the fifth telling standing at five, no witness, no hand at the flame, no sixth and no payer, kept he’s not Vail sealed and the promise of the foundling’s name neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T065/T095); \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and not paid:} at the end of the morning the hand outside the wool came up an inch toward the river’s note, took a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his and let it go whole on the same low note, and then for the first time did not come straight down to the fold but stayed at the inch for the space of the note’s fading, held and not reaching, the two inches to the crust still unclosed; the surgeon read it as a clamp left a moment after the bleeding had stopped and a tourniquet not yet released, the infant read it as a hand that had not given up wanting the crust, both true and neither winning, and the boy filed it as the \textbf{two hundred and third} answer, a letting-go followed by a staying at the inch, a new object on a place of its own on the sixth with a finger between it and the two hundred and second, closing none of the two inches and standing up as no reach, gift, power, hearing, seventh, stopping, fifth held change or payer, not laid across the house’s four held changes on four places, the covered grain, the four arithmetics or his own gaps; one staying was a keeping, two would be a habit and a habit would want a payer (T060/T086, T061/T082 advanced, not paid); in the afternoon she carried him down at the half-pace and went wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a step and no number, the three coverings at the well called weather and entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause, the month’s hunts and repairs staying directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather with a man shifting a burden answering the cost with the weather and going off toward the clay road and another with a cracked jar in a rope sling told to ask the pot, which said nothing, the dressed grain covered and unfigured under a number that did not know what it cost, Tarn’s stroke going over the shallow bright patch without the half-check, the returned half-check of the eighth standing with the Day 161 fraction, the Day 166 shelf beat and the Frost 5 beat as four held changes on four places and not a rule, and the fifth burned-slate telling, Ilva’s ninth hand with the strip in her sleeve, the row at five askings, the well-saying at three shapings, the shut-room tellings at two, the pot sayings at three with the Smoke 14 note apart, nine stoppings with no tenth, the heard bell beside the told and the told figure beside the paid all held unchanged (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T083/T085, T077, T062/T035/T031, T080, T101, T078, T050/T051, T033/T034); at the going of the light the hand came up an inch, took a small intake and let it go whole on the river’s note and came straight down --- it did not stay again, for one staying was a keeping and two would be a habit that wanted a payer --- and in the small hours he turned out the file as instruments on a towel, six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the stayed-at-the-inch object on its own place on the sixth, every gap left gap and nothing standing up as a reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, key, power, freedom, gift, doctrine or rule; the hand came down on the river’s note and laid itself back against the fold on the \textbf{two hundred and fourth} answer, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air with no payer named, three hundred and fourteen standing exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill or Grath, two hundred and four honest answers on the sixth place, the file open on the towel with every gap left gap, the silt-clouded plate of ice standing on its flat stone out of the path of feet and Bone going on without a boundary drawn, nothing on the fifteenth of Bone opened, joined, named, called, paid or ended (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082).}
