\CRday{Day 317}{Bone 18, Eighthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well and flat stone with the skinned trough and the clouded plate of ice, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling and flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge, its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only) and the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), the clay road and Cold Acre as a direction, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the eighteenth came on the way a vessel comes to the top of a kiln, from the inside by a change in the air no hand had made, no market, Cross or bell on an Eighthday and nothing from Bone 16 or 17 brought in as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, the boy coming into his three hundred and seventeenth day and six months and one hundred and thirty-seven days with nobody saying so, the count going 316 to 317 exact, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 317 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the body taken in its old order with the crust stiff and leathery two inches from the ear, its corner a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon’s knowing that a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly checked by the infant’s louder want with both true, the second louder, neither winning and the argument itself the work (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086); Sella went to the fire before the basket, told the coals the thaw, turned them with a broken pot and stood counting small intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, the boy hearing the three small words as his own three kept in a woman’s breath and a boy’s file with a finger between and neither the other’s cause, kept her finger on the loaf shelf’s front edge with the charcoal unread and two gaps unfigured, glanced once at the clay jar and shut her hand half over nothing, lifted the twice-mended pot with her thumb first where the wire crossed the crack with both proverbs to pot and fire and the crack showing, turned the dressed grain under wool with a still lighter touch and no figure, set the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, put the fold right without a look at his face, left the thread where it lay and did not touch the widow’s mark because a morning and a hearth are not openings and five openings in five months are five and not a rule (T058/T079, T100, T009/T013/T092); three counts stayed in three places --- the carried fire’s four low pulls and silent fifth, the boards’ four nails and a thumb-width knot, the river’s low over lower not numbered among the hearings --- with the heard bell in its square beside the told, six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the told figure beside the paid with no signature, and four arithmetics of the year behind one printed figure with one in twelve unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid, four readings four and not one account, the four true subtractions locked in Berr Clay’s box toward High Kiln and the finding on a place of its own with no payer not laid across the house’s not-doings, the covered grain, the four held changes, the staying, the early letting-go or his own gaps, the edges so near to touching that a less careful hand would call the touching a cause and the finger going between (T061/T082, T078, T015/T041/T047); the staying of Bone 15 and the early letting-go of Bone 17 stayed two objects on two places with a finger between and neither made again, one staying a keeping and two a habit, one early letting-go a letting-go and two a way, and both a habit and a way wanting a payer with none standing (T060/T086, T062/T035/T031); he turned out the file as instruments on a towel --- the burned slate at five with no sixth and no witness, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, the well-saying at three shapings, the shut-room tellings at two, the pot sayings at three with the Smoke 14 note apart, nine record-first hands with the ninth unread in a sleeve and no tenth, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, six hearings with the seventh place empty, the heard bell beside the told, seven green a colour and seven shape a shape with no eighth --- and found every gap left gap with nothing standing up as a reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, gift, doctrine or rule (T101, T080, T036/T076, T050/T051, T033/T034); in the morning the hand let a small intake go whole on the river’s note for the \textbf{two hundred and ninth} answer, the note having done before the hand came down so the letting-go was not early again and the hand did not stay, a restraint and not a payment with no payer named; in the afternoon she carried him down at the half-pace and went wide around the seven walked-around places with no number, the three coverings at the well staying weather entered nowhere with no fourth likeness made a cause, the dressed grain turned with a still lighter touch and no figure, a man down from Cold Acre with a hare across his shoulders answering the cost with the weather and a man with a cracked jar in a rope sling told to ask the pot, Tarn keeping six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip with the unforged collector sentence beside it, the ear-sentence stopping at the word that would call the loan as a ninth stopping with no tenth, the Seed 16 breath unspent, Ash in his knuckles and the pale clip-ring holding light, and Jorra coming through the door with meal-fine grey dust, parting dusty and clean forearms as clot from vessel, speaking to wheel and pot before any person, withholding the note three turns ahead, putting his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, giving the men in the back room no name and not saying the room was cold, with he’s not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T077, T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T083/T085, T036/T076, T035/T031/T062, T065/T095); Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken 317 days and the tile debt uncalled and worse for being uncalled; at the going of the light she carried him up and set him on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, went once more to the fire and did not look toward the bed, and the hand let a small intake go whole on the river’s note for the \textbf{two hundred and tenth} answer and laid itself back against the fold, not early and not staying, two hundred and ten honest answers standing on the sixth, each an object and not a power, and three hundred and seventeen standing exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill or Grath with six months and one hundred and thirty-seven days told by nobody, the fire’s fifth unpaid and Garl’s name unspoken the same number; nothing on the eighteenth was opened, joined, named, called, paid or ended, Bone 20 (Day 319), the month’s second reading, stood two mornings ahead in a day that had not earned it and was not brought in, and the file lay open on the towel with every gap left gap and the silt-clouded plate of ice standing on its flat stone out of the path of feet while Bone went on without a boundary drawn (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T060/T086).}
\CRday{Day 318}{Bone 19, Ninthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well and flat stone with the skinned trough and the silt-clouded plate of ice, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place on the worked strips, the kindling and flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the nineteenth came on an ordinary Ninthday with no market, Cross or bell and nothing from Bone 10 through 18 brought in as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, the boy coming into his three hundred and eighteenth day with nobody saying so, the count going 317 to 318 exact, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 318 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the body taken in its old order of crust two inches off gone leathery in the dry heat with its corner a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon’s knowing that a cold patient cannot clot checked by the infant’s louder want with both true, the second louder, neither winning and the argument itself the work (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086), three counts in three places that did not become one --- the carried fire’s four low pulls and its silent fifth, the boards’ four nails and a thumb-width knot, the river going low over lower not numbered among the hearings --- with the bell’s gap left in its square, six hearings standing beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the heard bell beside the told and the told figure beside the paid (T061/T082, T078), and four arithmetics of the year locked in Berr Clay’s box behind one printed figure with one in twelve unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space and the finding kept on a place of its own with no payer and a finger between it and the house’s not-doings, the covered grain, the four held changes, the staying, the early letting-go and his own gaps (T015/T041/T047); Sella went to the fire before the basket, told the coals it was the thaw, turned them with the back of a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted small intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, kept her finger on top of the loaf shelf with the charcoal unread, moved her lips along a two-gapped row unfigured, glanced once at the clay jar cold under lead glaze and shut her hand half over nothing with the little-door burn closing on air, lifted the twice-mended pot with her thumb first where the wire crossed the crack and said both proverbs to pot and fire with the crack showing, turned the dressed grain under wool with a lighter touch and no figure, set the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, righted the fold without a look at his face, left the thread and did not touch the widow’s mark, five openings in five months being five and not a rule with the next standing far off (T058/T079/T100, T009/T013/T092); in the afternoon she carried him down at the half-pace and went wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, the clean dark line and the finer grey thaw unswept both, the broken birth-slates beneath the lowest rack, the pan’s gone round ring with no scrape, crumb, print, chip or word, the skinned trough, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, no eighth likeness stood up and no number spoken, the three coverings at the well staying weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause, a man down from Cold Acre with a hare answering the cost with the weather and going off toward the clay road with nobody weighing it and nobody opening a slate and a man with a cracked jar in a rope sling told to ask the pot, which said nothing (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T083/T085, T077); Tarn at the kindling kept six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, told the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count, brought his ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped with no figure and no name as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, said Yes, house to an early and a late thaw while keeping the late because it puts off the paying, left the Seed 16 breath unspent with his chest tight since the dark, worked Ash into his knuckles in the colour of the clean dark line and held the pale clip-ring to the grey, his stroke going over the bright patch without the half-check and the returned half-check of Bone 8 staying with the Day 161 fraction, the Day 166 shelf beat and the Frost 5 beat as four held changes on four places and not a rule (T036/T076/T006, T062/T035/T031); Jorra came through the door with meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent finger and white in the creases where a fist had opened, not bone-coloured slip, parted dusty and clean forearms as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel and a pot before any person, knew the full note three turns ahead and withheld it from a High Kiln master who would call it early, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, gave the men in the back room no name and did not say the room was cold, with he’s not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062, T065/T095); the tray was checked unchanged with the burned slate at five, the row at five askings, the well-saying at three shapings, the shut-room tellings at two, the pot sayings at three with the Smoke 14 note apart, nine hands with Ilva’s strip in her sleeve offstage and no tenth, nine stoppings with no tenth, seven green a colour and seven shape a shape with no eighth, and Garl staying in objects with his name unspoken 318 days and no collector on the clay road (T101, T080, T064, T078, T050/T051, T033/T034, T009/T013/T092); the staying of Bone 15 and the early letting-go of Bone 17 stayed two objects on two places and were not made again, and the hand entered the \textbf{two hundred and eleventh} answer in the first light and the \textbf{two hundred and twelfth} in the small hours, each a small intake let go whole on the river’s note, coming straight down because the note had done before the hand came down, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air and promoted into no reach, hearing, seventh, stopping, payment, held change, gift, doctrine or rule with no payer named, the file lying open on the towel with every gap left gap, three hundred and eighteen standing exact and spoken by nobody, and nothing on the nineteenth opened, joined, named, called, paid or ended (T060/T086, T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 319}{Bone 20, Tenthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel, up the clay road to the Cross, the reading block and the moot-post’s finger’s width of shade where no slate lay, the out-of-line landing below the north bridge and the road toward Greybank, then back down the clay road to the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well where Ilva drew with the pail against her knee and an open slate lay on the stone lip a pace away, the flat stone with the silt-clouded plate of ice, the skinned trough, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling and flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the twentieth came up out of the dark as the month’s second Account-day and market with nothing from the nineteenth brought in as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, the boy coming into his three hundred and nineteenth day and six months and one hundred and thirty-nine days with nobody saying so, the count going 318 to 319 exact, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 319 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the body inventoried in its old order of crust, unnamed gap, frozen thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon’s knowing checked by the infant’s louder want with both true and neither winning (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086); Sella carried him down at the half-pace, gave the instruction to the wool and the river wind and never to the basket and set the basket in the moot-post’s finger’s width of shade where no slate lay, standing half a pace off through the reading and the bell (T058/T079); \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and not paid:} Berr Clay came up short off the clay road with the red wool cord folded square under his coat and the sweetish green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner, wiped his thumb twice on his apron before touching nothing, held a narrow slate unopened to his forearm, passed a finger over the figure, read One in twelve, as the notice says low into the two hundred and sent the figure twice over the basket --- once for the moot and once for the late households --- called the levy and denied it with The levy is called. It is not called by me and your house, never I, taking himself out of his own sentence as a surgeon takes a hand out of a field before the dressing goes on, and went off up the clay road with the box locked, Bone’s second true subtraction riding inside beside the three of Frost and the first of Bone, believing he had done a kindness, so that \textbf{five arithmetics of the year now stand behind one printed figure} with one in twelve unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space, five readings five and not one account, and the finding kept on a place of its own with no payer and a finger between it and the house’s not-doings, the covered grain, the four held changes, the stayed object, the early letting-go and his own gaps (T015/T041/T047, T061/T082); the reading answered nothing for the hare gone into the weather, the hand that went in on Seed 15, the man carried out on Day 188 or the dressed grain read over by a number that did not know its cost, and the bell went four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself, the heard bell staying in its square beside the told and its gap not made a seventh of the hearings or a payer (T078); Hessa Rale took Berr’s slate up the road toward Greybank before noon, edge-on and unread, answering the women who asked with I don’t read it. I carry it. There’s a difference, and the road doesn’t care which, her hand to the slate before her eyes to the crowd, not made a reader by the fifth arithmetic and her eighth hand eight and not a rule (T080 advanced, not paid), while the soft-cuffed clerk stayed set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called with hand to slate before eyes to stalls (T090 held), and a silent green-mouthed woman at the pot board and a foundling in cast-off clothes at the market’s edge stood as a seventh of each with no eighth, no name and no loaf (T050/T051, T033/T034 held); in the afternoon Sella carried him home at the going of the half-pace and went wide around the seven walked-around places with no number, the three coverings staying weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair, and Ilva drew at the well with clay pale in her nail crescents and grey rack dust in one thumb seam she did not scrub out, to the woman who asked what the firings of Bone had taken put her hand toward her sleeve and stayed, the notched strip not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the open slate, the charcoal, the cord, the knot-string or the ownerless saying, and answered Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account, her eyes going to the asker and her mouth opening after both with a half-beat, and the boy filing the order of reaching as the \textbf{ninth} record-first hand on its own place with a finger between it and Hessa’s eighth, filing no tenth and not making her a reader of her own keeping (T080 advanced, not paid); fresh scurf of road-mud come in on a coat gone up the road with the reading lay on the stone lip, brushed by nobody and given no figure, the dressed grain was turned under wool with a still lighter touch and no figure, Tarn kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip with the ear-sentence stopping at the calling word as a ninth stopping with no tenth, and Jorra parted dusty forearms from clean, spoke to wheel and pot before any person, withheld the note three turns ahead and put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, with he’s not Vail sealed (T036/T076, T035/T031/T062); the tray and the four held changes were checked unchanged with the burned slate at five and no sixth, nine hands and nine stoppings with no tenth, six hearings with the seventh place empty and five openings with the next far off (T101, T080, T062/T035/T031); the hand entered the \textbf{two hundred and thirteenth} answer in the moot-post’s shade and the \textbf{two hundred and fourteenth} at the close, each a small intake let go whole on the river’s note, coming straight down, not early a second time and not laid across the five arithmetics or the bell’s gap, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air with no payer named, and three hundred and nineteen stood exact and spoken by nobody, the second reading having changed the district’s arithmetic and changed nothing under the roof (T060/T086, T061/T082, T071/T072, T088).}
\CRday{Day 320}{Bone 21, Firstday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well and flat stone with the skinned trough and the silt-clouded plate of ice, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling and flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the twenty-first came on an ordinary Firstday with no market, Cross or bell and nothing from Bone 19 or 20 brought back as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment and the reading not re-read, the boy coming into his three hundred and twentieth day with nobody saying so, the count going 319 to 320 exact, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 320 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the body taken in its old order of crust two inches off gone leathery in the dry heat with its corner a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon’s knowing checked by the infant’s louder want with both true, the second louder, neither winning and the argument itself the work (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086); Sella went to the fire before the basket, told the coals the thaw, turned them with the back of a broken pot, said The house will keep it, counted small intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, kept her finger on top of the loaf shelf with the charcoal unread, moved her lips along a two-gapped row unfigured, glanced once at the clay jar cold under lead glaze and shut her hand half over nothing, lifted the twice-mended pot with her thumb first where the wire crossed the crack and said both proverbs to pot and fire with the crack showing, turned the dressed grain under wool with a still lighter touch and no figure, set the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, put the fold right without a look at his face, left the thread and did not touch the widow’s mark, five openings in five months being five and not a rule (T058/T079/T100, T009/T013/T092); three counts stayed in three places --- the carried fire’s four low pulls and its silent fifth, the boards’ four nails and a thumb-width knot, the river going low over lower not numbered among the hearings --- with the bell’s gap left in its square, six hearings standing beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the heard bell beside the told and the told figure beside the paid (T061/T082, T078), and \textbf{five arithmetics of the year behind one printed figure}, one in twelve unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space, five readings five and not one account, the five true subtractions locked up the clay road in Berr Clay’s box toward High Kiln and the finding kept on a place of its own with no payer and a finger between it and the house’s not-doings, the covered grain, the four held changes, the two small objects of the hand and his own gaps (T015/T041/T047); the staying of Bone 15 and the early letting-go of Bone 17 stayed two objects on two places and were not made again, neither standing up as a habit, a way, a fifth held change or a doctrine with a payer, and he turned the file out on the towel as instruments are turned out at the end of a list, laying each thing on its own place and asking nothing of any of it (T060/T086, T061/T082); in the afternoon the yard went around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, a man down from High Kiln with a hare answering the cost with the weather and a man with a cracked jar in a rope sling told to ask the pot, the three coverings at the well staying weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause, and the returned half-check of Bone 8 staying on the flagstones with the Day 161 fraction at the damper, the Day 166 beat beneath the shelf and the Frost 5 returned beat as four held changes on four places and not a rule, a thing kept by not being made again still kept (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T083/T085, T077, T062/T035/T031, T036/T076); the whole holding tray came out unchanged with the burned slate at five and no sixth, no witness and no hand at the flame, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, the well-saying at three shapings, the shut-room tellings at two, the pot sayings at three with the Smoke 14 note apart, nine hands with Ilva’s strip unread in her sleeve and no tenth, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and the loan uncalled, six hearings with the seventh place empty, five openings in five months with the widow’s mark where it hung and the next far off, and seven green a colour and seven shape a shape with no eighth (T101, T080, T036/T076/T006, T058/T079, T050/T051, T033/T034); Tarn kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, his ear-sentence stopping at the calling word as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, the Seed 16 breath unspent, Ash in his knuckles and the pale clip-ring holding light, with no collector on the clay road, and Jorra parted dusty forearms from clean, spoke to wheel and pot before any person, withheld the full note he knew three turns ahead from a High Kiln master, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, and kept he’s not Vail sealed, while Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken 320 days and the tile debt circling without a name (T036/T076, T035/T031/T062, T009/T013/T092); Sella carried him up at the going of the light and set him under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, righted the fold without a look at his face and left the thread, and the hand entered the \textbf{two hundred and fifteenth} answer in the morning and the \textbf{two hundred and sixteenth} at the very end of the day, when the yard had gone quiet and the river’s note was at its lowest, each a small intake held whole and let go on the same low note and coming straight down, the note having done before the hand came down so the letting-go was neither early nor stayed, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, borrowing no house count and supplying no payer and laid across neither the five arithmetics, the bell’s gap, the covered grain, the stayed object, the early letting-go nor his own gaps, and \textbf{two hundred and sixteen honest answers} stood on the sixth place, each an object and not a power and none a doctrine, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood; three hundred and twenty stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill and Grath, six months and one hundred and forty days were told by nobody, the keeping of the number was the only honest work there was to do and bought nothing at two inches of air and he went on keeping it because attention is the one thing no institution can tax, the river’s low note going quiet under the finger’s-width door while the silt-clouded plate of ice stood on its flat stone out of the path of feet, the file lying open on the towel with every gap left gap and Bone going on without a boundary drawn, with Bone 30 (Day 329), the month’s third and last reading, eight mornings ahead (T060/T086, T061/T082, T071/T072, T088, T015/T041/T047).}

\CRday{Day 322}{Bone 23, Thirdday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well and flat stone with the skinned trough and the silt-clouded plate of ice where Ilva drew with the pail against her knee, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling and flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Bone 23 came on an ordinary Thirdday with no market, Cross or bell and nothing from the twenty-second brought in as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, the handful let fall at the rack end held as one object and not made again, the boy coming into his three hundred and twenty-second day with the count going 321 to 322 exact, six months and one hundred and forty-two days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 322 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the body taken in its old order of crust, unnamed gap, frozen thread, cold at cheek, temple and wrist and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon’s knowing checked by the infant’s louder want with neither winning, three counts in three places that did not become one with the bell’s gap not fetched in to make a fourth, six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the heard bell in its square beside the told and the told figure beside the paid, five arithmetics of the year behind one unsigned figure with the finding on a place of its own and no payer not laid across the house’s not-doings, the covered grain, the four held changes, the handful, the two small objects of the hand or the boy’s gaps (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086, T015/T041/T047); Sella kept the hearth grammar exactly, fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot, The house will keep it, small intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger on top of the shelf with the charcoal unread, lips along a two-gapped row, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing, the twice-mended pot lifted on the thumb at the wire with both proverbs and the crack showing, the widow’s mark untouched at a morning, and this morning her fingers went into the dressed grain and came out again without closing and did not lift a handful or let one fall, which the boy filed as a keeping beside the object kept and not as a second, for two would be a habit wanting a payer and three a way wanting one, the surgeon taking a clean satisfaction in a field not disturbed twice while the infant took none and wanted the crust lifted, both true and the second louder and neither winning (T077 held, not repeated, T061/T082); at the yard well Ilva drew with the pail against her knee, the rope stiff in the dry cold giving its small dry rasp, clay dried pale in the crescents of her nails and grey rack dust worked into one thumb seam she did not scrub out, and to a woman who asked what the firings of Bone had taken her hand went toward her sleeve and stayed, the short strip of notched birch bark not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the open slate a pace away or the charcoal beneath the shelf, no figure coming off the wood, and she answered the question put and not the one behind it with Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account, then put her flat hand once more on the sleeve and went back to the pail, and nobody turned twice; the boy took the order of her reaching apart as a chart is taken apart and filed it as the \textbf{ninth} record-first hand with a finger between it and Hessa Rale’s eighth, filed no tenth, made her no reader of her own keeping and joined her to none of Marra, the soft-handed man, the soft-cuffed clerk, Hessa, the green-mouthed woman or the Drawing collector (T080 advanced, not paid); the holding tray was checked unchanged --- burned slate at five with no sixth, row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, well-saying at three shapings, shut-room tellings at two, pot sayings at three with the Smoke 14 note apart, six hearings with the seventh empty, nine stoppings with no tenth and the loan uncalled, four held changes on four places with the handful not made a fifth, five arithmetics in Berr’s locked box, the heard bell beside the told, seven green a colour and seven shape a shape with no eighth, no collector up or down the clay road, Garl’s name unspoken 322 days --- and at the going of the light Sella carried him up and in the small hours the hand went up an inch, took a small intake, held the interval whole, let it go on the note and came straight down on answer 220, with two hundred and twenty honest answers standing on the sixth and the number spoken by nobody.}

before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot, The house will keep it, small intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, and the boy put a finger between her counting in the room that does not touch his and his three, for two people keeping the same sound under one roof is not one sound and two likenesses are not a cause, her finger on top of the shelf with the charcoal unread, lips along the two-gapped row, one glance at the clay jar and the hand half over nothing, the twice-mended pot on the thumb at the wire with both proverbs and the crack showing, dressed grain turned beneath the wool with the lighter touch and no figure and no handful, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, widow’s mark untouched at a morning; in the afternoon the yard stood in its dry light as a field after harvest, went wide around the seven places with a look and a wide step and no number, kept the three coverings weather entered nowhere, sent the Cold Acre hare into the weather and the cracked jar to a pot that said nothing, and the boy checked the whole holding tray as a surgeon checks a tray before the dressing goes on --- burned slate at five, row at five askings with one shaping, well-saying at three shapings beside Hessa’s eighth hand, nine hands with Ilva’s strip unread and she offstage, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and the warm loft stone cold in its pot unreconciled by not trying, six hearings with the seventh empty, heard bell beside told, two shut-room tellings, three pot sayings with the Smoke 14 note apart, five openings in five months, seven green a colour and seven shape a shape, the widow’s mark hung where it hung, no collector on the clay road --- with Tarn at the kindling keeping six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged sentence, saying Six counted. The next I don’t count, saying Yes, house to the woman who asked what the seventh year would want and to both men who said the thaw would be early and late and keeping the late because it puts off the paying, his ear-sentence stopping at the word that would call the loan and the Seed 16 breath unspent and his chest tight, ash in his knuckles and the pale clip-ring holding what light there was, and with Jorra at the shed’s edge parting dusty forearms from clean, speaking to the wheel before any person, knowing the full note the pot would give three turns before it left his hands and withholding it from any High Kiln master who would call it early, his bent finger in the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence with the iron’s two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies, he’s not Vail sealed and the promise to the slate-burners neither given nor withdrawn, and Garl kept in objects with his name unspoken 323 days and the tile debt uncalled; Sella carried him up at the going of the light and never into the Debt Loft, the loft a small dry scrape above and behind with no interior opening, put the fold right without a look at his face and left the thread frozen and unwiped, and at the very end of the day with the yard quiet and the river’s note at its lowest the hand outside the wool went up an inch, took a small intake, held the interval whole, let it go on the same note and came straight down and laid itself back against the fold on answer 222, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across neither the five arithmetics, the bell’s gap, the covered grain, the handful, the stayed object, the early letting-go nor his own gaps, and neither early again nor stayed; the surgeon took a clean satisfaction in the field left as found while the infant wanted the crust lifted and the thread wiped and got neither, both true and the second louder and neither winning, three hundred and twenty-three standing exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill and Grath, six months and one hundred and forty-three days told by nobody, the keeping of the number the only honest work there was to do and bought nothing at two inches of air, the file open on the towel with every gap left gap, one stiff brown-edged crust two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, and the river’s low note going quiet under the finger’s-width door while Bone went on without a boundary drawn, six mornings short of the month’s last reading and not brought into a day that had not earned it.}

three counts stood in three places and did not become one --- the carried fire’s four pulls and its silent fifth, the boards’ four, four and a thumb-width knot, and the river’s low over lower not numbered among the hearings --- with the bell’s gap not fetched in to make a fourth, the heard bell in its square beside the told, six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the told figure beside the paid with no signature, and five arithmetics of the year behind one printed figure, one in twelve unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid, five readings five and not one account, the five true subtractions locked in Berr Clay’s box toward High Kiln and the finding on a place of its own with no payer not laid across the house’s not-doings, the covered grain, the four held changes, the handful, the two small objects of the hand or his own gaps, the edges so near to touching that a less careful hand would call the touching a cause and the finger going between (T061/T082, T078, T015/T041/T047); when it came and two fence-menders said the thaw would be early and late, and Tarn at the kindling said Yes, house to each and kept the late because a late thaw puts off the paying, agreeing so thoroughly that there was nowhere for an argument to find a foot, his chest tight since the dark, the Seed 16 breath unspent, Ash in his knuckle creases, the pale clip-ring holding light and Garl’s unforged collector sentence lying beside the seventh notch with no name on the man who turned back at the ford and no figure on the debt (T036/T076, T009/T013/T092); the thumb’s resting was checked and found where it had been left on its own place and not made again, not a tenth stopping, not the seventh year given, not a payment, not a fifth held change, not a hearing, not a near-full answer, not a mending and not a rule, with a finger between it and the nine stoppings, the four held changes, the handful and his own gaps, a touch that took nothing and paid nothing and was kept because it was true and not because it bought anything, for a thing kept because it is bought is an account and a thing kept because it is true is only a thing kept (T036/T076/T006, T060/T086, T061/T082); Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken 326 days and the tile debt uncalled and worse for being uncalled, and Jorra came through the finger’s-width door with meal-fine grey dust past the bent finger, parted dusty and clean forearms as clot from vessel, spoke to wheel and pot before any person, withheld the full note three turns ahead and put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence with the iron’s two bites and he’s not Vail sealed (T035/T031/T062); Sella carried him up at the going of the light and set him under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, a foot on the loft stair heard above and behind with no door opened and no interior entered, put the fold right without a look at his face and left the thread frozen and unwiped, and at the very end of the day, with the yard quiet and the river’s note at its lowest under the finger’s-width door, the hand outside the wool went up an inch, took a small intake, held the interval whole, let it go on the same low note and came straight down and laid itself back against the fold on answer \textbf{two hundred and twenty-eight}, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across neither the five arithmetics, the bell’s gap, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb’s resting, the stayed object, the early letting-go nor his own kept gaps, neither early again nor stayed; the surgeon took his clean satisfaction in a field left as found while the infant wanted the crust lifted and the thread wiped and got neither, and \textbf{two hundred and twenty-eight honest answers} stood on the sixth, each an object and not a power and none a doctrine, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood; three hundred and twenty-six stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill and Grath, six months and one hundred and forty-six days were told by nobody, the keeping of the number the only honest work there was to do all day and bought nothing at two inches of air, going on because attention is the one thing no institution can tax, the silt-clouded plate of ice standing on its flat stone out of the path of feet, the file open on the towel with every gap left gap and the hand laid back against the fold while the river’s low note went quiet under the finger’s-width door and Bone went on without a boundary drawn, three mornings short of the month’s third and last reading and not brought into a day that had not earned it (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086, T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 327}{Bone 28, Eighthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well and flat stone with the skinned trough and the silt-clouded plate of ice, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place on the worked strips, the kindling with the knife at its sill, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road and Cold Acre as directions, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the twenty-eighth came on an ordinary Eighthday with no market, Cross or bell and nothing from the twenty-seventh brought in as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, the boy coming into his three hundred and twenty-seventh day with the hand laid down on answer 228 as a tool put away where the next hand would find it without looking, the count going 326 to 327 exact, six months and one hundred and forty-seven days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 327 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the body taken in its old order of crust two inches off gone leathery in the dry heat with its corner a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the composed face that is not composure and the surgeon’s knowing that a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly checked by the infant’s louder want with both true and neither winning and the argument itself the work (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086); Sella kept the hearth grammar exactly, fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot, The house will keep it where another woman would have said I, small intake, hold and letting-go counted toward no opening with neither gap figured and the three acts kept on their own place with a finger between them and his three, for two people keeping the same sound under one roof are not one sound and two likenesses are not a cause, finger on top of the loaf shelf with the charcoal unread, lips along a two-gapped row unfigured, one glance at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, the twice-mended pot lifted thumb-first where the wire crossed the crack with both proverbs to pot and fire and the crack showing, dressed grain turned under wool with a still lighter touch and no figure and no handful, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, widow’s mark untouched at a morning and a hearth with five openings in five months five and not a rule and the sixth far off at Ash 2 (T058/T079/T100, T009/T013/T092); three counts stood in three places and did not become one --- the carried fire’s four low pulls and its silent fifth, the boards’ four nails and four and a thumb-width knot, and the river’s water over water not numbered among the hearings --- with the bell’s gap left in its square, six hearings standing beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the heard bell beside the told bell of the Long Night and the told figure beside the paid with no signature, and five arithmetics of the year behind one printed figure, one in twelve unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid, five readings five and not one account, the five true subtractions locked up the clay road in Berr Clay’s box toward High Kiln and the finding on a place of its own with no payer not laid across the house’s not-doings, the covered grain, the four held changes, the handful, the thumb’s resting, the two small objects of the hand or his own gaps, the edges so near to touching that a less careful hand would call the touching a cause and the finger going between (T061/T082, T078, T015/T041/T047); the file lay open on the towel with the staying of Bone 15, the early letting-go of Bone 17, the handful and the thumb’s resting each on its own place with a finger between and none made again, and four held changes on four places and not a rule; in the afternoon she carried him down at the half-pace and went wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, the three coverings at the well staying weather entered nowhere with the white gone off the north lip on Bone 3, the trough’s skin breaking and closing under a pail’s knock and the silt-clouded plate out of the path of feet, no fourth likeness standing up as a cause, the Cold Acre hare answering the price with the weather and the cracked jar sent to a pot that said nothing, both read as a chart left blank where the number should stand and entered nowhere, the fingers at the rack end going in and coming out empty with no handful lifted (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T083/T085, T077); Tarn kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, set the knife at the very edge of its sill where it could be checked and slipped off, said Six counted. The next I don’t count, brought his ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped there as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight since the dark, Ash in his knuckles and the pale clip-ring holding light, the thumb’s resting on the uncut seventh checked and not made again, and the warm loft stone cold in its unmarked pot unreconciled by not trying, while Jorra parted dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, spoke to wheel and pot before any person, knew the full note three turns ahead and withheld it from any High Kiln master, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence with the iron’s two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies, and kept he’s not Vail sealed (T036/T076/T006, T035/T031/T062); Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken 327 days and the tile debt circling without a name worse for being uncalled, and at the going of the light Sella carried him up and set him under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, the loft a small dry scrape above and behind with no interior entered; the hand entered the \textbf{two hundred and twenty-ninth} answer in the first light and the \textbf{two hundred and thirtieth} in the small hours, each a small intake held whole and let go on the river’s note, coming straight down because the note had done before the hand came down, neither early nor stayed, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer and laid across neither the five arithmetics, the bell’s gap, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb’s resting, the stayed object, the early letting-go nor his own gaps, and \textbf{two hundred and thirty honest answers} stood on the sixth, each an object and not a power and none a doctrine, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood; three hundred and twenty-seven stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill and Grath, six months and one hundred and forty-seven days were told by nobody, the keeping of the number the only honest work there was to do and bought nothing at two inches of air, going on because attention is the one thing no institution can tax, the file open on the towel with every gap left gap and the river’s low note going quiet under the finger’s-width door while Bone went on without a boundary drawn, two mornings short of the month’s third and last reading and not brought into a day that had not earned it (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T060/T086).}
\CRday{Day 328}{Bone 29, Ninthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well and flat stone with the skinned trough and the silt-clouded plate of ice where Ilva drew with the pail against her knee and an open slate lay a pace away, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, nothing from the twenty-eighth brought in as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, the empty fingers at the rack end not repeated and the thumb’s resting on the uncut seventh staying one object and not made again, the boy coming into his three hundred and twenty-eighth day with nobody to say what had been reached, the count going 327 to 328 exact, six months and one hundred and forty-eight days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 328 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the body inventoried in its old order of crust, unnamed gap, thread frozen and unwiped in the dry heat, cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the composed face that is not composure and the surgeon’s knowing that a cold vessel cannot clot checked by the infant’s louder want with both true and neither winning and the argument itself the work, the wanting that goes on under the expectation the way a coal goes on under ash, and the field left as found being the one thing nobody else was keeping and therefore without price or collector (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086); Sella kept the hearth grammar exactly, fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot, The house will keep it, the three small acts kept on their own place with a finger between them and his three, finger on top of the shelf so the charcoal stayed unread, lips along a two-gapped row unfigured, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, the twice-mended pot read as a wound closed where the hand would not have chosen, lifted thumb-first at the wire with both proverbs to pot and fire and the crack showing, dressed grain turned under wool with the lighter touch and no figure and no handful, pot rim two inches beyond the hand with the half-beat measured as the distance between intention and arrest and no look toward the bed, widow’s mark untouched, and the keeping of a tally she would not read and a mark she would not touch at a hearth set side by side with a finger between (T058/T079/T100, T009/T013/T092, T077 held); three counts stood in three places and did not become one with the bell’s gap not fetched in to make a fourth, six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the heard bell beside the told and the told figure beside the paid, and five arithmetics of the year behind one printed figure with one in twelve unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space and the finding on a place of its own with no payer not laid across the house’s not-doings, the covered grain, the four held changes, the handful, the thumb’s resting, the two small objects of the hand or his own gaps, a district’s arithmetic changeable where two hundred people stand and carried home in a locked box to two hundred tables with the printed figure none the wiser (T061/T082, T078, T015/T041/T047); in the afternoon she carried him down at the half-pace and went wide around the seven walked-around places with no number, the three coverings at the well staying weather with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause, and at the well Ilva drew with the pail against her knee, the rope stiff in the dry cold giving its small dry rasp, clay pale in her nail crescents and grey rack dust worked into one thumb seam she did not scrub out, her hands knowing the weight of a pail and the edge of a wet board and never soft and people noticing the pail first and the sleeve not at all; to a woman who asked what the firings of Bone had taken her hand went toward her sleeve and stayed, the short strip of notched birch bark pale where a thumb had rubbed the notches and dark in the uncut grain between not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the open slate a pace away, the charcoal beneath the loaf shelf, the cord, the knot-string or the ownerless saying, no figure coming off the wood, and she answered the question put and not the one behind it with Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account, her eyes to the asker and her mouth opening after both with a half-beat, the flat hand once more on the sleeve before she went back to the pail and nobody turning twice; the boy took the order of reaching apart as a chart is taken apart and filed it as the \textbf{ninth} record-first hand with a finger between it and Hessa Rale’s eighth, filed no tenth, made no figure of the slate’s nearness, made her no reader of her own keeping and joined her to none of Marra, the soft-handed man, the soft-cuffed clerk, Hessa, the green-mouthed woman at the pot board or the Drawing collector, for two likenesses are not a cause and a rule wants a payer and none stood (T080 advanced, not paid); the grain was turned under wool with fingers that went in and came out without closing, and the whole holding tray came out unchanged --- burned slate at five with no sixth, no witness and no hand at the flame, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness and expressly no sixth, the well-saying at three shapings with the eighth hand on its own place, shut-room tellings at two, three pot sayings with the Smoke 14 note apart, nine hands with Ilva’s ninth unread in her sleeve and no tenth, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and the loan uncalled, six hearings with the seventh empty, five openings in five months with the sixth far off at Ash 2, seven green a colour and seven shape a shape with no eighth, the heard bell in its square beside the told, Garl’s name unspoken 328 days and no collector up or down the clay road (T101, T080, T035/T031/T065/T095, T036/T076, T006, T078, T050/T051, T033/T034, T058/T079); Tarn kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged sentence with the thumb’s resting checked and not made again, and Jorra parted dusty forearms from clean, spoke to wheel and pot before any person, withheld the full note he knew three turns ahead and put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence with he’s not Vail sealed; at the going of the light Sella carried him up and set him under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look at his face, left the thread where it lay, and the hand entered the \textbf{two hundred and thirty-first} answer in the first light and the \textbf{two hundred and thirty-second} in the small hours, each a small intake let go whole on the river’s note, coming straight down, neither early nor stayed, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air and laid across neither the five arithmetics, the bell’s gap, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb’s resting, the ninth hand at the well, the stayed object, the early letting-go nor his own kept gaps, and \textbf{two hundred and thirty-two honest answers} stood on the sixth; three hundred and twenty-eight stood exact and spoken by nobody with six months and one hundred and forty-eight days told by nobody, the keeping of the number the only honest work there was to do and bought nothing at two inches of air, the boy’s attention passing from the strip in the sleeve to the reading one morning ahead without joining the two, and Bone going on without a boundary drawn, one morning short of the month’s third and last reading and not brought into a day that had not earned it (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T060/T086).}
\CRday{Day 329}{Bone 30, Tenthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well and flat stone with the skinned trough and the silt-clouded plate of ice, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the kindling with the knife at its sill, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (a foot on a stair heard above and behind, no interior entered), the clay road, and the Cross with the reading block under the moot-post, the moot-post’s finger’s width of shade, the pot board, the out-of-line landing below the north bridge and the market, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the thirtieth came on under the roof without a boundary drawn, the month’s third and last Account-day and market earned by its own morning and not by any that went before, nothing from the twenty-eighth or twenty-ninth crossing as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, the handful and the thumb’s resting not made again, the boy coming into his three hundred and twenty-ninth day with nobody to say what had been reached, the count going 328 to 329 exact, six months and one hundred and forty-nine days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 329 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the body taken in its old order of crust, unnamed gap, thread frozen and unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and the wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon’s knowing that a cold vessel cannot clot checked by the infant’s louder want with both true and neither winning and the argument the work, Sella going to the hearth before the basket with all the old grammar and the widow’s mark untouched, and five arithmetics riding locked up the clay road in Berr Clay’s box with the finding on a place of its own and no payer (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086, T058/T079, T015/T041/T047); in the afternoon she carried him down at the half-pace, went wide around the seven walked-around places with no number, kept the three coverings weather entered nowhere and the dressed grain covered and unfigured, and took him up the clay road toward the square where the market had begun, setting the basket in the moot-post’s finger’s width of shade where no slate lay and standing half a pace off through the reading and the bell; Berr Clay came up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat and the sweetish green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner, under the hot clay of him the smell of nothing at all, his hands large and clean and his thumb wiped twice on his apron before he touched nothing, once for the slate and once for the figure that would be on it, holding a narrow slate unopened against his forearm with the writing inward, passing a finger over the figure and letting his eyes rest on the writing a breath longer than the writing required, reading One in twelve, as the notice says low into the two hundred and sending the figure twice over the basket, once for the moot and once for the late households, never looking into the basket; he called the levy and denied it with The levy is called. It is not called by me and your house, never I, taking himself out of his own sentence as a surgeon takes a hand out of a field before the dressing goes on, and to a man who brought a number up out of a fist he said Your house wants it again, there’ll be a slate at the watch; he said something low to the block about kindness being entered, to which the block answered nothing, and went off up the clay road with the cord folded, the narrow slate under his arm and the box locked, Bone’s third true subtraction riding inside beside the five that had gone before, believing he had done the district a kindness. \textbf{The chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and not paid:} six arithmetics of the year now stand behind one printed figure, six are six and not one account, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space and a rule made from six refused for want of a payer; the boy kept the finding on a place of its own with no payer, not a lesson, grievance, mending, doctrine or rule, and did not lay it across the not-doings, the covered grain, the four held changes, the handful, the thumb’s resting, the two small objects of the hand or his own gaps, the edges coming near to touching and the finger going between; the reading answered nothing for the hand that went in on Seed 15, the man carried out on Day 188, the dressed grain under wool or the carried fire’s missing fifth (T015/T041/T047, T061/T082); Hessa Rale took the slate up the road toward Greybank before noon, edge-on to her forearm with the writing turned to her sleeve, her hand to the slate before her eyes to the crowd, saying I don’t read it. I carry it. There’s a difference, and the road doesn’t care which and Cross to Greybank. Reading goes up before noon. I’ve got a road to walk, her eighth hand staying eighth with no tenth, no figure coming off the slate, no fourth shaping made and no reader or witness made of her (T080 advanced, not paid); the bell went four, four and a gap, longer than a church bell, with the gap where the fifth should have stood and nobody crossing himself, staying in its square beside the told bell; below the north bridge the soft-cuffed clerk sat set at the out-of-line landing where a fifth step should have stood for a measure nobody called, his hand to his inward slate before his eye went up to the stalls, the market selling over him as water goes over a stone, and at the pot board a green-mouthed woman turned a cup a quarter and set it back while at the market’s edge a shape in cast-off clothes worn like a uniform stood where the light did not fall squarely, each filed as the seventh of its kind with no eighth, never named Fenna or Ulda and joined to no loaf, slate, sale, hearing, cause or romance (T078, T090 held, T050/T051, T033/T034); in the moot-post’s shade the hand entered the \textbf{two hundred and thirty-third} answer, small intake held whole and let go on the river’s note and straight down, the note having done before the hand came down, so neither early nor stayed; back in the yard at the going of the light the Cold Acre hare was answered with the weather, the cracked jar sent to a pot that said nothing, and a woman with a basket of kindling asking what the seventh year would want while two fence-menders said the thaw would be early and late, Tarn saying Yes, house to each and keeping the late because a late thaw puts off the paying, agreeing so thoroughly that no argument could find a foot, with no collector up or down the clay road; the whole holding tray was checked unchanged, Tarn’s thumb’s resting on the uncut Seventh held as one object not made again on Bone 28, 29 or 30, a touch that took nothing and paid nothing and was kept because it was true, the handful, the staying and the early letting-go each on its own place and not made again, four held changes on four places and not a rule, six hearings with the seventh empty, nine hands with no tenth and nine stoppings with no tenth, five openings in five months with the sixth far off at Ash 2, Jorra at the shed’s edge parting dusty forearms from clean and putting his bent finger into the cold damper with he’s not Vail sealed, Garl kept in objects with his name unspoken 329 days and the tile debt uncalled, and Sella setting him on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft with the fold righted and the thread left; at the very end the hand entered the \textbf{two hundred and thirty-fourth} answer, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, and \textbf{two hundred and thirty-four honest answers} stood on the sixth, each an object and not a power and none a doctrine; three hundred and twenty-nine stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill and Grath, six months and one hundred and forty-nine days were told by nobody, the keeping of the number the only honest work there was to do and bought nothing at two inches of air, the silt-clouded plate of ice standing on its flat stone out of the path of feet, the file open on the towel with every gap left gap and the river’s low note going quiet under the finger’s-width door while Bone went out without a boundary drawn and neither habit of naming its months set right, Ash 1 one morning ahead and Ash 2, the sixth opening, two mornings ahead, neither brought into a day that had not earned it (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086, T061/T082).}
