in the afternoon she carried him down at the half-pace and went wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, the three coverings at the well staying weather entered nowhere with the frost gone off the north lip on Bone 3, the trough’s skin breaking and closing under a pail’s knock and the silt-clouded plate out of the path of feet, no fourth likeness standing up as a cause, the Cold Acre hare answering the price with the weather and the cracked jar sent to a pot that said nothing, both read as a chart left blank where the number should stand, her fingers at the rack end going in and coming out without closing and no handful lifted, Tarn keeping six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence with the ear-sentence stopped at the word that would call the loan as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight since the dark, Ash in his knuckles and the pale clip-ring holding light, the thumb’s resting checked and not made again, and Jorra parting dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, speaking to wheel and pot before any person, withholding the full note three turns ahead from any High Kiln master, putting his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence with the iron’s two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies, he’s not Vail sealed and the promise to the slate-burners neither given nor withdrawn, the burned slate at five with a finger between the fifth and the four (T009/T013/T092, T098 carried, T083/T085, T077, T036/T076/T006, T035/T031/T062); Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken 330 days and the tile debt uncalled, and at the going of the light Sella carried him up and set him under the roof and never in the Debt Loft with the fold righted and the thread left and a small dry scrape from above and behind with no interior entered; the hand entered the two hundred and thirty-fifth answer in the last of the small hours as the light came, small intake held whole and let go on the river’s note and straight down because the note had done before the hand came down, neither early nor stayed, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, and two hundred and thirty-five honest answers stood on the sixth, each an object and not a power and none a doctrine; three hundred and thirty stood exact and spoken by nobody with six months and 150 days told by nobody, the keeping of the number the only honest work there was to do and bought nothing at two inches of air, the file open on the towel with every gap left gap and the river’s note coming on under the finger’s-width door while Ash came on without a boundary drawn and Ash 2, the sixth opening, stood one morning ahead and was not brought toward it (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086, T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 331}{Ash 2, Secondday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel, then the kiln mouth on the flagstones out of the draught for the dark month’s first firing, the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well and flat stone where Ilva drew with the pail against her knee and an open slate lay a pace away, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place on the worked strips, the kindling with the knife at its sill, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (a foot on the stair heard above and behind, no interior entered), and the clay road with no collector upon it, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the second came on in the dark without a boundary drawn and the kilns had been brought up in the night for the dark month’s first firing, the yard standing in the hot dry smell of clay giving up its water with tallow under it from the wheel-shed and the sweetish edge of lead glaze on a wrong wind off High Kiln that touched the fold and went out on the wind that brought it, a direction arrived nowhere and not a second edge paid, the boy coming into his three hundred and thirty-first day with the count going 330 to 331 exact, six months and 151 days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 331 days and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the body inventoried in its old order with the surgeon’s knowing checked by the infant’s louder want and neither winning (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086); \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and not paid:} at the kiln mouth Sella set the basket level on the flagstones out of the draught where the heat came sideways, and before any instruction went to the basket and before any word she stood over him with her hands still, put her left hand to the widow’s mark at her throat, the cord oiled where a working thumb had touched it ten thousand times and the little-door burn half-closing on the cord, held it one breath and let go, lifted the clay lid with the back of a hand and tipped the carried coal under the back of a broken pot, the fire taking with four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should have stood, its payer unnamed 331 days, \textbf{six openings in six months --- Tallow 1, Ember 1, Smoke 1, Frost 2, Bone 2 and Ash 2 --- now six and not a rule}, no seventh made due, nobody praising the opening, naming what it mended, entering a slate or making a lesson of it, the five behind not looked at again as signs or payments, the mark not touched again at shelf, well, rack, road, basket, yard, morning, afternoon, dusk or going of the light, and the boy taking it by its small sounds and noting only that the fifth pull was still missing, joining it to none (T058/T079, T088); a woman putting a pot down and a man with a wet pot were answered with the pot and the draught and directions and never figures, nobody made a feast of the firing and nobody crossed himself, and when he was carried back the old hearth grammar took up exactly where it had stood, The house will keep it, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot’s back, twice-mended pot thumb-first at the wire with both proverbs and the crack showing, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure and no handful, pot rim two inches beyond the hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, grey streak at her temple pale and coal-black hair pushed back with the burn-wrist, three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings with the seventh empty, told figure beside paid, six arithmetics locked in Berr Clay’s box and the finding on a place of its own with no payer, the finger going between (T015/T041/T047, T061/T082); in the afternoon Sella carried him down at the half-pace and went wide around the seven walked-around places with no number, the three coverings staying weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair, the opened kiln behind them keeping its heat in the ordinary way with nobody making a feast of it, the Cold Acre hare answered with the weather and the cracked jar sent to a pot that said nothing, her fingers at the rack end going in and coming out without closing and no handful lifted, and at the well Ilva drew with the rope stiff in the Ash cold giving its small dry rasp, clay pale in her nail crescents and grey rack dust worked into one thumb seam she did not scrub out, and to a woman who asked what the firings of Ash had taken her hand went toward her sleeve and stayed, the short strip of notched birch bark not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the open slate a pace away, the charcoal beneath the loaf shelf, the cord, the knot-string or the ownerless saying, no figure coming off the wood, and she answered Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account, her eyes to the asker and her mouth opening after both with a half-beat, the flat hand once more on the sleeve before she went back to the pail, the boy filing the order of reaching as the ninth record-first hand with a finger between it and Hessa Rale’s eighth and filing no tenth, making no figure of the slate’s nearness and no reader of her own keeping (T080 advanced, not paid); Tarn at the kindling kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged sentence, set the knife at the very edge of its sill, said It’s back. You can check and Six counted. The next I don’t count, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight, Ash in his knuckle creases and the pale clip-ring holding light, his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, the warm loft stone cold in its unmarked pot, the thumb’s resting checked and not made again, and Jorra came through the finger’s-width door with meal-fine grey dust past the bent finger, parted dusty forearms from clean, spoke to wheel and pot before any person, withheld the full note three turns ahead, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence with the iron’s two bites and he’s not Vail sealed, the burned slate at five, and three or more men unnamed going low into the back room before first grey (T036/T076/T006, T035/T031/T062); at the going of the light Sella carried him up at the half-pace, went wide around the seven places, set him under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look at his face, left the thread, and a foot came on the loft stair from above and behind with no interior entered; the hand entered the two hundred and thirty-seventh answer in the small hours and the two hundred and thirty-eighth at the very end, each a small intake let go whole on the river’s note and straight down because the note had done before the hand came down, neither early nor stayed, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, laid across neither the six arithmetics, the bell’s gap, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb’s resting, the sixth opening nor his own gaps, and two hundred and thirty-eight honest answers stood on the sixth; three hundred and thirty-one stood exact and spoken by nobody with six months and 151 days told by nobody, nothing opened, joined, named, called, paid or ended on the second except the one opening at the kiln mouth which changed the house’s count and changed nothing anybody would enter, Ilva’s strip still in her sleeve with no figure off the wood, the opened kiln missing its fifth behind the wall for the three hundred and thirty-first day, the file open on the towel with every gap left gap and the river’s low note going quiet under the finger’s-width door while Ash 2 stood one morning short of Ash 3 and was not brought toward it (T071/T072, T088, T061/T082, T060/T086).}

Sella kept the hearth grammar exactly in the morning, fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot, The house will keep it, small intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger on top of the loaf shelf with the charcoal unread, lips along a two-gapped row unfigured, one glance at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, the twice-mended pot lifted thumb-first where the wire crossed the crack with both proverbs to pot and fire and the crack showing, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure and no handful, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, the grey streak at her temple pale and the widow’s mark untouched at a morning and a hearth (T058/T079/T100, T009/T013/T092, T077 held); \textbf{the chapter’s first meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T035/T031/T065/T095):} in the afternoon, over the boards of the Clay Yard on the same breath as the price of barley and the weather, a voice with nobody behind it said that the slate which had burned was burned in the room with the damper shut --- the Greybank saying about a counting room shut in the war, which the yard had always taken as history eighteen leagues east, spoken here without a date, a room named, a hand at the flame, an owner or a witness standing anywhere to be asked, the voice going off up the terrace with the barley price after it while the yard went on around the two sayings as a broom goes around a stone it does not touch and nobody turned twice; the boy took the sentence apart as a surgeon takes a wound apart, by what was there and what was not, and set the joining on a place of its own with a finger between it and everything else, \textbf{not a sixth telling of the burned slate} (which stood at five with a finger between the fifth and the four), \textbf{not a third telling of the shut room} (which stood at two), not a hearing, not a seventh of the full note, not a stopping, not a payment, not a cause, not a confession, not a rule and not a chart a clerk would carry, with no payer and no name under it, and the claim went on gathering interest against Jorra’s promise, which was neither given nor withdrawn, the betrayal that waited to be called not called here; Sella, who had lost a husband to that danger and had never once described it that way herself, gave no name to the voice and no figure to the saying, and Jorra grew quieter as it went around the boards with the household straightening around the quiet without an order from anybody, his bent finger going into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence with the iron’s two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies and he’s not Vail sealed; \textbf{the chapter’s second meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T080):} after that, at the yard well, on the same breath as the price of barley and the weather, a second voice with nobody behind it gave the Frost 14 well-saying a \textbf{fourth shaping} --- the runner who had once carried the figure had come back down the clay road with the writing of the slate turned toward herself --- with no room named, no hand at a slate, no name for the person, no figure spoken, no confession, no cause and nobody standing anywhere to be asked, the weather answering first and the price of barley coming after, the voice going off up the terrace while the saying stood where it stood and nobody turned twice; the boy set the fourth shaping on a place of its own beside the first saying and the three earlier shapings with a finger between every pair and forbade the four to stand up and call themselves a witness, for a witness stands somewhere and can be asked and none stood, and he expressly did not join the voice to Ilva drawing a pace away, did not make her the speaker, did not lay it across the strip in her sleeve, Berr Clay’s twice-wiped thumb, the soft-cuffed clerk’s inward slate, the charcoal under the shelf or the joining said over the boards that morning, did not make Hessa a reader and did not pay the claim, so that four shapings were still four and no fifth came; Ilva drew with the pail against her knee, the rope stiff in the Ash cold giving its small dry rasp, clay pale in her nail crescents and grey rack dust worked into one thumb seam she did not scrub out, and to the woman who asked what the firings of Ash had taken her hand went toward her sleeve and stayed, the short strip of notched birch bark not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the open slate a pace away, the charcoal beneath the loaf shelf, the cord, the knot-string or the ownerless saying, no figure coming off the wood, and she answered Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account with her eyes to the asker and her mouth opening after both with a half-beat, the flat hand once more on the sleeve before she went back to the pail, the boy filing the order of reaching as the \textbf{ninth} record-first hand with a finger between it and Hessa Rale’s eighth, filing no tenth, making no figure of the slate’s nearness and making no reader of her own keeping (T080 advanced, not paid); the three coverings stayed weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause, the hunts and repairs stayed directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather and never figures, the Cold Acre hare answering the price with the weather and the cracked jar sent to a pot that said nothing, the dressed grain turned under wool with fingers going in and coming out without closing and no handful lifted; Tarn kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence with the knife at the very edge of its sill, brought his ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, the Seed 16 breath unspent, his chest tight, Ash in his knuckle creases, the pale clip-ring holding light, his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, the warm loft stone cold in its unmarked pot, the thumb’s resting checked and not made again on the fifth, and Jorra parted dusty forearms from clean, spoke to wheel and pot before any person, withheld the full note three turns ahead, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence and kept he’s not Vail sealed with the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T036/T076/T006, T035/T031/T062); Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken 334 days and the tile debt uncalled, and at the going of the light Sella carried him up at the half-pace, went wide around the seven places, set him on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, put the fold right without a look at his face, left the thread where it lay, and a foot came on the loft stair from above and behind with no interior entered; the hand entered the \textbf{two hundred and forty-third} answer after the boards and the \textbf{two hundred and forty-fourth} in the small hours, each a small intake held whole and let go on the river’s note, coming straight down because the note had done before the hand came down, neither early nor stayed, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer and laid across neither the six arithmetics, the bell’s gap, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb’s resting, the stayed object, the early letting-go, the sixth opening, the burned slate at five, the joining said over the boards, the fourth shaping nor his own gaps, and \textbf{two hundred and forty-four honest answers} stood on the sixth, each an object and not a power and none a doctrine; three hundred and thirty-four stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill and Grath, six months and 154 days were told by nobody, nothing on the fifth was opened, joined by a standing hand, named, called, paid or ended, the two sayings nobody owned standing on separate places with a finger between and neither arriving anywhere, Ilva’s strip staying in her sleeve with no figure off the wood, the runner not yet seen coming down any road, the file open on the towel with every gap left gap and the river’s low note going quiet under the finger’s-width door while Ash kept its middle days without a boundary drawn and stood five mornings short of mid-month (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086, T061/T082).}
\CRday{Day 335}{Ash 6, Sixthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well and flat stone with the skinned trough and the silt-clouded plate of ice, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling with the knife at its sill, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road coming down from the direction of Greybank with no collector upon it, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the sixth came on an ordinary Sixthday with no market, Cross or bell and nothing from the fifth of Ash crossing as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment, payer or prophecy, the two sayings of yesterday standing where they had been left on separate places with a finger between and a voice standing in no doorway not becoming a witness in the night, the boy coming into his three hundred and thirty-fifth day with the hand laid down on the two hundred and forty-fourth answer as a tool put away where the next hand will find it, the count going 334 to 335 exact, six months and 155 days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 335 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the body inventoried in its old order of crust gone stiffer and leathery two inches from the ear with its empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the composed face not composure and the surgeon’s knowing that a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed from outside and slowly checked by the infant’s louder want with both true, the second louder, neither winning and the argument the work (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086); Sella kept the hearth grammar exactly in the morning, fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot, The house will keep it, small intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger on top of the loaf shelf with the charcoal unread, lips along a two-gapped row unfigured, one glance at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, the twice-mended pot lifted thumb-first where the wire crossed the crack with both proverbs to pot and fire and the crack showing, dressed grain turned under wool with a still lighter touch and no figure and no handful, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, the grey streak at her temple pale, the little-door burn closing on air as she carried a cup, the day kept in loaves, glances and unnamed spaces and never in a figure, no new bare place and no third crust in the fold, the widow’s mark untouched because a morning and a hearth are not openings and six openings in six months are six and not a rule (T058/T079/T100, T009/T013/T092, T077); three counts stood in three places that did not become one with the bell’s gap left in its square, six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the heard bell beside the told bell of the Long Night and the told figure beside the paid, six arithmetics locked in Berr Clay’s box with the finding on a place of its own and no payer, the burned slate at five with the Ash 5 joining held apart on its own place and no sixth telling, the well-saying at four shapings with no fifth and no witness, the two sayings of yesterday lying on separate places with a finger between them and between them and Ilva’s strip in her sleeve, Berr’s twice-wiped thumb, the soft-cuffed clerk’s inward slate and the charcoal beneath the shelf, and neither making Hessa Rale a reader nor Jorra Vail a payer (T061/T082, T078, T015/T041/T047, T035/T031/T065/T095 held, T080 held); in the afternoon she carried him down at the half-pace and went wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, the three coverings staying weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair, the Cold Acre hare answering the price with the weather and the cracked jar sent to a pot that said nothing, a woman with a basket of kindling asking what the seventh year would want while two fence-menders said the thaw would be early and late and Tarn saying Yes, house to each and keeping the late because a late thaw puts off the paying, agreeing so thoroughly that no argument could find a foot, her fingers at the rack end going in and coming out without closing and no handful lifted; \textbf{the chapter’s third movement, advanced and NOT paid (T080):} the road brought the teller back, and it was neither the voice from yesterday nor a collector --- Hessa Rale came down the clay road in the afternoon with the writing of Berr’s narrow slate turned toward herself for the first time in the boy’s knowing of her, on Account-days going up that road toward Greybank before noon with the writing to her sleeve and the face turned away from everybody, here coming down it with the face turned toward her own forearm still edge-on, the writing looking at her sleeve and at nobody, the thumb along the grain of the frame with nothing pressing where the writing was, the second strap let out for the long road and dried pale scurf of road-mud standing unbrushed on the shortened skirt, her hand going to the slate before her eyes went to the yard, and to the woman by the path who asked what she carried she answered the question put and not the one behind it, Ask the road. It knows the way and I know the weight. That’s the whole of what either of us knows, with no figure coming off the slate and no choosing made; the boy took the turning apart by what was there and by what was not --- a face turned inward, a thumb along the grain, no pressure where the writing lay, no reader’s eye, no figure off the stone --- and filed it on a place of its own \textbf{beside} the fourth shaping of the well-saying with a finger between, a voice having said the runner had come back down the road with the writing turned toward her and here a runner coming down the road with the writing turned toward her, but a voice standing in no doorway is not a prophecy fulfilled and a sighting is not the payment of a saying, and he refused to join saying to sighting, make a fifth shaping, make Hessa a reader, make the sighting a payment or pay the claim, her order of reaching staying the \textbf{eighth} record-first hand on a place of its own with no tenth and she joined to none --- not Marra, not the soft-handed man of Slate Row, not the clerks, not Ilva, not the green-mouthed woman, not the Drawing collector and not the woman whose voice came over the boards; Tarn kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence with the knife at the very edge of its sill, said Six counted. The next I don’t count, brought his ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end with the Seed 16 breath drawn and not spent, his chest tight since the dark, Ash worked into his knuckle creases, the pale clip-ring holding light, his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, the warm loft stone cold in its unmarked pot and unreconciled by not trying, and the thumb’s resting on the uncut seventh of Bone 26 checked and not made again on the fourth, fifth or sixth of Ash; Jorra parted dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, spoke to wheel and pot before any person, knew the full note three turns ahead and withheld it from any High Kiln master, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence with the iron’s two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies, kept he’s not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn, the burned slate at five with no sixth and no witness; Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken 335 days, his salt-stiff coat and hollow wheel-seat and unswept clean dark line and finer grey, the twice-mended pot’s crack showing and both proverbs gone to pot and fire and never to a person, repair apart from restoration and the tile debt uncalled; the whole tray was checked and left as it lay with the heard bell in its square beside the told, seven a colour and seven a shape with no eighth, nine record-first hands with Hessa’s eighth and Ilva’s ninth apart and no tenth, nine stoppings with no tenth and the loan uncalled, five askings of the row with one shaping and no sixth, and no collector up or down the clay road; at the going of the light Sella carried him up at the half-pace, went wide around the seven places, set him on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, put the fold right at his ear and under his chin without a look at his face, let her hand rest the half-beat longer than the setting needed before it went away, left the thread where it lay, said The house will keep it and went to the hearth before the basket with the widow’s mark hanging where it hung and untouched, the fire answering four low pulls with the silence where the fifth should have stood and its payer unnamed 335 days; the hand entered the \textbf{two hundred and forty-fifth} answer in the first full of the morning and the \textbf{two hundred and forty-sixth} in the small hours, each a small intake held whole and let go on the river’s note, coming straight down as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it because the note had done before the hand came down, neither early nor stayed, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer and laid across neither the six arithmetics, the bell’s gap, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb’s resting, the stayed object, the early letting-go, the sixth opening, the Ash 5 joining, the fourth shaping, Hessa’s turned writing nor his own gaps, and \textbf{two hundred and forty-six honest answers} stood on the sixth, each an object and not a power and none a doctrine; three hundred and thirty-five stood exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Low Kiln, Sill and Grath, six months and 155 days were told by nobody, nothing on the sixth was opened, joined by a standing hand, named, called, paid or ended, the runner’s writing turned toward herself and no figure come off the slate, the keeping of the number the only honest work there was to do and bought nothing at two inches of air, the file open on the towel with every gap left gap and the river’s low note going quiet under the finger’s-width door while Ash kept its middle days without a boundary drawn and Ash 10, the dark month’s first Account-day and market, stood four mornings ahead and was not brought into a day that had not earned it --- forward, not closed (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086, T061/T082, T080 advanced, not paid).}

Account-day and market with Ash’s first arithmetic, stood one morning ahead and was not brought into a day that had not earned it.}
\CRday{Day 339}{Ash 10, Tenthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel, then down before first light through the Clay Yard and its seven walked-around places to the Cross, the reading block under the moot-post with its finger’s width of thin shade, the pot board across the square, the out-of-line landing below the north bridge and the market’s edge, and home again at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the dark month’s first Account-day and market came on its own morning and was earned by it, the boy coming into his three hundred and thirty-ninth day with the hand laid down on answer 252 taken up for 253 in the small hours and 254 at the going of the light, the count going 338 to 339 exact, six months and 159 days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 339 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, nothing from Ash 7, 8 or 9 crossing as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment and the pot-crack resting of the ninth kept on a place of its own beside the five and expressly not a sixth; \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and not paid (T015/T041/T047):} Berr Clay came up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat and the sweetish green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner, under the hot clay the smell of nothing at all, wiped his thumb twice on his apron before touching nothing, passed a finger over a narrow figure held writing-inward to his forearm, read \emph{One in twelve, as the notice says} low into the goers-by and sent it twice over the basket, once for the moot and once for the late households, called the levy and denied it with \emph{The levy is called. It is not called by me} and \emph{your house}, never I, said something low to the block about kindness being entered to which the block answered nothing, and went off up the road with the box locked and Ash’s first true subtraction inside believing he had done a kindness, so that \textbf{seven arithmetics of the year stand behind one unsigned figure, seven and not one account}, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space and the finding kept on a place of its own with no payer, not laid across the house’s not-doings, the covered grain, the five held objects, the pot-crack resting, the handful, the thumb’s resting, the two small objects of the hand or his gaps, the edges coming near to touching and the finger going between so that no doctrine stood up; Hessa Rale took the slate up the road before noon with hand to slate before eyes to crowd and the writing turned to her sleeve, answering \emph{I don’t read it. I carry it. There’s a difference, and the road doesn’t care which} and staying a runner and not a reader with her eighth hand and no tenth; the bell went four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself, the soft-cuffed clerk stayed set at the out-of-line landing for an uncalled measure with the market selling over him as water over a stone, and a silent woman with clay under her nails and a green at one mouth-corner turning a cup a quarter at the pot board and a small shape in cast-offs at the market’s edge catching light on a green sliver were filed as a seventh colour and a seventh shape with no eighth, neither named, joined or promoted; Sella’s grammar held at the fire, the grain and the pot with the widow’s mark untouched because a reading is not an opening, and 253 and 254 stood as exact answers worth nothing at two inches of air.}
\CRday{Day 340}{Ash 11, Firstday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, boards, pot board and towel in the small hours, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well where Ilva drew with the pail against her knee and a woman asked what Ash’s first reading had taken, the flat stone and silt-clouded plate, the skinned trough, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling with the knife at its sill, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (a sound from above and behind, no interior entered), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  an ordinary Firstday with no market, Cross or bell came on its own morning and brought nothing from the reading as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, the boy coming into his three hundred and fortieth day with answers 255 in the small hours and 256 at the close, the count going 339 to 340 exact, six months and 160 days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 340 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, three counts in three places that did not become one, six hearings with the seventh place empty, the heard bell beside the told, the told figure beside the paid and seven arithmetics locked unread behind one unsigned figure with the finding on a place of its own and no doctrine standing; Sella’s grammar held exactly, fire before basket, \emph{The house will keep it}, the charcoal unread, her lips on a two-gapped row unfigured, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing, the dressed grain turned under wool with no figure and no handful, the pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed and the widow’s mark untouched; at the well Ilva’s hand went toward her sleeve and stayed, the notched strip of birch bark pale where a thumb had rubbed it and dark in the uncut grain not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the open slate a pace away, no figure coming off the wood, and to the cost-question she answered \emph{Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account}, her order of reaching filed as the ninth record-first hand with a finger between it and Hessa’s eighth and no tenth, no ownerless saying at this well, no fifth shaping, the woman drawing made no witness and Hessa made no reader; the yard went around its seven places with a look and a wide step, the three coverings stayed weather and the hunts and repairs stayed directions — the Cold Acre hare answered with the weather, the cracked jar with the pot which said nothing, a cost-question with the weather — and the empty fingers at the rack end were filed beside the handful let fall on Bone 22 as a keeping and not a second handful; Tarn at the kindling kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence with the knife at the edge of its sill, said \emph{Six counted. The next I don’t count}, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent, chest tight since the dark, Ash in the knuckle creases, the pale clip-ring holding light, his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, the warm loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying, and the thumb’s resting on the uncut seventh of Bone 26 checked and not made again; Jorra came off the wheel-shed with meal-fine grey dust white in a fist-crease not bone-coloured slip, dusty and clean forearms parted as clot from vessel, men unnamed gone low before first grey, spoke to the wheel before any person with \emph{It doesn’t care whose hands. It cares if they’re steady} and told a pot \emph{You’ll do}, withheld the full note known three turns ahead from a High Kiln master who would call it early and make a song of it, and put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, one piece of iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies, \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn; the widow’s mark was not touched because a going of the light and a bed are not openings, and 255 and 256 stood as exact answers worth nothing at two inches of air.}
\CRday{Day 341}{Ash 12, Secondday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, boards, pot board and towel in the small hours, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well and flat stone with the skinned trough and the silt-clouded plate, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling with the knife at its sill, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (a sound from above and behind, no interior entered), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the twelfth came on an ordinary Secondday with no market, Cross or bell and nothing from the tenth or eleventh crossing as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, the boy coming into his three hundred and forty-first day with answers 257 in the small hours and 258 at the close, the count going 340 to 341 exact, six months and 161 days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 341 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, and Ash keeping its twelfth day without a boundary drawn while neither the older women’s naming by weather nor the slatemen’s by Account-days was set right or left wrong; the yard went around its seven places with a look and a wide step, the three coverings stayed weather with a finger between every pair, and the hunts and repairs stayed directions judged by the arm and the weather — the Cold Acre hare answered with the weather and gone toward the clay road unweighed, the cracked jar answered with the pot which said nothing, and to a woman with kindling asking what the seventh year would want and two fence-menders saying the thaw would be early and late Tarn said \emph{Yes, house} to each and kept the late because it puts off the paying, agreeing so thoroughly that no argument could find a foot; at the going of the light the twice-mended pot came up off the board with Sella’s thumb first where the wire crossed the crack and the hairline of the original break left showing between the old-brass staple and the tighter wire, both proverbs going to the pot and the fire and never to a person, repair kept apart from restoration, and the Ash 9 held breath at the crossing stayed where it was set beside the staying at the inch, the early letting-go, the handful let fall at the rack end, the thumb’s resting on the uncut seventh and the sixth opening at the kiln mouth, expressly not a sixth held object and not made again on the tenth, eleventh or twelfth; Tarn at the kindling kept six and the seventh at the lip, said \emph{Six counted. The next I don’t count}, stopped the ear-sentence at the calling word as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent, chest tight, Ash in the knuckles, the clip-ring holding light, stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, the warm loft stone cold and unreconciled by not trying, and the thumb’s resting checked and not made again; Jorra came off the shed with meal-fine grey dust, dusty forearms parted from clean as clot from vessel, men unnamed before first grey, wheel first and a pot after, the full note known three turns ahead withheld from a High Kiln master who would make a song of it, bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s sentence, one iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies, \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn; the whole tray was checked and left as it lay — six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the sixth the small flat knock out of Dessa Silt as the men lifted her filed where a thing out of a person must go, the heard bell beside the told with four, four and a gap and nobody crossing himself, the told figure beside the paid with no signature, seven a colour at the pot board and seven a shape at the market’s edge with no eighth and neither named or joined, nine record-first hands with Hessa’s eighth and Ilva’s ninth apart and no tenth, nine stoppings with no tenth, the row at five askings with no witness and no sixth, the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two and the Ash 5 joining, the fourth shaping and the Ash 6 turning each on its own place with a finger between, none spent, named or promoted; \textbf{seven arithmetics of the year stood behind one printed figure, seven and not one account}, the figure read still not the figure paid, the finding on a place of its own with no payer and not laid across the not-doings, the covered grain, the five held objects, the handful, the thumb’s resting, the two small objects of the hand, the sixth opening, the three Ash 5/6 movements, the pot-crack resting or his gaps, the edges coming near to touching and the finger going between so that no doctrine stood; Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken 341 days and the tile debt uncalled, Sella carried him up at the half-pace with her hand resting the half-beat longer at the fold and left the thread where it lay, the widow’s mark untouched because a going of the light and a bed are not openings; answer 258 was exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, and \textbf{258 honest answers stood on the sixth place}, each an object and not a power, with Ash 20, the month’s second Account-day, standing eight mornings ahead and named only as a date.}
\CRday{Day 342}{Ash 13, Thirdday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, boards, pot board and towel in the small hours, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well and flat stone with the skinned trough and the silt-clouded plate of ice, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling with the knife at its sill, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (a sound from above and behind, no interior entered), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the thirteenth came on an ordinary Thirdday with no market, Cross or bell, no collector up or down the clay road and no runner on any road, and nothing from Ash 10, 11 or 12 crossed the dark as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, the boy coming into his three hundred and forty-second day with the hand laid down against the fold on answer 258 as a tool put away where the next hand will find it, the count going 341 to 342 exact, six months and 162 days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 342 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number; the body was inventoried in the surgeon’s old order — crust gone stiff and leathery two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool and the empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped because nobody was ever given an instruction about the thread, cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house would perform — the composed face not composure, a cold patient unable to clot and to be warmed slowly from outside, and the infant’s louder want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle with both true, the second louder, neither winning and the argument itself the work; Sella kept the hearth grammar exactly, fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with the back of a broken pot, \emph{The house will keep it}, small intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger on top of the loaf shelf with the charcoal unread, lips on a two-gapped row unfigured, one glance at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, the twice-mended pot lifted thumb-first where the wire crossed the crack with both proverbs to pot and fire and the hairline showing, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure and no handful and the pot rim set two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed; in the afternoon she carried him down at the half-pace with the instruction to the wool and the river wind and never to the basket, went wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, kept the three coverings weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause, sent the Cold Acre hare to the weather and the cracked jar to a pot that said nothing, and to a woman with kindling asking what the seventh year would want and two fence-menders saying the thaw would be early and late Tarn said \emph{Yes, house} to each and kept the late because it puts off the paying; at the rack end her fingers went in and came out without closing and no handful was lifted, at the kindling Tarn kept six in the worn thumb-mark where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence with the knife at the very edge of its sill where a hand could check it or slip it off and the thumb’s resting of Bone 26 checked and not made again, and Jorra came off the wheel-shed with meal-fine grey dust white in a fist-crease, kept dusty and clean forearms apart as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel before any person, knew the full note three turns ahead and withheld it from any High Kiln master who would make a song of it, and put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence with one iron and two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies, \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed and the promise to the slate-burners neither given nor withdrawn; Garl stayed in objects with the salt-stiff coat, hollow wheel-seat, clean dark line and finer grey called the thaw, and the pot’s hairline showing, his name unspoken 342 days and the tile debt uncalled; at the going of the light the pot came up thumb-first with the crack showing, the widow’s mark was untouched because a going of the light and a bed are not openings, six openings in six months were six and not a rule and the Ash 9 held breath stayed where it was set beside the five, expressly not a sixth and not made again; seven arithmetics stood behind one unsigned figure with Ash’s first locked in Berr Clay’s box and Ash’s second five mornings ahead and not brought early, six hearings stood beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the sixth the small flat knock out of Dessa Silt filed where a thing out of a person must go, and the heard bell stayed in its square beside the told; the hand entered answer \textbf{259} in the small hours and \textbf{260} at the close, each a small intake held whole and let go on the river’s note, coming straight down because the note had done before the hand came down, neither early nor stayed, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment supplying no payer, and \textbf{260 honest answers} stood on the sixth place, each an object and not a power and none a doctrine; nothing on the thirteenth was opened, joined by a standing hand, named, called, paid or ended, the file lay open on the towel with every gap left gap and the river’s low note went quiet under the finger’s-width door, forward, not closed (T071/T072, T088, T009/T013/T092, T060/T086, T058/T079/T100, T077, T061/T082, T062/T035/T031, T035/T031/T065/T095).}
\CRday{Day 343}{Ash 14, Fourthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, boards, pot board and towel in the small hours, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well and flat stone, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling and its knife-sill, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (a sound from above and behind, no interior entered), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the fourteenth came on an ordinary Fourthday with no market, Cross or bell, no collector and no runner, and nothing from the thirteenth crossed as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, the count going 342 to 343 exact, six months and 163 days told by nobody, the fire’s fifth unpaid 343 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the body inventoried again in its old order and the surgeon’s knowing that a cold patient cannot clot checked by the infant’s louder want with both true, the second louder, neither winning; Sella kept the hearth grammar unchanged, fire before basket, coals told the thaw, \emph{The house will keep it}, the charcoal unread beneath her finger, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the clay jar with the little-door burn closing on air, the twice-mended pot up thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain turned with a still lighter touch and no handful, pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, the widow’s mark untouched because a morning and a hearth are not openings, six openings in six months and no seventh made due, and the whole tray checked and left as it lay — seven arithmetics behind one unsigned figure with Ash’s second offstage five mornings ahead and not brought early, six hearings with the seventh place empty, the heard bell beside the told, five burned-slate tellings, two shut-room tellings, five askings with no sixth, nine record-first hands with no tenth and nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the loan uncalled, and the breath held at the knife-sill on the thirteenth not spoken of and not made again; in the afternoon the yard went around its seven places again with the three coverings called weather and the hunts and repairs kept as directions, Tarn saying \emph{Yes, house} to early and late and keeping the late because it puts off the paying, her fingers at the rack end going in and coming out without closing and no handful lifted; \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T036/T076/T006, held with T061/T082):} at the kindling Tarn, who kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, set the small knife at the very edge of its sill where it could be checked, passed his hand over it as the house checks a tool, and let the hand stay at the sill a breath longer than the check required — not a long breath, not one a woman at the hearth would turn her head for, but a breath with a shape to it, held at the top of the reach where the other breath had stayed unspent since the dark — before taking it away; he cut nothing, counted nothing, did not bring the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan, did not spend the Seed 16 breath and checked the thumb’s resting of Bone 26 and did not make it again; the boy took the field apart by what was there (a hand that stayed) and by what was not (a cut, a count, a calling word, a spent breath, a thumb laid down again), and filed the held breath on a place of its own beside the staying at the inch, the early letting-go, the handful, Tarn’s thumb’s resting, the sixth opening and the pot-crack resting, with a finger between every pair, expressly not a sixth held object, not a seventh of anything, not a tenth stopping, not the seventh year given, not a habit, a way, a hearing, a near-full answer, a sign, a mending, a cause, a payment or a rule, not made again and joined to no other keeping, gathering quietly toward the far-off hand that will lay the district’s private keepings together, a hand that is not his and is still far off, with no payer standing under it; to the kindling woman and the two fence-menders Tarn said \emph{Yes, house} to the early thaw and the late, his stroke over the bright patch went without the half-check, the warm loft stone lay cold in its unmarked pot unreconciled by not trying, and Jorra came off the shed with meal-fine dust, parted dusty from clean forearms as clot from vessel, spoke to wheel and pot before any person, withheld the full note known three turns ahead, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s sentence, kept \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn, the burned slate at five and the shut-room tellings at two; at the going of the light Sella carried him up wide around the seven places, set him on the bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, left the thread where it lay, said \emph{The house will keep it}, and went to the hearth before the basket with the widow’s mark hanging untouched; the hand entered answer \textbf{261} in the small hours and \textbf{262} at the close, each a small intake held whole and let go on the river’s note, and the boy kept the two intervals apart — one spent into a sill a hand’s breadth beyond his reach and one into a sound — with no payer under either; \textbf{262 honest answers} stood on the sixth place, each an object and not a power; nothing on the fourteenth was opened, joined by a standing hand, named, called, paid or ended, and the one thing a man kept to himself was kept where no house could check it, forward, not closed (T036/T076/T006 advanced, not paid; T071/T072, T088, T009/T013/T092, T060/T086, T058/T079/T100, T077, T061/T082, T062/T035/T031, T015/T041/T047).}
\CRday{Day 344}{Ash 15, Fifthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, boards, pot board and towel in the small hours, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well and flat stone with the skinned trough and the silt-clouded plate of ice, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling with the knife at its sill, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (a sound from above and behind, no interior entered), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the fifteenth came on an ordinary Fifthday with no market, Cross or bell, no collector up or down the clay road and no runner on any road, 344 a number nobody marked, not round and not a threshold, with nothing from the fourteenth crossing as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment — the breath held at the knife-sill had stayed where it was put and bought no lesson under this roof — and the count going 343 to 344 exact, six months and 164 days told by nobody, the fire’s fifth unpaid 344 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number; the body was inventoried again in its old order of crust two inches off with its empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon’s knowing checked by the infant’s louder want with both true, the second louder, neither winning, and a grievance refused because it is an account with a payer standing under it and none stood; Sella kept the hearth grammar exactly at both ends of the day, fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot, \emph{The house will keep it}, intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, charcoal unread under her finger, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, the twice-mended pot up thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain turned under wool with a still lighter touch and no figure or handful, and the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed; the widow’s mark was untouched, six openings in six months were six and not a rule, and the Ash 9 held breath, the pot-crack resting and the new hand-at-the-sill breath sat each on its own place with a finger between every pair, none made again, none a sixth held object or a seventh of anything, and none joined to the charcoal, Ilva’s strip, the Ash 5 joining, the fourth shaping, the turned writing, the dressed grain or his gaps, gathering quietly toward a far-off hand that is not his; seven arithmetics stood behind one unsigned figure with no signature on the space, Ash’s first locked in Berr Clay’s box up the road and Ash’s second five mornings ahead and not brought early, six hearings stood beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the heard bell stayed in its square beside the told, and three counts in three places did not become one because agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stood; \textbf{in the afternoon Ilva drew at the yard well with the pail against her knee, the rope stiff in the Ash cold giving its small dry rasp, clay pale in her nail crescents and grey rack dust worked into one thumb seam she did not scrub out, and to a woman waiting her turn who asked what Ash’s firings had taken her hand went toward her sleeve and stayed, the notched strip of birch bark pale where a thumb had rubbed the notches and dark in the uncut grain not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the open slate a pace away, the charcoal beneath the loaf shelf, the cord, the knot-string or any ownerless saying, no figure coming off the wood, and with eyes to the asker and mouth opening after both with a half-beat she answered *Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account*, the question put and not the one behind it, then put her flat hand once more on the sleeve and went back to the pail, nobody turning twice (T080 advanced and NOT paid); the boy filed the order of her reaching as the }ninth\textbf{ record-first hand on its own place with a finger between it and Hessa Rale’s eighth, filed no tenth, made no figure of the slate’s nearness, made her no reader of her own keeping and joined her to none, and there was no ownerless saying at this well, no fifth shaping, and the turning of the runner’s writing stayed a sighting;} the yard went around its seven places again with the three coverings weather and the hunts and repairs directions, Tarn saying \emph{Yes, house} to early and late and keeping the late because it puts off the paying, her fingers at the rack end going in and coming out without closing and no handful lifted; at the kindling Tarn kept six and the seventh at the lip, said \emph{Six counted. The next I don’t count}, stopped the ear-sentence at the calling word as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and the loan uncalled, and the boy checked the held breath at the sill and found it where it had been put — the hand went to the sill, passed over the knife as the house would check it and went away when the checking was done, no breath stayed at the top of the reach, and it was not made again or joined to any other keeping; Jorra parted dusty from clean forearms as clot from vessel, spoke to wheel and pot before any person, withheld the full note known three turns ahead, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s sentence, kept \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn, the burned slate at five and the shut-room tellings at two; Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken 344 days and the tile debt uncalled; at the going of the light Sella carried him up at the half-pace wide around the seven places, set him on the bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, righted the fold without a look at his face, let her hand rest the half-beat longer than the setting needed and left the thread where it lay, and the widow’s mark hung untouched because a going of the light and a bed are not openings; the hand entered answer \textbf{263} in the small hours and \textbf{264} at the close, each a small intake held whole and let go on the river’s note, coming straight down against the fold as a man puts away a tool and laid across neither the seven arithmetics, the bell’s gap, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb’s resting, the stayed object, the early letting-go, the sixth opening, the pot-crack resting, the breath at the sill, the Ash 5 joining, the fourth shaping, the turned writing, the notched wood nor his gaps, and \textbf{264 honest answers} stood on the sixth place, each an object and not a power and none a doctrine; nothing on the fifteenth was opened, joined by a standing hand, named, called, paid or ended, no eighth sighting, sixth telling, fifth shaping, tenth hand or tenth stopping came due, the file lay open on the towel with every gap left gap, the pot’s hairline showed between old-brass staple and tighter wire, one stiff brown-edged crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and the thread at his mouth frozen and unwiped, and Ash 20 stood five mornings ahead and was not brought into a day that had not earned it, forward, not closed (T071/T072, T088, T009/T013/T092, T060/T086, T058/T079/T100, T077, T015/T041/T047, T061/T082, T083/T085, T098, T101 held).}
\CRday{Day 345}{Ash 16, Sixthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel in the small hours, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well and flat stone with the skinned trough and the silt-clouded plate of ice, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling with the knife at its sill, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (a sound from above and behind, no interior entered), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the sixteenth came on an ordinary Sixthday with no market, Cross or bell, no collector up or down the clay road and no runner on any road, with nothing from the thirteenth, fourteenth or fifteenth crossing as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer — a breath held at a knife-sill had stayed where it was put and bought no lesson under this roof — and the count going 344 to 345 exact, six months and 165 days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 345 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number; the body was inventoried in the surgeon’s old order of crust gone stiffer and browner two inches off with its corner a hair off the wool and its empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped because nobody was ever given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the composed face not composure, a cold patient unable to clot and to be warmed slowly from outside, and the infant’s louder want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle with both true, the second louder, neither winning and the argument itself the work; Sella kept the hearth grammar exactly at both ends of the day, fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot, \emph{The house will keep it}, small intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, charcoal unread under her finger on top of the shelf, lips on a two-gapped row unfigured, one glance at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, the twice-mended pot lifted thumb-first where the wire crossed the crack with both proverbs to pot and fire and the hairline showing, dressed grain turned under wool with a still lighter touch and no figure or handful, and the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, the half-beat taken apart as the distance between intention and arrest, bought at nothing and not a gift, for a gift wants a giver and nobody gave; in the afternoon she carried him down at the half-pace with the instruction to the wool and the river wind and never to the basket, went wide around the seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, kept the three coverings weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause, sent the Cold Acre hare to the weather and the cracked jar to a pot that said nothing, and to a woman with kindling asking what the seventh year would want and two fence-menders saying the thaw would be early and late Tarn said \emph{Yes, house} and kept the late because it puts off the paying; at the rack end her fingers went in and came out without closing and the empty fingers were filed beside the handful let fall on Bone 22 as a keeping and not a second handful; at the kindling Tarn kept six in the worn thumb-mark where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence with the knife at the very edge of its sill where a hand could check it or slip it off, said \emph{Six counted. The next I don’t count}, passed his hand over blade and sill as a man passes a hand over a tool put back where it belongs, checked the held breath at the sill from Ash 14 and found it where it had been put and did not make it again, checked the thumb’s resting of Bone 26 and did not make it again, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled; his stroke over the bright patch went without the half-check and the warm loft stone lay cold in its unmarked pot, unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness; Jorra came off the wheel-shed with meal-fine grey slate dust white in a fist-crease, not the bone-coloured slip, kept dusty and clean forearms on one tray and parted them as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel before any person, told a pot \emph{You’ll do}, knew the full note three turns ahead and withheld it from a High Kiln master, and put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, one piece of iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies, \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn, the burned-slate word at five, the shut-room tellings at two and the row at five askings with no sixth, and no ownerless voice over the boards that afternoon; two men under one roof had kept each a small thing no house could check and the boy set them on one tray and parted them as clot from vessel with a finger between, joining nothing, for a nearly-touching of two silences is not a touching; at the going of the light Sella carried him up at the half-pace wide around the seven places, set him on the bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, let her hand rest the half-beat longer than the setting needed, left the thread where it lay and did not touch the widow’s mark, six openings in six months being six and not a rule; seven arithmetics stood behind one unsigned figure with Ash’s first locked in Berr Clay’s box and Ash’s second offstage and named only as a date, six hearings stood beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the sixth the small flat knock out of Dessa Silt filed where a thing out of a person must go, the heard bell in its square beside the told, the told figure beside the paid with no signature, the three counts in three places not becoming one because agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stood; the hand entered answer \textbf{265} in the small hours and \textbf{266} at the close, each a small intake held whole and let go on the river’s note, coming straight down against the fold as a man puts away a tool, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment supplying no payer, and \textbf{266 honest answers} stood on the sixth place, each an object and not a power and none calling itself a doctrine; nothing on the sixteenth was opened, joined by a standing hand, named, called, paid or ended, the file lay open on the towel with every gap left gap, the pot’s hairline showed between old-brass staple and tighter wire, one stiff brown-edged crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and the thread at his mouth frozen and unwiped, and Ash 20 stood two mornings ahead and was not brought into a day that had not earned it, forward, not closed (T071/T072, T088, T009/T013/T092, T060/T086, T058/T079/T100, T077, T083/T085, T036/T076/T006, T062/T035/T031, T061/T082, T098 held).}

Sella kept the hearth grammar unchanged, fire before basket, coals told the thaw, \emph{The house will keep it}, charcoal unread under her finger on top of the shelf, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, the twice-mended pot up thumb-first with both proverbs to pot and fire and the hairline showing, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure and no handful, pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and the widow’s mark untouched because a morning and a hearth are not openings, six openings in six months not a rule and no seventh made due; the whole tray was checked and left as it lay — seven arithmetics behind one unsigned figure with Ash’s first locked in Berr Clay’s box and Ash’s second offstage two mornings ahead, six hearings with the seventh place empty and the sixth the small flat knock out of Dessa Silt filed where a thing out of a person must go, the heard bell in its square beside the told, the told figure beside the paid with no signature, nine record-first hands with no tenth and the ninth a finger from the eighth, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and the loan uncalled, five held objects with the pot-crack resting beside them and the Ash 14 breath beside that, and the boy set down what was there and looked for nothing to fill an empty place, because a finding filled to make a row come out even is a finding forged; exactly no voice came over the boards in the small hours and the Ash 5 joining, the fourth shaping and the Ash 6 turning stayed each on its own place, unspent and unpromoted; \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T035/T031/T065/T095 and T101):} in the afternoon an ownerless voice came over the boards from the direction of Slate Row, spoken over the boards and not into the basket, giving a word about a room shut with the damper closed and a slate burned over a man nobody named, with no room named, no hand at any flame, no figure, no date and nobody standing in any doorway to be asked; the weather answered first, a wrong wind off High Kiln carrying the sweet edge of lead glaze over the boards, touching the fold and going out on the wind that brought it, a direction arrived nowhere and not a second edge paid, and the price of barley answered after it and the voice went off up the terrace while the boards lay where they lay; the boy took the word apart as a surgeon takes a wound apart and filed it on a place of its own beside the Ash 5 joining with a finger between, a further shaping of that joining and an advancement of the finding that a place wants a witness and a witness is a day somebody stands somewhere and can be asked, but not the witness and not standing, expressly not a sixth telling of the burned slate (which stayed at five), not a third telling of the shut room (at two), not a sixth asking of the row (at five), not a fifth shaping of the well-saying (at four), not a hearing, not a seventh, not a cause, not a confession, not a reader, not a name, not a witness and not a payment, with no payer standing and nobody leaning in to take the answer down; \textbf{Ilva drew at the well with the pail against her knee, the rope stiff in the Ash cold giving its small dry rasp, clay pale in her nail crescents and grey rack dust in one thumb seam she did not scrub out, and to a woman waiting her turn who asked what Ash’s firings had taken her hand went toward her sleeve and stayed, the notched strip not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the open slate a pace away, the charcoal beneath the loaf shelf, the cord, the knot-string or any saying that arrived nowhere, no figure coming off the wood, and with eyes to the asker and mouth opening after both with a half-beat she answered *Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account*, then put her flat hand once more on the sleeve and went back to the pail, nobody turning twice; the boy filed the order of her reaching as the ninth record-first hand with a finger between it and Hessa Rale’s eighth, filed no tenth, made no figure of the slate’s nearness, made her no reader and expressly not the speaker of the voice over the boards (T080 advanced and NOT paid);} at the kindling Tarn kept six and the seventh at the lip, knife at the edge of its sill, checked the Ash 14 held breath a third time and found it where it was put and did not make it again, said \emph{Six counted. The next I don’t count}, brought the ear-sentence to the calling word and stopped with nine stoppings and no tenth, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled; Jorra parted dusty from clean forearms as clot from vessel, spoke to wheel and pot before any person, withheld the full note known three turns ahead, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s sentence, one iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies, and grew quieter when the direction went around the boards and up the terrace, the household straightening around the quiet without an order, the claim gathering interest against a promise neither given nor withdrawn, \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed; at the going of the light Sella carried him up at the half-pace wide around the seven places, set him on the bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, left the thread where it lay and did not touch the widow’s mark, the word that went up the terrace buying no opening here; the hand entered answer \textbf{267} in the small hours and \textbf{268} at the close, each a small intake held whole on the river’s note and coming straight down, and \textbf{268 honest answers} stood on the sixth place, each an object and not a power; nothing on the seventeenth was opened, named, called, paid or ended, no witness stood to be asked, the word stood nowhere in any doorway, and the file lay open on the towel with every gap left gap, forward, not closed (T035/T031/T065/T095 and T101 advanced, not paid; T080, T071/T072, T088, T009/T013/T092, T060/T086, T058/T079/T100, T077, T083/T085, T036/T076/T006, T061/T082 held).}

\CRday{Day 349}{Ash 20, Tenthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof in the dark before first light, then down to the Cross, the reading block under the moot-post and the moot-post’s finger’s width of shade, the pot board, the clay road up toward High Kiln, the north bridge and the out-of-line landing below it, the market’s edge, the terrace, and back under the Vail roof at the hearth, pot board, loaf shelf, bed, boards and towel in the small hours, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the twentieth came in the dark before first light earned by its own morning, the dark month’s second Account-day and market with a slate read under the moot-post and a bell, none of which had stood on the nineteenth to be carried back as a lesson, and the count going 348 to 349 exact, six months and 169 days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 349 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number; Sella carried him down before first light at the half-pace from every open slate with the instruction to the wool and the river wind and never to the basket, set the basket in the moot-post’s finger’s width of shade where no slate lay and stood half a pace off through the reading and the bell, never looking into it;
