two hundred leaned toward the block and eight pigs went over the wet boards uncounted aloud, and \textbf{Berr Clay came up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat, the sweetish green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner and the smell of nothing at all under the hot clay of him, wiped his thumb twice on his apron before touching nothing, held a narrow slate unopened to his forearm with the writing inward, passed a finger over the figure and let his eyes rest on the writing a breath longer than the writing required, read *One in twelve, as the notice says* low into the goers-by and sent the figure twice over the basket, once for the moot and once for the late households, called the levy and denied it with *The levy is called. It is not called by me* and *your house*, never *I*, said something low to the block about kindness being entered, and went off up the clay road with the cord folded, the narrow slate under his arm and the box locked, Ash’s second true subtraction riding inside beside the three of Frost and the first, second and third of Bone, believing he had done a kindness, with no anger and no triumph in it (T015/T041/T047 advanced and NOT paid)}; \textbf{eight arithmetics of the year now stood behind one printed figure, eight and not one account}, the printed figure one in twelve unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid and no signature on the space between, the district’s arithmetic changed where two hundred people stood and could not be changed back; the bell went four, four and a gap through the market, longer than a church bell, with nobody crossing himself, and stayed in its square beside the told bell of the Long Night, not folded into the three counts or made a seventh of the full note; before noon Hessa Rale took the slate up the road toward Greybank with the second strap let out and dried pale scurf of road-mud unbrushed on the shortened skirt, the writing turned to her sleeve and nothing pressing where the writing was, answering \emph{I don’t read it. I carry it. There’s a difference, and the road doesn’t care which} and \emph{Cross to Greybank. Reading goes up before noon. I’ve got a road to walk}, no figure coming off the slate, her eighth hand eight with no tenth; below the north bridge the soft-cuffed clerk stayed set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called, his slate inward and hand to slate before eye to stalls; at the pot board a silent woman with a green at one mouth-corner turned a cup a quarter and set it back, and at the market’s edge a small shape in cast-offs caught the light on a green sliver and went dull, each a seventh with no eighth, unnamed and joined to nothing; the boy took the reading as a surgeon takes a field, by the twice-wiped thumb, the finger over the figure, the self removed from the sentence and the box going away locked, and by the signature, household, hand and payer that were not there, and filed nothing yet; Sella carried him home at the going of the light and said nothing of what had been read over him, went to the hearth before the basket, kept the whole hearth grammar with the charcoal unread and the widow’s mark untouched, set him on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft and left the thread frozen; he filed the finding on a place of its own with no payer and did not lay it across the not-doings, the covered grain, the five held objects, the pot-crack resting, the hand-at-the-sill breath, the handful, the thumb’s resting, the two small objects of the hand, the sixth opening, the Ash 5 joining, the Ash 17 direction, the fourth shaping, the turned writing, the strip in the sleeve or his own kept gaps, the edges coming near to touching and the finger going between, and no doctrine stood up out of eight; Tarn kept six and the seventh, checked the Ash 14 held breath and did not make it again, stopped the ear-sentence at the calling word as a ninth stopping with no tenth and the loan uncalled; Jorra parted dusty from clean forearms as clot from vessel, withheld the note known three turns ahead, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s sentence, one iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies, \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn; the hand entered answer \textbf{273} in the small hours of the reading night and \textbf{274} at the close, and \textbf{274 honest answers} stood on the sixth place, each an object and not a power; nothing on the twentieth was opened, joined by a standing hand, named, called, paid or ended, and Ash 30 stood ten mornings ahead and was not spent in a night that had not earned it, forward, not closed (T015/T041/T047 advanced, not paid; T071/T072, T088, T009/T013/T092, T060/T086, T058/T079/T100, T077, T061/T082, T080, T090, T050/T051, T033/T034, T036/T076/T006, T062/T035/T031, T078 held).}
\CRday{Day 350}{Ash 21, Firstday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board, loaf shelf, boards and towel in the small hours, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well and flat stone with the skinned trough and the silt-clouded plate of ice, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the pan’s gone round ring, the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling with the knife at its sill, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the terrace, the Debt Loft with the warm loft stone cold in its unmarked pot, and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the twenty-first came on an ordinary Firstday with no market, Cross or bell, no collector up or down the clay road and no runner on any road, with nothing from the twentieth crossing as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, the count going 349 to 350 exact, six months and 170 days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 350 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, and the hand laid down against the fold on answer 274; \textbf{eight arithmetics of the year — the three of Frost, the first, second and third of Bone, Ash’s first and Ash’s second — stood behind one unsigned figure, eight and not one account}, both of Ash’s subtractions gone up the road the day before in a locked box with the key in a coat pocket that does not come back down, the figure read still not the figure paid and no signature on the space, buying no lesson here and answering none of the held questions; the body was inventoried again in the surgeon’s old order of stiffer browner crust two inches off with its empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint, and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon’s knowing checked by the infant’s louder want with both true, the second louder, neither winning; 350 was not a round number anybody under this roof would speak and not a threshold, and he had long since stopped expecting to be told what a number counted, which was not the same as not wanting it; Sella kept the hearth grammar exactly at both ends of the day, fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot, \emph{The house will keep it}, intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, charcoal unread under her finger on top of the shelf, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the clay jar cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, the twice-mended pot up thumb-first where the wire crossed the crack with both proverbs to pot and fire and the hairline showing between old-brass staple and tighter wire, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure and no handful and the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed; the widow’s mark hung untouched because a morning and a hearth are not openings, six openings in six months being six and not a rule and no seventh made due; the private tray was checked and left as it lay — six hearings of the full note beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the sixth the small flat knock out of Dessa Silt filed where a thing out of a person must go, the heard bell beside the told with four, four and a gap and nobody crossing himself, nine record-first hands with no tenth, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and the loan uncalled, the row at five askings with one shaping and no sixth, the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, and the Ash 5 joining, the Ash 17 direction, the fourth shaping and the Ash 6 turning each on a place of its own with a finger between, none spent, named, joined or promoted into a witness or a rule, for a rule is an account that has found a payer and none stood, the far-off hand that will lay the district’s private keepings together still far off and not his; in the afternoon the yard went around its seven places again with a look and a wide step and no number, the three coverings stayed weather entered nowhere with no fourth likeness made a cause, the dressed grain lay covered and unfigured with no handful lifted, the Cold Acre hare went to the weather, the cracked jar to a pot that said nothing, and to a woman with kindling asking what the seventh year would want and two fence-menders saying the thaw would be early and late Tarn said \emph{Yes, house} to each and kept the late because it puts off the paying; at the kindling he kept six and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, knife at the edge of its sill, the Ash 14 held breath found where it had been set and not made again, said \emph{Six counted. The next I don’t count}, brought the ear-sentence to the calling word and stopped as a ninth stopping with no tenth, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled, his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check and the warm loft stone cold in its unmarked pot, unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness; Jorra came off the wheel-shed with meal-fine dust white in a fist-crease, parted dusty from clean forearms as clot from vessel, spoke to wheel and pot before any person, withheld the note known three turns ahead, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s sentence, one iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies, grew quieter, \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn; no voice came over the boards to make a sixth of anything, and no runner or collector came on any road; Garl stayed in objects with his name unspoken 350 days and the tile debt uncalled; at the going of the light Sella carried him up at the half-pace wide around the seven places, set him on the bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, righted the fold without a look at his face, let her hand rest the half-beat longer than the setting needed and left the thread frozen and unwiped; the hand entered answer \textbf{275} in the small hours and \textbf{276} at the close, each a small intake held whole on the river’s note and coming straight down as a man puts away a tool, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, and \textbf{276 honest answers} stood on the sixth place, each an object and not a power and none calling itself a doctrine; nothing on the twenty-first was opened, joined by a standing hand, named, called, paid or ended, the file lay open on the towel with every gap left gap, the pot’s hairline showed between old-brass staple and tighter wire, one stiff brown-edged crust lay two inches from his ear with its empty place unnamed and the thread frozen and unwiped, and Ash 30 (Day 359) stood nine mornings ahead and was named only as a date, forward, not closed (T071/T072, T088, T009/T013/T092, T060/T086, T058/T079/T100, T077, T083/T085, T098, T015/T041/T047, T061/T082, T036/T076/T006, T062/T035/T031, T035/T031/T065/T095, T101 held).}
\CRday{Day 351}{Ash 22, Secondday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, boards, pot board and towel in the small hours, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the Vail corner with its clean dark line and finer grey called the thaw, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the gone pan’s round ring, the yard well where Ilva drew with the pail against her knee, the skinned trough and the flat stone with the silt-clouded plate of ice, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the worked strips with the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling with the knife at its sill, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the terrace, the Debt Loft (a sound from above and behind, no interior entered), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the twenty-second came on an ordinary Secondday with no market, Cross or bell, no collector up or down the clay road and no runner on any road, with nothing from the nineteenth, twentieth or twenty-first crossing as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment — the reading on the twentieth bought no lesson under this roof — and the count going 350 to 351 exact, six months and one hundred and seventy-one days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 351 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the body inventoried in the surgeon’s old order of stiff leathery brown-edged crust two inches off with its corner a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped because nobody was ever given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house would perform, the surgeon’s knowing that a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed slowly from outside checked by the infant’s louder want with both true, the second louder, neither winning and the argument itself the work (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086); Sella kept the hearth grammar exactly at both ends of the day, fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot, \emph{The house will keep it}, intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, the charcoal unread beneath her finger on top of the shelf, lips on a two-gapped row unfigured, one glance at the clay jar with the little-door burn closing on air, the twice-mended pot up thumb-first with both proverbs to pot and fire and the hairline showing between old-brass staple and tighter wire, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure and no handful, pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and the widow’s mark untouched because a morning and a hearth are not openings, six openings in six months and no seventh made due, while the whole file was turned out on the towel and left with every gap gap, eight arithmetics eight and not one account behind one unsigned figure with both Ash subtractions locked and unread in Berr Clay’s box up the clay road, six hearings with the seventh place empty, the heard bell in its square beside the told, nine hands with no tenth, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and the loan uncalled, the row at five askings, the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, and the Ash 5 joining and Ash 17 direction held apart with a finger between (T015/T041/T047, T061/T082, T058/T079/T100, T077, T036/T076/T006 held); at the well Ilva drew with the pail against her knee, rope stiff in the Ash cold, clay pale in her nail crescents and rack dust in one thumb seam, and answered \emph{Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account} with her hand to her sleeve and the notched birch strip unread, filed as the ninth record-first hand with no tenth and expressly not the speaker of any voice (T080 advanced, not paid); Tarn kept six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, knife at the edge of its sill, checked the Bone 26 thumb’s resting and the Ash 14 held breath and found each where put and not made again, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, chest tight, Ash worked into his knuckle creases, the pale clip-ring catching light; Jorra came off the wheel-shed with meal-fine slate dust white in a fist-crease, parted dusty from clean forearms as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel before any person, told a pot \emph{You’ll do}, withheld the note known three turns ahead, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence — one iron with two bites — and kept \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed with the promise of the boy’s name neither given nor withdrawn (T062/T035/T031); the hunts and repairs stayed directions judged by the arm and the weather, the Cold Acre hare going toward the clay road unweighed, the cracked jar answered by a pot that said nothing, a woman with kindling asking what the seventh year would want and two fence-menders saying the thaw would be early and late to each of whom Tarn said \emph{Yes, house} and kept the late because it puts off the paying; and in the small hours the hand went up an inch toward the river’s note, took a small intake, held the interval whole on the note’s own finishing, came straight down and laid itself back on answer 277 and again at the close on answer 278, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment, 278 honest answers standing on the sixth place; Ash kept its twenty-second day without a boundary drawn with both habits of naming the months left uncorrected, and Ash 30 (Day 359) stood six mornings ahead named only as a date. Forward, not closed.}
\CRday{Day 352}{Ash 23, Thirdday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board, boards and towel in the small hours, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the boards carrying a voice with no owner, the yard well and flat stone, the skinned trough thickened to hold a poured spoon, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the kindling with the knife at its sill, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the terrace, the Debt Loft (a sound from above and behind, no interior entered), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the twenty-third came on another ordinary Thirdday with no market, Cross or bell, no collector up or down the clay road and no runner on any road, with nothing from the morning crossing the yard as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, the count going 351 to 352 exact, six months and one hundred and seventy-two days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 352 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the body inventoried in its old order of stiffer browner crust two inches off with its empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon’s knowing checked by the infant’s want with both true, the second louder, neither winning (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086); Sella kept the hearth grammar beat for beat, fire before basket, coals told the thaw, \emph{The house will keep it}, intake and hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, charcoal unread beneath her finger, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing, the twice-mended pot up thumb-first with hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure and no handful, pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and the widow’s mark untouched because six openings in six months are six and not a rule and no seventh was made due (T058/T079/T100, T077); \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T035/T031/T065/T095 and T101):} in the afternoon an ownerless voice came over the boards from the direction of Slate Row, spoken over the boards and not into the basket, saying that a room had been shut with the damper closed and a slate burned over a man nobody named, and putting lower the direction that the room had been shut against the cold and the slate burned so a count would not go up, with no room named, no hand at any flame, no figure, no date, no name for the man, no account gone up or kept down and nobody standing in any doorway to be asked; weather answered first, a wrong wind off High Kiln carrying the sweet edge of lead glaze over the boards and touching the fold and going out on the wind that brought it, the price of barley answered after it, and the voice went up the terrace while nobody leaned in to take the answer down; the boy took it apart as a surgeon takes a wound apart, by what was there (a direction, a voice with no owner, reasons spoken by nobody, the weather and the price) and by what was not (a room, a hand, a figure, a date, a name, a payer, a man to be asked), and filed it on a place of its own beside the Ash 5 joining and the Ash 17 direction with a finger between every pair — a further shaping of that joining and an advancement of the finding that a place wants a witness and a witness is a day somebody stands somewhere and can be asked, \textbf{not} a sixth telling of the burned slate (which stays at five), \textbf{not} a third shut-room telling (which stays at two), \textbf{not} a sixth asking of the row (which stays at five), \textbf{not} a fifth shaping of the well-saying (which stays at four), \textbf{not} a hearing, \textbf{not} a seventh, \textbf{not} a cause, \textbf{not} a confession, \textbf{not} a reader, \textbf{not} a name, \textbf{not} a witness and \textbf{not} a payment, with no payer under it, and he did not join it to Ilva’s strip, Hessa’s turned writing, Berr’s box, the soft-cuffed clerk’s inward slate, the charcoal, the covered grain or the handful, the edges coming near to touching and the finger going between, nor let eight or nine findings stand up as a doctrine; Jorra grew quieter when the direction went around and up the terrace and the household straightened around the quiet without an order, Sella giving it no name, figure or lesson and not answering on behalf of the man nobody named; Tarn at the kindling kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip, said \emph{Six counted. The next I don’t count}, checked the Ash 14 held breath a fifth time and found it where put and not made again, checked the Bone 26 thumb’s resting likewise, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, Seed 16 breath unspent and loan uncalled; Jorra parted dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel before any person, withheld the note known three turns ahead and put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, one iron with two bites, while \emph{he’s not Vail} stayed sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T062/T035/T031); no Ilva on this day, no Berr, no Hessa on any road, the yard’s hunts and repairs staying directions judged by the arm and the weather; and in the small hours the hand went up an inch, took a small intake, held the interval whole on the note’s own finishing, came down on answer 279 in the morning and answer 280 at the close, exact and worth nothing at two inches of air, 280 honest answers on the sixth place; Ash kept its twenty-third day without a boundary drawn with both habits of naming the months uncorrected, and Ash 30 (Day 359) stood six mornings ahead named only as a date. Forward, not closed.}
\CRday{Day 353}{Ash 24, Fourthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel in the small hours, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the Vail corner with its clean dark line and finer grey called the thaw, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the gone pan’s round ring, the yard well with the skinned trough and the flat stone with the silt-clouded plate of ice, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the worked strips with the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling with the knife at its sill, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the terrace, the Debt Loft with the warm loft stone cold in its unmarked pot, and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the twenty-fourth came on an ordinary Fourthday with no market, Cross or bell, no collector up or down the clay road and no runner on any road, with nothing from the twenty-third crossing as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or witness — the word that had come over the boards stood nowhere to be asked and bought no lesson under this roof, and the Ash 23 direction stood where it had been put and did not repeat — and the count going 352 to 353 exact, six months and one hundred and seventy-three days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 353 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the body inventoried again in its old order of stiffer browner crust two inches off with its empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon’s knowing checked by the infant’s want with both true, the second louder, neither winning (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086); Sella kept the hearth grammar exactly at both ends of the day, fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot, \emph{The house will keep it}, intake and hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, charcoal unread beneath her finger on top of the shelf, lips on a two-gapped row unfigured, one glance at the clay jar with the little-door burn closing on air, the twice-mended pot up thumb-first with both proverbs to pot and fire and the hairline showing between old-brass staple and tighter wire, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure and no handful, pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and the widow’s mark untouched because a going of the light and a bed are not openings, six openings in six months and no seventh made due (T058/T079/T100, T077); at the going of the light she carried him up at the half-pace wide around the seven places, set him on the bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, righted the fold without a look at his face, let her hand rest the half-beat longer than the setting needed and left the thread frozen; Tarn at the kindling kept six in the worn thumb-mark where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence with no name on the man who turned back at the frozen ford and no figure on the debt, knife at the very edge of its sill, said \emph{Six counted. The next I don’t count}, checked the Bone 26 thumb’s resting and the Ash 14 held breath and found each where put and not made again — neither a sixth held object, a tenth stopping, the calling of the loan nor made a fifth with the handful, the thumb’s resting or the pot-crack resting — brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, Seed 16 breath unspent and loan uncalled, his stroke going over the shallow bright patch without the half-check, the returned half-check of Bone 8 staying with the Day 161 fraction, the Day 166 beat and the Frost 5 beat as four held changes on four places and not a rule, the warm loft stone lying cold in its unmarked pot unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness (T036/T076/T006); Jorra came off the wheel-shed with meal-fine slate dust white in a fist-crease, parted dusty from clean forearms as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel before any person, told a pot \emph{You’ll do}, withheld the note known three turns ahead, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence — one iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies — and kept \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed with the promise neither given nor withdrawn while the claim went on gathering interest (T062/T035/T031); the whole file was turned out on the towel and checked and left with every gap gap, six hearings of the full note beside and never among with the seventh place empty (the sixth the small flat knock out of Dessa Silt as the men lifted her), the heard bell four, four and a gap in its square beside the told bell, eight arithmetics of the year — three of Frost, first, second and third of Bone, Ash’s first and second — behind one unsigned figure, eight and not one account, both Ash subtractions locked and unread up the clay road in Berr Clay’s box, the figure read still not the figure paid and no signature on the space, nine record-first hands with no tenth (Ilva’s ninth, Hessa’s eighth), nine stoppings with no tenth, the row at five askings, the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, and the Ash 5 joining, Ash 17 direction and Ash 23 direction held apart with a finger between every pair, advanced and not paid, none spent, named, joined, promoted into a witness, a sixth telling, a third shut-room telling, a sixth asking, a fifth shaping, a reader, a cause or a payment, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood (T015/T041/T047, T061/T082, T078, T080, T035/T031/T065/T095 and T101 held); no Ilva, no Berr, no Hessa on any road, no green-mouthed woman or foundling sighting and no ownerless voice on the twenty-fourth, the Cold Acre hare going toward the clay road unweighed, the cracked jar answered by a pot that said nothing, a woman with kindling asking what the seventh year would want and two fence-menders saying the thaw would be early and late to each of whom Tarn said \emph{Yes, house} and kept the late because it puts off the paying; and in the small hours at the very end of the day the hand went up an inch toward the river’s note, took a small intake, held the interval whole on the note’s own finishing, came straight down and laid itself back on answer 281 in the morning and answer 282 at the close, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, 282 honest answers standing on the sixth place, each an object and not a power; Ash kept its twenty-fourth day without a boundary drawn with both habits of naming the months uncorrected, and Ash 30 (Day 359) stood six mornings ahead named only as a date. Forward, not closed.}
\CRday{Day 354}{Ash 25, Fifthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board, boards and towel in the small hours, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the Vail corner with its clean dark line and finer grey called the thaw, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the gone pan’s round ring, the yard well with the skinned trough and the flat stone with the silt-clouded plate of ice, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the worked strips with the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling with the knife at its sill, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the terrace, the Debt Loft (a sound from above and behind, no interior entered), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the twenty-fifth came on an ordinary Fifthday with no market, Cross or bell, no collector up or down the clay road and no runner on any road, with nothing from the twenty-second, twenty-third or twenty-fourth crossing as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment — the word that had gone over the boards on the twenty-third stood nowhere to be asked and bought no lesson under this roof, and the Ash 23 direction stood where it had been put and did not repeat — and the count going 353 to 354 exact, six months and one hundred and seventy-three days becoming one hundred and seventy-four, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 354 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, 354 not round and not a threshold but one more in a row nobody counted aloud, the body inventoried again in the surgeon’s old order of stiff leathery brown-edged crust two inches off with its corner a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped because nobody was ever given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon’s knowing that a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed slowly from outside checked by the infant’s louder want with both true, the second louder, neither winning and the argument the work (T071/T072, T088, T009/T013/T092, T060/T086); Sella kept the hearth grammar exactly at both ends of the day, fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot, \emph{The house will keep it}, intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, charcoal unread beneath her finger on top of the shelf, lips on a two-gapped row unfigured, one glance at the clay jar standing cold under lead glaze with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, the twice-mended pot up thumb-first where the wire crossed the crack with both proverbs to pot and fire and the hairline showing between old-brass staple and tighter wire, dressed grain turned under wool with a still lighter touch and no figure or handful, and the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, the half-beat read as the distance between intention and arrest, bought at nothing and not a gift, for a gift wants a giver and nobody gave; the widow’s mark hung untouched because a morning, a hearth, a going of the light, a yard and a bed are not openings, six openings in six months being six and not a rule with the sixth held behind at Ash 2 and no seventh made due; the whole file was turned out on the towel and checked and left with every gap gap, eight arithmetics of the year — three of Frost, first, second and third of Bone, Ash’s first and second — behind one unsigned figure, eight and not one account, both Ash subtractions locked and unread up the clay road in Berr Clay’s box with the key gone up in a coat pocket and not coming back down, the figure read still not the figure paid and no signature on the space, the finding on a place of its own with no payer and no doctrine standing up out of eight, six hearings of the full note beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the sixth the small flat knock out of Dessa Silt filed where a thing out of a person must go, the heard bell four, four and a gap in its square beside the told bell of the Long Night, nine record-first hands with no tenth, nine stoppings with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and the loan uncalled, the row at five askings, the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the well-saying at four shapings, and the Ash 5 joining, Ash 17 direction and Ash 23 direction held apart with a finger between every pair, advanced and not paid, none spent, named, joined, promoted into a witness, a sixth telling, a third shut-room telling, a sixth asking, a fifth shaping, a hearing, a cause or a payment, for a rule is an account that has found a payer and none stood (T015/T041/T047, T061/T082, T078 held); in the afternoon the yard went around its seven places with a look and a wide step and no number, the three coverings stayed weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause, the gone white frost on the well’s north lip not come back, the trough’s skin breaking under a pail and closing, the silt-clouded plate of ice lifted out of the path of feet, the dressed grain lying covered and unfigured with the empty fingers set beside the Bone 22 keeping as a keeping and not a second handful, and the Cold Acre hare going to the weather unweighed, the cracked jar answered by a pot that said nothing, a woman with kindling asking what the seventh year would want and two fence-menders saying the thaw would be early and late, to each of whom Tarn said \emph{Yes, house} and kept the late because it puts off the paying though the paying had stood in the ruts since the water went; at the kindling Tarn kept six in the worn thumb-mark where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, knife at the very edge of its sill, checked the Bone 26 thumb’s resting and the Ash 14 held breath and found each where put and not made again, said \emph{Six counted. The next I don’t count}, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, Seed 16 breath unspent and loan uncalled, his stroke over the shallow bright patch without the half-check, the four held changes on four places not a rule, the warm loft stone lying cold in its unmarked pot unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness; Jorra came off the wheel-shed with meal-fine slate dust white in a fist-crease, parted dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel before any person, told a pot \emph{You’ll do}, withheld the note known three turns ahead from any kiln-master who would call it early, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence — one iron with two bites, the holding and the taking, with no Grathic word for both mercies — and kept \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed with the promise neither given nor withdrawn while the claim gathered interest, the extra holding of the morrow not present and not hoped for (T062/T035/T031, T036/T076/T006, T077, T083/T085, T098); no Ilva, no Berr, no Hessa on any road, no green-mouthed woman or foundling sighting and no ownerless voice over the boards on the twenty-fifth; at the going of the light Sella carried him up at the half-pace wide around the seven places, set him on the bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, righted the fold without a look at his face, let her hand rest the half-beat longer than the setting needed and left the thread frozen and unwiped; in the small hours the hand went up an inch toward the river’s note, took a small intake, held the interval whole on the note’s own finishing, came straight down and laid itself back on answer \textbf{283} in the morning and answer \textbf{284} at the close, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, \textbf{284 honest answers} standing on the sixth place, each an object and not a power and none calling itself a doctrine; Ash kept its twenty-fifth day without a boundary drawn with both habits of naming the months uncorrected, and Ash 30 (Day 359) stood five mornings ahead named only as a date. Forward, not closed (T071/T072, T088, T009/T013/T092, T098, T060/T086, T058/T079/T100, T077, T083/T085, T036/T076/T006, T062/T035/T031, T015/T041/T047, T078, T061/T082 held).}
\CRday{Day 355}{Ash 26, Sixthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board, boards and towel in the small hours, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the Vail corner with its clean dark line and finer grey called the thaw, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the gone pan’s round ring, the yard well where Ilva drew with the pail against her knee and the open slate a pace away, the skinned trough thickened to hold a poured spoon and the flat stone with the silt-clouded plate of ice, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the worked strips with the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling with the knife at its sill, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper where a finger stayed a breath longer than the work required, the terrace, the Debt Loft (a sound from above and behind, no interior entered), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the twenty-sixth came on an ordinary Sixthday with no market, Cross or bell, no collector up or down the clay road and no runner on any road, the day before kept exactly and left exactly, nothing crossing as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, and the count going 354 to 355 exact, six months and one hundred and seventy-four days becoming one hundred and seventy-five, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 355 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the body inventoried again in the surgeon’s old order of stiffer browner crust two inches off with its empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon’s knowing checked by the infant’s louder want with both true, the second louder, neither winning, the day offering no new thing and that itself an exact result entered nowhere (T071/T072, T088, T009/T013/T092, T060/T086); Sella kept the hearth grammar beat for beat at both ends of the day, fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot, \emph{The house will keep it}, intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, charcoal unread beneath her finger on top of the shelf, lips on a two-gapped row unfigured, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, the twice-mended pot up thumb-first with both proverbs to pot and fire and the hairline showing, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure and no handful, pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and the widow’s mark untouched because six openings in six months are six and not a rule and no seventh was made due (T058/T079/T100, T077); the dark month was at its last tend, with a harder cold at the finger’s-width door, the trough skin thickened to hold a poured spoon, the plate of ice lifted a little out of the path of feet, the gone white frost not come back, the river’s note sitting lower, the kiln standing cold behind the wall with nobody going out to look, three coverings entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause, and Ash 30 (Day 359) four mornings ahead named only as a date, never as a promise, its nearness not brought into a morning that had not earned it (T083/T085); \textbf{Ilva drew at the yard well with the pail against her knee, the rope stiff in the Ash cold giving its small dry rasp, clay pale in her nail crescents and grey rack dust in one thumb seam she did not scrub out, and to a woman waiting her turn who asked what Ash’s firings had taken her hand went toward her sleeve and stayed, the short strip of notched birch bark pale where a thumb had rubbed it and dark in the uncut grain between, not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the open slate a pace away, to the charcoal beneath the loaf shelf, to the cord or to any saying that arrived nowhere, no figure coming off the wood, and with eyes to the asker and mouth opening after both with a half-beat she answered the question put and not the one behind it, *Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account*, then put her flat hand once more on the sleeve and went back to the pail, nobody turning twice; the boy took the order of reaching apart as a surgeon takes a field apart and filed it as the ninth record-first hand on its own place with a finger between it and Hessa Rale’s eighth and no tenth, made no reader of her keeping, joined her to none, and expressly did not make her the speaker of any voice, no voice coming at that well and no fifth shaping of the saying (T080 advanced, not paid)}; Tarn at the kindling kept six in the worn thumb-mark where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, knife at the very edge of its sill, chest tight and Ash worked into the knuckle creases in the colour of the clean dark line, checked the Bone 26 thumb’s resting and the Ash 14 held breath and found each where put and not made again, said \emph{Six counted. The next I don’t count}, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, Seed 16 breath unspent and loan uncalled (T036/T076/T006); \textbf{THE CHAPTER’S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE, advanced and NOT paid (T062/T035/T031 and T061/T082):} Jorra came off the wheel-shed with meal-fine grey dust white in a fist-crease, parted dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel before any person, told a pot \emph{You’ll do}, withheld the note known three turns ahead, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence so the end of her instruction arrived at the pot and the household straightened around the waiting as cloth straightens when a weight is lifted — one iron with two bites, the holding and the taking, with no Grathic word for both mercies — and then, after the tongue had been moved and the sentence finished and the household straightened, after the work was done and not before, \textbf{left the bent finger in the cold iron a breath longer than the work required}, making no song of it, naming it to nobody, not looking toward the basket, giving no name to the men in the back room and not saying the room was cold; the boy took the interval apart by what was there and by what was not and filed it on a place of its own with a finger between it and the five held objects, the pot-crack resting, the hand-at-the-sill breath and his own gaps, a private keeping gathered once and not spent, expressly \textbf{not} a sixth held object, not a seventh, not an eighth of anything, not a habit, not a way, not a hearing, not a near-full answer, not a mending, not a cause, not a payment and not a rule, with no payer standing under it, gathering toward the far-off hand that will one day lay the district’s private keepings together, and that hand not his; he did not join it to Jorra’s dust, the damper’s double bite, the uncalled debt, the covered grain, the charcoal, Ilva’s strip or the Ash 23 direction, the edges coming near to touching and the finger going between, and \emph{he’s not Vail} stayed sealed with the promise neither given nor withdrawn and the claim gathering interest against it; the whole file was turned out on the towel and checked and left, six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty, heard bell beside told, eight arithmetics eight and not one account, nine hands and nine stoppings with no tenth, the row at five askings, the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the well-saying at four shapings, the three directions apart, and the new holding on its own place beside the five objects, the pot-crack resting and the hand-at-the-sill breath; no voice came over the boards to make a sixth of anything and none was supplied to make a row come out even; at the going of the light Sella carried him up wide around the seven places, set him on the bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, righted the fold without a look at his face, let her hand rest the half-beat longer than the setting needed and left the thread frozen; in the small hours the hand went up an inch, took a small intake, held the interval whole on the note’s own finishing, came straight down and laid itself back on answer \textbf{285} in the morning and answer \textbf{286} at the close, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, \textbf{286 honest answers} standing on the sixth place; Ash kept its twenty-sixth day without a boundary drawn with both habits of naming the months uncorrected, and Ash 30 (Day 359) stood four mornings ahead named only as a date. Forward, not closed (T062/T035/T031 and T061/T082 advanced, not paid; T080 advanced, not paid; T071/T072, T088, T009/T013/T092, T060/T086, T058/T079/T100, T077, T083/T085, T036/T076/T006, T015/T041/T047, T078, T035/T031/T065/T095 and T101 held).}
\CRday{Day 356}{Ash 27, Seventhday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board, boards and towel in the small hours, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the Vail corner with its clean dark line and finer grey called the thaw, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the gone pan’s round ring, the yard well with the skinned trough thick enough to hold a spoon and the flat stone with the silt-clouded plate of ice, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the worked strips with the field’s empty place and the returning-line place where the yard went widest of all, the kindling with the knife at its sill, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper where the extra interval was found where put and not made again, the terrace, the Debt Loft with the warm loft stone cold in its unmarked pot, and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the twenty-seventh came on an ordinary Seventhday with no market, Cross or bell, no collector up or down the clay road and no runner on any road, with nothing from the twenty-fifth or twenty-sixth crossing as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment — the directions of the fifth, seventeenth and twenty-third stood where they had been put and did not repeat and bought no lesson under this roof — and the count going 355 to 356 exact, six months and one hundred and seventy-five days becoming one hundred and seventy-six, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 356 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, 356 not round and not a threshold anybody under the roof would speak, the body inventoried again in the surgeon’s old order of stiff leathery brown-edged crust two inches off with its empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon’s knowing checked by the infant’s louder want with both true, the second louder, neither winning (T071/T072, T088, T009/T013/T092, T060/T086); Sella kept the hearth grammar beat for beat at both ends of the day, fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot, \emph{The house will keep it}, intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, charcoal unread beneath her finger on top of the shelf, lips on a two-gapped row unfigured, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, the twice-mended pot up thumb-first where the wire crossed the crack with both proverbs to pot and fire and the hairline showing, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure and no handful, pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and the widow’s mark untouched because a going of the light and a bed are not openings, six openings in six months being six and not a rule and no seventh made due (T058/T079/T100, T077); the yard went around its seven places with a look and a step and no number, going widest around the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, the three coverings stayed weather entered nowhere with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause, the dressed grain lay covered and unfigured with the empty fingers beside the Bone 22 keeping as a keeping and not a second handful, and the Cold Acre hare went to the weather unweighed, the cracked jar was answered by a pot that said nothing, a woman with kindling asked what the seventh year would want and two fence-menders said the thaw would be early and late, to each of whom Tarn said \emph{Yes, house} and kept the late because it puts off the paying; at the kindling Tarn kept six in the worn thumb-mark where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beyond it where it could not, beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, knife at the very edge of its sill, checked the Bone 26 thumb’s resting and the Ash 14 held breath and found each where put and not made again, neither a sixth held object, a seventh, a tenth stopping, the calling of the loan nor made a fifth with the handful, the pot-crack resting or the new holding in the iron, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, Seed 16 breath unspent and loan uncalled, his stroke over the shallow bright patch without the half-check and the four held changes on four places not a rule, the warm loft stone cold in its unmarked pot unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness, and the new holding of the day before lying where nobody would enter it and not laid across the loan, the knife or the flagstones (T036/T076/T006, T061/T082); Jorra came off the wheel-shed with meal-fine slate dust white in a fist-crease, gave the men in the back room no name and did not say the room was cold, parted dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel before any person, told a pot \emph{You’ll do}, withheld the note known three turns ahead, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence — one iron with two bites, the holding and the taking, with no Grathic word for both mercies — and \textbf{then took his finger out, leaving the extra interval where he had put it on the twenty-sixth and not making it again, for a second would be a habit and a third a way, and both want a payer standing under them and none stood}, making no song of it, naming it to nobody, not looking toward the basket and not checking whether anybody had noticed, while \emph{he’s not Vail} stayed sealed as a lid nobody had tried to lift in three years and the promise of the boy’s name to the men who burn slates was neither given nor withdrawn with the claim going on gathering interest (T062/T035/T031 advanced, not paid); no Ilva at the well, no Berr, no Hessa on any road, no green-mouthed woman or foundling sighting, no runner, no collector, no market, no Cross, no bell and no ownerless voice over the boards on the twenty-seventh; the whole file came out on the towel and was checked and left with every gap gap, six hearings of the full note beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the heard bell four, four and a gap in its square beside the told bell, the told figure beside the paid with no signature, \textbf{eight arithmetics of the year — three of Frost, first, second and third of Bone, Ash’s first and second — behind one unsigned figure, eight and not one account}, both Ash subtractions locked and unread up the clay road in Berr Clay’s box, the finding on a place of its own with no payer and no doctrine stood up out of eight, nine record-first hands with no tenth (Ilva’s ninth, Hessa’s eighth), nine stoppings with no tenth, the row at five askings, the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the well-saying at four shapings, the Ash 5 joining, Ash 17 direction and Ash 23 direction apart with a finger between every pair, and the holding of Ash 26 on a place of its own beside the five objects, the pot-crack resting, the hand-at-the-sill breath and the boy’s gaps, gathered once, not spent, not a sixth, seventh or eighth held object, not a habit and not a rule, no payer standing; at the going of the light Sella carried him up at the half-pace wide around the seven places, set him on the bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, righted the fold without a look at his face, let her hand rest the half-beat longer than the setting needed and left the thread frozen; in the small hours the hand went up an inch toward the river’s note, took a small intake, held the interval whole on the note’s own finishing, came straight down and laid itself back on answer \textbf{287} in the morning and answer \textbf{288} at the close, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, \textbf{288 honest answers} standing on the sixth place, each an object and not a power and none calling itself a doctrine; three counts in three places — the carried fire at four and a gap, the boards four, four and a knot, the river low over lower — did not become one, because agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stood, and the bell’s gap stayed in its square and was not folded into any of them; Ash kept its twenty-seventh day without a boundary drawn with both habits of naming the months uncorrected, and Ash 30 (Day 359) stood three mornings ahead named only as a date. Forward, not closed (T061/T082, T071/T072, T088, T009/T013/T092 and T098, T060/T086, T058/T079/T100, T077, T083/T085, T036/T076/T006, T062/T035/T031 advanced not paid, T078, T080, T015/T041/T047, T035/T031/T065/T095 and T101 held).}
\CRday{Day 357}{Ash 28, Eighthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel in the small hours, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the Vail corner with its clean dark line and finer grey called the thaw, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the gone pan’s round ring, the yard well where Ilva drew with the pail against her knee and the open slate a pace away, the skinned trough thick enough to hold a poured spoon and the silt-clouded plate of ice on the flat stone, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the worked strips with the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling with the knife at its sill, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the Debt Loft (a sound from above and behind, no interior entered), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the twenty-eighth came on an ordinary Eighthday with no market, Cross or bell, no collector up or down the clay road and no runner on any road, with nothing from the twenty-fifth, twenty-sixth or twenty-seventh crossing as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer and the directions of the fifth, seventeenth and twenty-third standing where they were put and not repeating, the count going 356 to 357 exact, six months and one hundred and seventy-six days becoming one hundred and seventy-seven, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 357 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the body inventoried in the surgeon’s old order of stiff leathery brown-edged crust two inches from the ear with its corner a hair off the wool and its empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped because nobody was ever given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the composed face not composure and the surgeon’s knowing checked by the infant’s louder want with both true, the second louder, neither winning and the argument itself the work (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086); Sella went to the hearth before the basket, told the coals the thaw, turned them with a broken pot’s back, said \emph{The house will keep it} where another woman would have said I, counted intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, kept her finger on top of the loaf shelf with the charcoal unread, moved her lips along a two-gapped row, glanced once at the clay jar with the little-door burn closing on air, lifted the twice-mended pot thumb-first where the wire crossed the crack with both proverbs to the pot and the fire and the hairline showing, turned the dressed grain under wool with a touch lighter than a woman uses on a sleeping child and no figure or handful, set the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and carried him down at the half-pace with the instruction to the wool and the river wind and never to the basket (T058/T079/T100, T077); she went wide around the seven places with a look and no number, went widest of all around the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, and kept the three coverings weather with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause (T009/T013/T092, T098, T083/T085); at the well Ilva’s hand went to her sleeve and stayed, the notched birch strip unread and not joined to the open slate a pace away, and she answered \emph{Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account} to the woman who asked what Ash’s firings had taken, her reaching filed as the ninth record-first hand with a finger between it and Hessa’s eighth and no tenth, expressly not the speaker of any voice (T080 advanced and not paid); Tarn kept six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence with the knife at the edge of its sill, said \emph{Six counted. The next I don’t count}, found the Bone 26 thumb’s resting and the Ash 14 held breath where put and not made again, brought the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled, his chest tight and Ash in the creases of his knuckles (T036/T076/T006); Jorra came off the wheel-shed with meal-fine slate dust white in a fist-crease, parted dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel before any person and told a pot \emph{You’ll do}, withheld the note he knew three turns ahead from any High Kiln master, and put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, one piece of iron with two bites, without leaving the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time (T062/T035/T031); hunts and repairs stayed directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather --- the Cold Acre hare sent to the weather, the cracked jar to a pot that said nothing, and \emph{Yes, house} to the early and late thaw with the late kept because it puts off the paying (T077); the widow’s mark was untouched, six openings in six months were six and not a rule, and no seventh, sixth hearing, sixth held object, sixth telling, third shut-room telling, sixth asking, fifth shaping, tenth hand or tenth stopping was supplied (T058/T079, T061/T082); three counts in three places stayed three with the bell’s gap in its square, six hearings stood beside and never among with the seventh place empty, eight arithmetics stood behind one unsigned figure with both Ash subtractions locked in Berr’s box and the finding on a place of its own with no payer and no doctrine out of eight, and the hand came up an inch toward the river’s note, held a small intake whole on the note’s own finishing, came straight down and filed answers 289 and 290, each exact, worth nothing at two inches of air and not promoted into a reach, a payment or a power; Ash 30 (Day 359) stood two mornings ahead and was named only as a date; forward, not closed.}
\CRday{Day 358}{Ash 29, Ninthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel in the small hours, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the Vail corner with its clean dark line and finer grey called the thaw, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the gone pan’s round ring, the yard well with the skinned trough and the silt-clouded plate of ice on the flat stone, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the worked strips with the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling with the knife at its sill, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper, the Debt Loft with the warm loft stone cold in its unmarked pot, and the clay road with no collector upon it, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the twenty-ninth came on the last fully quiet tending day of the dark month, an ordinary Ninthday with no market, Cross or bell, no collector on the clay road, no runner on any road, no Ilva at the well and no ownerless voice over the boards, with nothing from the twenty-eighth crossing as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment and the directions of the fifth, seventeenth and twenty-third standing where they were put, the count going 357 to 358 exact, six months and one hundred and seventy-seven days becoming one hundred and seventy-eight, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 358 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number (T071/T072, T088, T009/T013/T092), the body inventoried again in its old order of stiffer browner crust two inches off with its empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon’s knowing checked by the infant’s louder want with both true, the second louder, neither winning and the argument the work (T060/T086); Sella did the whole hearth grammar again in the first grey beat for beat and the boy checked the second doing against the first and found them the same --- fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot’s back, \emph{The house will keep it}, intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, finger on top of the loaf shelf with the charcoal unread, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, the twice-mended pot lifted thumb-first with both proverbs and the hairline showing, the dressed grain turned under wool with no figure and no handful, and the pot rim set two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077); the yard went around its seven places with a look and a wide step and no number, the three coverings stayed weather with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause, and the hunts and repairs stayed directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather, the Cold Acre hare sent to the weather and the cracked jar to a pot that said nothing, Tarn saying \emph{Yes, house} to the early and late thaw and keeping the late because it puts off the paying (T009/T013/T092, T098, T083/T085, T077); no sixth telling of the burned slate came over the boards, no third telling of the shut room, no sixth asking of the row, no fifth shaping of the well-saying, no tenth hand and no tenth stopping, and no runner, collector, market, Cross or bell was made due on a day that had not earned one (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101, T080); Tarn kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, knife at the edge of its sill, found the Ash 14 held breath and the Bone 26 thumb’s resting where put and not made again, brought the ear-sentence to the calling word and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled, his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, the returned half-check of Bone 8 staying on the flagstone’s own place with the Day 161 fraction, the Day 166 beat and the Frost 5 beat as four held changes on four places and not a rule, and the warm loft stone lying cold in its unmarked pot, unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness (T036/T076/T006); Jorra came off the wheel-shed with meal-fine slate dust white in a fist-crease, parted dusty from clean forearms as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel before any person and told a pot \emph{You’ll do}, withheld the note he knew three turns ahead, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence and did not leave the extra interval of Ash 26 a second time, for a second would be a habit and a third a way, both of which want a payer and none stood (T062/T035/T031); the widow’s mark was untouched because an afternoon and a going of the light are not openings, six openings in six months were six and not a rule with no seventh made due, the handled grain lay covered and unfigured, and three counts in three places did not become one with the bell’s gap in its square and eight arithmetics still eight behind one unsigned figure with the finding on a place of its own (T058/T079, T077, T015/T041/T047 held); the hand came up an inch toward the river’s note, held a small intake whole on the note’s own finishing, came straight down and filed answers 291 and 292, exact, worth nothing at two inches of air and laid across none of the held objects (T061/T082); the last clean morning of the dark month offered nothing and that itself was an exact result entered nowhere, the keeping went on as the only honest work there was, Ash 30 stood one morning ahead named only as a date, the ninth arithmetic stayed unnamed for one more day, and Stone came on in the dark beyond the door and was not brought into a day that had not earned it; forward, not closed.}
\CRday{Day 359}{Ash 30, Tenthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof in the dark before first light, then down the clay road to the Cross, the reading block under the moot-post and the moot-post’s finger’s width of shade where no slate lay, the pot board and the market with its eight pigs going over the wet boards, the out-of-line landing below the north bridge, the road toward Greybank and the market’s edge, then back under the Vail roof at the hearth, pot board, loaf shelf, bed, boards and towel in the small hours, with the Clay Yard’s seven walked-around places, the yard well and flat stone, the skinned trough and the plate of ice, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the gone pan’s round ring, the worked strips with the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling with the knife at its sill, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and a sound only), the cold damper and the Debt Loft with the warm loft stone cold in its unmarked pot, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the thirtieth came in the dark before first light earned by its own morning, the dark month’s third and last Account-day and market with a slate read under the moot-post and a bell, none of which had stood on the twenty-ninth to be carried back as a lesson, nothing from Ash 28 or 29 crossing as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, the count going 358 to 359 exact, six months and one hundred and seventy-eight days becoming one hundred and seventy-nine, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 359 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the body inventoried again in its old order with the surgeon’s knowing checked by the infant’s louder want and both true, neither winning, and the argument the work (T071/T072, T088, T009/T013/T092, T060/T086); Sella went to the hearth before the basket with the whole old grammar, told the coals the thaw, turned them with a broken pot’s back, said \emph{The house will keep it}, counted intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, kept the charcoal unread beneath her finger, moved her lips along a two-gapped row, glanced once at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing, lifted the twice-mended pot thumb-first with both proverbs and the hairline showing, turned the dressed grain under wool with no figure and no handful and set the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand, then carried him down before first light at the half-pace with the instruction to the wool and the river wind and never to the basket, set the basket in the moot-post’s finger’s width of shade where no slate lay, put the fold right under his chin with the back of one knuckle and stood half a pace off through the reading and said nothing to the wicker (T058/T079/T100, T077); \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T015/T041/T047):} Berr Clay came up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat, the sweetish green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner and the smell of nothing at all under the hot clay of him, wiped his thumb twice on his large clean apron before touching nothing, held a narrow slate inward to his forearm, passed a finger over the figure through his sleeve and let his eyes rest on the writing a breath longer than the writing required, read \emph{One in twelve, as the notice says} low into the goers-by and sent it twice over the basket, once for the moot and once for the late households, called the levy and denied it with \emph{The levy is called. It is not called by me} and \emph{your house}, never I, said something low to the block about kindness being entered to which the block answered nothing, and went off up the clay road with the cord folded, the slate under his arm and the box locked, Ash’s third true subtraction riding inside beside the three of Frost and the first, second and third of Bone, believing he had done a kindness with no anger and no triumph in it; \textbf{nine arithmetics of the year now stand behind one unsigned figure, nine and not one account}, one in twelve printed and unchallenged, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space, the finding on a place of its own with no payer and no doctrine out of nine, expressly not laid across the not-doings, the covered grain, the five held objects, the pot-crack resting, the hand-at-the-sill breath, the holding of Ash 26, the Ash 5 joining, the Ash 17 direction, the Ash 23 direction or the boy’s kept gaps, the edges coming near to touching and the finger going between, and the reading answering none of the held questions and buying no lesson under the Vail roof; the bell went four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself, the heard bell staying in its square beside the told bell and not folded into the three counts with six hearings beside and never among and the seventh place empty (T078, T061/T082); before noon Hessa Rale took the slate up the road toward Greybank with the second strap let out, dried pale road-mud scurf unbrushed on the shortened skirt, the writing turned to her sleeve and nothing pressing where the writing was, and answered \emph{I don’t read it. I carry it. There’s a difference, and the road doesn’t care which} and \emph{Cross to Greybank. Reading goes up before noon. I’ve got a road to walk.}, a runner and not a reader with the eighth record-first hand and no tenth (T080); the soft-cuffed clerk stayed set at the out-of-line landing where a fifth step should have stood for a measure nobody called, his slate inward and his hand to slate before eye to stalls, the market selling over him as water over a stone and nobody taking him off (T090); at the market’s pot board a silent woman with the seventh green at one mouth-corner turned a cup a quarter and set it back, and at the market’s edge a small shape in cast-offs caught the light on a green sliver and went dull, a seventh colour and a seventh shape with no eighth, unnamed, never Fenna or Ulda, not joined to Berr’s green, to each other or to any hearing, cause or romance, and the foundling’s half-turn after the knock was a turn and not a hearing (T050/T051, T033/T034); Sella carried him home at the going of the light saying nothing of where they had been or what had been read over the wicker, came to the hearth before the basket under the roof, left the thread frozen and unwiped, and kept the widow’s mark untouched, for a market, a Cross, a going of the light and a reading are not openings, six openings in six months are six and not a rule and no seventh was made due (T058/T079); in the afternoon the yard went around its seven places with a look and a wide step and no number, went widest around the returning-line place, kept the three coverings weather with a finger between every pair, lifted no handful of the dressed grain, and sent the hunts and repairs as directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather while a wrong wind off High Kiln brought the sweet edge of lead glaze over the boards and went on about its business, nobody tasting it twice (T009/T013/T092, T098, T083/T085, T077); Tarn kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, knife at the edge of its sill, found the Ash 14 breath and the Bone 26 thumb where put and not made again, brought the ear-sentence to the calling word and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled, the four held changes on four places and not a rule, and the warm loft stone cold in its unmarked pot, unreconciled by not trying, which is not forgiveness (T036/T076/T006), while Jorra came off the wheel-shed with meal-fine slate dust white in a fist-crease, spoke to the wheel before any person, told a pot \emph{You’ll do}, withheld the note he knew three turns ahead, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence and did not leave the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time, \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed and the promise of the boy’s name neither given nor withdrawn (T062/T035/T031); the whole file came out on the towel and was checked and left as it lay, nine arithmetics nine and not one account, six hearings with the seventh place empty, nine hands and nine stoppings with no tenth, the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the well-saying at four shapings, the row at five askings with no witness, the Ash 5 joining, the Ash 17 direction and the Ash 23 direction apart with a finger between every pair, three counts in three places that did not become one, and nothing promoted by the reading (T061/T082, T078, T080, T035/T031/T065/T095, T101); the hand came up an inch toward the river’s note, held a small intake whole on the note’s own finishing, came straight down and filed answers 293 in the small hours after the reading and 294 at the close, 294 honest answers standing on the sixth place, each an object and not a power, and not one standing up and calling itself a doctrine;
