the count closed at 359 exact because the day closed and not because anybody called it, the surgeon taking his cold satisfaction in a field left as found and costing nothing, which was how he knew it was not the same as peace, while the infant went on wanting the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle, both true, the second louder, neither winning; no collector came up or down the clay road, no runner came on any road, and no second reading, green-mouthed woman sighting, foundling sighting or ownerless voice came in the afternoon; Ash went out without a boundary drawn and neither habit of naming the months was set right or left wrong, and Stone came on in the dark beyond the door and was not brought into a day that had not earned it, its first firing standing far off, the boy’s first birthday on Stone 7 (Day 366) beyond that and the Hearth Drawing on Stone 12 (Day 371) further still, none named to him under any roof; forward, not closed.}
\CRday{Day 360}{Stone 1, Firstday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel in the small hours, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the Vail corner with its clean dark line and finer grey called the thaw, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the gone pan’s round ring, the yard well with the trough skinned over and the silt-clouded plate of ice on the flat stone, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the worked strips with the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling with the knife at its sill, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (a direction and low voices only), the cold damper, the finger’s-width door and the river beyond it, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road and Cold Acre as directions, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the deep-winter month came on in the dark without a boundary drawn, an ordinary Firstday with no market, Cross or bell, no collector on the clay road and no runner on any road, nothing from Ash 28, 29 or 30 crossing as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, the count going 359 to 360 exact, six months and one hundred and seventy-nine days becoming one hundred and eighty, nobody under the roof speaking the number or marking a threshold though six months stood exactly at the close of this day, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 360 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the body inventoried in the surgeon’s old order of stiff leathery brown-edged crust two inches off with its corner a hair off the wool, its empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon’s knowing that a cold patient cannot clot checked by the infant’s louder want with both true, the second louder, neither winning and the argument the work (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086); Sella went to the hearth before the basket with the whole old grammar, fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot’s back, \emph{The house will keep it} where another woman would say I, intake and hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, charcoal unread beneath her finger on top of the shelf, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, the twice-mended pot up thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure or handful, pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, the widow’s mark untouched because a morning and a hearth are not openings, six openings in six months not a rule and no seventh made due, and the unswept ridge thickened in the cold and set down as weather entered nowhere; she carried him down in the afternoon at the half-pace with the instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire to be banked against their coming back, went wide around the seven places widest around the returning-line place, and set him on his bed under the roof at the going of the light and never in the Debt Loft, saying nothing of where they had been; Tarn kept six in the worn thumb-mark where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, knife at the very edge of its sill, passed his hand over blade and sill, checked the Bone 26 thumb’s resting and the Ash 14 held breath and found each where put and not made again, said \emph{Six counted. The next I don’t count} to the wood and \emph{Yes, house} to the early and late thaw keeping the late because it puts off the paying, brought the ear-sentence up to the word that would call the loan and stopped as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, chest tight since the dark, Ash worked into his knuckle creases, the pale clip-ring at his left wrist, his stroke over the bright patch without the half-check; Jorra came off the wheel-shed with meal-fine grey slate dust white in a fist-crease, men unnamed gone low into the back room before first grey, parted dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel before any person (\emph{It doesn’t care whose hands. It cares if they’re steady}) and told a pot \emph{You’ll do}, knew the full note three turns ahead and withheld it from any High Kiln master, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence and did not leave the extra interval of Ash 26 a second time, \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T036/T076/T006, T062/T035/T031, T058/T079/T100, T077, T098); \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T083/T085 and T078):} in the afternoon the river’s note under the finger’s-width door came no longer water over water in the open but low under a skin, the Ilm having taken its winter ice from bank to bank, a man come down from Cold Acre shifting a hare across his shoulders saying \emph{It’s gone under} and, asked what the ice would cost, \emph{Ask the weather. It laid it on. It’ll take it off}, nobody opening a slate and no figure coming, the boy filing the new note on a place of its own beside water over water, a covering put on by the cold and taken off by the cold and entered nowhere, expressly not a sixth low thing standing up as a rule, not a hearing, not a seventh of the full note, not a fourth of the three coverings, not a sign, lesson, cause, payment or payer, gathering toward the deep winter and the first firing and the birthday and the Drawing and paying none of them, no ownerless voice coming over the boards and the Ash 5 joining, the Ash 17 direction and the Ash 23 direction standing where put and not repeating; in the small hours the hand went up an inch toward the note under its skin, took a small intake, held the interval whole on the note’s own finishing under the ice, came straight down and laid itself back against the fold as a man puts away a tool --- answers 295 in the morning’s small hours and 296 at the close, each exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment, laid across none of the held objects, 360 exact spoken by nobody and the file left open on the towel with every gap left gap, forward, not closed.}
\CRday{Day 361}{Stone 2, Secondday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel in the small hours, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the Vail corner with its clean dark line and finer grey called the thaw, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the gone pan’s round ring, Ilva at the yard well with the rope stiff in the cold and an open slate a pace away, the trough skinned over and the silt-clouded plate of ice on the flat stone, the drying racks and rack end on the clay road, no runner on any road and no ownerless voice over the boards, nothing from Stone 1 crossing as sign, lesson, mending, cause or payment, the river’s winter skin found where it had been laid on the day before and not made again, not added to the three coverings and not made a sixth low thing or a fourth likeness, the count going 360 to 361 exact, six months and one hundred and eighty days becoming one hundred and eighty-one, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 361 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the body inventoried again in the surgeon’s old order of leathery crust, unnamed gap, frozen thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon’s knowing checked by the infant’s louder want with both true, the second louder, neither winning (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086); Sella kept the hearth grammar beat for beat, fire before basket, coals told the thaw, \emph{The house will keep it}, charcoal unread, lips on a two-gapped row unfigured, the twice-mended pot up thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure or handful, pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, the widow’s mark untouched because a morning and a hearth are not openings, six openings not a rule and no seventh made due, the three counts in three places still not becoming one and the bell’s gap staying in its square; she carried him down and up at the half-pace, went wide around the seven places widest around the returning-line place, and set him on his bed under the roof at the going of the light and never in the Debt Loft, saying nothing of where they had been; at the well Ilva stood with the pail against her knee, the rope giving its small dry rasp as the bucket came up, clay dried pale in her nail crescents and grey rack dust worked into the seam of one thumb she did not scrub out, her hands knowing the weight of a pail and the edge of a wet board and never soft, and when a woman waiting her turn asked what Stone’s firings had taken her hand went toward her sleeve and stayed, the short strip of notched birch bark pale where a thumb had rubbed the notches and dark in the uncut grain between not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the open slate a pace away, to the charcoal beneath the shelf, the cord, the knot-string or any saying that arrived nowhere, eyes to the asker and mouth after both with a half-beat in the gap, answering the question put and not the one behind it: \emph{Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account}, then putting her flat hand once more on the sleeve and going back to the pail with nobody turning twice; the boy took the order of her reaching apart as a surgeon takes a field apart --- hand to record before eyes to person, eyes before mouth, the half-beat in the gap where a lesser observer would put an intention --- and filed it as the ninth record-first hand on a place of its own with a finger between it and Hessa Rale’s eighth, filing no tenth, making no reader of her keeping and joining her to none, she being expressly not the speaker of any voice, no fifth shaping of the Frost 14 well-saying, no third telling of the shut room and no sixth asking of the row (T080 advanced and not paid); the afternoon’s hare, cracked jar, kindling and mending went off as directions judged by the carrying arm and the weather, Tarn saying \emph{Yes, house} to early and late and keeping the late, six in the thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip, the Bone 26 thumb’s resting and the Ash 14 held breath found where put and not made again, the ear-sentence stopped at the word that would call the loan as a ninth stopping with no tenth, Jorra at the damper with meal-fine dust and the two bites of iron, the Ash 26 holding found where put and not made again, the promise ungiven; in the small hours the hand went up an inch toward the note under its skin, took a small intake, held the interval whole on the note’s own finishing under the ice, came straight down and laid itself back against the fold --- answers 297 in the small hours of the morning and 298 at the close, each exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment, 361 exact spoken by nobody and forward, not closed.}
\CRday{Day 362}{Stone 3, Thirdday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel in the small hours and river’s winter skin found where put and not made again, Ilva not at the well and her absence promoting no tenth, the count going 361 to 362 exact, six months and one hundred and eighty-one days becoming one hundred and eighty-two, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 362 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the body inventoried again in the surgeon’s old order of perform, the surgeon’s knowing checked by the infant’s louder want with both true, the second louder, neither winning (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086); Sella kept the hearth grammar exactly at both ends of the day with fire before basket, coals told the thaw, \emph{The house will keep it}, charcoal unread, the twice-mended pot up thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure or handful, pot rim two inches out with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, the widow’s mark untouched because a morning, an afternoon and a going of the light are not openings and six openings in six months are not a rule, the thickened ridge entered nowhere; she carried him down in the afternoon at the half-pace, went wide around the seven places widest around the returning-line place, took the going-around as a field is taken before work by the small signs first, and lifted him home at the going of the light with her whole attention on the basket’s level, set him on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, righted the fold without a look at his face, let her hand rest the half-beat longer than the setting needed and left the thread frozen and unwiped, saying nothing of where they had been or of the hare, the jar, the kindling or the mending; Tarn kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, checked the Bone 26 thumb’s resting and the Ash 14 held breath and found each where put and not made again, said \emph{Six counted. The next I don’t count}, stopped the ear-sentence at the word that would call the loan as a ninth stopping with no tenth, chest tight, Ash worked into his knuckles, the stroke over the bright patch without the half-check; Jorra came off the wheel-shed with meal-fine dust white in a fist-crease, men unnamed gone low into the back room before first grey, parted dusty from clean forearms as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel before any person and told a pot \emph{You’ll do}, withheld the full note he knew three turns ahead from any High Kiln master, put his bent finger into the cold iron ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence and did not leave the extra interval of Ash 26 a second time, \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn; in the small hours the whole file came out on the towel at the head of the bed as instruments come out on a towel and was checked and left as it lay, \textbf{three hundred honest answers standing on the sixth place, each an object and not a power and not one standing up and calling itself a doctrine}, six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty, the heard bell four, four and a gap in its square, nine hands with no tenth, nine stoppings with no tenth and the loan uncalled, five held objects with the pot-crack resting beside them, the hand-at-the-sill breath beside that and the Ash 26 holding beside all, the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the well-saying at four shapings, the row at five askings, the Ash 5 joining, the Ash 17 direction and the Ash 23 direction held apart, nine arithmetics behind one unsigned figure with all three Ash subtractions locked in Berr Clay’s box up the clay road, the finding on a place of its own with no payer, and the river’s winter skin on its own place beside water over water, not a fourth covering, not a sixth low thing, not a hearing and not spent on any date; the three counts in three places did not become one and attention was the whole spend, and the hand went up an inch toward the note under its skin, took a small intake, held the interval whole on the note’s own finishing under the ice, came straight down and laid itself back against the fold --- answer 300, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, three hundred a round number nobody under any roof speaks or marks, Stone 3 done and the deep-winter month held, forward, not closed.}

in the afternoon Sella carried him down at the half-pace and went wide around the seven places, widest by the width of a step at the returning-line place where she did not go around twice to make a figure of it, the boy keeping the wide step as a keeping and not a sign for no payer stood under that ground, the three coverings staying weather with a finger between every pair and no fourth likeness made a cause, the river’s skin found where put and not spent, the dressed grain covered and unfigured, her empty fingers a keeping beside the one object of Bone 22 and not a second handful, the hare, cracked jar, kindling and mending going as directions with Tarn saying \emph{Yes, house} to early and late thaw and keeping the late (T083/T085, T077, T009/T013/T092, T098); at the kindling Tarn kept six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, knife at the edge of its sill, hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, the Ash 14 breath and Bone 26 thumb found where put and not made again, the ear-sentence brought to the word that would call the loan and stopped as the ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled, chest tight, Ash worked into the knuckles, pale clip-ring giving back the little light, stroke over the flagstones without the half-check (T036/T076/T006); Jorra came off the wheel-shed with dust white in a fist-crease, three or more men unnamed gone low into the back room before first grey, dusty and clean forearms parted as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel before any person, told a pot \emph{You’ll do}, withheld the full note three turns ahead, put his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, one iron with two bites, and took it out without leaving the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time, the promise ungiven and \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed, no voice coming over the boards to repeat the Ash 5 joining, Ash 17 direction or Ash 23 direction or supply a sixth telling, third telling, sixth asking, fifth shaping, witness or name (T062/T035/T031, T035/T031/T065/T095, T101 held); she carried him up the nineteen steps at the going of the light, set him on his bed under the roof and never in the Debt Loft, righted the fold without a look at his face, let her hand rest the half-beat longer than the setting needed, left the thread frozen and unwiped and said nothing of where they had been; in the small hours the surgeon took his small clean satisfaction in a field taken as found and left as found and it cost him nothing, which was how he knew it was not the same as peace, the infant’s louder want underneath with both true, neither winning; the whole file came out on the towel as instruments come out and was gone over by the place of each thing, and the hand went up an inch toward the river’s note, took a small intake, held the interval whole on the note’s own finishing under the ice, came straight down and laid itself back against the fold as a man puts away a tool --- answer 312, exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across none of the held objects, three hundred and twelve honest answers standing on the sixth place, each an object and not a power and not one standing up and calling itself a doctrine; three hundred and sixty-eight stood exact, six months and one hundred and eighty-eight days told by nobody, a whole year finished and named by no roof, one morning between it and Stone 10, the boards overhead keeping four nails on the near one, four on the next and a thumb-width knot where a fifth might have been driven and was not, the crust keeping its hair-lifted corner and its empty place unnamed and no third; forward, not closed.}
\CRday{Day 369}{Stone 10, Tenthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel in the small hours, then down the nineteen steps to the Cross, the reading block under the moot-post and the moot-post’s finger’s width of shade, the pot board and the out-of-line landing below the north bridge, up the clay road toward Greybank, and in the afternoon the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the Vail corner with its thaw, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the gone pan’s round ring, the yard well with its stiff rope, skinned trough and silt-clouded plate on the flat stone, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the worked strips with the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling with the knife at its sill, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (three or more men unnamed gone low before first grey), the cold damper, the finger’s-width door and the river under its skin, the Debt Loft (heard only), Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the deep-winter month’s first Account-day and market came on like water over a stone and the district’s arithmetic changed for the tenth time where two hundred people stood, Sella setting the basket in the moot-post’s finger’s width of shade where no slate lay and standing half a pace off through the reading and the bell with his cheek against the post’s cold iron, Berr Clay coming up short off the clay road with the red cord folded under his coat, the sweet green of tasted glaze at one mouth-corner and the smell of nothing at all, wiping his thumb twice, passing a finger over the figure through his sleeve, reading one in twelve twice over the basket once for the moot and once for the late households, calling the levy and denying it with your house never I as a surgeon draws a hand from a field before the dressing, saying something low to the block about kindness entered, and going off with the box locked and Stone’s first true subtraction inside beside the three of Frost and the first, second and third of Bone and Ash so that ten arithmetics stood behind one printed figure with the figure read still not the figure paid and no doctrine out of ten; Hessa taking the slate up toward Greybank before noon edge-on with the writing turned to her sleeve and answering I don’t read it. I carry it and Cross to Greybank. Reading goes up before noon. I’ve got a road to walk with no figure coming off the slate, her reaching the eighth record-first hand with no tenth; the soft-cuffed clerk staying at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called as the market sold over him, a silent woman at the pot board turning a cup a quarter and a small shape in cast-offs catching light on a green sliver and going dull, each a seventh with no eighth, unnamed and unjoined, never Fenna and never Ulda; eight pigs going over the wet boards with nobody counting them aloud, the bell going four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself, the heard bell staying in its square beside the told, six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty; the count going 368 to 369 exact, six months and 188 days becoming 189 told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the widow’s mark untouched because a market and a reading are not openings and no eighth made due, the river’s winter skin found where put and not spent on the Account-day, no ownerless voice coming over the boards and the Ash 5 joining and the Ash 17 and Ash 23 directions standing where put; the hand outside the wool coming up an inch on the bell’s finishing under the morning and laying itself flat on answer 313 in the morning and, after the afternoon’s hare, cracked jar, kindling and fence-mending as directions, the seven walked-around places gone around widest at the returning-line place, the grain unfigured and no handful, Tarn’s six and seventh and stopped ear-sentence, Jorra’s dust, two bites of iron and ungiven promise, the twice-mended pot’s hairline and both proverbs to pot and fire, and the surgeon’s small clean satisfaction costing nothing, coming straight down on answer 314 at the close, each exact, worth nothing at two inches of air and laid across none of the kept things; forward, not closed.}
\CRday{Day 370}{Stone 11, Firstday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel in the small hours and again at the close, up and down the nineteen steps, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the Vail corner and its thaw, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the gone pan’s round ring, Ilva at the yard well with an open slate a pace away, the trough skinned over and the silt-clouded plate of ice on the flat stone, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the worked strips with the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling with the knife at its sill, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (three or more men unnamed gone low before first grey), the cold damper, the finger’s-width door and the river under its skin, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road and Cold Acre as directions, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the eleventh came on an ordinary Firstday with no market, Cross, bell, runner or collector and nothing due at any post, the tenth reading standing behind the household and not crossing as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, the count going 369 to 370 exact and six months and 189 days becoming 190 told by nobody who would know what a number counted, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid and Garl’s name unspoken 370 days, the body inventoried in the surgeon’s old order by the small sounds first with crust two inches off and its corner hair-lifted, empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon’s knowing checked by the infant’s louder want with both true, the second louder, neither winning; Sella going to the hearth before the basket, telling the coals it was the thaw, turning them with a broken pot’s back, saying The house will keep it where another woman would say I, carrying him down and up at the half-pace with the instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire never to the basket, the twice-mended pot up thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure and no handful, the charcoal unread beneath her finger on top of the shelf, the widow’s mark untouched at a well and a yard because neither was an opening and no eighth was made due; at the yard well Ilva drew with the pail against her knee and the rope stiff in the cold giving its small dry rasp, clay pale in her nail crescents and grey rack dust in one thumb seam she did not scrub out, and to the woman who asked what Stone’s firings had taken her hand went toward her sleeve before her eyes went to the asker and her mouth opened after both with a half-beat in the gap, the notched strip of birch not taken out, read, copied, counted or joined to the open slate a pace away, to the charcoal beneath the shelf, to the cord, to the knot-string or to any saying that arrived nowhere, no figure coming off the wood, answering the question put and not the one behind it: Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account, then putting her flat hand once more on the sleeve and going back to the pail with nobody turning twice; the boy taking the order of her reaching apart as a surgeon takes a field apart and filing it as the ninth record-first hand on a place of its own with a finger between it and Hessa Rale’s eighth, filing no tenth, making no reader of her keeping and joining her to none, she being expressly not the speaker of any voice, no fifth shaping of the Frost 14 well-saying, no sixth asking of the row, no third telling of the shut room and no witness standing, the far-off hand that will lay the private keepings together still far off and not his; the arithmetics standing behind one unsigned figure up the clay road with no eleventh brought into a morning that had not earned one; in the afternoon the yard going around its seven places widest around the returning-line place, the three coverings staying weather entered nowhere, the river’s skin found where put and not spent on the Drawing one morning ahead, the hare, cracked jar, kindling and fence-mending going as directions with Tarn saying Yes, house to the early thaw and the late and keeping the late, six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged sentence, the Ash 14 breath and Bone 26 thumb found where put and not made again, the ear-sentence stopped at the word that would call the loan as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, chest tight since the dark, Ash in the knuckle creases, pale clip-ring at the left wrist and stroke over the bright patch without the half-check, Jorra coming off the wheel-shed with dust white in a fist-crease, men unnamed low in the back room, dusty forearms parted from clean as clot from vessel, the wheel spoken to before any person and a pot told You’ll do, the full note three turns ahead withheld from any High Kiln master, the bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence with one iron’s two bites and no second holding of Ash 26, he’s not Vail sealed and the promise ungiven; no ownerless voice over the boards and the Ash 5 joining, Ash 17 direction and Ash 23 direction standing where put; the hand outside the wool coming up an inch on the river’s note under the ice and laying itself flat on answer 315 in the small hours of the morning and again on answer 316 at the close, each exact, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment, the file open on the towel with every gap left gap and no sixth hearing, seventh opening, sixth held object, tenth hand or tenth stopping supplied to make a row come out even; forward, not closed.}
\CRday{Day 371}{Stone 12, Secondday, Y.H. 813, the Hearth Drawing  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel in the small hours and again at the close, then the Drawing house two doors down the Clay Yard with its bench by the door, pot on the bench, draught under the bench going along the floor to the corner, the drawing pallet against the far wall and the folded quilt on the other side of the hearth, seen only from a basket at the edge of the light, then the Clay Yard and its seven walked-around places with the Vail corner and its thaw, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the gone pan’s round ring, the yard well with its stiff rope, skinned trough and silt-clouded plate, the kindling, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room, the cold damper, the finger’s-width door and the river under its skin, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the Drawing stood on its own morning and earned its own telling, the count going 370 to 371 exact, six months and one hundred and ninety-one days told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the body inventoried in the surgeon’s old order with the crust hair-lifted two inches off and its empty place unnamed, thread frozen and unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon’s knowing and the infant’s wanting both true, the second louder, neither winning; Sella going to the hearth before the basket, telling the coals it was the thaw and saying The house will keep it, carrying him to the Drawing house and setting the basket at the edge of the light where he could see and not join, level and out of the draught, standing half a pace off with her hands gone still, her hand not going to the widow’s mark because a Drawing was not an opening and no eighth was made due; from the basket only, a cuff soft from washing and folded back twice, a flat leather satchel, a cold iron tube coming out of a roll of wool, fingertips grey the colour of skimmed milk gone off, a hand to the slate before the eyes to the bed, the collector finding the way in the neighbour’s forearm by touch and holding the tube without pressing and without hurry, saying once to the slate The measure is banked. The account stands. The return is recorded in an ordinary hand with no pause in it, filed on a place of its own and joined neither to the neat dark hand, to Marra, to the Court-table clerk nor to the soft-cuffed clerk, no tenth standing up in the empty place, the reason in the way he held the iron --- that he believed he kept the world alive by taking what was already going --- being the part that would be remembered against him, no name and no interior given; the neighbour on the board-bed giving under the tube with a small flat knock and a pale round place left on the arm, not a wound and no blood, the boy not making the knock a seventh hearing because a hearing wants a source standing and that room was seen from a basket and not entered, six hearings standing beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the knock on its own place outside them; on the other side of the hearth a child three days out of a thin return worse on the third day, grey at the fingertips finer than the collector’s and red at the hairline, more colour in the face which the room took for the turn and called a graft settling, the surgeon reading the afterdrop waiting on the far side of a warming that must be slow and from the outside, extremity before core and pink returning as the surface still cold and not the core, knowing he could not speak, reach, warm or say leave it or warm it slowly; the mother holding a cup of warm milk she never drank and asking Will he know me if he comes through?, a death-house woman answering A child knows warmth before it knows a face and an older one Warmth goes in slow. You can’t hurry a graft. My mother knew it and her mother knew it, the room correcting him without knowing he had spoken, nobody setting the pot nearer the fire, nobody rubbing the small cold hands, nobody saying what the red mark meant and the boy supplying none; a bench and pot by the door, a draught going along the floor to the corner, the room’s nails four and four and a thumb-width knot, and a place in the figures where a line should have stood and did not every time the room was read, the boy setting the room on a place of its own beside the birth room in House Silt, the Vail kiln-house and the room where the slate was read on market-day with a finger between every pair, four likenesses and not one account, an account wanting a hand to lay them together and a payer under all four and none standing, joining it to none of the Greybank saying, the shut counting room, the burned slate of Slate Row or the Ash 5, 17 and 23 directions, supplying no sixth telling, third telling, witness, name, room, hand, figure or payer; Sella carrying him home at the going of the light at the half-pace and saying nothing of where they had been or of the room, the tube, the child or the cup; under the roof the hearth grammar renewed in full with the widow’s mark oiled and untouched, the twice-mended pot’s hairline showing with both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain covered and unfigured with no handful, the twice-wiped thumb only in memory of the morning, Tarn’s six and seventh and checked keepings with the loan uncalled, Jorra’s dust, two bites of iron and Ash 26 not repeated, he’s not Vail sealed and the promise under the wheel-shed neither given nor withdrawn, the river’s winter skin found where put and not spent, three counts in three places not becoming one, the bell’s gap in its square, ten readings behind one unsigned figure with no signature and no doctrine out of ten; the hand outside the wool coming up an inch on the river’s note, holding the interval whole on the note’s own finishing under the winter skin, coming straight down and laying itself flat on answer 317 at the going of the light and again on answer 318 at the close, each exact, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment laid across neither the ten readings, the bell’s gap, the flat knock, the child’s grey fingertips, the mother’s cup, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb’s resting, the held breath at the sill, the two bites of iron, the river’s skin, the widow’s mark nor his own kept gaps, three hundred and eighteen honest answers standing on the sixth place and not one a doctrine, the boards overhead keeping four nails and a knot and the floor four pulls and a silence, the Drawing behind the household with no lesson made of it; forward, not closed.}
\CRday{Day 372}{Stone 13, Thirdday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel in the small hours, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the Vail corner with its clean dark line and finer grey called the thaw, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the gone pan’s round ring, Ilva at the yard well with an open slate a pace away, the trough skinned over and the silt-clouded plate of ice on the flat stone, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the worked strips with the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling with the knife at its sill, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (three or more men unnamed gone low before first grey), the cold damper, the finger’s-width door and the river under its skin, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road and Cold Acre as directions, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the first ordinary tending day after the Hearth Drawing came with nothing from Stone 10, 11 or 12 crossing as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, the count going 371 to 372 exact, six months and 191 days becoming 192 told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the body inventoried in the surgeon’s old order with the leathery crust hair-lifted two inches off and its empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon’s knowing checked by the infant’s louder want with both true and neither winning; Sella going to the hearth before the basket, telling the coals it was the thaw, turning them with a broken pot’s back, saying The house will keep it, the twice-mended pot up thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure and no handful, charcoal unread beneath her finger on top of the shelf, widow’s mark untouched because a morning and a hearth are not openings and no eighth made due, the pot rim set two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed; Ilva at the well with clay pale in her nail crescents and rack dust in one thumb seam unscrubbed, her hand to her sleeve before her eyes to the asker and her mouth after both, the notched birch strip not taken out, read or joined to the open slate or the charcoal, answering the question put and not the one behind it: Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account, filed as the ninth record-first hand with a finger between it and Hessa Rale’s eighth and no tenth, expressly not the speaker of any voice; the yard going around its seven places widest around the returning-line place and once and not twice, the three coverings weather entered nowhere and the river’s skin found where put and not spent, the hare, cracked jar, kindling and fence-mending going as directions with Tarn saying Yes, house to the early thaw and the late and keeping the late, six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged sentence, the Ash 14 sill-breath and Bone 26 thumb found where put and not made again, chest tight, Ash worked into the knuckles, pale clip-ring catching the light, ear-sentence stopped at the word that would call the loan as a ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, Seed 16 breath unspent and loan uncalled; Jorra coming off the wheel-shed with dust white in a fist-crease, men unnamed low in the back room, dusty and clean forearms parted as clot from vessel, the wheel spoken to before any person and a pot told You’ll do, the full note three turns ahead withheld from any High Kiln master, bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence with one iron’s two bites and no second holding of Ash 26, he’s not Vail sealed and the promise ungiven; no ownerless voice over the boards, the Ash 5 joining and the Ash 17 and Ash 23 directions standing where put and buying no lesson; the hand outside the wool coming up an inch on the river’s note under its winter skin to file answers 319 in the small hours of the morning and 320 at the close, each exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment laid across none of the kept things, the empty place beside the crust left untouched so that a later keeping would be a change and not a habit; forward, not closed.}
\CRday{Day 373}{Stone 14, Fourthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, pot board, loaf shelf, boards and towel in the small hours, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places and the clay road where it passes the yard, Hessa Rale coming down out of Greybank, then back under the roof at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the fourteenth came on an ordinary Fourthday with no market, Cross, bell, runner or collector and no ownerless voice over the boards, nothing from the thirteenth crossing as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, the count going 372 to 373 exact, six months and 192 days becoming 193, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid and Garl’s name unspoken the same number; the surgeon’s inventory renewed in the old order with a stricter rhythm, crust two inches off with its empty place unnamed and no third, thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopped at cheek, temple and wrist as at the end of a line written out for it, afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the infant’s want quarrelling with it and neither winning; Sella’s morning grammar beat for beat, hearth before basket, coals told the thaw, The house will keep it, dressed grain covered and unfigured with no handful, twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, finger on top of the shelf so the charcoal stayed unread, widow’s mark untouched because a morning and a hearth are not openings; the yard going around its seven places widest around the returning-line place, the three coverings weather entered nowhere and the river’s skin found where put beside water-over-water, not a fourth covering and not spent on any date, the empty place beside the crust left as it had been on the two mornings before: no hand, no third, no name; in the afternoon Hessa Rale came down the clay road out of Greybank with Berr Clay’s narrow slate held edge-on to her forearm, the writing turned toward her sleeve, the second strap let out for the long road and dried pale scurf of road-mud unbrushed on the skirt she had shortened, the small flat correction of the strap and the turn of the wrist coming first and her hand going to the slate before her eyes went to the yard, giving no figure, reading nothing aloud and not looking into the basket, the boy filing the turning of the writing toward herself beside the Ash 6 sighting with a finger between, no fifth shaping of the Frost 14 well-saying, no reader, no witness, no payment, her eighth record-first hand staying eight with no tenth, a sighting not a saying and nothing in the one paying the other; four rooms with the same gap in their count (the birth room, the kiln-house, the market-day slate room and the Drawing house seen two doors down) held apart with a finger between every pair, four likenesses and not one account, an account wanting a hand to lay them together and a payer under all four and none standing, advanced and not paid; six hearings with the seventh place empty and the Drawing’s flat knock outside them, ten arithmetics behind one unsigned figure and no doctrine out of ten; no sixth hearing, seventh opening, sixth held object, sixth telling, third shut-room telling, sixth asking, fifth shaping, tenth hand or tenth stopping supplied to make a row come out even, for a finding filled to make a row come out even is a finding forged; the hand outside the wool filing answers 321 in the small hours of the morning and 322 at the close, each exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment; forward, not closed.}
\CRday{Day 374}{Stone 15, Fifthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board, boards and towel in the morning and small hours, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the kindling with the knife at its sill, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (three or more men unnamed gone low before first grey), the cold damper, the finger’s-width door and the river under its skin, back under the roof at the going of the light where the fold is righted and the wool tucked into the crust’s empty place, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the fifteenth came without a boundary drawn, the deep-winter month holding both its names, by the weather with the older women and by the count of Account-days with the slatemen, neither habit set right or left, nothing from the thirteenth or fourteenth crossing as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, the count going 373 to 374 exact, six months and 193 days becoming 194 told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid and Garl’s name unspoken the same number; the surgeon took the body in its old order and let it humiliate him, crust harder and browner two inches off with its corner hair-lifted and its empty place unnamed, thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint as at the end of a written line, afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the reverse order in which heat leaves and returns known and useless, the infant’s want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle quarrelling with it, both true, the second louder, neither winning; Sella’s hearth grammar renewed, coals told the thaw, The house will keep it, twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing, dressed grain covered and unfigured with no figure and no handful, charcoal unread beneath her finger, clay jar glanced at with the hand half over nothing, widow’s mark untouched, seven openings not a rule and no eighth made due, the empty place beside the crust deliberately left untouched through the morning and held on a place of its own beside the shelf’s two gaps, the pan’s gone ring and the field’s empty place with a finger between every pair; the yard going around its seven places widest around the returning-line place, the three coverings weather entered nowhere and the river’s skin found where put beside water-over-water and not spent, Tarn keeping six and the seventh with the knife at the sill and the ear-sentence stopped at the word that would call the loan as a ninth stopping with no tenth, Jorra parting dusty from clean forearms as clot from vessel, speaking to the wheel before any person, withholding the full note three turns ahead and taking his bent finger out of the cold damper without a second holding, he’s not Vail sealed and the promise ungiven; the chapter’s one meaningful change, T097 with T060/T086 advanced and NOT paid: at the going of the light Sella set him on his bed, put the fold right at his ear and under his chin without a look at his face and tucked the wool into the empty place beside the crust, a small keeping with no word, no third crust, no name, no look and no instruction to the basket, her hand resting the half-beat longer than the setting needed before it went away, the thread left frozen and unwiped; the boy filed it on a place of its own beside the crust’s gap, the shelf’s two gaps, the pan’s gone ring and the field’s empty place, expressly not a joining of rooms, not a third crust, not a gift, not a payment, no payer, not a sixth held object, not a habit or a rule, gathered once and not made again, gathering interest toward the far-off finger that is not his; six hearings with the seventh place empty and the Drawing’s flat knock outside them, nine hands and nine stoppings with no tenth, ten arithmetics behind one unsigned figure, four rooms held apart, burned slate at five, shut-room tellings at two, row at five askings with no witness, well-saying at four shapings, nothing supplied to make a row come out even; \CRday{Day 379}{Stone 20, Tenthday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof in the dark before first light and again in the small hours, then down the nineteen steps through the Clay Yard and its seven walked-around places to the Cross, the reading block under the moot-post and the moot-post’s finger’s width of thin shade, the pot board across the square, the out-of-line landing below the north bridge, the clay road up toward High Kiln, the market’s edge, and back under the roof at the hearth, pot board, loaf shelf, bed, boards and towel, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the deep-winter month’s second Account-day and market came in the dark before first light earned by its own morning, nothing from the nineteenth crossing as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, the count going 378 to 379 exact, six months and 198 days becoming 199 told by nobody, the fire’s fifth unpaid and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the keeping found where put a fifth time and not made again, no second fold, third crust, name, gift, payment or payer (T097/T060/T086); Sella carrying him down before first light at the half-pace from every open slate with the instruction to the wool and the river wind and never to the basket, setting the basket in the moot-post’s finger’s width of shade where no slate lay, standing half a pace off through the reading and the bell and saying nothing to it, the cold iron of the reading block coming to his cheek and going away, the widow’s mark untouched because a market and a Cross are not openings (T058/T079); Berr Clay coming up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat, the sweetish green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner and the smell of nothing at all under the hot clay of him, his hands large and clean, wiping his thumb twice on his apron before touching nothing, holding a narrow slate unopened against his forearm, passing a finger over the figure through his sleeve and letting his eyes rest on the writing a breath longer than the writing required, reading One in twelve, as the notice says low into the goers-by and sending the figure twice over the basket, once for the moot and once for the late households, calling the levy and denying it with The levy is called. It is not called by me, Your house wants it again, there’ll be a slate at the watch and If your household has heard otherwise, your household has heard wrong — your house, never I, taking himself out of his own sentence as a surgeon draws a hand from a field before the dressing goes on, saying something low to the block about kindness being entered to which the block answered nothing, and going off up the clay road with the box locked and Stone’s second true subtraction inside beside the three of Frost and the first, second and third of Bone and Ash, believing he had done a kindness with no anger and no triumph, the twice-wiped thumb filed on a tray of its own and joined to none; \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T015/T041/T047):} eleven arithmetics now stand behind one unsigned figure — the three of Frost, the first, second and third of Bone, the first, second and third of Ash, Stone’s first and Stone’s second — eleven are eleven and not one account, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space and no doctrine out of eleven, the finding on a place of its own with a finger between and not a grievance, sign, power, lesson or payment, the eleven true subtractions riding locked up the clay road with the key gone up in a coat pocket that does not come back down and the boy having no key, the dressed grain read over by a number that did not know what it cost, the two hundred leaning in and going back to the pigs with figures and fists no slate could enter, and nothing answering for the hand that went in on Seed 15, the man carried out on Day 188 or the carried fire’s missing fifth; the bell going four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself, the heard bell kept in its square beside the told and not made a seventh hearing, six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the Drawing’s flat knock outside; Hessa Rale taking Berr’s narrow slate up the clay road before noon edge-on to her forearm with the writing turned to her sleeve, the thumb along the grain of the frame, the second strap let out and dried pale scurf of road-mud unbrushed on the shortened skirt, her hand to the slate before her eyes to the crowd, telling the woman who asked what she carried A slate. I don’t read it. I carry it. There’s a difference, and the road doesn’t care which and the woman who wanted more Ask the road. It knows the way and I know the weight. That’s the whole of what either of us knows, filing the turning of the writing toward herself beside the Ash 6 sighting with a finger between, no fifth shaping, no witness, no reader, no payment, her eighth staying eight (T080); the soft-cuffed Fishstairs clerk set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called, the market selling over him as water over a stone, the silent woman with clay under her nails and the sweetish green at one mouth-corner turning a cup a quarter and setting it back where it stood and a small shape in cast-offs catching the light on a green sliver and going dull — a seventh green and a seventh shape with no eighth, unnamed, never Fenna and never Ulda, joined to no ear, hearing, cause or romance (T050/T051, T033/T034); four rooms keeping the same gap held apart with a finger between every pair, four likenesses and not one account, the keeping at the fold sitting beside them and not laid across any; Sella carrying him home at the going of the light and saying nothing of what was read over the basket, putting the fold right at his ear and under his chin with no second fold, renewing the hearth grammar, the widow’s mark untouched and the carried fire’s four pulls with the fifth missing; answers 333 and 334 filed exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, no ownerless voice over the boards, the Ash 5 joining, the Ash 17 direction and the Ash 23 direction standing where put and not repeating and buying no lesson, and Stone keeping its twentieth day without a boundary drawn while the month held both its names.}

eleven arithmetics behind one unsigned figure with the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space and no doctrine out of eleven, their eleven true subtractions locked in Berr’s box up the road, six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the Drawing’s flat knock outside, the heard bell four, four and a gap beside the told, nine record-first hands and nine stoppings with no tenth, the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings with no witness, the well-saying at four shapings, four rooms with the same gap held apart, and no sixth hearing, seventh opening, sixth held object, sixth telling, third shut-room telling, sixth asking, fifth shaping, tenth hand, tenth stopping or twelfth arithmetic supplied to make a row come out even, for a finding filled to make a row come out even is a finding forged; answers 335 and 336 filed exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment, the surgeon’s small clean satisfaction in a field taken as found and left as found costing nothing which was how he knew it was not peace, the infant’s want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle still louder and neither verdict given; no ownerless voice over the boards and the Ash 5 joining, the Ash 17 direction and the Ash 23 direction standing where put and not repeating, and Stone keeping its nineteenth, twentieth and twenty-first days without a boundary drawn, the month holding both its names with neither set right or left in so many words, and the count going on under the roof in Low Kiln, Sill, Grath.}
\CRday{Day 381}{Stone 22, Secondday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, kiln mouth behind its wall, boards and towel in the small hours, then the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the Vail corner with its clean dark line and finer grey called the thaw, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the gone pan’s round ring, the yard well where Ilva drew with the pail against her knee and an open slate a pace away, the skinned trough and the silt-clouded plate of ice on the flat stone, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the worked strips with the field’s empty place and the returning-line place where the yard went widest, the kindling with the knife at its sill, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (three or more men unnamed gone low before first grey), the cold damper, the finger’s-width door and the river under its winter skin, the Debt Loft (heard only), and the clay road and Cold Acre as directions, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the twenty-second came in the last full working week before the year’s last reading with nothing from Stone 19, 20 or 21 crossing as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, the count going 380 to 381 exact, six months and 200 days becoming 201 told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the body taken in the surgeon’s old order with the crust gone harder and browner in the dry heat, its corner a hair off the wool, thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon’s knowing that a face composed by cold is not composure checked by the infant’s louder want with both true, the second louder, neither winning and the quarrel the work (T060/T086); the keeping found where put a seventh time before the light and at the going of the light, changed by nobody, with no second fold, third crust, name, gift, payment or payer, seven findings from a hand that only read adding no seventh placing, a habit wanting a hand that placed twice and a way a third and both a payer where none stood, filed on a place of its own beside the crust’s gap, the shelf’s two gaps, the gone pan’s round ring and the field’s empty place, not a joining of rooms, not a sixth held object, not a sign, hearing, mending, cause or rule and not laid across the eleven readings or the four rooms’ gap, the far-off finger still far off, not his and not come (T097/T060/T086 advanced and NOT paid); Sella’s grammar beat for beat at both ends of the day, fire before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with a broken pot’s back, The house will keep it, small intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, charcoal unread beneath her finger on top of the shelf, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, the twice-mended pot up thumb-first with the hairline showing between old-brass staple and tighter wire and both proverbs to pot and fire, dressed grain turned under wool with no figure and no handful, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, widow’s mark untouched because a morning and a hearth are not openings and seven openings in seven months are not a rule; Ilva at the well with clay pale in her nail crescents and rack dust in a thumb seam unscrubbed, her hand to her sleeve before her eyes to the asker and her mouth after both, the notched birch strip not taken out, read, copied or joined to the open slate or the charcoal, answering Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account as the ninth record-first hand with a finger between it and Hessa Rale’s eighth and no tenth, expressly not the speaker of any voice (T080); the yard going around its seven places with a look and a wide step and no number, widest around the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, once and not twice because a second going-around would make a figure of once and a figure wants a payer standing under it, the three coverings weather entered nowhere and the river’s skin found where put and not spent on the week’s work (T009/T013/T092, T098, T083/T085); the walk-ons bringing directions and never figures, the Cold Acre hare-carrier answering the price with the weather, the cracked-jar man told to ask the pot which said nothing, to the kindling woman and the fence-menders saying the thaw would be early and late Tarn saying Yes, house to each and keeping the late; Tarn at the kindling keeping six in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, Six counted. The next I don’t count, the Ash 14 held breath and Bone 26 thumb’s resting found where put and not made again, ear-sentence stopped at the word that would call the loan as a ninth stopping with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end, Seed 16 breath unspent and loan uncalled, chest tight since the dark, Ash in the knuckle creases, pale clip-ring catching the light, stroke over the bright flagstone patch without the half-check; Jorra through the finger’s-width door with meal-fine grey dust white in a fist-crease, three or more men unnamed gone low into the back room before first grey, dusty and clean forearms parted as clot from vessel, speaking to the wheel before any person and telling a pot You’ll do, knowing the full note three turns ahead and withholding it from any High Kiln master, bent finger into the cold iron of the damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence and out again without the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time, He’s not Vail sealed and the promise ungiven (T062/T035/T031); eleven arithmetics behind one unsigned figure with the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space and no doctrine out of eleven, six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the Drawing’s flat knock outside, the heard bell four, four and a gap beside the told, no ownerless voice over the boards and the Ash 5 joining and the Ash 17 and Ash 23 directions standing where put, answers 337 and 338 filed exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, the surgeon’s satisfaction in a field found as left and left as found costing nothing which was how he knew it was not peace; forward, not closed.}
\CRday{Day 382}{Stone 23, Thirdday, Y.H. 813  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, hearth, pot board, kiln mouth, boards and towel in the small hours and again at the close, the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the boards where a word came with nobody standing under it, the clay road going up out of Low Kiln where Hessa Rale passed before noon, the yard well, the trough and the silt-clouded plate of ice, the drying racks with the dressed grain under wool, the worked strips and the returning-line place, the kindling with the knife at its sill, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and its finger’s-width-open back room (three or more men unnamed gone low before first grey), the cold damper, the finger’s-width door and the river under its winter skin, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the twenty-third came on an ordinary Thirdday with no market, Cross, bell, collector or ownerless voice in the morning, nothing from the twenty-second crossing as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, the count going 381 to 382 exact, six months and 201 days becoming 202 told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the surgeon’s inventory renewed in the old order with the crust hardened another night two inches off with its corner a hair off the wool, thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and wrist, afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the knowing that a basket set level out of the draught is the careful rewarming he would choose checked by the infant’s louder want with neither winning (T060/T086); Sella’s morning grammar beat for beat, hearth before basket, coals told the thaw, The house will keep it, dressed grain covered and unfigured with no handful, twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, charcoal unread, clay jar glanced at with the hand half over nothing, widow’s mark untouched; before noon Hessa Rale went up the clay road toward Greybank with Berr Clay’s narrow slate edge-on to her forearm and the writing turned toward her sleeve, thumb along the grain of the frame, second strap let out, dried pale road-mud scurf unbrushed, her hand to the slate before her eyes to the yard, telling the woman who asked I don’t read it. I carry it. There’s a difference, and the road doesn’t care which and the woman who wanted more Ask the road. It knows the way and I know the weight. That’s the whole of what either of us knows, filing the turning beside the Ash 6 sighting with a finger between, no fifth shaping, no reader, no witness, no payment, her eighth staying eight and no tenth (T080); \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change, advanced and NOT paid (T035/T031/T065/T095 and T101):} in the afternoon a fourth ownerless direction came over the boards from the direction of Slate Row with no owner standing anywhere, spoken over the boards and not into any basket on the same breath as the price of barley and the weather, saying a room had been shut against the cold and a slate burned so a count would not go up and that the cold and the count had gone out through the same gap, with no room named, no hand at any flame, no figure, no date, no person named and nobody standing to be asked, and the boy opened it as a surgeon opens a wound by what was there and by what was not and filed it on a place of its own beside the Ash 5 joining and the Ash 17 and Ash 23 directions with a finger between every pair, expressly not a sixth telling of the burned slate (which stands at five), not a third telling of the shut room (which stands at two), not a fifth shaping of the Frost 14 well-saying (which stands at four), not a sixth asking of the row (which stands at five with no witness), not a hearing, not a seventh, not a witness, not a cause, not a confession, not a reader, not a joining to Jorra’s promise or to the keeping at the fold, not a payment and not a rule, for a rule is an account that has found a payer and none stood, gathering interest toward the far-off hand that will lay the district’s private keepings together and call the joining an account, a hand not his and not come; the yard went around its seven places widest around the returning-line place once and not twice, the three coverings weather entered nowhere and the river’s skin found where put, the walk-ons bringing directions and never figures; Tarn keeping six and the seventh with the knife at the sill edge and his hand up and away without the breath held at the top of the reach, Six counted. The next I don’t count, the Ash 14 breath and Bone 26 thumb found where put and not made again, ear-sentence stopped at the calling word with the Seed 16 breath unspent and the loan uncalled, the fourth direction over the boards calling no loan and supplying no tenth stopping; Jorra with meal-fine grey dust white in a fist-crease, men unnamed low in the back room, dusty and clean forearms parted as clot from vessel, speaking to the wheel before any person and telling a pot You’ll do, full note known three turns ahead and withheld, bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence and out without the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time, growing quieter after the direction over the boards with the household straightening around the quiet without an order, He’s not Vail sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn, the burned slate not made six by a voice over the boards; eleven arithmetics behind one unsigned figure, six hearings with the seventh place empty and the Drawing’s flat knock outside, heard bell four, four and a gap, answers 339 and 340 filed exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, the runner gone up the clay road with the writing turned to her own sleeve; forward, not closed.}

\CRday{Day 389}{Stone 30, Tenthday, Y.H. 813, the year’s third and last Account-day and market  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof in the dark before first light and again in the small hours at the year’s close, then down the nineteen steps through the Clay Yard’s seven walked-around places, widest around the returning-line place, to the Cross, the reading block under the moot-post and the moot-post’s finger’s width of shade where no slate lay, the pot board across the square with eight pigs going over the wet boards and a Sill assessor writing them down, the road up toward High Kiln, the north bridge and the out-of-line landing below it, the market’s edge, and back under the Vail roof at the hearth, pot board, loaf shelf, bed, boards and towel, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the thirtieth came in the dark before first light earned by its own morning, the year’s third and last Account-day and market with a slate read under the moot-post and a bell, nothing from the twenty-eighth or twenty-ninth crossing under the roof as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, the count going 388 to 389 exact, six months and 208 days becoming 209 told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid and Garl’s name unspoken 389 days with their payer and their man unnamed, the body taken in the surgeon’s old order with crust, gap, frozen thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and wrist and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon’s knowing that a basket set level out of the draught is the rewarming he would choose and cannot ask for checked by the infant’s louder want with both true, neither winning (T060/T086); Sella going to the hearth before the basket, telling the coals it was the thaw, saying \emph{The house will keep it}, neither gap figured, charcoal unread beneath her finger on the shelf’s top edge, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing, market and going of the light and bed not openings and no eighth made due (T058/T079/T100), carrying him down before first light at the half-pace from every open slate, setting the basket in the moot-post’s finger’s width of shade and standing half a pace off through the reading and the bell with no instruction and no reason to the basket, and carrying him home at the going of the light saying nothing of what had been read over the wicker, fold right at ear and chin with no second fold; \textbf{Berr Clay came up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat, the sweetish green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner and the smell of nothing at all under the hot clay of him, wiped his thumb twice before touching nothing, held a narrow slate unopened to his forearm, passed a finger over the figure through his sleeve, read *One in twelve, as the notice says* low into the goers-by and sent the figure twice over the basket, once for the moot and once for the late households, called the levy and denied it with *your house*, never I, taking himself out of his own sentence as a surgeon draws a hand from a field before the dressing goes on, said something low to the block about kindness being entered, and went off up the road with the cord folded, the slate under his arm and the box locked, Stone’s last true subtraction riding inside beside the eleven before it, believing he had done a kindness with no anger and no triumph — the belief that will one day be remembered against him (T015/T041/T047 advanced and NOT paid)}; the boy filing the \textbf{twelve arithmetics} — the three of Frost, the first, second and third of Bone, the first, second and third of Ash, and Stone’s first, second and last — twelve and not one account, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space and no doctrine out of twelve, twelve true subtractions locked in Berr’s box with the key gone up in a coat pocket that does not come back down and the boy having no key, not laid across the keeping at the fold, the four rooms’ gap, the four directions or any of his own gaps, and the hand that would lay them together and the payer under them not standing; Berr’s order of reaching filed on a tray of its own beside the other record-first hands with no tenth; bell four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself, its gap kept beside the told and not folded in (T078); Hessa Rale up the road toward Greybank before noon with the narrow slate edge-on to her forearm and the writing turned to her sleeve, \emph{I don’t read it. I carry it} and \emph{Ask the road}, her eighth staying eight and no figure coming off the face of it (T080 held); the soft-cuffed clerk set at the out-of-line landing for a measure nobody called with the market selling over him as water over a stone (T090 held), a silent woman with the sweetish green of lead glaze at the pot board turning a cup a quarter and a small shape in cast-offs at the market’s edge, a seventh colour and a seventh shape with no eighth, unnamed, never Fenna or Ulda, joined to no loaf, slate, sale, hearing or cause (T050/T051, T033/T034 held); the dressed grain covered under wool read over by a figure that did not know its cost (T077); answers 353 and 354 filed exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, Stone keeping its thirtieth day without a boundary drawn, the deep-winter month holding both names neither set right nor left, the year going out as it came in without a line across it, twelve readings standing behind one unsigned figure and nothing under the roof standing up and calling itself an account, the surgeon’s only victory a refusal that cost him nothing, the infant getting none of the three wants, the loan uncalled at the very end of the seventh year, Jorra’s promise neither given nor withdrawn, the cold foot uncured and the second chill’s cause withheld, the Five standing beyond and not brought in, and the count going on under the roof in Low Kiln, Sill, Grath, forward, not closed.}
