\textbf{the year’s fire came up the Clay Yard in a clay dish passed from hearth to hearth in the dark, a woman at one door and a man at the next and a girl further down each saying their house had kept the flame and nobody saying where it had first been lit or what it had cost, the coal tipping under the back of a broken pot at the kiln mouth with no hand under this roof making an opening of it, the boy taking each saying as a thing said and not a source standing and the fire that warmed the house having no name on its giver, kept as a finding and not a cause (T088 advanced toward the far-off naming of the Hearth as a wound)}; in the room two doors down the boy set at the edge of the light to see and not join with Sella standing half a pace off and giving the basket no instruction, \textbf{the collector coming in out of the cold with a flat leather satchel, a cuff soft from washing folded back twice with the grey of the wash worked into the wrist seam, a cold iron tube grey where the light touched it and darker where his fingers had it and fingertips the colour of skimmed milk gone off, his hand going to the slate before his eyes went to the bed and his mouth after both, saying once low to the slate *The measure is banked. The account stands. The return is recorded* in an ordinary writing hand with no pause, catch or small check from first word to last, the boy filing the order on a tray of its own with a finger between it and the neat dark hand, Hessa Rale’s eighth, Ilva’s ninth, Berr Clay’s twice-wiped thumb, the soft-cuffed clerk’s inward slate and the Drawing collector’s ordinary hand, expressly not Marra, not the Court-table clerk, not the Fishstairs clerk and not the Drawing collector, no tenth hand standing up in the empty place, and the man going away believing he keeps the world alive by taking what is already going — the belief, not anger or triumph, that will one day be remembered against him (T080/T090 advanced, NOT paid)}; the neighbour under the tube giving a small sound low in the throat and showing a pale round place on her arm, not a wound and no blood, covered with her sleeve and written on no tray, expressly not a seventh hearing with the six standing beside and never among and the seventh place empty (T061/T082); twelve arithmetics standing behind one unsigned figure with no thirteenth brought into a holy day, the burned-slate word at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings with no witness, the well-saying at four shapings, the heard bell beside the told with neither gap folded into the fire’s four and a gap, the Drawing’s flat knock outside the hearings, four rooms with the same gap held apart, the Ash 5 joining and the Ash 17, Ash 23 and Stone 23 directions standing where put and not repeating and buying no lesson (T035/T031/T065/T095/T101 held), no ownerless voice coming over the boards; the keeping in the crust’s empty place found where put and still a finding with no second fold, no third crust, no name and no payer, the far-off finger that would lay shelf and fold together still far off, not his and not come (T097/T060/T086); answers 355 and 356 filed exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, the surgeon’s satisfaction in a field taken as found and left as found cost nothing and was not peace, the infant getting none of the three wants, Tarn’s loan uncalled and Jorra’s promise ungiven, the cold foot uncured and the second chill’s cause withheld, and the count going on under the roof in Low Kiln, Sill, Grath, forward, not closed.}
\CRday{Day 391}{Weighing, Y.H. 813, the second of the Five  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board, loaf shelf, boards and towel in the small hours, the finger’s-width door and the river under its winter skin, then the nineteen steps down into the Clay Yard and up the path from the reading, the yard well, the flat stone with the silt-clouded plate, the skinned trough, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the gone pan’s round ring, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the worked strips with the field’s empty place and the returning-line place, the kindling with the knife at its sill and six pieces in the worn thumb-mark, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge, the back room and the cold damper, the pot board and the bed under the roof at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the second of the Five came the way weather comes, a day with a name and no tend-day and no market and no boundary drawn, the Kindling measure staying on its own tray with a finger between it and the reading and buying no lesson here, nothing from Kindling crossing under the roof as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, the count going 390 to 391 exact, six months and 210 days becoming 211 told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid and Garl’s name unspoken 391 days, the body taken again in its old order of leathery crust, fold found where put, frozen thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and wrist and the afterdrop waiting, the surgeon’s knowing checked by the infant’s louder want with both true and neither winning (T071/T072, T088, T060/T086); Sella going to the hearth before the basket, telling the coals it was the thaw, saying \emph{The house will keep it}, counting intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, charcoal unread, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing, the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, the dressed grain turned under wool with no figure or handful, the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat, and the widow’s mark untouched, no eighth made due on a holy day (T058/T079/T100); \textbf{the word of the reading came up the yard in the middle of the morning not as news or command but as a voice people had been holding in the ear and repeating without meaning to, a woman saying it to a pail, a man to a coil of rope, a girl to the dust, wearing the grammar of the Cross in a temple’s clothes, calm and clean with no gravel, haste or catch, the speaker taken neatly out of his own sentences as a surgeon draws a hand from a field before the dressing goes on, announcing a whole return for somebody absent from every room in the yard — measure kept, account squared, a person made whole again on a slate — saying the name cleanly once and going on to the next measure without saying it again, the yard taking up the grammar and leaving the space where the name had stood as a ledge keeps the round pale place where a cup stood, the household not repeating the name under this roof and the boy writing it into no file and looking toward no house, keeping the silence after it on the gap tray beside the told bell’s gap and the unfigured spaces with no payer standing and no cause written across it, not letting it stand up as a witness, a reader or a payment, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood (T080/T090 advanced, NOT paid)}; the speaker not Berr Clay, not the Sill assessor and not the Drawing collector, filed apart on a place of his own, joined neither to the Kindling collector’s ordinary hand, the neat dark hand, Hessa Rale’s turned wrist nor the four directions, no tenth hand and no reader made by being clean, the four rooms that keep the same gap — the birth room in House Silt, the Vail kiln-house, the market-day slate room and the Drawing house — staying four with a finger between every pair and no Court room brought under the roof as a fifth likeness (T081); in the afternoon the yard going around its seven walked-around places once and not twice, widest around the returning-line place, the three coverings and the river’s winter skin entered nowhere with a finger between every pair, the field keeping its empty place; \textbf{Tarn taking the broom only after Sella’s words had gone to the bristles, bent at the shoulders from six years in the slip pit with grey Ash worked into his knuckle creases in the colour of the clean dark line and the pale clip-ring at his left wrist giving back the little light, asking the weather for the hare’s price and a pot for the cracked jar’s firing and saying *Yes, house* to the kindling woman and to the fence-menders wanting the thaw early and late while keeping the late because it puts off the paying, agreeing so thoroughly that no argument found a foot; at the kindling six pieces in the worn thumb-mark where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, the small knife at the very edge of its sill, his hand passing over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, the coming away the whole of the checking, cutting nothing, counting nothing, spending nothing and saying *Six counted. The next I don’t count*, the Ash 14 held breath and the Bone 26 thumb’s resting found where put and not made again beside the five held objects and the pot-crack resting with a finger between every pair, his ear-sentence about the ear worth more than the debt brought all the way to the word that would call the loan and stopped there, a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, the Seed 16 breath unspent at the top of the reach, no look along the road, a term ending not a payment, a forgiveness or a freedom but a leaving more exposed, the fear of being entered again for vagrancy still his without a figure and unsaid, and what he wanted a slate with his own name on it and no mark against it though he thought he wanted freedom and needed a way to keep warm without being spent (T036/T076/T006, T061/T082)}; \textbf{Jorra coming through the finger’s-width door off the Vail wheel-shed with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal and white in a fist-crease, not the bone-coloured slip of the wheel, three or more men unnamed gone low into the back room before first grey with no name and no word that the room was cold from him, dusty forearms parted from clean as clot from vessel, wheel and pot spoken to before any person, the full note known three turns ahead with air and a want in it and withheld from any High Kiln master who would call it early and sing a pot before its time, his bent finger going into the cold iron of the damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence, taking the cold out of the fingertip, moving the tongue a hair’s breadth and leaving itself standing so that the end of her instruction arrived at the pot, one piece of iron with two bites, the holding and the taking, the extra holding of Ash 26 not made a second time, neither looking at the other nor saying what the iron had been asked to carry, *He’s not Vail* sealed and the promise under the wheel-shed neither given nor withdrawn (T062/T035/T031)}; the silence after Weighing’s name, Tarn’s stopped ear-sentence and Jorra’s ungiven promise checked on three separate places with a finger between every pair and not let stand up and call themselves a rule, for a rule is an account that has found a payer and none stood; answers 357 and 358 filed exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, the carrying fire fifth unpaid under the floor, the keeping still a finding, the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings with no witness, the well-saying at four shapings, nine hands and nine stoppings with no tenth, six hearings with the seventh place empty, twelve arithmetics behind one unsigned figure with no signature and no doctrine, the four directions standing where put and not repeating, the colder foot uncured and the second chill’s cause withheld, Tarn’s loan uncalled and Jorra’s promise ungiven, and the count going on under the roof in Low Kiln, Sill, Grath, forward, not closed.}
\CRday{Day 392}{the Long Night, Y.H. 813, the third of the Five  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, loaf shelf, boards and towel in the dark with no fire after dusk, the finger’s-width door and the river under its winter skin, then the nineteen steps down through the Clay Yard’s seven walked-around places and back up at the going of the light, the doorsteps, the flat stone by the well and an overturned pail outside a house whose fire had also been banked early where the neighbours sat telling the Return, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the third of the Five came as weather comes, a day with a name and no tend-day and no market and no boundary drawn, the measure taken on Kindling and the clean voice of Weighing staying behind the household and buying no teaching here, the count going 391 to 392 exact, six months and 211 days becoming 212 told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid and Garl’s name unspoken 392 days with its payer and its man unnamed (T071/T072, T088), the body taken in the surgeon’s old order of crust two inches off with its corner a hair off the wool, fold found where put and no second fold, thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, a basket set level out of the draught where the heat came sideways the rewarming he would choose and could not ask for, a face composed by cold not composure and pink returning the surface still lying over a cold core, checked by the infant’s louder want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle with both true, neither winning and the quarrel the work (T060/T086); Sella banking the fire early against the going of the light, telling the coals it was the thaw where another woman would say I, saying \emph{The house will keep it} to the pot, counting intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, her finger on top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stayed unread, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing, the twice-mended pot up thumb-first with the hairline showing between old brass and tighter wire, both proverbs to pot and fire, the dressed grain turned under wool with no figure and no handful, the pot rim set two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, carrying him down and up the nineteen steps at the half-pace from every open slate, instruction to the wool, the river wind and the fire and never to the basket, going around the seven places once and not twice, widest around the returning-line place, setting him under the roof and never in the Debt Loft with the fold right at his ear and under his chin and no second fold, and the widow’s mark not touched because the dark was not an opening and seven openings in seven months were seven and not a rule with no eighth made due (T058/T079/T100); no fire lit after dusk, the house sitting down into the dark holding its own shape the way a vessel holds what it has with a crack nobody mentioned, four low pulls under the floor and the silence where the fifth should have stood with nobody lifting the floor and nobody supplying the pull (T088); the yard’s neighbours making ready for the dark and passing the bell as four, four and a gap from mouth to mouth as a coal is passed in a dish, each house saying it had kept the count and none saying where the count began, no bell rung, the told bell kept in its square beside the bell heard from the Cross, four, four and a gap, its gap not folded into the fire’s four and a gap, the boards’ four and four and a thumb-width knot or the twelve arithmetics behind one unsigned figure and not made a seventh hearing or a fourth count, three counts in three places staying three because agreeing any two would want a payer put under both and none stood (T078, T061/T082); the stories of the Return going around among the seven places with gaps the shape of vessels’ intervals, a pause where a name should stand, a space where a counting should be, an interval that was not a hearing though it had the shape of one, a woman saying the count had stopped at four in her grandmother’s time and the fifth been left for the weather with a small intake before the word, a man whose voice had been at the well saying a name called from the Cross had gone on being a calling after the caller went away, neither with a figure or a source standing, the boy making no seventh hearing of any story and not laying a story’s gap across the told bell’s gap, the silence after Weighing’s name or his own kept spaces, for two gaps agreeing would want a payer put under both and none stood; \textbf{one neighbour telling of a whole return announced in a clean voice for somebody not in any room to hear it, the Cross’s grammar in his mouth and a temple’s clothes on his meaning, coming to the place where a name would stand and leaving it standing empty while nobody in the dark supplied it, his voice going quiet there with the exact weight of a thing set down and not picked up and then going around it as a man steps around a hole in a floor he has not been asked to mend, the boy putting that quiet on the gap tray beside the told bell’s gap, Weighing’s missing name, the crust’s two inches, the shelf’s two gaps, the gone pan’s round ring, the field’s empty place and the unfigured spaces with a finger between every pair and writing no payer over it and no cause across it, not letting it stand up as a witness, a reader, a payment or a doctrine, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood}; \textbf{the single present-tense break earned by the form of that announcement and untagged: *The page over the speakers says a name. The white room does not look up, and his hands stay in the field.* Then it was the Long Night under the Vail roof again and nothing had been paid, the form shown for two sentences and gone back into the mouth where it is kept, borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, the unsent call to Nina paid on Day 38 and expressly not paid again, and the boy bringing no other room across, for a man who brings a whole room across for two sentences will end by putting a payer under both lives and none stood under either (T020 not paid again)}; the bell told once more before the stories were done, four, four and a gap, the heard bell staying heard and the told staying told, the boy setting no hand to join the three counts; the keeping found where put and still a finding with thirteen findings standing and no fourth crust or second fold, Tarn’s loan uncalled at the very end of the seventh year with the Seed 16 breath unspent and Jorra’s promise neither given nor withdrawn though neither man came under the roof this night, the burned-slate word at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings with no witness, the well-saying at four shapings, nine record-first hands with no tenth and nine stoppings with no tenth, four rooms keeping the same gap with a finger between every pair and no Court room brought in as a fifth likeness, twelve arithmetics behind one unsigned figure with no signature and no doctrine and their twelve true subtractions locked in Berr Clay’s box up the clay road with the key gone up in a coat pocket, the Ash 5 joining and the Ash 17, Ash 23 and Stone 23 directions standing where put and not repeating and buying no lesson, no voice coming over the boards, and nothing opened, joined, named, called, paid, forgiven or ended; the file coming out on the towel at the head of the bed as instruments come out when a case is done with every gap left gap, the river keeping its note of water over water under its winter skin beyond the finger’s-width door and the note having done before any hand came down; the hand outside the wool coming up an inch toward the note, not reaching, taking a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holding the interval whole on the note’s own finishing under the covering, letting it go as the note ended and laying itself flat against the fold as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking, the letting-go neither early nor stayed and the hand not staying; answer 360 filed exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, laid across neither the twelve readings, the bell’s gap, the flat knock, the child’s grey fingertips, the mother’s cup, the covered grain, the handful, the thumb’s resting, the held breath, the two bites of iron, the river’s skin, the widow’s mark, the fourth direction nor the keeping at the fold, the surgeon’s small clean satisfaction in a field taken as found and left as found cost nothing and was not peace, the infant getting none of the three wants, and the count going on under the roof in Low Kiln, Sill, Grath, with the Remembering, the Last Day and Ilmen 1 of Y.H. 814 standing beyond the dark, unbrought, forward, not closed.}
\CRday{Day 393}{the Remembering, Y.H. 813, the fourth of the Five  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel in the small hours and again at the going of the light, then the nineteen steps down into the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the Vail corner with its clean dark line and finer grey called the thaw thickened in the dry cold with the faint sour tang of Ash, the yard well with the skinned trough and the silt-clouded plate on the flat stone, the drying racks and rack end with the dressed grain under wool, the worked strips with the field’s empty place and the returning-line place where the yard went widest, the kindling with the knife at its sill and Garl’s unforged collector sentence, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge, the cold damper, House Silt three doors down with the finger’s-width-open door, the pewter tin above the empty bed with its pale fold and thumb-bright lid, the finger’s-width door and the river under its winter skin, the Debt Loft (never entered), and the clay road, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the fourth of the Five came as weather comes, a holy day with a name and no tend-day and no market and no boundary drawn, with nothing from Kindling, Weighing or the Long Night crossing under the roof as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, the count going 392 to 393 exact, six months and 212 days becoming 213 told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid and Garl’s name unspoken 393 days with their payer and their man unnamed (T071/T072, T088), the body taken in the surgeon’s old order of stiff leathery brown-edged crust two inches off with its corner a hair off the wool, the empty place holding the fold found where put and not made again, the thread frozen in the dry heat and unwiped because nobody under any roof was ever given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a line written out for it, and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, a face composed by cold not composure and pink returning the surface still lying over a cold core, checked by the infant’s louder want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle with both true, the second louder and neither winning (T060/T086); Sella going to the hearth before the basket, telling the coals it was the thaw where another woman would have said I, turning them with the back of a broken pot, counting a small intake, a hold and a letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, her finger along the top of the loaf shelf so the charcoal stayed unread, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the clay jar under lead glaze with the sweetish edge coming and going on a wrong wind and her hand shut half over nothing, the twice-mended pot up thumb-first with the hairline showing between old brass and tighter wire and both proverbs to pot and fire and never to a person, the dressed grain turned under wool with no figure and no handful, the pot rim set two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, and the widow’s mark not touched, seven openings in seven months not a rule and no eighth made due on a holy day (T058/T079/T100); \textbf{the names of the dead going up the Clay Yard from door to door the way a coal goes in a dish from hearth to hearth, a woman saying one to a pail, a man to his latch, a girl to the dust, each house taking the sound and passing it on and keeping its own with nobody dating any of them, the boy counting the spaces between the sounds without knowing which were names and giving no interior to any voice, for a voice in a yard is a voice in a yard and not a room entered and a pause is not a person; one name going among them and not coming under the Vail roof — Dessa Silt’s, dead since the opening of the year and uncollected, carried by neighbours who had known her by sound and by the shape of a silence, never spoken to the boy and with no number given, the mercy-lie standing as a fact nobody under any roof could correct (T080/T090); Garl’s name unspoken its three hundred and ninety-third day and no whole return announced under this roof (T009/T013/T092)}; the clean voice’s missing name and the Long Night story’s empty name coming up on the gap tray beside the told bell’s gap with a finger between every pair, neither filled, neither made a witness, a reader, a payment or a doctrine, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood, the heard bell staying in its square beside the told, four, four and a gap, three counts in three places staying three and six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the Drawing’s flat knock outside (T061/T082, T078); \textbf{on an errand three doors down the pewter tin above the empty bed in House Silt seen from the basket’s low angle with its pale fold at the seam and its bright thumb-rub on the lid and not opened, the neighbour at her cloth not looking up at the writing or the tin, no name under the sieve-wire scar spoken, no number in a thumb given, the boy not turning the errand into a visit to a bank, not making a quest of the lid and not writing a cause across the fold, a thing left where it lies still kept and entered nowhere (T089, T008, T023/T020 held)}; at the well the day’s costs arriving as directions and going away as weather, a number brought up out of a fist toward the pail and put back in the sleeve so the figure arrived nowhere, a woman sent to the pot with the house has said it, another told to ask the weather where the cold had been bought, the boy filing the order of reaching as anatomy, hand to the record before eye to the person and mouth after both, nine record-first hands on nine trays with no tenth (T080/T090); the yard around its seven places once and not twice and widest around the returning-line place, the three coverings and the river’s skin entered nowhere and found where put, the keeping at the fold found where put and still a finding, not a habit, a way, a sign, a gift, a payment or a rule, no third crust and no second fold (T097/T060/T086, T083/T085, T098); answers 361 and 362 filed exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, the surgeon’s satisfaction in a field taken as found and left as found costing nothing and not peace, the infant getting none of the three wants, Tarn’s loan uncalled and Jorra’s promise ungiven, four rooms with the same gap held apart and no Court room brought in as a fifth, no ownerless voice over the boards, the four old directions standing where put and buying no lesson, and the count going on under the roof in Low Kiln, Sill, Grath, forward, not closed.}
\CRday{Day 394}{the Last Day, Y.H. 813, the fifth and last of the Five  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, loaf shelf and boards where the bread was baked and set to cool, the Vail corner with its clean dark line and finer grey called the thaw thickened in the dry cold with the faint sour tang of Ash where no broom had gone in two years, the skirting board with its unswept ridge, the towel at the bed head in the small hours, then the nineteen steps down into the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the returning-line place where the yard went widest, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the rack end with the gone pan’s round ring, the drying racks with the dressed grain under wool, the kindling with the knife at its sill, six pieces in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and the cold damper, the finger’s-width door and the river under its winter skin, and the clay road and Cold Acre as directions, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the fifth and last of the Five came with the same face it had worn coming in, a holy day with a name and no tend-day and no market, nothing from the Remembering crossing under the roof as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer and the Last Day not made a boundary or a payment, the count going 393 to 394 exact, six months and 213 days becoming 214 told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid and Garl’s name unspoken 394 days with their payer and their man unnamed (T071/T072, T088), the body taken again in the surgeon’s old order of leathery crust two inches off with its corner a hair off the wool, fold found where put and not made again, thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the knowing that a cold patient cannot clot and must be warmed slowly from outside, never hurried, never rubbed, checked by the infant’s louder want with both true and neither winning (T060/T086); Sella going to the hearth before the basket, telling the coals it was the thaw, neither gap figured, charcoal unread beneath her finger on top of the shelf, lips on a two-gapped row, one glance at the clay jar with the hand half over nothing, the widow’s mark not touched because a baking was not an opening and seven openings in seven months were seven and not a rule with no eighth made due (T058/T079/T100); \textbf{bread baked under the Vail roof with the dough worked and the loaves browned and set on the boards to cool with no figure and no handful, the loaf shelf keeping its two gaps and its unread charcoal and no third crust going into the fold; the grey at the Vail corner and along the skirting board left where it lay in the places the yard had left it, thickened in the dry cold with the faint sour tang coming up where no broom had gone in two years, Sella not sweeping it early while other houses swept, a neighbour with kindling and a woman turning a loaf calling it dealt with because it would be burnt in the morning, and Sella saying neither dealt with nor not, the boy keeping the called-gone grey and the left-in-place ridge on two places with a finger between and making no fourth likeness a cause, for a cause is an account that has found a payer and none stood (T009/T013/T092, T083/T085 advanced and NOT paid)}; the twice-mended pot up thumb-first with the hairline showing between old brass and tighter wire and both proverbs to pot and fire, repair kept apart from restoration, the dressed grain turned under wool with a touch lighter than a woman would use on a sleeping child, the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T077); \textbf{Tarn at the kindling with six pieces in the worn thumb-mark where the house could check and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged sentence, the stack keeping four, four and a space, the small knife at the very edge of its sill, his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, the coming away the whole of the checking, cutting, counting and spending nothing and saying to the wood Six counted. The next I don’t count, the ear-sentence brought all the way to the word that would call the loan and stopped there as a remembered ninth stopping with no tenth, no figure and no name, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the seventh year run to its very end and the term already ended, a term ending not a payment, a forgiveness or a freedom but leaving a man more exposed, the fear of being entered again for vagrancy still his without a figure and a want he did not voice for a slate with his own name on it and no mark against it, no look along the road, chest tight since the dark, Ash worked into the knuckle creases and the pale clip-ring at the left wrist giving back the little light, his stroke over the shallow bright flagstones without the half-check, the Ash 14 held breath and the Bone 26 thumb’s resting found where put and not made again, and Yes, house to the hare-carrier, the cracked-jar man, the kindling woman and the two fence-menders while keeping the late thaw because it puts off the paying (T036/T076/T006, T077, T061/T082)}; \textbf{Jorra through the finger’s-width door off the wheel-shed with meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal and white in a fist-crease, not the bone-coloured slip, three or more men unnamed gone low into the back room before first grey, dusty and clean forearms parted as clot from vessel, wheel and pot spoken to before any person, the full note known three turns ahead with air under it and a want in it and withheld from any High Kiln master who would call it early, his bent finger into the cold iron of the damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence and out without the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time, one iron with two bites the holding and the taking, He’s not Vail sealed as a lid nobody had tried to lift in three years and the promise under the wheel-shed neither given nor withdrawn (T062/T035/T031)}; the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings with one shaping and no witness, the well-saying at four shapings and the four Ash/Slate directions standing where put, none added to on a holy day and none buying a lesson, the Ash 5 joining and the Ash 17, Ash 23 and Stone 23 directions not repeating, no ownerless voice over the boards and no fifth shaping standing up out of the yard’s stories (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101); the seventh pull under the floor gathering toward a day when the Hearth would be named for what it is, a wound a district keeps warm and asks no question of the payer, but that day not come; the heard bell beside the told with three counts in three places staying three and six hearings beside and never among with the seventh place empty and the Drawing’s flat knock outside (T078, T061/T082); answers 363 and 364 filed exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, the surgeon’s satisfaction costing nothing and not peace, the infant getting none of the three wants, the loft scrape from above and behind going off without a figure, the keeping at the fold found where put and still a finding, the twelve arithmetics behind one unsigned figure, the loan uncalled at the very end of a term already ended and Jorra’s promise ungiven, and the count going on under the roof in Low Kiln, Sill, Grath, forward, not closed.}
\CRday{Day 395}{Ilmen 1, Y.H. 814, Firstday  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, loaf shelf, boards and towel in the small hours and again at the going of the light, the Vail corner with its clean dark line and finer grey called the thaw thickened in the dry cold with the faint sour tang of Ash where no broom had gone in two years, the place in the Clay Yard where the yard’s grey was swept into a low ridge along the wall, fed into a shallow heap on the bare clay and burnt with a coal so that a thread of smoke went up straight and then lay flat along the ground, the nineteen steps down and up at the half-pace from every open slate, the seven walked-around places with the returning-line place where the yard went widest, the lowest rack with its broken birth-slates, the gone pan’s round ring, the yard well with the skinned trough and the silt-clouded plate on the flat stone, the drying racks with the dressed grain under wool, the kindling with the knife at its sill and Garl’s unforged collector sentence, the flagstones, the finger’s-width door and the river under its winter skin, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  Ilmen 1 came on its own morning with the tend begun again as a fact of the Court’s counting and not an act of anybody under this roof, a Firstday on which the year turned with nothing signed, no boundary drawn on the floor and no signature standing on the space, nothing from the Last Day crossing under the roof as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, the count carried in exact at 394 into a morning that had not earned a figure, the year’s first arithmetic standing nine mornings off at Ilmen 10 and not brought in (T015/T041/T047 advanced and NOT paid), the count going 394 to 395 exact, six months and 214 days becoming 215 told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid and Garl’s name unspoken 395 days with their payer and their man unnamed (T071/T072, T088); the body taken in the surgeon’s old order at the coming and going of the light and in the small hours, crust gone harder in the dry heat with its corner a hair off the wool, fold found where put and not made again, thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the infant’s three wants quarrelling without verdict and getting none of the three (T060/T086, T097); \textbf{the yard burning the grey the Last Day had left in the corners and a neighbour calling it gone and dealt with while the woman with the rake noticed the ridge still lying along the Vail wall and said You’ll have that too, Widow, now the rest is up, Sella telling the broom where to stand and giving neither woman nor man an answer, and the boy keeping the neighbour’s called-gone grey on one place beside the left-in-place ridge at the Vail corner with a finger between, a thing called finished not finished for being called so and the Ash’s memory not spent, explained or promoted into a sign, the chart he had once signed saying a wound was closed when the surface had only come together over a cold cavity coming up without being asked and going back without a payer (T009/T013/T092, T083/T085)}; Sella’s grammar resumed as though nothing had turned, hearth before basket, coals told the thaw and turned with the broken pot’s back, neither gap figured, charcoal unread, lips on a two-gapped row, the clay jar glanced at with the hand half over nothing, the twice-mended pot up thumb-first with the hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, the dressed grain turned under wool with no figure and no handful and the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, the widow’s mark hanging where it hung and not touched because a burning and a Firstday were not openings and seven openings in seven months were seven and not a rule (T058/T079/T100, T077); the yard’s seven places gone around once and not twice and widest around the returning-line place, the three coverings and the river’s skin weather entered nowhere and found where put and not spent on the burning or the turning of a year (T009/T013/T092, T098, T083/T085); \textbf{the twelve arithmetics of Y.H. 813 carried across into Y.H. 814 unchanged behind one unsigned figure — the three of Frost, the first, second and third of Bone, the first, second and third of Ash and Stone’s first, second and last — twelve and not one account, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space and no doctrine out of twelve, their twelve true subtractions locked in Berr Clay’s box up the clay road with the key gone up in a coat pocket and no key in the boy’s hand, the reset supplying no payer to the old twelve or a new one, and the boy not laying his twelve old findings across a new figure to make a row come out even (T015/T041/T047 advanced and NOT paid)}; in the small hours the file coming out on the towel as instruments come out when a case is done, every gap left a gap — the crust’s gap, the shelf’s two gaps, the gone pan’s round ring, the field’s empty place, the keeping at the fold found where put and still a finding, the told bell’s gap, the silence after Weighing’s name, the place the Remembering did not fill, the neighbour’s called-gone grey and the left-in-place ridge on two places, Tarn’s stopped ear-sentence at the very end of a term already ended, Jorra’s promise under the wheel-shed neither given nor withdrawn and Garl’s unforged collector sentence beside the seventh notch — \textbf{nine record-first hands standing with no tenth} (Hessa’s eighth with her slate up the road unread, Ilva’s ninth with her strip in her sleeve, Berr’s twice-wiped thumb, the soft-cuffed clerk’s inward slate at the out-of-line landing, the Drawing collector’s ordinary hand, the Kindling collector’s ordinary hand with its belief that will one day be remembered against him, the neat dark hand, Marra’s and the finger beneath the shelf, the clean-voice speaker filed apart), nine stoppings with no tenth, six hearings with the seventh place empty and the Drawing’s flat knock outside, heard bell beside told with three counts in three places staying three, the burned slate at five, the shut-room tellings at two, the row at five askings with no witness, the well-saying at four shapings, the four Ash/Slate directions held apart, green a colour and the foundling a shape with no eighth, the cold foot uncured and the second chill’s cause withheld, the river under its skin beside water over water, four rooms with the same gap held apart and no Court room brought under the roof as a fifth, every one advanced and none paid, and no silences stood up together and called themselves a rule (T061/T082, T080/T090, T035/T031/T065/T095, T101, T050/T051, T033/T034, T081, T078); through the finger’s-width door the river keeping its note of water over water under the winter skin, a covering put on by the cold and taken off by the cold entered nowhere and not a hearing or a sign, the note having done before any hand in the room came down; the hand outside the wool coming up an inch toward the note, not reaching, taking a small intake from the room whose floor does not touch his, holding the interval whole on the note’s own finishing under the covering, letting it go as the note ended and coming straight down and laying itself flat against the fold on answer \textbf{366} as a man puts away a tool where the next hand will find it without looking, six honest answers standing on the sixth place from these three days and 366 since the first, not one a doctrine; the surgeon’s small clean satisfaction in a field taken as found and left as found costing nothing and not peace, the infant getting none of the three wants, nothing opened, joined, named, called, paid, forgiven or ended, the Opening of the Slates come and gone with a yard burning its grey and a household that said nothing and left no signature, and the count going on under the roof in Low Kiln, Sill, Grath, with Ilmen 10 nine mornings off, forward, not closed.}
\CRday{Day 396}{Ilmen 2, Y.H. 814, Secondday  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel in the small hours and again at the going of the light, the Vail corner with its clean dark line and finer grey called the thaw thickened in the dry cold with the faint sour tang of Ash, the finger’s-width door and the river under its winter skin, the nineteen steps down and up at the half-pace from every open slate, the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places widest around the returning-line place, the yard well where a pail was set where it always stood, the drying racks, the kindling with the knife at its sill, six pieces in the worn thumb-mark and the seventh at the lip beside Garl’s unforged collector sentence, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and the cold damper, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the first tend-day after the turned year came with the house back at its grammar as though nothing had turned, no slate opened within reach of the basket and no figure given for the boy, nothing from the Last Day or Ilmen 1 crossing as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, the count going 395 to 396 exact, six months and two hundred and fifteen days becoming two hundred and sixteen told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid and Garl’s name unspoken 396 days with their payer and their man unnamed (T071/T072, T088), the body taken in the surgeon’s old order of stiff leathery brown-edged crust two inches off with its corner a hair off the wool, the empty place holding the fold found where put and still a finding, thread frozen and unwiped because nobody was ever given an instruction about the thread, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint as at the end of a written line and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the knowing that a face composed by cold is not composure and that a cold patient cannot clot checked by the infant’s louder want of the crust lifted, the thread wiped and a hand on the pot handle with both true, neither winning and the quarrel the work (T060/T086); Sella going to the hearth before the basket at both ends of the day, telling the coals it was the thaw, turning them with the back of a broken pot, counting intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, keeping her finger above the unread charcoal and her lips on a two-gapped row, glancing once at the clay jar under lead glaze with her hand shut half over nothing and the little-door burn closing on air, lifting the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the hairline showing between old-brass staple and tighter wire and both proverbs to pot and fire, turning the dressed grain under wool with no figure or handful and setting the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T058/T079/T100, T077), the widow’s mark untouched because a morning, a shelf and a basket were not openings and seven openings in seven months were seven and not a rule with no eighth made due; twelve arithmetics of Y.H. 813 carried across into Y.H. 814 unchanged behind one unsigned figure, twelve and not one account, the figure read still not the figure paid, no signature on the space and no doctrine out of twelve, their twelve true subtractions locked in Berr Clay’s box up the clay road with the key gone up in a coat pocket that never comes back down and the boy with no key, the reset supplying no payer and Ilmen 10 standing eight mornings off unbrought (T015/T041/T047); the yard going around its seven walked-around places with a look and a wide step and no number, once and not twice, widest around the returning-line place where a hand went in on Seed 15 and did not come out, the three coverings and the river’s skin found where put and unspent, the keeping at the fold found where put and still a finding (T098, T083/T085, T097); at the kindling Tarn standing at the very end of a term already ended with six pieces where the house could check and the seventh at the lip where a hand could take it, the knife at the very edge of its sill and his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, telling the wood \emph{Six counted. The next I don’t count}, cutting, counting and spending nothing, the ear-sentence stopping at the word that would call the loan, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled and the term ended leaving him more exposed than it found him, the fear of vagrancy and the unvoiced want of a slate with his own name and no mark against it still his, his chest tight since the dark, Ash worked into his knuckle creases, the pale clip-ring at his left wrist giving back the little light and his stroke over the bright flagstones without the half-check (T036/T076/T006); Jorra parting dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, men unnamed gone low into the back room before first grey, speaking to the wheel and a pot before any person, withholding the full note he knew three turns ahead from any High Kiln master who would call it early, and putting his bent finger into the cold damper ahead of Sella’s unfinished sentence and taking it out without the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time, the iron’s two bites read as one clamp that holds and stops flow, \emph{He’s not Vail} sealed and the promise under the wheel-shed neither given nor withdrawn (T062/T035/T031); answers 367 and 368 filed exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, a restraint and not a payment borrowing no house count and supplying no payer, six honest answers standing on the sixth place and not one a doctrine, the surgeon’s satisfaction in a field taken as found and left as found costing nothing and therefore not peace (T071/T072), nothing opened, joined, named, called, paid, forgiven or ended and the house going on as a house goes when a pot is set down in its place and the fire kept, forward.}
\CRday{Day 397}{Ilmen 3, Y.H. 814, Thirdday  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot and the cold clay jar beyond it under lead glaze, boards and towel in the small hours and again at the going of the light, the boards and the wrong wind off High Kiln, the nineteen steps down and up at the half-pace from every open slate, the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well where a number rose out of a fist and went back into a sleeve, the drying racks, the kindling with the knife at its sill and the seventh piece at the lip, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the Vail wheel-shed edge and the cold damper, the clay road with a glaze-hand come down from High Kiln and a runner gone up before noon, the out-of-line landing below the north bridge named in report only, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the third came on a second ordinary tend-day with nothing from Ilmen 2 crossing as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, the count going 396 to 397 exact, six months and two hundred and sixteen days becoming two hundred and seventeen told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid and Garl’s name unspoken 397 days with their payer and their man unnamed (T071/T072, T088), the body taken again in the surgeon’s old order with the crust two inches off and its corner hair-lifted, the fold found where put and still a finding, thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and wrist and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the infant’s three wants quarrelling without verdict, both true, the second louder, neither winning (T060/T086); Sella keeping the whole hearth grammar beat for beat, fire before basket, coals told the thaw, intake, hold and letting-go toward no opening with neither gap figured, charcoal unread, lips on a two-gapped row, dressed grain covered under wool with no figure or handful, twice-mended pot thumb-first with hairline showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, widow’s mark untouched (T058/T079/T100, T077); a wrong wind off High Kiln bringing the sweet edge of lead glaze over the boards and past the pot board where the jar stood cold, Sella’s hand going toward it and shutting half over nothing with the little-door burn closing on air, and the boy filing the edge as weather and gave it no source, for a source is an account that has found a payer and none stood; a glaze-hand come down the clay road standing at the well with the sweetish green of tasted lead glaze at one corner of his mouth, wiping the back of his wrist and saying to the weather about the pots \emph{They’ll take a glaze this weather if you let them}, then going off toward the racks with the green still there, the boy filing the green as a colour on a place of its own beside Berr Clay’s green and the greens at past markets, with a finger between every pair, no eighth, no name, no hearing, no cause and no woman named under the roof (T050/T051); costs coming to the yard as directions and going away as weather, a number out of a fist toward the pail arriving nowhere and going back into a sleeve, a woman with clay pale in her nail crescents sent to the pot with \emph{the house has said it} and the pot saying nothing, the order of reaching filed as anatomy with no tenth hand made of any of them (T077, T080); word coming up the yard before noon that a runner had gone up the clay road with the writing turned to her own sleeve and unread, a reported shape and no sighting, Hessa’s eighth staying eighth and she not made a reader, Ilva’s strip staying in her sleeve with the count kept in wood and her ninth staying ninth, Berr’s twelve true subtractions staying locked in his box with the key gone up in a coat pocket and the boy having no key (T080, T015/T041/T047); the three coverings, the river’s winter skin, the called-gone grey beside the left-in-place ridge, the four rooms with the same gap held apart, the six hearings with the seventh place empty and the Drawing’s knock outside, the heard bell beside the told with three counts in three places, the cold foot uncured and the second chill’s cause withheld all found where put and unspent (T083/T085, T009/T013/T092, T081, T061/T082, T078, T012/T093/T094/T096); in the afternoon the chapter’s one meaningful change planted and NOT paid: word coming up the yard from a neighbour come up from below the north bridge that the soft-cuffed clerk was still set at the out-of-line landing with his slate turned inward for a measure nobody had called, cuff soft from washing and folded back twice and gone grey, hand to the slate before eyes to the landing, calling nothing and writing no name, a reported shape seen by nobody under the roof and made no witness and the landing not named a door; the boy filing the order of reaching on a place of its own with nine hands staying nine and the clerk’s reported hand on the ninth tray, the clean-voice speaker not made a tenth, and Tarn’s head going a degree toward the landing and back to the broom without a word, taking up the broom only after it had been given its instruction and going on over the flagstones without another turn, the first movement joining an ended term and a valuable ear to the people who would measure it, held as a shape on its own place and not repeated as a habit or a rule, not a payment, hearing, seventh, calling of the loan, tenth stopping, argument or danger come due, nobody arrested or called and no slate opened within reach of the basket (T090/T080, T036/T076/T006); Jorra again parting dusty from clean forearms, men unnamed going low into the back room before first grey, the full note known three turns ahead and withheld, the damper’s two bites and Ash 26 not repeated, the promise under the wheel-shed ungiven and \emph{he’s not Vail} sealed (T062/T035/T031); the burned slate at five, shut-room tellings at two, row at five askings with no witness, well-saying at four shapings and four Ash and Slate directions held apart and not repeated (T035/T031/T065/T095, T101); answers 369 and 370 filed exact, complete, worth nothing at two inches of air, six honest answers on the sixth place and not one a doctrine, the surgeon’s cheap satisfaction not peace, the creek’s low note finishing under its winter skin on its own finishing before the hand came down, the count at 397 exact and Ilmen 10 seven mornings off unbrought, nothing opened, joined, named, called, paid, forgiven or ended and the house going on as a house goes when a pot is set down in its place and the fire kept, forward.}

stood at the very end of a term already ended with six where the house could check and the seventh at the lip, his hand over blade and sill and away with no breath held at the top of the reach, \emph{Six counted. The next I don’t count}, the ear-sentence stopping at the word that would call the loan, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled and a term ending leaving a man more exposed than it found him; Jorra came through the finger’s-width door with meal-fine grey slate dust white in a fist-crease, parted dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel, spoke to the wheel before any person and took the cold out of the damper’s two bites without leaving the extra holding of Ash 26 a second time, the promise under the wheel-shed neither given nor withdrawn; the twelve arithmetics of Y.H. 813 stood unchanged behind one unsigned figure with no key to Berr’s box and Ilmen 10 five mornings off unbrought, answers 373 and 374 were filed exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air, six honest answers standing on the sixth place and not one a doctrine, and nothing opened, joined, named, called, paid, forgiven or ended, the house going on as a house goes when a pot is set down in its place and the fire kept, forward.}
\CRday{Day 400}{Ilmen 6, Y.H. 814, Sixthday  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, boards and towel in the small hours and again at the going of the light, the room off the Vail wheel-shed with its finger’s width of open and its low voices (a direction and dust only, no interior entered), the yard’s edge where a man from Slate Row stood with his hands loose, the nineteen steps down and up at the half-pace from every open slate, the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places widest around the returning-line place, the yard well, the drying racks with the lowest rack and its broken birth-slates, the kindling with the knife at its sill and the seventh piece at the lip, the flagstones with the shallow bright patch, the cold damper, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the sixth came on another ordinary tend-day with no market, Cross or bell, no collector up or down the clay road, no runner seen, no ownerless voice over the boards and none of the four old directions repeating, nothing from Ilmen 5 crossing as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, the count going 399 to 400 exact, six months and two hundred and nineteen days becoming two hundred and twenty told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid and Garl’s name unspoken 400 days with their payer and their man unnamed, the body taken again in the old order with the surgeon’s knowing checked by the infant’s three wants, both true, the second louder, neither winning; before first grey three or more men unnamed went low into the back room off the wheel-shed, keeping its finger’s width of open and its sound of low voices, and Sella gave them no name and did not say the room was cold; Jorra came through the finger’s-width door with the day’s meal-fine grey slate dust ground small as meal and white in a fist-crease where a hand had opened, not the bone-coloured slip of the wheel, parted dusty forearms from clean as clot from vessel and asked neither which slate had been broken nor whether it was a birth-slate while the broken ones under the lowest rack stayed entered by nobody; then, from the basket’s low angle as Sella went wide around the seven walked-around places once and not twice, \textbf{the chapter’s one meaningful change, planted and NOT paid:} a man from Slate Row whose name was on no roll stood at the yard’s edge with his hands loose, the soft hands of a man who sits at a table and the patient face of a man who can wait in a doorway, and nobody asked him what he wanted and he did not say, no loaf passing, no slate shown, no word carrying, no figure read and no threshold crossed; the boy read him as a man standing where no work was going on, gave him no interior, no name and no diagnosis, filed his face on a place of its own beside the older record-first hands without making a tenth of it or a sale of the waiting or a witness of the men, and kept the face, Jorra’s ungiven promise and Tarn’s held degree on three places with a finger between, not laid together to make a cause, for a doctrine is an account that has found a payer and none stood; Tarn’s hand went over blade and sill and away again with no breath held and he did not turn his head toward the landing, the degree of Ilmen 3 held as a shape and not repeated, while Jorra withheld the full note he knew three turns ahead and left the extra holding of Ash 26 in the cold damper unspent; Sella kept the hearth grammar beat for beat at both ends of the day, and answers 375 and 376 were filed exact and worth nothing at two inches of air, six honest answers standing on the sixth place and not one a doctrine, nothing opened, joined, named, called, paid, forgiven or ended, the face at the edge going on gathering interest without being called and the house going on, forward.}
\CRday{Day 401}{Ilmen 7, Y.H. 814, Seventhday  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, loaf shelf with its loaves pushed along and the unnamed space at the row’s end, boards and towel in the small hours and again at the going of the light, the clay jar cold under lead glaze beyond the board, the Vail corner with its clean dark line and finer grey called the thaw thickened in the dry cold with the faint sour tang of Ash, the finger’s-width door and the river under its winter skin, the nineteen steps down and up at the half-pace from every open slate, the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places, the yard well, the drying racks with dressed grain under wool, the kindling with Garl’s unforged collector sentence beside the seventh notch, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and the cold damper with Tarn and Jorra offstage, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the seventh came as an ordinary tend-day closing the new year’s first working week, with no market, Cross or bell, no collector on the clay road, no runner on any road, no ownerless voice over the boards and none of the four directions repeating, nothing from Ilmen 6 crossing as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer and the man at the edge not brought under the roof as a lesson, the house keeping its days badly in loaves pushed along a shelf, glances at the clay jar and a space at the row’s end nobody called a number while the boy kept four hundred and one exact against it and did not stand the number up as a threshold, a doctrine or a figure, the count going 400 to 401 exact, six months and two hundred and twenty days becoming two hundred and twenty-one told by nobody, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid and Garl’s name unspoken 401 days with their payer and their man unnamed and the two silences standing side by side without becoming one; the body was taken in the old order with crust, fold found where put, thread frozen and unwiped, cold at cheek, temple and wrist and the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody would perform, the surgeon’s rewarming he would choose and could not ask for checked by the infant’s three wants, both true, the second louder, neither winning; Sella came to the hearth before the basket, told the coals it was the thaw and that they would want more come the drying, kept the charcoal unread and her lips on a two-gapped row, shut her hand half over nothing at the clay jar, lifted the twice-mended pot thumb-first with the crack showing and both proverbs to pot and fire, turned the dressed grain under wool with a touch lighter than a woman would use on a sleeping child and \emph{Lie down. You’ll keep better there}, and set the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed, the widow’s mark untouched and no eighth opening made due; the twelve arithmetics stood behind one unsigned figure with the printed one in twelve unchallenged and no key to Berr’s box, Ilmen 10 standing three mornings off with the year’s first arithmetic waiting there as a reset and not a signing and not brought into a day that had not earned it, the nine record-first hands and nine stoppings unchanged with no tenth, six hearings with the seventh place empty and the Drawing’s knock outside, the heard bell beside the told with three counts in three places staying three, four rooms held apart, the river’s note under its winter skin ending on its own finishing before any hand came down, and Tarn’s ended term, Jorra’s ungiven promise, the clerk’s inward slate and the face at the edge each on a place of its own with a finger between; at the going of the light the towel came out as instruments come out when a case is done and the field was gone over by the place of each thing with every gap left a gap, the hand outside the wool coming up an inch toward the note (the inch not a reach), taking a small intake, holding the interval on the note’s finishing and laying itself flat against the fold without wiping the thread or lifting the crust, answers 377 and 378 filed exact and worth nothing at two inches of air, six honest answers 373 through 378 on the sixth place and not one a doctrine, the surgeon’s satisfaction in a field taken as found and left as found costing nothing and therefore not peace, the infant getting none of its three wants, and nothing opened, joined, named, called, paid, forgiven or ended, the house going on as a house goes when a pot is set down in its place and the fire kept, forward.}

\CRday{Day 404}{Ilmen 10, Y.H. 814, Tenthday, the first Account-day and market of Y.H. 814  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof in the small hours before first light and again at the close at the hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, loaf shelf, rack end with the dressed grain under wool, bed, boards and towel, down the nineteen steps at the half-pace from every open slate and across to the Cross, the reading block under the moot-post with its finger’s width of thin shade where no slate lay, the market pot board with a silent woman turning a cup a quarter, the market’s edge with a small shape in cast-offs catching light on a green sliver, the clay road up toward High Kiln, the out-of-line landing below the north bridge (reported, not witnessed), the road toward Greybank, the watch, and the Clay Yard with its seven walked-around places widest around the returning-line place, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the year’s first Account-day and market came on in the dark before first light, earned by its own morning with nothing from Ilmen 8 or 9 crossing as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer and no tend-day set against a holy day, the count going 403 to 404 exact, six months and two hundred and twenty-three becoming two hundred and twenty-four days told by nobody, answers 383 and 384 entered on the sixth place, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 404 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, Sella setting the basket in the moot-post’s shade with no slate under it and standing half a pace off through the reading and the bell, saying nothing of it to the basket, Berr Clay coming up short off the clay road with the red wool cord folded under his coat, the sweetish green of tasted lead glaze at one mouth-corner and the smell of nothing at all, wiping his thumb twice before touching nothing, holding the narrow slate unopened to his forearm and passing a finger over the figure through his sleeve, reading \emph{One in twelve, as the notice says} low and sending it twice over the basket, once for the moot and once for the households that came late, calling the levy and denying it with \emph{your house}, never I, taking himself out of his own sentence as a surgeon draws a hand from a field before the dressing goes on, sending a man with a number in a shut fist to a slate at the watch so the number went from fist to mouth to shoulder and arrived nowhere, saying something low to the block about kindness being entered with no anger and no triumph, and going off up the road with the box locked believing he had done a kindness, the boy taking the reading apart as a surgeon takes a field apart and filing it as the first of Y.H. 814 and not a thirteenth, one reading and not an account, a reset not a signing, no payer, no signature, no doctrine, the figure read still not the figure paid, and twelve old findings not laid across the new figure to make a row come out even, for paper is not a payer, Berr’s low saying going on a place of its own with a finger between it and both the twelve findings and the new figure, the bell going four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself, Hessa Rale going up the road before noon toward Greybank with the narrow slate edge-on to her forearm and the writing turned to her sleeve, giving no figure and not made a reader by the carrying, her eighth hand staying eighth and joined to none, the soft-cuffed clerk reported at the out-of-line landing with his slate inward for a measure nobody called, the green at the pot board and the shape at the market’s edge kept as sightings with no eighth of either, no loaf, slate or sale passing between them, the arithmetic read that morning over grain covered at home not knowing what it cost and the space between figure and price having no signature, Sella carrying him home at the going of the light saying nothing of what was read over the wicker, turning the dressed grain under wool with a touch lighter than a woman would use on a sleeping child, setting the pot rim two inches beyond the reaching hand, keeping the charcoal unread and the widow’s mark untouched, and in the small hours the hand coming up an inch on the river’s note’s own finishing under the winter skin and coming down flat on the fold on answer 384, the district’s arithmetic begun again and cannot be undone with nobody in the square addressing the boy it would carry, nothing opened, joined, named, called, paid, forgiven or ended, the first arithmetic up the road in the locked box with no key in his hand, and Ilmen 20 (Day 414) standing ten mornings off unbrought (T015/T041/T047, T071/T072, T088, T077, T080, T050/T051, T061/T082, T058/T079/T100)}

\CRday{Day 406}{Ilmen 12, Y.H. 814, Secondday  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot and the cold clay jar beyond it under lead glaze, rack end with dressed grain under wool, boards and towel in the small hours and again at the close, the yard well with its stone lip and bucket-round and the flat stone by the well with a cup’s pale round place, the trough, the Vail corner with its clean dark line and finer grey called the thaw thickened in the dry cold with the sour tang of Ash, the seven walked-around places and the field’s empty place out on the worked strips, the kindling with the knife at its sill, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge and cold damper, the finger’s-width door and the river under its winter skin, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the twelfth came as an ordinary tend-day with no market, Cross or bell, no collector on the clay road, no runner on any road, no ownerless voice over the boards and none of the four directions repeating, nothing from Ilmen 11 crossing as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer, the count going 405 to 406 exact, six months and two hundred and twenty-five becoming two hundred and twenty-six days told by nobody, answers 387 and 388 entered on the sixth place, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid 406 days with its payer unnamed and Garl’s name unspoken the same number, the crust gone harder again through the dry nights and past the point where a child would still eat it, the fold found where put, the thread stiff and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint, the Afterdrop waiting, and the basket set level out of the draught read as the careful rewarming he would choose and could not ask for; in the afternoon, among the bucket-round at the well where Ilva drew with the pail against her knee and clay pale in her nail crescents and rack dust in one thumb seam, one neighbour said that the woman who carries the slate had once carried a figure that named a person she knew, and the boy filed it as a fifth shaping of the well-saying on a tray of its own with a finger between it and Hessa Rale’s eighth record-first hand, another between it and the Cross-to-Greybank road saying and a third between it and the four ownerless directions, expressly not a witness, a confession, a reader made or a sixth shaping, with no owner, name, figure, date or hand at a slate and nobody to ask; Ilva’s hand went to her sleeve before her eyes went to the asker and her mouth after both, the notched strip stayed unread in its fold with no figure coming off the wood, she answered the question put and not the one behind it --- \emph{Ask the pot what it cost. I keep the count, not the account} --- her ninth hand stayed nine and she was expressly not the speaker of the well-saying; the fifth shaping was not laid across Tarn’s ended term, the degree, Jorra’s promise, the face at the edge or the arithmetic gone up the road, and no sixth came due by the day’s quiet; Sella kept the whole hearth grammar at the going of the light and carried him up the nineteen steps, Tarn kept six and the seventh without a look along the road and let the well-word come to no cause at the kindling, and Jorra gave it no nod and the runner no name while the burned slate stood at five and the four directions apart and unspent; in the small hours the fifth shaping sat on its own tray between the eighth hand and the road saying, the hand came down on answer 388, nothing was opened, joined, named, called, paid, forgiven or ended, and Ilmen 20 stood beyond a day that had earned only its twelfth (T080 advanced NOT paid, T071/T072, T060/T086, T097, T058/T079/T100, T077, T036/T076/T006, T062/T035/T031/T065/T095, T009/T013/T092, T088)}

the fifth shaping of the well-saying found where put and not repeated, named, made due or joined to the face, the clerk’s inward slate, Tarn’s degree, Jorra’s promise or the four directions, Ilva’s strip unread in her sleeve offstage and the man from Slate Row’s face filed and not counted among the nine hands; \CRday{Day 414}{Ilmen 20, Y.H. 814, Tenthday, the month’s second Account-day and market  —  under the Vail kiln-house roof in the small hours at the bed, loaf shelf’s low angle, hearth, pot board with the twice-mended pot, rack end with dressed grain under wool, boards and towel, then down the nineteen steps at the half-pace from every open slate and across to the Cross, the reading block under the moot-post and its finger’s width of shade where no slate lay, the market pot board where a silent woman turned a cup a quarter with the sweetish green at one mouth-corner, the market’s edge where a small shape in cast-offs caught light on a green sliver, the clay road up toward High Kiln, the out-of-line landing below the north bridge (reported, never entered), the road toward Greybank, the watch, and back under the roof at the going of the light, Low Kiln, Sill, Grath  —  the twentieth came in the dark before first light earned by its own morning with nothing from the nineteenth crossing as sign, lesson, mending, cause, payment or payer and Ilmen 30 standing eight mornings off as a date, the count going 413 to 414 exact, six months and two hundred and thirty-three becoming two hundred and thirty-four days told by nobody, answers 403 and 404 entered on the sixth place, the carried fire’s fifth unpaid and Garl’s name unspoken 414 days with their payer and their man unnamed, the crust gone leathery past the point where a child would still eat it with its corner a hair off the wool, the keeping at the fold found where put and still a finding, the thread frozen and unwiped, cold stopping at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint and the afterdrop waiting, the surgeon’s knowing checked by the infant’s three wants with both true, the second louder, neither winning; Sella setting the basket in the moot-post’s shade where no slate lay and standing half a pace off through the reading and the bell, saying nothing to the basket, the widow’s mark untouched because a market and a reading are not openings; Berr Clay coming up short off the clay road with the red wool cord of his office folded square under his coat, the sweetish green of tasted glaze at one mouth-corner and the smell of nothing at all under the hot clay of him, wiping his thumb twice before touching nothing, holding the narrow slate unopened to his forearm, passing a finger over the figure through his sleeve, reading One in twelve, as the notice says low and twice over the basket once for the moot and once for the late households, calling the levy and denying it with your house never I as a surgeon draws a hand from a field before the dressing, sending a man’s number from a shut fist to a slate at the watch where it went from fist to mouth to shoulder and arrived nowhere, saying something low to the block about kindness being entered with no anger, no triumph and no payer, and going off up the road with the box locked and the second true subtraction of the month inside believing he had done a kindness; eight pigs going over the wet boards with no figure called, figures brought to a heap of turnips and left side by side without being made to agree, the bell going four, four and a gap with nobody crossing himself, Hessa Rale going up the clay road before noon with the narrow slate edge-on to her forearm and the writing to her sleeve, unread and not made a reader by a second figure, her eighth hand eight, the soft-cuffed clerk reported below the north bridge with his inward slate and his figure entered before a face was looked at still on a place of its own, the green at the pot board and the shape at the market’s edge sightings with no eighth; the boy filing two readings of the year behind one unsigned figure, two and not one account, the first not a thirteenth, the second supplying no signature, the figure read still not the figure paid, twelve old arithmetics not laid across two new ones to make a row come out even because paper is not a payer and the key went up a coat pocket that never comes back down, every kept thing advanced and not paid, nothing opened, joined, named, called, paid, forgiven or ended, the house going on as a house goes when a pot is set down in its place and the fire kept (T071/T072, T015/T041/T047 advanced NOT paid, T080/T090, T058/T079/T100, T060/T086/T097, T078, T061/T082, T088, T098)}
